## REQ-816 — End's question on the customer's demo pill opens inside the window (demo-loop cycle dm1, M1)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle dm1 (run r83b6287b), issue **M1** "Customer cannot confirm or dismiss the End question: pill grows rightward, buttons open off-screen (desktop and 390px, EN/ES)" — RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD (at cbcae62d).
**Cause (RCA):** the customer pill is anchored `left:12px` + `translate(dock)` (DemoModeOverlay.tsx), so it only grows right. REQ-781 added right-edge places: a peek from the right-edge mini-pill sits flush right at the width at rest (`view.w − restWidth`), as do the bottom-right / top-right `pillSpots`. The mini-pill's × (`demo-pill-tab-end`) opens the pill with End already asking (EndDemo `askAtOnce`), ~250 px wider (657–671 px at 1280; 366 px and two rows on a 390 phone), and REQ-300's freeze (`place()` returns while `[data-cy=demo-end-ask]` is up) kept the narrow pill's left — demo 3 saw the pill at x 875, w 657 (right edge 1532 on 1280); demo 4's phone x 113, w 366 (right edge 479 on 390).
**Requirement:** when End's question comes up on the customer's pill, the pill is placed once at its asking size, before paint, so its right edge is at most `view.w − PILL_MARGIN` and its top under the top margin (`keepInView` in shared/demo-mode/pill.ts); only then does REQ-300's freeze hold it still. A pill that already fits does not move (a left-edge peek stays flush). Covers a peek from the right-edge tab, the bottom-right / top-right spots and the phone's wrapped compact pill. The peek box itself is now the shared `peekBox` (same rule as before). The placePill fallback is untouched.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-in-view.test.ts` ("REQ-816 …": right-edge tab at 1280×800, rest 405 → peek at 875 (the bug) and asking 657 → `left + width ≤ view.w − margin` with the foot kept; rest 444 / asking 671; phone 390×844 asking 366×74 → left 12; bottom-right and top-right spots grown to asking size stay inside; a fitting pill does not move; the overlay re-places in a `useLayoutEffect` on `[asking]` with `keepInView` and uses `peekBox`).
- integration: n/a — front-end placement only; no endpoint, store or message changed.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-end-ask-right-edge.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-816 … [en]" and "[es]": a super admin opens a demo; the customer's page is covered with text and a control down its left side so the pill folds on the RIGHT edge; at 1280×800 and at 390×844 a click on `demo-pill-tab-end` brings the question up with the pill, question, Yes and Keep going inside the window (right ≤ vw − 12), and a real click on "Yes, end it" / "Sí, terminar" ends the demo — `demo-ended` shows, "You ended the demo" in EN).
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm1-pill-ask-offscreen off origin/demo-fixes cbcae62d):**

## REQ-817 — The stage names the customer by the name they save mid-demo, never their phone or a '+' tag (demo-loop cycle dm1, issue m3)
**Source:** Raphael, "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm1 (run r83b6287b), issue m3 ("Stage keeps naming the customer by phone number (and a '+' cursor tag) after they gave a name"). RCA (analyst + skeptic, UPHELD, at cbcae62d): GET /demo-mode/active recomputes `targetName` on every call (REQ-355: the phone only while the name is the sign-in placeholder), but the stage asked it only while the customer's app was NOT connected (`DemoStage.tsx` effect 1), and when it did ask, `sameDemo` compared only `id` + `presenters` (d7459350), so a fresh answer carrying the new name was kept as "the same demo". The pill, the banners and the customer's cursor (`<DemoPointer name>`) read that frozen name; the cursor's resting tag (`tagLabel`) took the first character of each word — '+' for "+15125550402". The customer's overlay had the same `sameDemo`, so its tab carry (`pm:demo-pill`) kept the phone too.
**Requirement:** Once the customer saves a name during a demo, the stage's pill, banners and the customer's cursor show it — with no reload of either side — and the customer's carried demo holds it. A name with no letters (an unnamed customer's phone) rests on its last two digits, never '+'.
**Decisions:**
- `sameDemo` moves to `shared/demo-mode/stage-frame.ts` and compares `targetName` and `presenterName` as well as `id` + `presenters`; the stage and the customer's overlay both use it (a poll's echo still does not re-render; the link effects are keyed on `demo.id`, so a name change does not reconnect).
- The stage keeps asking /active while the customer's app is connected, every `ACTIVE_NAME_REFRESH_MS` (15 s, `shared/demo-mode/protocol.ts`; `activeAskDelay`), and asks at once whenever the customer's next page joins (`onPeerOnline`) — a name saved in onboarding or Settings followed by a page load shows within a second, one saved with no navigation within 15 s.
- `tagLabel` / `initialOf` take the first LETTER of each word (`initialsOf`); a name with no letters gives its last two digits; neither → '' (tag) / '?' (off-screen initial).
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-stage-name-refresh.test.ts` ("REQ-817 …": `sameDemo` with a `targetName` change / a `presenterName` change is not the same demo, the echo is; `activeAskDelay` and `ACTIVE_NAME_REFRESH_MS`; `tagLabel("+15125550402", true)` → "02", `initialOf` → "02"; wiring — both islands import the shared `sameDemo`, the stage re-arms with `activeAskDelay(peerOnlineRef.current)` and asks on `onPeerOnline`).
- integration: `backend/src/demo-mode/entrypoints/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-817 (cycle dm1, m3) a customer who saves a name mid-demo: the presenter's next /active names them by it…") — pins the contract the stage reads; the backend was already right, so this one is green before and after (no server change).

## REQ-812 — The demo stage page speaks the presenter's language from the shell down: <html lang>, boot language and tab title, not only the pill (demo-loop dm1, p2)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm1 (run r83b6287b), issue **p2** "Second demo's stage page is half Spanish (html lang, title) and half English (pill)", RCA CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD at cbcae62d.
**Cause (RCA):** `/demo/stage` resolved the PRESENTER's language (REQ-341) only for its own DocTitle and the DemoStage island, never onto `ctx.state.lang`. Under impersonation `ctx.state.user` is the customer, so the app shell's `resolveSsrLang` fell through to the customer's language — Spanish once they switched in demo 1 — giving `<html lang="es">`, `window.__PM_LANG="es"` and `<HtmlLang initial="es">`, whose on-mount title heal (REQ-709) rewrote the English "Demo mode · DocuMonster" to "Modo demo · DocuMonster" while the pill stayed English.
**Requirement:** On every `/demo/*` page the language is the presenter's (whoami's impersonator; the signed-in person's when not impersonating): `front-end/routes/demo/_middleware.ts` sets `ctx.state.lang = await presenterLangForRequest(ctx.req, user)` after `loadUser`, and `routes/demo/stage.tsx` reads `ctx.state.lang` (one whoami per request). `<html lang>`, the boot language, HtmlLang's mount, the route DocTitle and DemoStage all agree; the title stays "Demo mode · DocuMonster" after HtmlLang mounts for an English presenter guiding a Spanish customer.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-stage-shell-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-812 …": the middleware sets `ctx.state.lang` from `presenterLangForRequest(ctx.req, user)` before `ctx.next()`; the stage reads `ctx.state.lang` and no longer calls the resolver; the shell resolves `state.lang` first into `<html lang>`, `bootLangScript`, `HtmlLang initial`). Amended (pinned the old call site, each says REQ-812): `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-lang.test.ts`, `jest/unit/demo-stage-chrome.test.ts`, `jest/unit/person-lang.test.ts`.
- integration: `front-end/lib/demo-stage-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-812 …": the real /demo middleware + real `_app.tsx` shell + real `/demo/stage` page in a Fresh App, backend answered in process — customer es + presenter en → `<html lang="en">`, title "Demo mode · DocuMonster", `window.__PM_LANG="en"`; customer en + presenter es → Spanish throughout; no impersonation → the person's own es; no session → 302 /).
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-presenter-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-812 (cycle dm1, p2): …" — customer profile es, Hans en; Hans opens the demo; after hydration `<html lang>` is "en", `document.title` stays "Demo mode · DocuMonster", the pill reads "Demo mode").

## REQ-815 — The stage's out-of-view ghost chevron sits where the customer's chevron does (demo dm1 p4)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm1 (run r83b6287b), issue p4 "Pointer name tags and off-screen chevron positioned and styled differently on stage vs customer" (fleet-2/stdout:80: "ghost svg left:5 top:8 vs customer off-mark left:-7 top:2").
**Cause (RCA, confirmed by the skeptic, at cbcae62d):** the customer's DemoPointer placed the cue chevron with `offMark(pointer, cue.box)` (against the edge it is off, centred on the tip: left -7, top 2 for an element above), while the stage's PointerGhost (07f2e1dc, REQ-645) hard-coded it in the middle of the arrow box (`(ARROW_W-OFF_MARK_PX)/2`, `(ARROW_H-OFF_MARK_PX)/2` = 5, 8) — 12 px right and 6 px lower from the same reported tip. The placed report carries only the tip and the way (`p`, `d`), never the customer's box, so the stage could not run `offMark`. A second source of drift: `offMark` re-derived the way from the tip's position in the box (`offEdge`), so an element straight above with the tip on the scroller's left edge read as up-left on the customer and up on the stage.
**Requirement:** the out-of-view chevron's offset in the arrow box comes from one shared helper that needs only the way to the element, `cueMarkOffset(dir)` (shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts): per axis, ±1 → against that edge (OFF_MARK_INSET in), 0 → centred on the tip (-OFF_MARK_PX/2); turned to point that way. DemoPointer's cue branch and PointerGhost both use it; the cue carries its `dir` (DemoModeOverlay and DemoStage pass `p.dir`), the same way the report's `d` carries. The off-the-screen marker (`off`, REQ-451/635) keeps `offMark`. The tag wording ("You"/"Tú" on the stage vs the presenter's initial on the customer) is unchanged — owner design (REQ-642/REQ-633).
**Tests:**
- unit: `front-end/lib/demo-chevron-offset-shared.test.tsx` ("REQ-815 (demo dm1 p4) …": DemoPointer with a cue and PointerGhost with a dir, rendered for the same tip and way — above (the tester's case), below, right, left, up-left, above with the tip on the left edge — draw the chevron svg at equal left/top/turn; `cueMarkOffset` values for up/down/right/left).
- integration: same file, "REQ-815 … round trip": the customer's `placeView` → `placedReport` → the stage's `reportedGhost` → both components land the chevron on the same pixel (±0.5 px from the report's 4-decimal fraction). No server change.
- e2e: n/a — the two components' chevron boxes are compared from their real render; the browser lane was not to be run for this fix.
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm1-chevron-offset-shared off origin/demo-fixes cbcae62d):**
- RED (helper added, components untouched): `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/demo-chevron-offset-shared.test.tsx` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 7 failed"; e.g. above: "Actual left: 5, top: 8 / Expected left: -7, top: 2"; tip on the left edge: ghost 5/8 vs customer 2/2.
- GREEN: same file → "ok | 8 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A lib/demo-*.test.tsx` → "ok | 48 passed | 0 failed"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-` → "Test Suites: 63 passed · Tests: 765 passed". `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched files; `deno fmt` on the touched files (all clean at the base).

## REQ-814 — On a phone, an out-of-view anchor's chevron and cue are never drawn over the sticky topbar (demo-loop dm1, m7)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm1 (run r83b6287b), issue m7 "On phone, off-screen chevron and scroll cue drawn over the sticky topbar" (fleet-2/stdout:63: `translate(87.486px, 0px)`, off-mark at 80,2, cue at 117,4, all over HEADER.topbar sticky 0–91). Amends REQ-645 rule 3 (c4-M6).
**Cause (RCA, confirmed by analyst + skeptic at cbcae62d):** `visibleBox` (shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts) judged sticky/fixed bars against the box already narrowed by clipping ancestors. Settings' "Account" h3 sits in an `overflow:hidden` `.panel`; scrolled fully above the view, the panel collapsed the box to top 0 / height ≤ 0, so the full-screen-layer guard `r.height * 2 >= bottom - top` skipped the 91 px topbar → `{left:16, top:0, width:358, height:0}` and placeView put the chevron at y=0. Same for any clipped panel showing less than twice the bar's height. The stage's `clipOf` (front-end/lib/demo-mode/mirror-replay.ts) calls the same function.
**Requirement:** a bar is judged against the screen (its height against the screen's; its width against the scroller-cut outer box, or the clipped box) and cuts both boxes. When the clipping ancestors leave nothing, the box is the outer one — the screen cut by the bars and the scroll containers only — never top 0 with no height. The stage picks it up through `clipOf`.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pointer-identity.test.ts` ("REQ-814 visibleBox (dm1 m7): the target's overflow:hidden panel scrolled fully above the view …" → `{left:0, top:91, width:390, height:713}`, placeView y=91 pointing up; "REQ-814 visibleBox (dm1 m7): the panel partly visible but less than twice the topbar's height …" → `{left:16, top:91, width:358, height:59}`).
- integration: n/a — a pure geometry function in shared/, no endpoint or store.
- e2e: n/a — the browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the unit tree reproduces the tester's measured numbers exactly (87.486, 0) and the next demo cycle re-checks it live.
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm1-visiblebox-bar-clip off origin/demo-fixes cbcae62d):** RED — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pointer-identity -t REQ-814` → "Tests: 2 failed" (Expected: 91, Received: 0; height 150 / top 0 instead of 59 / 91). GREEN — the same file "Tests: 51 passed, 51 total"; every jest unit suite touching presenter-anchor / mirror-replay / DemoModeOverlay / visibleBox → "Test Suites: 53 passed · Tests: 698 passed". `deno lint`, `deno check` (presenter-anchor.ts, mirror-replay.ts, DemoModeOverlay.tsx) and `deno fmt --check` on the two touched code files clean.

## REQ-838 — The stage never flashes "Waiting for {name}'s app…" at a customer's page change and draws nothing of a signed-out customer's screen; its copy of the customer's pill speaks only the customer's language; the customer's pill says "{name} stepped away" — never "is guiding you · Connecting…" — while the presenter has left the stage (demo-loop cycle dm2, issues m5 + p4 + p8)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57 on demo-fixes `27db8c23`, the second run, after cycle dm1's REQ-812..824), Demo-mode-only test, five testers. Issue `m5` — "Every page change flashes a "waiting for the app" state on the stage, with a mixed EN/ES pill copy" (demo 2: "for 0.1–0.4 s the chip reads "Esperando la app de Maria Lopez…""; the stage's copy of the English customer's pill read "Demo mode DocuMonster is guiding you Conectando… End demo"). Issue `p4` — "While the customer is signed out, the stage still draws a pill ghost and pointer advice the customer doesn't have" (demo 4: the ghost "Modo demo DocuMonster te está guiando Connecting… Terminar demo" over the signed-out banner, the "You" arrow still drawn; demo 5: "Tu puntero no está en la pantalla de Maria Lopez — muévelo para mostrarlo"). Issue `p8` — "The customer pill says "is guiding you · Connecting…" while the presenter has left the stage" (demo 1: the staff browser went to /admin; "Demo mode | Alex is guiding you | Connecting… | End demo"). RCA (workflow wf_2c0fbfcf-083, analyst + skeptic, at demo-fixes `27db8c23`): m5 LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH; p4 CONFIRMED, UPHELD, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION; p8 CONFIRMED, UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH. Two of these are dm1 fixes that did not reach far enough: REQ-823 held a "closing" page only while another tab was open, and its `signedOut` changed only the banner.
**Cause (RCA):** (m5, the flash) An address-bar navigation, `page.goto` or the browser's reload button fires no Navigation API `navigate`, so the leaving page says "closing" (leave-hint.ts). In `transport.ts` `tabLeft`, the last tab closing called `endGrace()` (REQ-391 m21: a closed tab is "waiting" at once), so the stage showed the "Esperando la app de {name}…" chip and banner until the next page's socket joined. REQ-823's SILENT_GRACE_MS hold applied only while another tab was open. (m5 + p4, the mixed language) On a drop (`pillFaceOffline`) and when the next page joined (`pillFaceAwaiting`), the stage rewrote the face and dropped `label`, the customer's own status word (REQ-430). `ghostWords` then fell back to the stage's dictionary: the customer's title, line and End beside the presenter's "Conectando…" / "Connecting…". (p4) REQ-823 set `signedOut` but changed only the banner. `pillShown` was `look.elsewhere ? null : pillBox`, and the overlay sends `r:null` only from an effect cleanup, which a full-page sign-out redirect never runs. The pointer-absent badge was gated on neither signedOut nor waiting. His "You" marker and arrow ghost stayed drawn. (p8) The customer's pill had three status words. The transport's "waiting" (socket open, no stage) fell through to "Connecting…" (REQ-232, `1701c3a1`), and the line "{name} is guiding you" ignored the status. So "the presenter left" and "the socket is opening" looked the same.
**Requirement:**
1. (m5) The presenter's link holds the customer's last tab whose page went "closing" the way it holds one that went without a word: "between" (the stage's "Loading their next page…") for SILENT_GRACE_MS, then "waiting" if no page of that browser tab came. A next page with the same tab key, or an older page that says none, is followed, and the stage is Live again. Only a sign-out is "waiting" at once (REQ-823 M2).
2. (m5 + p4) The customer's pill sends its own words, in its face, for what the stage guesses on its own: `connectingLabel` ("Connecting…") and `endedLabel` ("The demo ended"), in the customer's language. They are checked and capped like the label (PILL_LABEL_MAX). When the stage rewrites the face — `pillFaceOffline` (their app dropped) or `pillFaceAwaiting` (their next page joined) — it says the status in those words. A face already in that status keeps its own label. The stage's dictionary (`ghostWords` → `statusKeyOf`) is used only for a page that sent no word.
3. (p8) While its link is up and no stage is (transport "waiting"), the customer's pill says "{name} stepped away" ("{names} stepped away"; es "{name} se ausentó" / "{names} se ausentaron"). The line "The demo is still open" ("La demo sigue abierta") replaces "{name} is guiding you", and it never says "Connecting…" then. "Connecting…" is kept for a link that is opening, joining or lost. The compact pill adds no "● {name}" beside a status that names him. The status rides to the stage as `away` (PillStatus, REQ-372). The stage's own word for it is "Stepped away" / "Se ausentó" (`demoMode.away`), which names nobody. With the presenter back on the stage, the pill says "Connected" and "{name} is guiding you" again.
4. (p8) The customer's link says "waiting" only once it can know nobody is there. Before its welcome, and for JOIN_GRACE_MS (2 s) after it with no stage heard, it is still "connecting": the welcome lists this hub's stages, and stages on other hubs answer its arrival through KV a moment later. A stage heard ends the join at once, and a lost socket joins afresh. So a customer's page change never flashes "{name} stepped away".
5. (p4) While the customer is signed out, the stage draws nothing of the screen they no longer have. No copy of their pill, open or tucked (`pillShown` is null). None of his pointer: no "You" marker, no arrow ghost. No "Your pointer isn't on {name}'s screen — move to show it", neither while signed out nor while their app is gone (`look.waiting`). The banner and chip still say "{name} signed out".
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-status-words.test.ts` (21 tests, each named "REQ-838 …"). The only tab closing (keyed or not) is "between", then live on its next page. A real close is "between" until SILENT_GRACE_MS, then "waiting", long before PRESENCE_GRACE_MS; signout is "waiting" at once. The customer's link is "connecting" before its welcome and through JOIN_GRACE_MS, "waiting" after, "relay" through a stage's leave grace, and joins afresh after a lost socket. The `pillStatusOf` table; `away` on the wire and `statusKeyOf("away")`; the en + es words; the overlay's wiring. `pillFaceOffline` / `pillFaceAwaiting` say the customer's word, never the stage's "Conectando…", and a face already in the guessed state keeps its own. The words ride the wire capped, junk dropped; overlay → sendPill → the stage's faceOf carry them. The signed-out gating of pillShown, the pointer-absent badge, the "You" marker and the arrow ghost.
- unit, amended: `jest/unit/demo-stage-live.test.ts` (REQ-391: closing is "between", then "waiting" after SILENT_GRACE_MS) · `jest/unit/demo-stage-tab-leave-follow.test.ts` (REQ-823: the only tab closing gives ["between", "relay"]) · `jest/unit/demo-stage-replaced-labels.test.ts` (REQ-646: pillShown is null while elsewhere or signed out).
- integration: n/a — no server change. The hub, the backend and the server side of the wire are untouched: the face's two optional words and `away` pass through the hub inside the pill message. The backend `src/demo-mode/` tests stay green.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-status-words.e2e.test.ts`. "REQ-838 m5 …": an English customer and a Spanish stage; `page.goto`, then a reload, in her only tab. The stage says "Cargando su siguiente página…", never "Esperando…" at once or inside the hold, its copy of her pill never says "Conectando…" / "Conectado", and it ends "En vivo". "REQ-838 p4 …": the pointer-absent badge is up, then she signs out from the sidebar. The stage says "Ana Torres signed out"; then no pill ghost, no pointer-absent badge, and no "You" marker even after he moves over the frame. "REQ-838 p8 …": Hans goes to /admin. Her pill says "Hans stepped away", data-status "away", the line "The demo is still open", never "Connecting…". Hans comes back: "Connected" and "Hans is guiding you".
- e2e, amended: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-live.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-391 m21: a closed tab is "Waiting…" within CLOSE_NOTICED_MS = 3.5 s — SILENT_GRACE_MS plus the poll, still short of the 5 s grace).
**Evidence (2026-11-15/16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-pill-status-words, branch fix/cdm2-pill-status-words off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):** RED first. jest `npx jest unit/demo-pill-status-words.test.ts unit/demo-stage-live.test.ts unit/demo-stage-tab-leave-follow.test.ts unit/demo-stage-replaced-labels.test.ts --selectProjects unit` gave "Test Suites: 4 failed, 4 total · Tests: 20 failed, 61 passed, 81 total". ## REQ-835 — End's open question: the stage's ghost is the customer's real pill box and wraps like it; a resize keeps the asking pill inside the window (demo-loop cycle dm2, m2 + M2) — REQ-816 / REQ-228 / REQ-822 AMENDMENT
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issues **m2** "The stage's copy of the customer's open End question uses an old position, so it is clipped at the frame edge. It is also drawn as one row with no wrapping." and **M2** "Customer's open End question pill moves off-screen when the window narrows (no resize clamp, REQ-228)". Both BUG_CONTRADICTION, RCA CONFIRMED and skeptic UPHELD at 27db8c23. A dm1 fix that did not hold: REQ-816 said "the stage's ghost follows the move", and REQ-228's tests promise "clamping after a resize".
**Cause (RCA):** (m2) `sendPill` (DemoModeOverlay.tsx) took the position from `atRef` (left/top) and the size from a live `offsetWidth/offsetHeight`. `atRef` is written only by `place()`, and `place()` returns early while `[data-cy=demo-end-ask]` is up (REQ-300 / REQ-822). REQ-816's layout effect moved the pill with `setDock` and never updated `atRef`. So the stage got the OLD left/top (the peek from the right-edge mini-pill: 818) with the NEW width (771): 818..1589, which `pillGhost` cut at the frame edge with "…". On a 390 phone the old compact top plus the new ~111 px height ran past the bottom. Separately, the ghost body in DemoStage.tsx was always `white-space:nowrap` with no flex-wrap, and its text spans used `flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0`, so they shrank to 13-17 px. (M2) The REQ-816 clamp ran only when `[asking]` changed, and every re-place path (resize, the 700 ms interval, scroll, the ResizeObserver) went through the frozen `place()`. A window narrowed to 390 kept the 1280 translate, so the pill ended up at x 611 → 977.
**Requirement:** While End asks, the customer's pill is kept inside the window on every re-place, not only when the question opens. One `clampAsk` (shared `askDock`: anchored at left PILL_MARGIN plus its foot, then `keepInView`) runs from the `[asking]` layout effect (again one frame later, after a compact switch), from `place()`'s asking branch (resize, interval, scroll, ResizeObserver) and from a frame after `onResize`. It moves the pill only when it would be off-screen, so REQ-300 still holds: a pill that fits keeps its dock. It writes `atRef` from the box it fits. The rect sent to the stage is the pill's REAL box: `getBoundingClientRect()` less the part of the glide still to go (`pillRestBox`, `translateOf` of the computed transform). It is sent again when the glide ends (`transitionend`). The folded tab still sends its tab box. The face carries `wraps` (the customer's `pillWraps({compact, open, asking})`). When it is set, the stage's ghost wraps into rows with normal white-space, its words are never squeezed to slivers, and End's question takes a row of its own with the answers under it (`ghostFlow`). Otherwise the ghost stays one row, cut with an ellipsis.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-geometry.test.ts` ("REQ-835 …"). Opened from the right-edge peek (818 at 1280, asking 771 px), the rect sent equals the laid-out bounding box both mid-glide and at rest, and not the old 818..1589. On a 390 phone the taller wrapped pill is sent at its real top. Asking plus a resize from 1280 to 390 (dock x 599, 366 px wide, 611 → 977) gives a right edge ≤ 390 − 12. A pill that fits keeps the same dock object (REQ-300). `translateOf` handles none / matrix / matrix3d. `wraps` survives the wire and junk is dropped, and a wraps flip with the question shows at once. `ghostFlow` wraps vs one row. Wiring: sendPill uses getBoundingClientRect + pillRestBox and the transitionend re-send; clampAsk is run by the layout effect, place()'s asking branch and onResize; the face carries `wraps: pillWraps(...)`; the stage's ghost uses `ghostFlow(pillFace.wraps === true)`. Amended neighbours: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-in-view.test.ts` (REQ-816: the effect runs `clampAsk`, which measures and calls `askDock`) and `jest/unit/demo-stage-pill-asking.test.ts` (REQ-822: place()'s asking branch may run `clampAsk()` before `sendPill()`).
- integration: n/a. This is front-end placement and the face on the existing peer link only; no endpoint, store or server message changed.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-ghost-ask-geometry.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-835 …"). A super admin opens a demo on a 1280×800 customer, and her page leaves the pill only its right-edge mini-pill. Its × brings the question up, the pill is inside the window, and the stage's ghost, converted to customer px through the frame's scale, is her pill's box (± 3 px), uncut, with the question. Her window then narrows to 390×844 with the question still up. Her pill is pulled back inside (right ≤ 378), the ghost is her pill's box again, and the ghost wraps (flex-wrap: wrap, more than one row, Yes under the question) as her pill does.
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-end-ask-pill-geometry off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):**
- RED first. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pill-ask-geometry` → "Tests: 10 failed, 10 total" (`askDock` / `translateOf` / `ghostFlow` is not a function, and the wiring is absent). The e2e on the unfixed base (a detached worktree at 27db8c23 with only the story copied in) → "✗ REQ-835 … timed out: desktop: the stage's ghost is the customer's pill box, uncut — {"customer":{"left":421,"right":1268,"top":749,"bottom":792},"ghost":{"screenW":1280,"left":782,"top":749,"right":1280,"bottom":792,"clipped":true,…,"wrap":"nowrap"}}", which is the reported clip at the frame edge.
- GREEN. The same jest run → "Tests: 10 passed, 10 total". `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo` → "Test Suites: 74 passed, 74 total · Tests: 890 passed, 890 total". `SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-ghost-ask-geometry.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-835 … 103.6s" (and again in a 4-story run: "✓ REQ-835 … 89.2s"). Neighbours: "✓ REQ-548", "✓ REQ-816 [en]", "✓ REQ-822", and "✓ REQ-816 [es]" when run alone. Under host load ~80-116, two earlier runs lost a shots auto-screenshot ("Protocol error (Page.captureScreenshot)" / "page.screenshot: Timeout 90000ms") on the Demo click's navigation, before any assertion. That happened on the base too.
- `deno lint` and `deno check` are clean on DemoModeOverlay.tsx, DemoStage.tsx, pill.ts and protocol.ts. `deno fmt` ran on every touched file (all were fmt-clean at the base) and on the new tests.
## REQ-827 — The stage shows when the customer has a native date picker or file chooser open: a "Choosing a date…" / "Customer is choosing a file…" chip under the field (demo-loop cycle dm2, issue s1)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue **s1** "Native select/date/file popups not visible on either side - claimed headless limit". RCA FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD, judge MISSING_IN_FLOW, at 27db8c23.
**Cause (RCA):** three cases. (1) Native select: REQ-638 already draws the open list on the stage from a DOM mousedown (headless too); the testers set values with `browser_select_option` (no mousedown) and never looked for the drawn list — a tester-prompt gap, no app change. (2) Native date/time pickers and (3) the OS file chooser are drawn outside the DOM and neither `mirror-record.ts` (OPEN_ATTR only for selects; "file" only in NO_VALUE) nor `mirror-replay.ts` (no date/file/picker handling) handled them: with a real customer the stage showed nothing while she chose a date or a file (SettingsPage, ReportsPage, WorkOrdersPage, FieldTasksPage, TimesheetPage, WorkerScreen all carry such inputs).
**Requirement:**
- The recorder marks `data-mirror-open` (REQ-638's OPEN_ATTR) on an `input[type=date|time|datetime-local|month|week]` (not disabled or readonly) from a primary mousedown on it or a click that reaches it (a label click; WorkerScreen's `showPicker()` runs from that click), and on F4 / Alt+Arrow; it is cleared on change, blur, Escape/Enter/Tab, a mousedown elsewhere or the input leaving the page.
- It marks an `input[type=file]` (not disabled) from the click that opens the chooser (a label or a script's `.click()` reach it too); cleared on change, `cancel`, the window getting its focus back, a mousedown elsewhere or the input leaving the page — never on the blur the dialog itself causes.
- The stage's replayer draws its own chip (`data-mirror-picker="date"|"file"`, `aria-hidden`, `pointer-events:none`, never a mirrored node) under the marked input — under its nearest ancestor with a box when the input has none (a hidden file input inside its label button) — reading "Choosing a date…" / "Customer is choosing a file…" in the presenter's language (`demoMode.pickerDate`, `demoMode.pickerFile`, en + es; DemoStage passes them through the replayer's `pickerLabel`). The OS dialog itself is never mirrored.
- The tester prompt (`demo-loop/demo5.sh`) tells the testers to open a select with a real `browser_click` (not `browser_select_option`) and check the stage frame for the REQ-638 list, and that date/file pickers show as a chip on the stage.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-mirror-picker-open.test.ts` ("REQ-827 …": recorder → JSON → replayer on the fake DOM — date mousedown/click/keys open the chip, change/blur/Escape/mousedown-elsewhere close it, time/datetime-local/month too, disabled/readonly/text inputs never; file click opens, change/cancel/window focus close, its own blur does not; a hidden file input's chip sits under its label; the label comes from `pickerLabel`; the page's own attribute never crosses; en/es keys present).
- integration: n/a — front-end only (recorder → replayer on one page, no endpoint or store); the unit test runs the real recorder into the real replayer through a JSON round trip.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-picker-open.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-827 (cycle dm2, s1): …" — in real Chromium, the real recorder streams into the real replayer's sandboxed frame: clicking a date input draws the "Choosing a date…" chip under it on the stage within 1 s, a value closes it; clicking a file input's label draws "Customer is choosing a file…", setting the file closes it).
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-mirror-date-file-pickers off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23, host load 90–120):**
- RED first. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-mirror-picker-open` → "Tests: 14 failed, 3 passed, 17 total" (no chip, no mark; the 3 passing are the never-open guards). e2e with the base recorder/replayer: `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-picker-open.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-827 … expected {"text":"Choosing a date…","visible":true,"under":true}, got "null"".
- GREEN. The unit file → "Tests: 17 passed, 17 total"; every demo/mirror jest suite (`--testPathPattern 'demo-|mirror'`) → "Test Suites: 530 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 5400 passed". e2e → "✓ REQ-827 (cycle dm2, s1) … 0.7s — rc 0". In the same batch REQ-638's select story passed. Its send-menu story timed out on `page.screenshot` (90 s at load 123), a load problem unrelated to this change. `deno lint` and `deno check` (mirror-record.ts, mirror-replay.ts, DemoStage.tsx) are clean, and `deno fmt --check` is clean on the touched and new files.
- Tester prompt: `demo-loop/demo5.sh` (outside git) got a "Native pickers (REQ-638, REQ-827)" line: use a real browser_click on a select (not browser_select_option), check the stage for `[data-mirror-listbox]`, and check `[data-mirror-picker]` chips for date/file inputs. The native calendar and OS dialog are never visible headless.
- `showPicker()` called outside a click is not hooked: the recorder does not patch the page's prototypes. The app's one call (WorkerScreen's date pick) runs from a click, and that click opens the mark.
## REQ-837 — The presenter's name tag sits on the same side on the stage as on the customer's screen, and the stage shows the customer's "is pointing below — scroll ↓" words for an out-of-view anchor (demo-loop cycle dm2, m3 + p3)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issues **m3** "Presenter's name tag is placed and worded differently on the stage (fixed 'Tú' bottom-right) and on the customer's screen (moving 'A'/'D' initial)" (fleet-1/stdout:69: customer tag "D" at 99,192 above the arrow vs stage "Tú" at 121,253; fleet-2/stdout:67 case (c): the "A" tag at 114,711 over the sidebar's "Add a worker" → "Add a w[A]ker") and **p3** "Stage shows only the chevron (and 'Tú') for an out-of-view anchor, not the customer's 'X is pointing below — scroll ↓' cue words". Both are dm1 re-check NOT_FIXED halves: REQ-815 aligned only the chevron's offset.
**Cause (RCA, analyst + skeptic UPHELD, at 27db8c23):** (m3) OwnMarker (front-end/components/demo-mode/OwnPointer.tsx:52-54) pinned its tag at `left:${w + 2}px;top:${h - 4}px` (+18.8,+17) with no placement call, while the customer's DemoPointer places its tag on every painted frame with `tagPlacement` + `coverage` (above / below / right). The customer's placed report (`placedReport`, shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts:655-674) carried only `p`, `o`, `d`, so the stage could not copy the tag's side. (m3c) `contentAt` scores text 1 and only another control 3; a sidebar link's label under the tag scored as plain text and could win as the least-covered spot. (p3) PointerGhost rendered only the chevron and `label` for `dir`, and DemoStage.tsx:961 sent colleagues' cues with `text: ""` (REQ-645 had specified only the chevron for the stage).
**Requirement:**
1. The customer's report carries where its tag went: `t: {s: side, x, y, w, h}` — the tag's top-left relative to the arrow's box and its size, as fractions of their viewport (`placedReport(…, tag)`; DemoPointer's `placeTag` returns the placement, `onTag` tells PeerPointer → DemoModeOverlay, which reports again when the tag moves). `samePlaced` compares `t`; `parsePlaced` keeps a well-formed `t` (known side, each in [-1, 1]) and drops a malformed one without dropping the report.
2. The stage reads it for the anchor he holds (`reportedTag`, scaled to the fitted frame; a report of another anchor keeps the tag drawn) and OwnMarker and PointerGhost draw their tag there, keeping the edge that faces the arrow (`alignTag`). With no `t`, OwnMarker places its tag as DemoPointer does (`tagPlacement` with `coverage` of the page, inside the frame) — never the fixed +18,+17. The tag's words stay "You"/"Tú" (owner design, REQ-642).
3. A label inside a sidebar or nav (`nav, aside, [role=navigation]`) counts as a control in `coverage`, even the label of the link the arrow is on, so the tag is steered off it when another spot exists.
4. Out of view, PointerGhost carries the customer's words: DemoStage passes `cueText = t(cueKey(dir), {name})` (the presenter's name from the roster, as the customer's overlay names him; the stage's language — the stage is not told the customer's) and `cueBox = visOnStage(anchor)`; the ghost renders "Tú · {name} is pointing below — scroll ↓" (`demo-pointer-ghost-cue`) placed with `tagPlacement` inside that box. Colleagues' out-of-view pointers on the stage get the same words instead of `""`.
**Tests:**
- unit: `front-end/lib/demo-stage-pointer-tag.test.tsx` ("REQ-837 (demo dm2 m3) unit: …" — `placedReport` carries `t` as fractions; the reporter re-sends when only the tag moved; the wire keeps a good `t` and drops an unknown side; `placeTag` returns its placement; OwnMarker draws its tag above when the report says above; OwnMarker with no report places with `tagPlacement` + covers and moves off a covered tail; PointerGhost draws its tag at the reported placement; "(demo dm2 p3) unit": PointerGhost with `dir` + `cueText` renders "Tú · DocuMonster is pointing below — scroll ↓" inside `cueBox`; "(demo dm2 m3c) unit": a nav label scores as a control in `coverage`).
- integration: same file — "(demo dm2 m3) integration": customer tag above → `placedReport` → JSON → `parsePeerMessage` → `reportedTag` on a half-size frame → `alignTag` → OwnMarker draws its tag "above", bottoms aligned; a report of another anchor keeps the drawn tag. "(demo dm2 p3) integration": DemoStage passes PointerGhost `cueText`/`tag`, words cues with `cueKey`, and no longer sends `text: ""` for colleagues.
- e2e: n/a — the demo loop does not run the browser lane per fix; the two components' tags are compared from their real render and the report's real wire round trip, and the next demo cycle re-checks it live.
**Not reproduced live:** sub-point (c) was not reproduced on a live /dashboard (it needs a two-browser demo session); the fix is the RCA's "steer away from sidebar/nav labels" rule, proven at the `coverage` level only.
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-stage-pointer-tag off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):**
- RED (exports stubbed so each test reports on its own): `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/demo-stage-pointer-tag.test.tsx` → all 11 FAILED, e.g. "placeTag returns the placement", OwnMarker "Values are not equal" (no data-tag-side / fixed spot), PointerGhost side "tail" vs "right", "the cue words are drawn", nav label score 9 vs 27, DemoStage "a colleague's out-of-view pointer still gets an empty cue text".
- GREEN: same file → "ok | 11 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A --no-check lib/demo-*.test.tsx components/demo-mode/` → "ok | 63 passed | 0 failed"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-` → "Test Suites: 73 passed · Tests: 880 passed". `deno fmt --check`, `deno lint`, `deno check` clean on every touched file.

## REQ-832 — Under an open dialog the customer's demo pill is placed against the page beneath the backdrop, so it never lands on the sidebar's Log out (demo-loop cycle dm2, p1)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue p1 "Customer pill/folded chip covers page content (composer, headings, footer, Log out) - re-check 9 NOT_FIXED". Demo 5 (fleet-4 stdout:85): with the send dialog open at 1280×800 the pill "jumps to the bottom-left and EXPANDS over Log out" — REQ-818's "never Log out" did not hold under a dialog.
**Cause (RCA, analyst + skeptic CORRECTED, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION, at 27db8c23):** the overlay's counters `pageAt` and `countControls` (front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx) asked only the TOPMOST element at each sample point. Under a dialog that is its full-screen backdrop (static/assistant-page.css: `position:fixed; inset:0; background rgba(20,44,48,.45)`), painted but with areaFrac 1.0 ≥ PAGE_BACKDROP_AREA, so `countsAsPage` is false and it is no control. Every spot outside the dialog's panel read clear, `dockPill` returned home, and `placePill`'s dialog branch kept the whole pill at the bottom-left over `.nav-item--logout`. The rest of p1 (demos 1, 3, 4: the pill over a composer frame, settings text, footer text) is REQ-781/818's chosen rule — covering text is allowed — and demo 2 (stays expanded after "Keep going") is REQ-820's hover hold; neither is changed here.
**Requirement:** while a dialog is up, every spot the pill may take is judged against what the customer would see under it: the dialog's own layer as before (its panel and controls), and beneath the backdrop the page's controls (the backdrop and the boxes that hold it skipped — `pastBackdrop` in shared/demo-mode/pill.ts, used by the overlay's `hitAt` for `pageAt`, `pageUnder`, `countControls` and the peek's `peekBox`). So the pill docks home only when no control lies beneath it there, else above the dialog's box, top-left, top-right, else folds to the mini-pill spot with the fewest controls — never over Log out because the dim hid it. Text and cards beneath the dim may still be covered (REQ-818). With no dialog up, nothing changes.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-dialog-backdrop.test.ts` ("REQ-832 …": `pastBackdrop` takes the dialog's layer as is, skips the backdrop and its holders to reach Log out beneath (`under: true`), returns the topmost with no backdrop; the send dialog open at 1280×800 with Log out at 16,742 → `placePill` puts the pill off Log out and off the panel, with no control under it; the overlay's `pageAt`/`countControls` go through `hitAt` → `pastBackdrop` and the placement hands them the backdrop). `demo-pill-no-gap` and `demo-pill-control-fallback` wiring regexes accept the backdrop-bound closure.
- integration: n/a — front-end placement only: no endpoint, store or projection changed.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-dialog-backdrop.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-832 …": a real demo on /customers at 1280×800, a send-like dialog opened (fixed inset:0 rgba dim, a centred role=dialog panel): the pill, whole or folded, overlaps neither `.nav-item--logout` nor the panel, still so 2 s later).
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-pill-dialog-backdrop off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):**
- RED first. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pill-dialog-backdrop` → "Tests: 5 failed, 5 total" ("TypeError: (0 , pill_ts_1.pastBackdrop) is not a function"; the wiring case "Expected pattern: /pastBackdrop\(/"). e2e with pill.ts + DemoModeOverlay.tsx at HEAD: `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-dialog-backdrop.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-832 … expectation failed: send dialog open: the pill ([12,749,536,792], tucked false) is not over Log out ([16,742,212,784]) — got {"overLogout":true,"overPanel":false}" (demo 5's exact symptom).
- GREEN. jest unit `--testPathPattern demo` → "Test Suites: 74 passed · Tests: 885 passed". e2e `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-dialog-backdrop.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✓ REQ-832 … 111s" (the pill docks just above the dialog's panel, REQ-637). Neighbours: `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-logout.e2e.test.ts e2e/demo-mode/demo-dialog-dim-stage.e2e.test.ts` → "✓ REQ-818 … 228.3s", "✓ REQ-765 … 136.2s".

## REQ-228 AMENDMENT — the headline "never cover the page" is retired in favour of REQ-781/REQ-818: the customer's pill stays off CONTROLS; covering text and cards stays allowed (demo-loop cycle dm2, p1) — FLAGGED FOR THE OWNER
**Source:** demo-loop cycle dm2, issue p1 (re-check 9 NOT_FIXED); the RCA and the judge found requirements.md saying both "REQ-228 — The demo pills never cover the page" and REQ-818's "Covering text and changing corners between pages stay allowed (REQ-781)". REQ-228's own body already scoped it to controls ("sits where no link, button, field or other control of the page is under it"); only its heading promised more.
**Amendment:** REQ-228's rule is "never cover a CONTROL of the page" (REQ-781, REQ-818, and REQ-832 under a dialog); text, cards and a composer's frame may be under the floating pill or its mini-pill. **Owner decision pending:** Raphael may instead restore a no-cover rule — the chip and the whole pill scored by `pageUnder` (text and cards counted) before controls — which would make demos 1, 3 and 4 of p1 bugs again.
**Tests:** no tests — docs only.
## REQ-836 — A name the customer saves reaches the demo stage at once (pushed, not polled), and until then the stage writes their phone as the app does, never a '+' string (demo-loop cycle dm2, issue m1; AMENDMENT of REQ-817's 15 s decision)
**Source:** Raphael, "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue m1 "Stage names the customer by raw phone number until well after the name is saved (REQ-817 re-check NOT_FIXED)". RCA (analyst + skeptic UPHELD, at 27db8c23): REQ-817 held as specified, but the spec built in the lag. (1) `targetNameOf` (backend/src/demo-mode/domain/business/display-name/mod.ts) returned the raw `u.phoneNumber` for a placeholder name, so the stage showed "+15125550400" while /admin showed "(512) 555-0400". (2) The stage learned a new name only by asking GET /demo-mode/active again — every `ACTIVE_NAME_REFRESH_MS` (15 s) while connected, or on the customer's next page (`onPeerOnline`). /welcome's steps live in one page, so a name saved on step 1 waited for the next tick (fleet-0: 13,140 ms) or the next page load (fleet-3/4: ~10 s). Nothing pushed the rename.
**Requirement:** Until the customer has a name the stage names them by their phone as the app writes it ("(512) 555-0400"), never an E.164 '+' string. Once they save a name on their page — /welcome's first step, Settings, the staff name prompt — the stage's pill and their cursor take it within about two seconds, with no page load on either side.
**Decisions:**
- `fmtPhone` moves to `shared/identity/phone.ts`. `front-end/lib/format.ts` re-exports it, so every caller is unchanged. `targetNameOf` returns `fmtPhone(u.phoneNumber)` for a placeholder name. A non-NANP number comes back as typed.
- The push reuses the app's existing `pm:profile-updated` event (`front-end/lib/profile-events.ts`, `announceProfile`) rather than adding a second `pm:me-updated`. Settings and StaffNamePrompt already fire it after a successful PUT /api/me. /welcome's `NameStep` now fires it too, after its save.
- `front-end/lib/demo-mode/rename-signal.ts` `relayRenames(send)` sends a `{ k: "renamed" }` peer frame for every announcement that carries a `name`; a business rename alone is not one. DemoModeOverlay subscribes it in its link effect (`link?.send`) and stops it on cleanup.
- `shared/demo-mode/protocol.ts` adds `{ k: "renamed" }` to `PeerMessage` and `parsePeerMessage`. The hub relays it like any other peer frame; no server change.
- DemoStage's `onPeer`, on a viewer's `renamed`, calls `pollRef.current?.()`: one /active round trip, and the answer already carries the saved name (the announcement fires after the PUT resolves).
- AMENDMENT of REQ-817: its 15 s `ACTIVE_NAME_REFRESH_MS` ask stays, but only as a fallback for a rename made somewhere else (another browser, an admin edit). A name saved on the customer's page no longer waits for it.
**Tests:**
- unit (backend): `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/business/display-name/test.ts` ("REQ-355 + REQ-836 targetNameOf …": the placeholder label is "(512) 555-3001"; "REQ-836 targetNameOf — an unnamed customer's label never carries a '+' …" for +1 / 1 / 10-digit input, and a non-NANP number stays readable).
- unit (jest): `jest/unit/demo-stage-rename-push.test.ts` ("REQ-836 …": `parsePeerMessage`/`parseClientMessage` keep `renamed`; `relayRenames` sends `renamed` on a name announcement, ignores a business-name-only one, and stops on unsubscribe; `fmtPhone` lives in shared and format.ts re-exports it; targetNameOf uses it; wiring: NameStep announces after its save, the overlay relays with `link?.send`, the stage's `onPeer` `case "renamed"` calls `pollRef.current?.()`).
- integration: `backend/src/demo-mode/entrypoints/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-836 (cycle dm2, m1) the customer's `renamed` frame reaches the presenter's socket …": before the save, /active names the customer "(512) 555-3061"; the customer saves "Maria Lopez" and sends `renamed`; the presenter's socket gets it stamped from the viewer; the next /active names Maria Lopez). Amended for the formatted label (each marked REQ-836): the REQ-355 and REQ-817 tests in the same file.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-rename-push.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-836 (cycle dm2, m1): …": the customer sits on /welcome with no name; Hans opens the demo; the stage pill shows the formatted phone and not "+1…"; the customer types "Maria Lopez" on step 1 and presses Continue with no navigation; the pill names Maria Lopez within 2,500 ms of the PUT's response). Amended: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-name-refresh.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-817) now expects the formatted phone.
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-stage-customer-name off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23, host load ~100):**
- RED first. `deno test -A src/demo-mode/domain/business/display-name/test.ts` → "FAILED | 3 passed | 2 failed" (Actual "+15125550400" / Expected "(512) 555-0400"). The int file → "FAILED | 21 passed | 2 failed" (REQ-355 and REQ-817 on the formatted label). `--filter REQ-836` (`--no-check`, since `renamed` was not in the type yet) → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed". `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-stage-rename-push` → "Tests: 4 failed, 4 total" (`parsePeerMessage({k:"renamed"})` Received null; "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/demo-mode/rename-signal'"; `shared/identity/phone.ts` missing; NameStep announces nothing). `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-rename-push.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-836 … expectation failed: REQ-836 the stage names an unnamed customer by their formatted phone (pill: "Demo mode\nGuiding +15129054759\n…") — expected true, got false".

## REQ-829 — The demo carries the presenter's live language: an es-profile staff member on /admin?lang=en gets an English stage and an English /admin after End (demo-loop dm2, m7)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue **m7** "Stage and /admin after End are Spanish although the presenter used /admin in English (pm_lang=en cookie ignored)", RCA CONFIRMED + skeptic CORRECTED (entry point is DemoModeOverlay placePresenter, not AdminPage:306) at 27db8c23.
**Cause (RCA):** `presenterLangForRequest` (front-end/lib/presenter-lang.ts) read only whoami's `impersonator.language`, then the resolved user's language, then en — no URL, no cookie — and REQ-812 installs it as `ctx.state.lang` on every /demo page. The staff profile was es (verify-otp's es default, REQ-590); the English on /admin came from `?lang=en`, which REQ-592 keeps page-scoped. Every hop dropped it: the row Demo button (DemoModeOverlay `placePresenter` → `location.assign(STAGE_PATH)`), the lock banner's Back to the demo (AdminPage), the /admin guide gate's Back to the demo (AdminGuideGate `href="/demo/stage"`), End's handover (`endedHref(notice)`) and Leave (`"/admin"`). Side defect: with no impersonator language the fallback was the impersonated CUSTOMER's language.
**Requirement:** The presenter's live UI language travels with the demo as `?lang=`: `shared/demo-mode/ended.ts` gains `withLang(href, lang)`, `stageHref(lang)` and `endedHref(notice, lang?)`; placePresenter and AdminPage's lock banner go to `stageHref(langSignal.value)`, AdminGuideGate links `stageHref(lang)`, DemoStage's End handover goes to `endedHref(notice, langSignal.value)` and Leave to `withLang("/admin", langSignal.value)`. `presenterLang(who, user, carry)` ranks: an explicit `?lang=` → whoami's impersonator profile (the person's own when not impersonating) → the `pm_lang` cookie → en — never the impersonated customer's language. `presenterLangForRequest` and `adminGateForRequest` read the carry from the request (`presenterCarry(req)`). Amends REQ-812 (the stage's language is the presenter's LIVE language first, the profile second) and REQ-341's fallback.
**Tests:**
- unit: `front-end/lib/presenter-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-829 …": ?lang= beats profile and cookie; junk ignored; profile beats cookie; no profile language → cookie, not the customer's; `presenterLangForRequest` on /demo/stage?lang=en and the cookie fallback; the REQ-341 fallback test amended). `jest/unit/demo-presenter-lang-carry.test.ts` ("REQ-829 …": the ordering, `stageHref`/`withLang`, `endedHref(notice, lang)` survives `readEndedNotice`, and every hop — DemoModeOverlay, AdminPage, AdminGuideGate, admin-gate, DemoStage End/Leave — carries the language). Amended pins (each says REQ-829): `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-lang.test.ts`, `jest/unit/demo-mode-protocol.test.ts`, `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-pointer.test.ts`.
- integration: `front-end/lib/demo-stage-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-829 presenter es viewing /admin?lang=en: /demo/stage?lang=en is English throughout" — real /demo middleware + shell + page: `<html lang="en">`, "Demo mode · DocuMonster", `__PM_LANG="en"`); `front-end/lib/admin-gate.int.test.ts` amended (Back to the demo → `/demo/stage?lang=…`).
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-lang-carry.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-829 (cycle dm2, m7): …" — Hans's profile es, pm_lang=en; /admin?lang=en; Demo → the stage's `<html lang>` is en and the title English; End → /admin `<html lang="en">` saying "You ended the demo", no "Terminaste la demo"). `e2e/admin-impersonate-gate/admin-impersonate-gate.e2e.test.ts` amended (href `/demo/stage?lang=(en|es)`).
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-presenter-lang-carry off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):**
- RED first. `cd front-end && deno test --no-check -A --unstable-kv lib/presenter-lang.test.ts lib/demo-stage-lang.int.test.ts` → 5 FAILED ("AssertionError: Values are not equal: <html lang> is the carried language"; the ordering tests; "never the impersonated CUSTOMER's language"). `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-presenter-lang-carry|demo-stage-presenter-lang'` → "Tests: 11 failed, 8 passed, 19 total". `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-lang-carry.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-829 … expectation failed: the stage's <html lang> is the language the presenter was viewing — expected "en", got "es"".

## REQ-830 — A full page load never paints the customer's pill whole at home before it folds: the first frame matches the last page (demo-loop dm2, p6)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue **p6** "Customer pill flashes expanded at bottom-left on every page load before folding" (fleet-1 stdout: '274ms Demo mode DocuMonster is guiding you Connected End demo @12,749' → '347ms Demo × @1184,760' on /quotes; '221ms … @12,749' → '280ms Demo × @1184,720' on /reports). RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, at 27db8c23.
**Cause (RCA):** every link is a full load (REQ-535). The carried-demo `useLayoutEffect` (DemoModeOverlay.tsx ~724-741) seeded only the demo; `pill-carry.ts` `keepDemo` stored no placement, `dock` started `{0,0}` and `tucked` `false`, so the first render with a demo was the whole pill at home (left 12, bottom-left). The placement that folds and moves it ran in a plain `useEffect` keyed `[shown, demo?.role]` — after paint — so that frame was painted for ~60-70 ms. Introduced by 79e03b85 (REQ-535 carry without placement) + 07947c3d (REQ-637/REQ-545 folding decided post-paint).
**Requirement:** (1) `keepDemo` also keeps the pill's last placement — `{ tucked, tabAt, dock, full? }` (`PillPlace`) — and `carriedDemo` hands it back when well formed (a malformed one is dropped; the demo still carries). The overlay keeps it as it changes (in `place()`) and as the page goes (pagehide), and the carried-demo layout effect seeds `tucked`, `tabAt`, `dock` and the whole size before paint. (2) The first `place()` runs in a `useLayoutEffect` keyed `[shown, demo?.role]` (before paint); the interval, resize/scroll listeners and ResizeObserver stay in the `useEffect` on the same keys.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-carry-place.test.ts` ("REQ-830 …": the placement round-trips through the store; a whole pill carries tucked false and its dock; no placement → none carried; malformed placements are dropped; source pin — every `keepDemo` passes `lastPlaceRef.current` and the carried layout effect seeds `setTucked`/`setTabAt`/`setDock` from `carried.place`).
- integration: `front-end/lib/demo-pill-first-paint.test.tsx` ("REQ-830 (dm2 p6): a page loaded from one whose pill was folded commits the mini-pill first …": the real island mounted under deno-dom with a carried folded placement in sessionStorage; the first pill style rendered, before any after-paint effect, is the mini-pill's `tabStyle` at `translate(1172px, 11px)`; plus a source pin that the first `place()` runs in a layout effect and the interval in the effect).
- e2e: n/a — the browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the mount test reproduces the tester's exact home frame (left 12, translate 0,0) and the next demo cycle re-checks it live.
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-pill-first-paint-place off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):**
- RED: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pill-carry-place` → "Tests: 3 failed, 2 passed, 5 total" (round-trip "Received: undefined"; source pin "Expected pattern: /lastPlaceRef\.current/ Received string: keepDemo(sessionStore(), demo, peerOnline, Date.now());"). `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/demo-pill-first-paint.test.tsx` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" ("first committed style is the mini-pill's (tabStyle), got: position:fixed;left:12px;…transform:translate(0px, 0px)"; "the effect that first calls place() is a layout effect" — actual `useEffect(() =>`).

## REQ-831 — On the customer's screen the presenter's arrow and click wave are drawn above the demo pill and End's question (demo-loop cycle dm2, m4)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue **m4** "Customer's presenter arrow and click wave are stacked below the demo pill" (demo 3: "z-index 2147483002 < demo-pill 2147483003. demo-wave-clip is z 2147483001. elementsFromPoint(1217,771) = demo-end-cancel, demo-end-ask, demo-pill, FOOTER (no pointer)"). RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION (REQ-242: the stage is a live mirror of the customer's screen) at 27db8c23.
**Cause (RCA):** the customer overlay's base `Z = 2147483000` (front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx). The pill and its folded tab sat at `Z + 3` (d226b76f, REQ-153), PeerPointer got `z={Z + 1}` (d7459350, REQ-214), so DemoPointer drew the wave clip at Z+1 and the arrow at Z+2: both under the pill and under End's question inside it. The stage does the opposite (pill/End ghosts at Z, PointerGhost/OwnPointer at Z+1). No REQ ever compared the two. REQ-235/816/820/822 made the pill something to point at but never looked at the z order.
**Requirement:** the presenters' pointers on the customer's screen have their own layer above the pill: `PILL_Z = Z + 3` (pill and tab, still above the page, its dialogs and coach mark) and `POINTER_Z = PILL_Z + 1`, passed to PeerPointer. The wave clip is at POINTER_Z and the arrow at POINTER_Z + 1. Both stay pointer-events:none, so End / Yes, end it / Keep going still take the click through the arrow. The off-screen mark keeps `offZ={OFF_MARK_Z}` (REQ-635), under the page's modal dims.
**Tests:**
- unit: `front-end/lib/demo-pointer-above-pill.test.tsx` ("REQ-831 (demo dm2 m4): …": resolves the z the overlay passes PeerPointer and the pill's / tab's z-index from the overlay source, renders DemoPointer with that z (SSR), and checks that the arrow is above the pill and tab, the wave clip is above the pill, both are pointer-events:none, and the off mark is still OFF_MARK_Z). Amended: `front-end/lib/demo-pointer-off-mark.test.tsx` (the "not off" pin is now z 2147483004 → arrow 2147483005, with a REQ-831 note), `jest/unit/demo-pill-text.test.ts` (REQ-294's pillStyle regex allows the line break deno fmt now puts after `const pillStyle =`).
- integration: n/a. Only the client-side stacking order changes; no endpoint, store or server render is involved.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pointer-above-pill.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-831 (demo-loop cycle dm2, m4): …"). Alex opens a demo from /admin. The customer (1280×800, /customers) brings the pill out and clicks End. Alex moves his stage mouse onto the customer's Keep going. Hit-testing a point of his arrow over the pill (the arrow's and pill's subtrees are made hittable for that one probe, since both are pointer-events:none), the arrow comes before demo-pill, demo-end-cancel and demo-end-ask. Keep going still closes the question when clicked through the arrow.

## REQ-834 — A tab left open through the customer's sign-out and re-login rejoins the demo; REQ-823's sign-out latch is time-boxed, not for the page's life (demo-loop cycle dm2, M1) — REQ-823 AMENDMENT
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), Demo-mode-only test, five testers, issue `M1` — "Tab open before customer logout never rejoins after re-login; stage shows the other tab as 'Live'" (demo 4, fleet-3/stdout:74-80: "Tab 1 has no [data-cy=demo-pill] after 3 s and still none after 11 s (visibilityState=visible, hasFocus()=true)… ended the demo and started a new one. Tab 1 still had no pill… Only an in-app navigation inside tab 1 (/quotes → /customers) brought the pill back"). A cycle-dm1 fix (REQ-823 M2) that regressed the re-login path. RCA (analyst + skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION, at demo-fixes `27db8c23`).
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-823's `onSignout` handler in `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx` set `signedOutRef.current = true` in every open tab (signout-signal.ts relays `pm:logout` over the `pm:demo-signout` BroadcastChannel), and nothing ever cleared it. The `/active` poller's ask returned early on it for the page's whole life (`if (signedOutRef.current) return;`), and onVisible's `catchUp()` went into the same early return. Tab 0 signed out, landed on "/", signed in again on a new page (a fresh overlay, so it rejoined). Tab 1 was never reloaded: its cookie carried the new live session, but its overlay never asked /active again, so no pill, no link, no claim, and no new demo could reach it either. The stage's "Live" was accurate for what it could know (tab 0 was the only connected socket). Introduced by c71146af0.
**Requirement (amends REQ-823 #3):**
1. After a sign-out (this tab's `pm:logout` or another tab's `signout` on the channel) a page asks /active for no demo for `SIGNOUT_HOLD_MS` (5 s: the redirect and the backend's session delete), never for the page's whole life. After that the server decides: a dead session's ask fails (REQ-823 #5 also refuses its sockets), a session that signed in again gets its demo.
2. A page that mounts the overlay with a session says `{k:"signin"}` on the `pm:demo-signout` channel. A page still in its hold lets go at once and asks /active now (`poller.now()`); a sign-in with no sign-out behind it changes nothing.
3. End to end: the customer signs out in tab 1 and back in while tab 2 stays open (never reloaded); tab 2 shows the pill within 5 s of being in front again, and a key in tab 2 takes the stage there (Live, its screen and page). REQ-823 M2 still holds: after a plain sign-out the other tab's pill goes and the stage never goes Live on it.
**Implementation:** `front-end/lib/demo-mode/signout-signal.ts` — `SIGNOUT_HOLD_MS`, `onSignout` options `onSignin` / `sayIn`, and `signoutGate({ out, back })` (`holds()`, `stop()`); `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx` — `signedOutRef` replaced by `gateRef` (the gate's `out` is REQ-823's old body, `back: () => pollerRef.current?.now()`), the ask checks `gateRef.current?.holds()`.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-signout-rejoin.test.ts` ("REQ-834 …": the hold is 3-5 s; a mounting page says `signin` and holds nothing; another tab's sign-out then a sign-in lifts the hold at once and runs `back` once, junk and a bare sign-in do nothing; the hold expires by itself after SIGNOUT_HOLD_MS; the overlay's /active poll gated the overlay's way — skipped while held, asks on the sign-in broadcast, asks again once the window is over; the overlay's wiring, no `signedOutRef`) · amended REQ-823 wiring test in `jest/unit/demo-stage-tab-leave-follow.test.ts` (the overlay hears the sign-out through `signoutGate`).
- integration: n/a — front-end only: no endpoint, store or protocol change (REQ-823 #5's backend refusal of a dead session's sockets is unchanged and still covered by its own int test).

## REQ-826 — The stage's "Now showing {name}'s other tab" banner names the page, never its URL, and sits in the chrome row above the frame (demo-loop cycle dm2, issue p10; REQ-645 AMENDMENT, extends REQ-642)
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57, demo-report.md), issue `p10` "Stage tab-switch banner prints a raw URL with UUID and covers the top of the frame" (fleet-4: "Ahora ves la otra pestaña de Maria Lopez (/q/cfe16416-ed6e-48ee-9b98-a636c835d3e3?lang=en)… The banner also sits over the top of the frame."). RCA: analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, at 27db8c23.
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `DemoStage.tsx` `noteTab(path)` stored the mirrored page's raw path (`rep.path()`, which the recorder fills with `location.pathname + location.search`, mirror-record.ts:425), and the banner printed it verbatim through `t("demoMode.tabSwitched", { name, path: tabNote })`. (2) The banner's style was `top:${fit.top - bannerH}px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)`, centred on the frame's top edge, so its lower half covered the mirrored header. REQ-642 (51a8c3ca) had moved the off/absent badges out of exactly this pattern; REQ-645's banner (07f2e1dc) landed an hour later with the old geometry.
**Requirement:**
- The banner names the page: `pageLabel(path, t)` in `shared/demo-mode/page-label.ts` maps the path to a `demoMode.page.*` key (/q/:id → Quote, /i/:id → Invoice, /dashboard → Dashboard, /settings → Settings, /quotes → Quotes, /quotes/:id → Quote, /customers/:id → Customer, / → Home, …), localized in lang/en.json and lang/es.json. The query string, the hash and every ID are dropped. A page with no name of its own reads as its first path segment ("/field-notes/…" → "Field notes"); a first segment that is itself an ID reads "another page".
- The copy takes `{page}`: en "Now showing {name}'s other tab ({page}) — move to point there", es "Ahora ves la otra pestaña de {name} ({page}) — mueve el puntero para señalar ahí".
- `data-cy="demo-tab-switched"` has its siblings' chrome-row geometry: `top:${stageBadgeTop(fit.top - bannerH)}px`, `transform:translateX(-50%)`, height `STAGE_BADGE_H` — its box ends above the frame's top, never over the replica.
- REQ-645 AMENDMENT: its wiring test in `jest/unit/demo-pointer-identity.test.ts` and its e2e notice ("… other tab (/settings) …" → "… other tab (Settings) …") are updated to match.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-stage-tab-banner.test.ts` ("REQ-826 (demo-loop cycle dm2, p10) …", 7 cases: en and es page names for /q/<uuid>?lang=en, /i/:id, /dashboard, /settings, …; first-segment fallback and the ID-only case; every key pageLabelKey returns exists in en and es; the `{page}` copy; DemoStage wired to `pageLabel(tabNote, t)`; REQ-642's chrome-row check extended to demo-tab-switched — stageBadgeTop, STAGE_BADGE_H, translateX only). `jest/unit/demo-pointer-identity.test.ts` REQ-645 wiring case amended.
- integration: n/a — a pure stage render and a shared string mapping; no endpoint, store or isolate crossing is involved.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-rest.e2e.test.ts` (`saysOtherTab`, used by the REQ-645 m36 story): the notice reads "Now showing Ana Torres's other tab (Settings) — move to point there" and its bounding box ends above the frame's top (`b.y + b.height <= frame.y`). Not run here: the browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the next demo cycle re-checks it live.
