## REQ-833 — After a restart the customer's pill says "started a new demo", THEN "{name} is guiding you", then yields — on the phone's compact pill too (demo-loop cycle dm2, issue m6) — AMENDMENT of REQ-298 and REQ-821
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue **m6** ("On a phone restart the customer never sees '{name} is guiding you' before the pill compacts and folds"); RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION (REQ-298 says the restart line shows "before its plain \"{name} is guiding you\" line"; REQ-821 promises the guiding line on a join). This is a dm1 fix (REQ-821) that did not hold on a restart.
**Cause (RCA, at 27db8c23):** two links. (1) `DemoModeOverlay.tsx` hid `data-cy=demo-details`, the only place `guidingText` renders, on the compact (≤640 px) pill with `compact && !open && !started`. `joined` was not in that condition, so REQ-821's grace kept the compact pill whole as "● Alex | Connected | End demo" and never named who was guiding. (2) On a restart, REQ-298's line (`RESTART_SAY_MS` 10 s) and REQ-821's grace (`JOIN_SAY_MS` 5 s from link-up) started on the same demo-id change, so the grace ran out under the restart line. When `fresh` dropped, `joined` was already false: `yieldsRef` turned true and the `[peek, open, fresh]` effect folded the pill about 49 ms later. Fleet-0 timeline: 73 ms "Alex started a new demo" → 10061 ms "Alex | Connected | End demo" → 10110 ms "Demo ×".
**Requirement:** a restart is said in this order: "{name} started a new demo" (REQ-298/647: up to `RESTART_SAY_MS`, or until the customer acts after `RESTART_MIN_MS`), then "{name} is guiding you" for a fresh `JOIN_SAY_MS` (5 s, or until the customer presses or types after `RESTART_MIN_MS`), and only then does the pill yield to the page (REQ-545/637/781). The guiding phase follows only when the restart line's clock ran out. If the customer dismissed the line by acting, the pill yields as before. It happens once per demo id. While REQ-821's join grace is up, the phone's compact pill shows its details row ("{name} is guiding you"), and the "● Alex" short-name chip steps aside so the name is said once (REQ-373), just as it does for the restart line.
**Implementation:** `shared/demo-mode/restart.ts`: `restartNotice`'s `onChange(fresh, read)` now reports whether input (`true`) or the clock (`false`) ended the line. `joinGrace` gains `restartEnded(id, read)`, owed once per arrived id: when the clock ran out it calls `say()` and `onChange(true)` for a fresh `JOIN_SAY_MS`. `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`: `pillDetailsShown({ compact, open, started, joined })`. `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`: the restart notice's `onChange` sets `fresh` and, on false, calls `joinRef.current?.restartEnded(demoRef.current?.id ?? "", read === true)`. `demo-details` now uses `pillDetailsShown(…, joined)`, and `showGuide = copy.showShort && !started && !joined`.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-restart-guiding-line.test.ts` ("REQ-833 …": both clocks on one fake timeline wired as the overlay wires them. The restart line runs 10 s, then "guiding" for exactly `JOIN_SAY_MS`, then the pill yields. Input after `RESTART_MIN_MS` ends the guiding phase. A line dismissed by input is not followed by a grace. A stale or repeated `restartEnded` says nothing. `pillDetailsShown` on compact covers joined, started, open and desktop. The overlay wiring is checked.) Amended: `jest/unit/demo-mode-restart.test.ts` (REQ-298's compact-details source check now expects `pillDetailsShown`).
- integration: n/a. Front-end only, with no endpoint, store or protocol change. An SSR test cannot reach the state: the overlay's demo, `joined` and `fresh` are client state, null on the server render (`front-end/lib/demo-ended-sticky-ssr.test.tsx` still passes). The compact-pill rule is the pure `pillDetailsShown`, unit-tested above.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-restart.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-222/298's story, amended. The customer is at 420 px, the compact pill. After "Hans started a new demo", the whole pill's details row must read "Hans is guiding you" with no restart line, within 16 s.)
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-restart-guiding-line off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):**
- RED first. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-restart-guiding-line` → "Tests: 6 failed, 6 total" (`TypeError: g.restartEnded is not a function` ×4, `pillDetailsShown is not a function`, and the overlay pattern was not found).
- GREEN. `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-'` → "Test Suites: 74 passed, 74 total · Tests: 886 passed, 886 total". `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/demo-ended-sticky-ssr.test.tsx` → "ok | 3 passed". `deno lint` and `deno check` are clean on `islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`, `shared/demo-mode/restart.ts` and `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`. `deno fmt` is clean on every touched file (all were clean at the base).
- e2e NOT proven: the host was at load average 96. `PORT=5847 deno task serve` + `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-restart.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` on the base sources failed at REQ-298's own step ("expected \"Hans started a new demo\", got null"), before the REQ-833 check. With the fix it failed on "page.screenshot: Timeout 90000ms exceeded". Re-run the story on a quiet host.
## REQ-828 — After "Keep going", the stage's ghost folds back to the tab with the customer's pill, not a frame later (demo-loop dm2, p7) — AMENDMENT to REQ-822 / REQ-636
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue **p7** "After 'Seguir' (Keep going), the stage ghost shows the intermediate whole pill at once but holds the customer's re-fold for a frame" (customer "Demo | ×" while the stage ghost read "Alex | Conectado | Terminar demo" until the next read, under 2 s). RCA CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD at 27db8c23.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-822's `pillShowsAtOnce` (shared/demo-mode/pill.ts) shows a face at once only when End's question goes up or down (OVERLAY_ONLY = asking/ask/yes/no/clipped). On Keep going the question-down face (peek still open, `tucked:false`) showed at once; when the peek ended, the fold face changed `tucked`, which is not overlay-only, so `createPillSync` held it for a mirror frame (REQ-636, up to PILL_HOLD_MAX_MS 15 s). A still page sends no frame, so the stage kept the whole pill the customer no longer showed.
**Requirement:** a face whose only change from the face on the stage is the tuck (plus the rect that goes with it) shows at once when the face on the stage was itself shown at once and no mirror frame sent after it has been replayed since — folding changes nothing on the mirrored page. `PillSync.atOnce()` (shared/demo-mode/pill-sync.ts) says so (cleared by a frame sent after the at-once face, a held face released, a face shown with its frame, or `reset()`); DemoStage passes it as `pillShowsAtOnce(shownFace, faceOf(m), awaiting, pills.atOnce())`. A tuck after a frame, after a face shown with its frame, or together with new words still waits for its frame (REQ-636); an unchanged face is not hurried.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-stage-pill-tuck-at-once.test.ts` ("REQ-828 (demo-loop cycle dm2, p7) …", through `createPillSync` + `pillShowsAtOnce`: asking → question down → tucked with no frame between → the tuck shows at once; a trailing frame sent before Keep going does not break it; a frame sent since → held until its frame; a tuck after a face shown with its frame → held; tuck + new words → held; `reset()` ends the chain; DemoStage passes `pills.atOnce()`). Neighbours unchanged and green: `demo-stage-pill-asking`, `demo-pill-ghost-sync`, `demo-pill-ghost-sync-wire`.
- integration: n/a — pure stage-side logic in shared/ and one island call; no endpoint, store or wire change.
- e2e: n/a — the browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the next demo cycle re-checks Keep going live.
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-pill-tuck-at-once off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):**
- RED (with `PillSync.atOnce()` added, pill.ts / DemoStage untouched): `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-stage-pill-tuck-at-once` → "Tests: 3 failed, 4 passed, 7 total" — the fold face "Expected: {… "tucked": true} Received: null" (held for its frame), and DemoStage not passing `pills.atOnce()`.
- GREEN: same file plus `demo-stage-pill-asking|demo-pill-ghost-sync` → "Test Suites: 4 passed · Tests: 34 passed"; `--testPathPattern 'demo-|pill'` → "Test Suites: 530 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 5390 passed". `deno lint` (pill.ts, pill-sync.ts, DemoStage.tsx) and `deno check islands/DemoStage.tsx` clean; `deno fmt --check` clean on the four touched/new files.
## REQ-825 — The 404 page loads Inter like the stage, and the pill's font never ends on a bare generic (demo-loop cycle dm2, issue p9; REQ-294 AMENDMENT)
**Requirement (Raphael):** "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm2 (run r9c47ba57), issue p9: on the 404 page (a mistyped URL such as `/w`) the customer's demo pill was drawn in a Courier-like monospace face in the headless box, while the stage's ghost of it read in the app's sans (fleet-r9c47ba57-3/stdout:133). RCA (analyst + skeptic UPHELD, at 27db8c23): the pill and the ghost both use `PILL_FONT` (`shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`), whose first face is Inter; the stage (`demo-stage.css`) and every app page (`dashboard.css`, `assistant.css`) load Inter from Google Fonts, but the 404 page (`routes/_error.tsx`) links only `error-page.css`, which loaded no font. So on the 404 the stack fell through to system-ui / sans-serif, which that box maps to monospace. REQ-294's fix had only given the body the same stack, so it changed nothing. This amends REQ-294 (3), "so it reads the same on every page, the 404 included": (1) `error-page.css` @imports Inter the same way `demo-stage.css` does; (2) `PILL_FONT` and the 404 body stack add concrete installed sans faces (Arial, Helvetica) before the generic `sans-serif`; (3) the REQ-294 comments in `error-page.css`, `_error.tsx` and `pill.ts` now describe what actually happens.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/error-page-inter-font.test.ts` ("REQ-825 …": `demo-stage.css` and `error-page.css` both @import Inter from fonts.googleapis.com, and the @import comes first in `error-page.css`; `_error.tsx` links it; the 404 body stack starts with Inter and has Arial before sans-serif; `PILL_FONT` starts with Inter and ends on sans-serif, with Arial and Helvetica before it and no monospace; the overlay pill and the stage ghost both draw with `PILL_FONT`). `jest/unit/demo-pill-text.test.ts`'s REQ-294 case is amended: `PILL_FONT` is the `--font-body` named faces plus `Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`. Integration: the existing `jest/integration/error-page.int.test.ts` REQ-294 case still holds; no new case, because there is no backend or wire change and the served CSS is covered by the e2e. e2e `e2e/error-page-font/error-page-font.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-825: …": on `/w` the body font starts with Inter and `document.fonts` has a loaded Inter face).
**Evidence (2026-11-15, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm2-error-page-inter-font off origin/demo-fixes 27db8c23):** RED first: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` gave "Tests: 3 failed, 1 skipped, 5385 passed". The failures were all REQ-825: the error-page.css @import (`Expected pattern: /@import url\("https:\/\/fonts\.googleapis\.com…family=Inter…/`, received the old REQ-294 file); the 404 body with no Arial (`Expected: > -1, Received: -1`); and `PILL_FONT` with no Arial (`Expected: > 0, Received: -1`). The e2e ran against an own serve on PORT=57391 with the old `error-page.css`: `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:57391 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/error-page-font -- --no-check` gave "✗ REQ-825 … expectation failed: the 404 page has a loaded Inter face". GREEN: the same unit project gave "Test Suites: 530 passed, 530 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 5388 passed, 5389 total", and the same e2e gave "✓ REQ-825: the 404 page loads Inter, so a pill drawn in PILL_FONT reads in Inter · 32.3s". `deno lint` and `deno check` were clean (`_error.tsx`, `pill.ts`, DemoModeOverlay, DemoStage). `deno fmt --check` was clean on the touched TS/CSS. The new e2e file follows e2e/'s unformatted long-line convention. Not run: a full demo session ending on the 404 page with the box's own fonts. The box's fontconfig mapping cannot be inspected from the host.
## REQ-855 — While a staff member guides a customer, the presenter's own chrome is the presenter's: no red impersonation bar beside the demo pill (nor over /admin's guide gate), the pill speaks the presenter's language and carries it back to the stage, and the pill and the gate have an EN | ES switch (demo-loop cycle dm3, issues m5 + m6 + rc-17) — AMENDMENT of REQ-537 / REQ-232 / REQ-829
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd, demo-report.md), issues **m5** "On the presenter's other pages during a demo, the red 'Impersonating … Return to your account' bar shows next to the demo pill (and on /admin the guide-gate card too), with no EN/ES control" (fleet-0 stdout:64, fleet-2 stdout:29), **m6** "The presenter's own demo pill on customer pages speaks the customer's language (ES) while the impersonation bar and stage speak the presenter's (EN)" (fleet-0 stdout:65: bar "Impersonating Maria Lopez (as Alex) | Return to your account" in EN, pill "Modo demo Guiando a Maria Lopez | Volver a la demo" in ES) and **rc-17** "Re-check 17: stage stayed Spanish after a hand-set pm_lang=en cookie, and End went to /admin?lang=es (demo 3)". RCA (analyst + skeptic) at demo-fixes 5fef7e6d: m5 CONFIRMED / UPHELD (judge BUG_POLISH), m6 CONFIRMED / CORRECTED (judge BUG_CONTRADICTION — REQ-829 "the demo carries the presenter's live language"), rc-17 TEST_ARTIFACT for the cookie check itself, with m6's hop as a real contributing defect (judge BUG_CONTRADICTION).
**Cause (RCA):** (m5) `front-end/islands/ImpersonationBanner.tsx` decided by path only — `shown = impersonationBannerOn(location.pathname) && who.impersonating`, false only on /demo/stage (REQ-537) — and never asked whether the impersonation is a demo this staff presents (`demoModeClient.active()` ran only after a click on Return). So on every other page of a demo the red bar sat next to DemoModeOverlay's "Demo mode · Guiding {name} · Back to the demo" pill, and on /admin next to the REQ-376 guide-gate card too: three notices, two vocabularies, two competing exits — and once inside the impersonation the staff had no language control of their own (the customer's topbar toggle saves the CUSTOMER's profile). (m6) The overlay's presenter and Opening… branches translated with `demoChromeT` (REQ-544), which reads the page's live langSignal; under impersonation a customer page's langSignal is the customer's language (resolveSsrLang → personLanguage(customer); the impersonator is not REQ-631's actor). Its Back to the demo (`placePresenter`) went to `stageHref(langSignal.value)` — the customer's language — and that `?lang=` outranks the presenter's own profile on the stage (`presenterLang`, REQ-829), and End/Leave carried it on to /admin. (rc-17) A hand-set pm_lang cookie loses by design (REQ-829 ranks it last); the Spanish stage and /admin?lang=es came from a carried ?lang=es (m6's hop) or an es profile, and there was no real EN/ES control to use instead (m5).
**Requirement:**
1. The presenter's own chrome on a page that is not the stage — DemoModeOverlay's presenter pill, its Opening…, the ended notice of a demo it presented, and its hop back to the stage — speaks the PRESENTER's language (`presenterChromeLang`, `front-end/lib/presenter-lang-rank.ts`): on the presenter's own session (not impersonating — /admin where Demo was pressed) the page's live language (REQ-829 unchanged); under impersonation REQ-829's ranking — an explicit `?lang=` → whoami's `impersonator.language` → the `pm_lang` cookie → en — never the customer page's language. The pure `presenterLang` ranking moves unchanged into that client-safe module (`lib/presenter-lang.ts` re-exports it) so an island can use it. The overlay asks whoami once per page when a presenter's demo shows (or Demo was pressed) and draws the presenter pill once it has answered (never a frame in the customer's language); `placePresenter` goes to `stageHref(<that language>)`. The customer's pill keeps `demoChromeT`.
2. The red impersonation bar is not drawn while this staff presents the demo (GET /demo-mode/active says `role: "presenter"` — asked on mount once whoami says impersonating, before the bar is drawn), nor over /admin's guide gate (an impersonation of a non-super-admin on /admin*, which has its own exits); it comes back when the overlay says the presented demo is gone (`DEMO_PRESENTING_EVENT`). A plain impersonation elsewhere keeps it (REQ-181, REQ-723). Rule: `impersonationBarShown` (`shared/demo-mode/stage-chrome.ts`).
3. Where the bar used to be (the presenter impersonating, off the stage) the presenter pill carries the way out — End demo (asks first, like the stage's End; with other presenters: Leave the demo), which hands the account back and lands on /admin in the presenter's language — and an EN | ES switch for the presenter's language: the same page with `?lang=` set (`langToggleHref`) plus `persistLang`, never the customer's topbar toggle.
4. /admin's guide gate (`components/AdminGuideGate.tsx`) shows the EN | ES switch (`PublicLangToggle` on `langToggleHref(url, …)`); its Back to the demo already carries `gate.lang` (REQ-829) and its Return to your account now lands on `/admin?lang=<gate.lang>`.
**Tests:** (TDD: each written first and seen red, see Evidence)

## REQ-853 — The folded demo chip avoids text and stays put while the page loads under it (demo-loop cycle dm3, issues p1 + p8)
**Source:** Raphael, "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd, `demo-loop/runs/r02524ccd/demo-report.md`), issues **p1** "Folded 'Demo ×' chip sits over the footer address line (covers 'SC 29588' in Spanish)" and **p8** "Folded chip jumps 80 px (1184,760 → 1184,680) about 0.7 s after /dashboard loads". RCA (analyst + skeptic UPHELD, at 5fef7e6d): `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts` placePill's step 2 (`tab = tabs.find(controls(r) === 0)`) folded at the first tab spot with no CONTROL under it and never asked `blocked`, so on /clients at 1280×800 (Log out under (0,760)) the chip landed at (1184,760) over the compact footer's `<span data-site-address>` (a span is no control), which the longer ES line pushes to x 1251 (fleet-2 stdout:21). And placePill always scanned from tabs[0] with no preference for the spot the chip already had (or carried in, REQ-830), while the first place() (REQ-830's layout effect) saw /dashboard's loading skeleton and nothing re-placed until the next 700 ms `PILL_CHECK_MS` poll — the overlay's ResizeObserver watched only the pill (fleet-2 stdout:61: 1184,760 at 364 ms → 1184,680 at 1051 ms).
**Requirement:**
- The folded mini-pill prefers a tab spot with NOTHING of the page under it (`blocked` — text, cards, media, controls) before one with merely no control; only when every tab spot has something under it does it fall back to the first with no control (REQ-781/818 unchanged). This holds in the plain fold, under a dialog with nowhere to dock, and in the last resort. At 1280×800 on /clients in Spanish the chip lands at (1184,720), off the address.
- The chip keeps the spot it has (`placePill({ keep })`: the overlay's `lastPlaceRef`, seeded by REQ-830's carry) while it is as clear as the best spot: kept if nothing is under it; if something is, the first spot with nothing under it wins (text-avoiding beats staying); if no spot is free of everything, the kept spot stays while no control is under it. A kept box that is not one of `tabSpots` is ignored.
- The overlay places the pill again in the next frame when the PAGE changes: a ResizeObserver on `document.body` and a MutationObserver (childList, subtree) on the body, frame-debounced, ignoring mutations inside `[data-demo-overlay]` (no feedback loop) — not only on the 700 ms poll. Any remaining move happens with the page's own change.
**REQ-228 AMENDMENT (cycle dm3) — settles the owner decision left pending by the cycle dm2 REQ-228 AMENDMENT:** the folded mini-pill avoids text: it covers text or a card only when every mini-pill spot has something under it. The whole pill keeps REQ-781/818's rule (step 1 nothing under it; step 3 no control under it, text allowed) — p1 was about the chip.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-tab-spot.test.ts` ("REQ-853 …", 12 cases): the 1280×800 tab spot order; an ES-width footer address under (1184,760) → (1184,720), off the text; text under every tab spot → still the first with no control; a dialog with nowhere to dock prefers the text-free tab spot; a carried tab at (1184,680) over a skeleton with nothing at (1184,760) stays at 680; no carried spot → (1184,760); a kept spot that gained a control is left; a kept spot over text is left for a text-free one; text everywhere → a kept control-free spot stays; a stale kept box is ignored; the overlay passes `keep: kept` from `lastPlaceRef.current?.tucked`, and observes `document.body` with a ResizeObserver and a frame-debounced MutationObserver that skips `[data-demo-overlay]`.
- integration: n/a — front-end placement only: no endpoint, store, peer message or projection changed.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-tab-spot.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-853 …": a real demo with a Spanish customer at 1280×800: on /clients the pill does not overlap `[data-site-address]`; with customers and quotes seeded, after a /dashboard reload the chip, once drawn, never moves; an idle /dashboard is measured about once a poll (≤ 10 placements in 3 s — the observers do not feed themselves); a button drawn under the chip moves it off within 3 frames, 5 times).
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm3-pill-tab-spot off origin/demo-fixes 5fef7e6d):**
- RED first. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pill-tab-spot` → "Tests: 7 failed, 5 passed, 12 total" (the 5 passes are the guard cases that already hold): the ES footer case "Expected top 720, Received 760"; the dialog case "Expected top 720, Received 760"; the carried case "Expected top 680, Received 760"; the wiring cases "Expected pattern: /keep:\s*kept/", "Expected pattern: /new MutationObserver\(/". e2e on base pill.ts + DemoModeOverlay.tsx: `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-tab-spot.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ … p1: /clients ES at 1280×800 — the pill ({"left":1184,"top":760,"right":1252,"bottom":792}, tucked true) is not over the footer address ({"left":1008,"top":772,"right":1251,"bottom":796}) — expected false, got true" (demo 3's exact numbers); with the p1 assertion skipped, "✗ … p8: a control drawn under the chip moves it off within 3 frames (not at the 700 ms poll) — took [{"ms":407,"frames":4},{"ms":119,"frames":3},{"ms":263,"frames":3},{"ms":178,"frames":2},{"ms":852,"frames":19}]".

## REQ-849 — The customer's pill shown out of its edge tab keeps PILL_MARGIN (12 px) from the window's edges like every other spot, and the pointer that opened it keeps it whole from the gap (demo-loop cycle dm3, issue p14) — AMENDMENT of REQ-818 / REQ-545
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd), issue **p14** "Customer's expanded pill sits flush (0 px margin, 0.08 px past the edge) against the right edge at the bottom, while top-right keeps 12 px" (demo 4 on /invoices: x 836–1280.08; on /welcome the top-right spot sat at 863–1268). RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH, at 5fef7e6d.
**Cause (RCA):** the bottom-right box is the PEEK (the whole pill out of the folded right-edge tab), not a `pillSpots` spot. `peekBox` (shared/demo-mode/pill.ts) used `max = view.w - w` with no margin and `flush = max` for a right-edge tab (0 for a left-edge one), "so the pointer that opened it is on it" (REQ-545/818). `pillSpots` keeps PILL_MARGIN (1280 − 12 − 444 = 824). The extra 0.08 px: the overlay measured the pill's width with `el.offsetWidth` (444, an integer) while the real box was 444.08 px.
**Requirement:** the peek keeps PILL_MARGIN from both window edges: at the right margin for a right-edge tab, at the left margin for a left-edge one, centred over a tab along the bottom but never closer than the margin, and every place it slides to off a control (REQ-818) stays inside the margins. The pointer that opened it may now rest in the 12 px gap, on the tab's old box. The peek's hold region is the pill plus the tab's box: the fold timer (REQ-820 `peekTimer`) keeps waiting while a mouse/pen pointer is anywhere in that region, and a pointer that was in it and leaves it folds the pill after 300 ms, as leaving the pill does. The pill's width is measured as `Math.ceil(getBoundingClientRect().width)`, so it never ends past its margin.
**Implementation:** `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`: `peekBox` clamps to `[PILL_MARGIN, view.w − PILL_MARGIN − w]` (the steps start at the margin), and a new pure `peekHolds({ pill, tab, x, y })` says whether a point is in the pill ∪ tab box. `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`: `peekTabRef` (the tucked tab's box, set in place()) and `pointRef` (the last mouse/pen point); the fold timer's `held` adds `peekHolds(…)` while peeked; a `[peek]` effect tracks `pointermove` (touch ignored) and arms the 300 ms fold when the pointer leaves the region; `fullRef.w = Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().width)`.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-peek-edge-margin.test.ts` ("REQ-849 …": right-edge tab → right edge ≤ view.w − margin and equal to `pillSpots`' right column (1268); left-edge tab → left = 12; bottom tabs near either edge inside the margins; every control-slid place inside the margins; `peekHolds` true in the gap beside the tab, true on the pill, false away and above the tab, false with no tab / no pointer; overlay wiring: `Math.ceil(….width)` for `fullRef`, `held` uses `peekHolds`). Amended (REQ-818's flush numbers): `jest/unit/demo-pill-control-fallback.test.ts` (left 0 → PILL_MARGIN, right edge view.w → view.w − PILL_MARGIN), `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-in-view.test.ts` (peek left 875 → 863), `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-geometry.test.ts` (818 → 806, 1589 → 1577).
- integration: n/a — front-end placement only; no endpoint, store or wire change (the pill's rect is still sent the same way).
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-peek-edge-margin.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-849 …": the customer on /customers at 1280×800, the pill folded to its edge tab; a real pointer onto the tab, then to its outer end 3 px from the edge, resting 8 s: no refold, every whole frame ≥ 12 px from both edges, the pointer in the gap outside the pill's real box; leaving folds it).
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm3-peek-edge-margin off origin/demo-fixes 5fef7e6d):**
- RED (unit): `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-pill-peek-edge-margin` → "Tests: 9 failed, 9 total" (`Expected: <= 1268 Received: 1280`; `Expected: 12 Received: 0`; `Expected: >= 12 Received: 0` ×2; the gap precondition `Expected: > 1280 Received: 1276`; `peekHolds is not a function` ×2; the two wiring patterns not found).
- RED (e2e, base pill.ts + overlay, own serve PORT=57923): `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> BASE_URL=http://localhost:57923 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-peek-edge-margin.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → "✗ REQ-849 … expectation failed: every whole frame keeps 12 px from the window's edges (vw 1280) — 4289:756-1280 4520:756-1280 …".
- GREEN: unit `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-|pill'` → "Test Suites: 85 passed, 85 total · Tests: 989 passed, 989 total". e2e (fixed tree, own serve PORT=57933) → "✓ REQ-849 … · 49.4s"; the neighbouring REQ-820 story `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-peek-hold.e2e.test.ts` → "✓ REQ-820 … · 76.4s". `front-end` `deno test -A` on `lib/demo-ended-sticky-ssr`, `demo-pill-first-paint`, `demo-end-ask-viewer`, `demo-pointer-above-pill` → all ok. `deno lint` + `deno check islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx` clean; `deno fmt` clean on every touched file (all clean at base).

## REQ-854 — A reload of the customer's page with the pill folded never flashes the whole pill's words in the stage's ghost: the stage's guess keeps the old page's fold (demo-loop cycle dm3, p6) — REQ-636 AMENDMENT
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." The box was left as the folded tab's, so the ghost's whole-pill branch (`pillFace.tucked !== true`) drew "title | line | Connecting… | End" inside the 96x32 tab until the new page's own folded face replaced it (GUESSED, REQ-822). ## REQ-636 AMENDMENT (REQ-854) — the stage's awaiting guess keeps the old page's fold

## REQ-850 — A customer's cursor left outside a window she narrowed leaves the stage; the stage never draws it past the frame's edge, and a re-send of the same spot does not wake its tag (demo-loop cycle dm3, p10) — AMENDMENT of REQ-305 and REQ-374
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd, demo-report.md section 3a), issue **p10** "After the customer narrows the window, the stage draws the customer's cursor past the frame's edge; its label turns from ML to the full name" (fleet-r02524ccd-3/stdout:102: last mouse x ≈ 1200 at 1280 wide; after the resize to 390 the stage drew "Maria Lopez" at x ≈ 800, past the frame's right edge 799; the tag changed from "ML" to "Maria Lopez"). RCA: analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH, at 5fef7e6d; introduced by bc47624e (REQ-305).
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `DemoModeOverlay.tsx` replace() (run on resize) re-sent the resting pointer whenever its anchor changed. The rest (x 1200) was now outside the 390 px viewport, so `elementsFromPoint` found nothing and `pointToFrac` clamped it to vx = 1. No `leave` was sent for a cursor no longer in the viewport. (2) On the stage, `placeOnStage` → `placeIn(fracToPoint(vx=1))` landed exactly on the frame's right edge, which `outsideBox` counts as inside, so the 24 px arrow was drawn from the edge outward. (3) `DemoPointer`'s idle effect depended on the pointer object, so the re-send reset the tag to its full name.
**Requirement:**
- Customer side: a resting pointer outside this viewport (`inViewport`, `front-end/lib/demo-mode/pointer-anchor.ts`: right and bottom edges exclusive) is not on her screen. replace(), the throttle's (trailing) send and `resendPointer` send `{k:"leave"}` and clear `lastMoveRef`/`sentRef` (`dropRest`) instead of a clamped fraction.
- Stage side (guard): `placeAnchorIn(a, p, box, arrow)` (`shared/demo-mode/motion.ts`) draws a fraction-only anchor at vx or vy ≥ 1 like REQ-393's off anchor: pulled inside the frame by `ARROW_BOX`, marked outside. `DemoStage.placeOnStage` uses it. Anchors with a node, and inside points, are placed as before.
- `DemoPointer` resets the tag's idle state on `idleKey(pointer, outside)`, which covers a new x/y or an edge toggle. A new object for the same spot leaves a resting tag at rest. REQ-374 AMENDMENT: "any re-placement" now means a new spot or an edge toggle.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-customer-cursor-offview.test.ts` ("REQ-850 (demo-loop cycle dm3, p10) …", 9 cases): `inViewport` at the edges and at the old x 1200; replace(), the throttle and resendPointer wired to `inViewport`/`dropRest` before any re-send; `dropRest` clears the refs and sends leave; `placeAnchorIn` at vx = 1 and vy = 1 keeps the whole arrow inside the 481–799 frame, marked outside; inside, node and `o` anchors unchanged; DemoStage wired; `idleKey` is equal for a same-spot new object and differs for a move or an edge toggle; DemoPointer's effect is keyed on it. Amended: `jest/unit/demo-mode-pointer-look.test.ts` (REQ-374 deps check) and `jest/unit/demo-mode-pointer-anchor.test.ts` (REQ-305 placeOnStage and replace() regexes).
- integration: n/a. Front-end and shared logic only, with no endpoint, store or wire-format change (`leave` already exists). The idle effect is client-only, and SSR render tests cannot run it; the existing DemoPointer SSR tests (`front-end/lib/demo-pointer-*.test.tsx`, 53 cases) still pass.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-customer-cursor-offview.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-850 …"). The customer, at 1280 × 860 on /dashboard, rests her mouse at x 1200 until the stage's tag is at rest. She narrows to 390 × 844 with the browser's synthetic pointerleave held back: headless Chromium fakes one on the re-layout, and the fleet's real run had none. The stage must drop her pointer within 5 s and keep it gone for 3 s.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm3-customer-cursor-offview off origin/demo-fixes 5fef7e6d):**
- RED. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-customer-cursor-offview` → "Tests: 9 failed, 9 total" (`inViewport`/`placeAnchorIn`/`idleKey` not functions; the overlay, stage and pointer wiring patterns not found). e2e on the base sources (`PORT=57863 deno task serve`; `BASE_URL=http://localhost:57863 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-customer-cursor-offview.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check`) → "✗ … timed out: REQ-850: her pointer leaves the stage … (still drawn: arrow 812.82–836.82 (frame right 812.81), idle true, tag "AT")". That is the p10 picture: the arrow starts on the frame's right edge and hangs past it.
- GREEN. The same unit file gave "Tests: 9 passed". `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-|pointer|motion'` → "Test Suites: 87 passed · Tests: 998 passed". `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/demo-pointer-*.test.tsx lib/demo-click-wave*.test.tsx lib/demo-chevron-offset-shared.test.tsx lib/demo-stage-pointer-tag.test.tsx` → "ok | 53 passed". The e2e with the fix passed 3 of 3 runs ("✓ … 6.5s / 49.7s / 16.5s"). An earlier, stricter version of the story failed on any sample drawn past the edge. It passed 1 of 2 runs: in one it caught the old arrow for a moment, after the frame had already refit and while the leave was still in flight. The story now waits up to 5 s for the leave. `deno lint` and `deno check` (DemoModeOverlay, DemoStage, DemoPointer, pointer-anchor, motion) are clean. `deno fmt --check` is clean on every touched TS file and the new unit test. The e2e file follows e2e/'s long-line convention.

## REQ-848 — On the stage, tags avoid the customer's text in the frame; no in-frame "not shown" pill; the stage's copy of the customer's resting tag is see-through (demo-loop cycle dm3, m4 + p9) — AMENDMENT of REQ-813 and REQ-837
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd), issues **m4** ("Stage's dashed 'You · not shown' tag and hollow arrow are drawn over the customer's text in the frame") and **p9** ("Customer's own 'ML' cursor on the stage covers frame content"); RCA + skeptic CONFIRMED (corrected mechanism), judge BUG_POLISH.
**Cause (RCA, at 5fef7e6d):** every tag on the stage was placed with `coverage(document)`. Over the frame, `elementFromPoint` returns the transparent click-capture `div[data-cy=demo-stage-layer]` (DemoStage.tsx) above the `pointer-events:none` iframe, so `contentAt` never entered the replay: every candidate scored 0 and `tagPlacement` kept the first (tail) slot, over 'Replace Kitchen Faucet' (m4) and the day '20' / 'Keep going' (p9). On top, REQ-813 always drew a white, dashed "You · not shown" pill while absent (redundant with the chrome-row `demo-pointer-absent` banner), and REQ-633's resting tag is opaque.
**Requirement:** the stage's tags (the customer's pointer, his own marker, his ghost) are placed by a hit-test of the REPLAY: stage px mapped to the replay's px ((x - fit.left) / fit.s) and tested in the iframe's document (`frameCoverage`, DemoPointer.tsx), handed in as `covers` (`coversFrame` in DemoStage). While absent his own marker is the faint hollow arrow only — no in-frame label. The stage's copy of the customer's resting tag rests at `STAGE_TAG_REST_OPACITY` (0.6), a per-instance `restTagOpacity` on DemoPointer; the presenter's arrow on the customer's own screen keeps REQ-633's opaque tag (default `TAG_REST_OPACITY` = 1).
**Tests:**
- unit: `front-end/lib/demo-stage-covers-frame.test.tsx` ("REQ-848 …": `frameCoverage` sees the replay's text where `coverage(stage document)` scores 0; with text under the tail slot OwnMarker's and PointerGhost's tag move to a free slot; absent renders no label and keeps the hollow arrow; `pointerLook(resting, restTag)` with the default still 1). Amended: `front-end/components/demo-mode/OwnPointer.test.tsx` (REQ-813's absent tests now assert no label), `jest/unit/demo-stage-own-pointer-absent.test.ts` (OwnPointer is no longer passed `absentLabel`).
- integration: `front-end/lib/demo-stage-covers-frame.test.tsx` ("REQ-848 … integration": DemoStage hands `covers={coversFrame}` to its DemoPointer, OwnPointer and PointerGhost, `restTagOpacity={STAGE_TAG_REST_OPACITY}` to the customer's DemoPointer, no `absentLabel=`; DemoPointer's painter uses the `covers` it is given).
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-scroll-pointer.e2e.test.ts`, REQ-813's step in the "next page" story now also requires no `demo-pointer-own-label` inside the absent marker.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm3-stage-covers-frame off origin/demo-fixes 5fef7e6d):**

## REQ-851 — At narrow widths the stage's copy of End's open question draws the customer's rows: the question and both answers are ONE group, as EndDemo lays them out (demo-loop cycle dm3, p3) — REQ-835 AMENDMENT
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd), issue **p3** "At narrow widths the stage copy of the End question wraps into 3 rows where the customer's has 2" (fleet-r02524ccd-3/stdout:98-99: customer 2 rows, ~87 px, "Sí, terminar" and "Seguir" beside the question; stage 3 rows — header, question, answers; fleet-r02524ccd-0 the same at 560 px). BUG_CONTRADICTION, RCA CONFIRMED and skeptic CORRECTED at 5fef7e6d. A dm2 fix that did not hold: REQ-835 promised the ghost "wraps like it".
**Cause (RCA):** EndDemo (front-end/components/demo-mode/EndDemo.tsx:138-170) puts the question, Yes and Keep going in ONE `span[data-cy=demo-end-ask]` (`display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap`), and `ownRow` gives that GROUP `flex-basis:100%;min-width:0`. The stage (front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx ~2075-2098) drew the three as sibling flex items of the ghost, and REQ-835's `ghostFlow().ask` (`flex:1 0 100%`, shared/demo-mode/pill.ts:782, commented "the question takes a row of its own, its answers under it (EndDemo's ownRow)") gave the full row to the question alone, so the answers always fell to a third row. REQ-835's e2e asserted `yesBelowAsk === true`, which locked that layout in, and never compared row counts.
**Requirement:** The stage's ghost of End's question draws the same rows as the customer's pill. The question and both answers are one group (`demo-pill-ghost-asking`) styled by `ghostFlow().ask`, EndDemo's flow: `display:inline-flex;align-items:center` with gap 8 px × the frame's scale; wrapping, `flex-wrap:wrap;flex:0 1 100%;min-width:0` (EndDemo's ownRow: the group takes the row and wraps inside it); one row, `flex-wrap:nowrap;flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0`. The question is `ghostFlow().q` (`flex:0 1 auto`; cut with an ellipsis only on the one-row ghost). The ghost's metrics are the customer pill's × the frame's scale, so the same words break in the same places: padding 12 px, gap 10 px, `justify-content:space-between`; Yes 5×12 px padding, radius 8, 12 px type; Keep going 5×6 px padding, 12 px type. While End asks, the pill's ResizeObserver re-places it at once (clamp + send, `resized`): the wrap reflow changes the size, fires no `transitionend`, and the stage must not keep the pre-wrap box for the 150 ms debounce.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ghost-ask-wrap.test.ts` ("REQ-851 …"): `ghostFlow(true).ask` is the group's flow (inline-flex, wrap, centered, min-width 0, basis 100%) and `q` is `flex:0 1 auto`; the group carries every layout declaration of EndDemo's ownRow span, read from EndDemo.tsx (display, align-items, flex-wrap, min-width, basis 100%); the one-row ghost keeps the group nowrap and cuts only the question; wiring: DemoStage's `demo-pill-ghost-asking` span wraps ask + yes + no, styled `flow.ask`, the question `flow.q`; DemoModeOverlay's pill ResizeObserver runs `resized`, which re-places at once while `demo-end-ask` is up. Amended neighbour: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-geometry.test.ts` (REQ-835's ghostFlow test now expects `flex:0 1 100%` + `flex-wrap:wrap` on the group, not `flex:1 0 100%` on the question).
- integration: n/a — front-end layout only (the ghost's markup and the pill's existing face on the peer link); no endpoint, store or message changed.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-ghost-ask-geometry.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-835 … + REQ-851 (dm3, p3) …"). REQ-835's 1280 → 390 story now narrows to 560, then 390. At each width the ghost is the customer's pill box and its drawn rows (End's group counted by its question and answers, rows by vertical centre) equal hers, with Yes on the question's row exactly when hers is. At 560 Yes must be beside the question on her pill (her 2 rows). `yesBelowAsk === true` is gone.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm3-ghost-ask-wrap off origin/demo-fixes 5fef7e6d, serve on PORT=5737, host load 20-30):**

## REQ-852 — End's open question never covers a control: the asking pill is placed once where no control is (demo-loop cycle dm3, p4) — REQ-228 / REQ-835 AMENDMENT
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd, demo-report.md), issue **p4** "Open pill (End's question) covers top-of-page content: the DocuMonster logo link on /welcome, the EN/ES toggle area on /q". RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION (the REQ-228 AMENDMENT, REQ-781 and REQ-818 promise the customer's pill never covers a CONTROL).
**Cause (RCA, at 5fef7e6d):** End's question widened the pill in place and REQ-835 only pulled it back inside the window. `clampAsk` (front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx) → `askDock` → `keepInView` (shared/demo-mode/pill.ts) count no controls, and `place()` is frozen while End asks (REQ-300). On /welcome at 1280×800 the 444 px pill at the top-right pillSpot (824..1268 × 12..55) grew to 671 px and was pulled to 597..1268, over the centred `<a href="/" class="welcome-shell__brand">` (565..718 × 30..58; fleet-0 stdout:52). The /q EN/ES toggle case (fleet-4:41) fits the same mechanism but is LIKELY only (no y coordinate).
**Requirement:** when End's question comes up, the asking box (measured at its asking size) is placed ONCE where no control of the page is under it: `askSpot` (shared/demo-mode/pill.ts, next to `askDock`) tries the current anchor, the same row anchored at the opposite edge (then the near edge), then the bottom row (home bottom-left, then bottom-right), and takes the first with no control under it (`countControls`, through a dialog's backdrop via `pastBackdrop`), else the one with the fewest (a tie keeps the earlier). Each candidate is laid out by `askDock`, so REQ-835's in-view clamp stays the last step. A clear current anchor keeps the same dock object, and REQ-300's freeze holds after this one placement: `place()`'s asking branch and the resize still only run `clampAsk`.
**Implementation:** `askSpot` in shared/demo-mode/pill.ts; `placeAsk` in DemoModeOverlay.tsx, run by the `[asking]` layout effect right before `clampAsk()`.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-control-aware.test.ts` ("REQ-852 …", 9 cases: the bug reproduced with REQ-835's clamp alone (597..1268 × 12..55 over the brand); the /welcome geometry (brand 565..718 × 30..58, a 444 px top-right pill growing to 671 px) lands bottom-left 12..683 × 749..792; opposite edge of the same row before the bottom row; bottom-right after a blocked bottom-left; a clear anchor keeps its dock object (REQ-300); fewest wins / tie keeps the anchor; kept in view on a 390 phone; the island wiring (`placeAsk(); clampAsk();` in the `[asking]` effect, `askSpot` + `countControls(r, backdrop)`; `place()` never re-chooses while asking)).
- integration: n/a — front-end layout only; no endpoint, store or wire message changes.
- e2e: n/a here — the browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the next demo cycle re-checks /welcome and /q with End's question open (and the RCA's open question: whether /q's overlap was the asking pill).

The bug case passed, proving the 597..1268 overlap at base.

## REQ-847 — The stage's out-of-view cue words sit where the customer's cue does, at any frame scale (demo-loop cycle dm3, p16) — AMENDMENT of REQ-815 / REQ-837
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd), issue **p16** "Stage out-of-view cue sits ~6 px lower (and ~1 px righter) than the customer's cue" (fleet-r02524ccd-2/stdout:64: customer `demo-pointer-cue` at 320,96, stage `demo-pointer-ghost-cue` at 321,102 in customer px, the chevrons both at 314,60; the frame at s ≈ 0.86). The stage overlay is not scaled with the frame, so 36 stage px = 36 / 0.86 ≈ 41.9 customer px (60 + 41.9 ≈ 102 vs 96) and 6 / 0.86 ≈ 7 (321 vs 320). The customer's cue span already reports its placement (`tagRef` → `placeTag` → `onTag` → `placedReport`'s `t`).

Either way, at s = 0.86 the stage cue's top equals the customer's within 1 px. The chevron (REQ-815) and the in-view tag (REQ-837) are unchanged.

- integration: same file — "REQ-847 … integration: customer cue → placedReport → wire → reportedGhost + reportedTag at s=0.86" (the round trip lands the ghost's cue top/left within 1 px of the customer's) and "DemoStage hands its ghost the reported tag in cue mode too, and the frame's scale" (no `tag={ghost.dir ? null`, `tag={ownTag}` and `scale={fit.s}` on PointerGhost).

**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/lib/demo-mode/mirror-replay.ts` `anchorAt` returned the INNERMOST mirrored element with a box under the point (REQ-242, 9484f703). Over a nav label that is `span.nav-item__label`, which `DashSidebar.tsx` takes out of the page when collapsed (`{!collapsed && <span class="nav-item__label">}`). The anchor died, and its print `{t:'span', nm:'Dashboard'}` matched nothing afterwards (`pickByPrint` requires the same tag), so under REQ-645 no arrow was drawn although the same link was still on screen.
**Requirement:** the presenter's anchor is the nearest control around the point (`closest(CONTROL_SELECTOR)` from `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`: `a[href]`, button, input, … role=button/link/tab/…) when that control is mirrored and laid out; its fraction is taken in the control's box and its print is the control's (a link's address included), so a nav link's label leaving the page, or the next page load, keeps or re-finds it. With no control around the point, the innermost mirrored element is the anchor, as before. REQ-645 is otherwise unchanged: an element that is truly gone (after "Lock it in", a dialog closing) and has no one print match draws nothing, with no fallback to his still mouse. REQ-242's "resting pointer re-sent after every snapshot" is SUPERSEDED (already by REQ-645) and is not a test target.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-anchor-control-ancestor.test.ts` ("REQ-845 (demo-loop cycle dm3, m1) …", 3 cases, real recorder → replayer over the fake DOM: over `span.nav-item__label` the anchor and its print are the `<a href>`; after the label span is removed (the collapse, recorded and replayed) the anchor is still live and `pointOf` is on the narrowed link; a point with no control around it anchors its innermost element, and that element removed gives no point — REQ-645 kept). `jest/unit/support/fake-dom.ts` gains `closest()` for CONTROL_SELECTOR's simple selectors.
- integration: n/a — the replay is a front-end module; no endpoint, store or wire change (the anchor's shape on the wire is unchanged).
- e2e: n/a here — the browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the next demo cycle re-checks the sidebar collapse live.

## REQ-844 — An ended stage no longer shows "End demo" before the hop to /admin (demo-loop cycle dm3, issue p13) — AMENDMENT of REQ-235
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm3 (run r02524ccd), issue **p13** ("Ended stage still shows 'End demo' for about 1 s before redirect"). RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH (a label that lies) at 5fef7e6d.
**Cause (RCA):** `DemoStage.end()` sets `ended`, awaits `demoModeClient.end`, then waits 800 ms before `backToOwnAccount` (about 1.1 s in all). The `onEnded` path waits 1500 ms. Throughout, the stage pill rendered `<EndDemo disabled={ended || leavingHere}>` with no `!ended` guard (Leave already had one). Disabled, EndDemo cancels its question and draws the "End demo" button at 0.55 opacity, so the pill read "… The demo ended … End demo" until the redirect.
**Requirement:** the stage pill offers End only while the demo is live. Once `ended` is set, by either path, no `[data-cy=demo-end]` (nor its question) is drawn; the pill's "The demo ended" line stays until the hop to /admin. Implemented as `stageEndShown(ended)` in `shared/demo-mode/stage-chrome.ts`, gating `<EndDemo>` in `front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx` (its `disabled` is now `leavingHere` alone). Unmounting EndDemo calls `onAsking(false)`, so the stage's `endAsking` state is cleared too.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-stage-ended-hides-end.test.ts` ("REQ-844 (dm3 p13) …": `stageEndShown` true only while live; DemoStage's only `<EndDemo>` sits behind `{stageEndShown(ended) && (`; both `end()` and `onEnded` set `ended` before `backToOwnAccount`).
- integration: n/a. Front-end only, no endpoint, store or protocol change; `ended` is client state that an SSR render cannot reach.
- e2e: n/a here. The browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the next demo cycle re-checks the pill after "Yes, end it" live.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm3-ended-hides-end off origin/demo-fixes 5fef7e6d):**
- RED: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-stage-ended-hides-end` → "Tests: 2 failed, 1 passed, 3 total" (`stageEndShown is not a function`; the text before `<EndDemo` was `{/* REQ-235 — End asks first */}`, no guard).
- GREEN: `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-'` → "Test Suites: 85 passed, 85 total · Tests: 983 passed, 983 total". `deno lint` (DemoStage.tsx, stage-chrome.ts) and `deno check islands/DemoStage.tsx` clean; `deno fmt --check` clean on the three touched files.
## REQ-866 — The customer's pill's fallbacks count controls: End's question on /welcome and a whole pill that may not fold never fall back over a control (demo-loop cycle dm4, m2 + m2b) — AMENDMENT of REQ-852 / REQ-781 / REQ-818
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9, demo-report.md), issues **m2** "End's open question still covers the /welcome brand link (REQ-852's fix did not hold)" (fleet-rf5fcb8b9-0 stdout:60: the asking pill at [597,12,671,43] over the brand [562,28,156,34]) and **m2b** "A whole pill that is not allowed to fold falls back to home (bottom-left) over Log out and footer links" (fleet-rf5fcb8b9-3 stdout:83-86: 12,749 444×43 over "Cerrar sesión" and two footer links on /customers, ES, 1280×800, "Aún no hay clientes"). RCA m2 CONFIRMED (skeptic CORRECTED the footer geometry), m2b LIKELY (skeptic UPHELD); judge BUG_CONTRADICTION for both (REQ-852 "never covers a control"; REQ-818 "never the sidebar's Log out").
**Cause (RCA, at 7401e980):** m2 — `askSpot` (shared/demo-mode/pill.ts) tried only five boxes and a tie kept the anchor; on /welcome the brand is under both top-row boxes and the full SiteFooter's centred phone link under both bottom-row boxes, so all tie at 1. REQ-852's unit fixture modelled only the brand. m2b — `placePill` returned `whole(o.home)` blindly for a pill that may not fold (`yields:false` during REQ-821's join grace / REQ-298's restart line, or `floats`), in both the dialog and the non-dialog branch; REQ-818's fewest-controls last resort ran only for folding pills.
**Measured on the real pages (this fix's e2e, 1280×800, ES):** /welcome's asking pill is 912 px wide (status + guide line + question + answers) and every one of REQ-852's boxes held a control (at the anchor [12,589]: "Omitir configuración por ahora"). On /customers with no customers every pillSpot of the 563 px whole pill holds controls — home 3 (Cerrar sesión + 2 footer links), bottom-right 3, bottom-centre 5, top-left 3, top-right 3 — so "the fewest" alone still ties at home; the rows between are needed.
**Requirement:** (1) End's question: when none of REQ-852's five boxes is clear of controls, `askSpot` keeps looking — a centred box in the anchor's row and the bottom row, then the rows between the top and the bottom a pill height plus a gap apart, nearest the anchor's row first, each at the anchor's side, the other side, then centred — and takes the first with no control under it; only when none is clear, the fewest (a tie keeps the anchor, REQ-852). It returns how many controls are under the chosen box. Text under it stays allowed (REQ-228 AMENDMENT / REQ-853). (2) A whole pill that may not fold (no `pillSpots` box free of controls): never home blindly — the rows between (`pillRows`: from home's row up, left edge, right edge, centred), the first with nothing of the page under it, else the first with no control; else the box with the fewest controls (tied, the least of the page under it, then the earlier — home first). The same in the dialog branch (a pillSpot clear of controls first). Folding pills are unchanged (REQ-818/853).
**Implementation:** shared/demo-mode/pill.ts — `askSpot` (generator of tries, `controls` in its result), `pillRows` (new, exported), `placePill`'s `standing()` used by both non-folding fallbacks. No island change: `placeAsk` / `place()` already call these.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ask-control-aware.test.ts` ("REQ-866 …", 12 cases: the bug — with the footer's phone link every REQ-852 box holds a control; /welcome's real geometry (brand [562,28,156,34] + tel link [592,734,96,24]) → the asking box covers no control, in the window, dock consistent, `controls: 0`; rows between tried nearest the anchor first; a centred box when both edges hold a control; nothing clear → fewest, tie keeps the anchor; yields:false with home over Log out → not home; floats → the fewest; dialog with no dock → not home; tied on controls → less of the page wins; a tie on both keeps home; /customers' measured counts (every pillSpot 3) → the clear row between; a row with nothing under it before one with only no control).
- integration: n/a — front-end placement only; no endpoint, store or wire message changes.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-fallback-controls.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-866 … m2 [es]": a new contractor on /welcome at 1280×800 in Spanish opens End's question — no control of the page under the asking pill (sampled through elementsFromPoint, the pill skipped) and both answers in view; "REQ-866 … m2b [es]": a first join on /customers (no customers, the footer at the window's foot) at 1280×800 in Spanish — for the join grace the whole pill never overlaps `.nav-item--logout`).

## REQ-863 — The presenter's demo pill and /admin guide gate on his other tabs speak the language the demo runs in, not his profile's (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue p5) — AMENDMENT of REQ-829 / REQ-855
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". This is demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9, `demo-loop/runs/rf5fcb8b9/demo-report.md`), issue **p5**: "Presenter's demo pill on his other pages opens in the customer's language (ES) while the stage is EN". It re-checks dm3's m6 and finds it NOT_FIXED in demo 3: fleet-rf5fcb8b9-2/stdout:28 shows the pill "Modo demo / Guiando a Maria Lopez" next to /demo/stage?lang=en, and stdout:27 shows the gate "Estás guiando a Maria Lopez en este navegador…". RCA by analyst and skeptic at 7401e980: LIKELY, medium confidence, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-855's `presenterChromeLang` and `adminGateFor` both rank the presenter's language under impersonation by REQ-829's order: this page's `?lang=`, then whoami's `impersonator.language` (the presenter's PROFILE), then `pm_lang`, then en. The stage's English comes from the `?lang=en` carried from /admin?lang=en. A fresh tab (/dashboard, /admin) has no `?lang=`, so an es-profile presenter (a new account is born es) got a Spanish pill and gate beside an English stage. Nothing recorded the language the demo was actually running in.
**Requirement:**
1. Each browser records the presenter's live demo language in the `pm_demo_lang` cookie (`front-end/lib/presenter-lang-rank.ts`: Path=/, SameSite=Lax, 12 h). Three places write it:
   - the /demo middleware, from the stage's explicit `?lang=` (`recordDemoLang`)
   - /admin's guide gate, from its explicit `?lang=` (its EN | ES switch)
   - the presenter pill's EN | ES switch (`persistDemoLang`, next to `persistLang`)
2. While impersonating, `presenterLang` ranks it right after an explicit `?lang=` and before `impersonator.language`. The full order is `?lang=`, then `pm_demo_lang`, then the profile, then `pm_lang`, then en. It feeds the pill (`pageLangCarry`), the guide gate and the stage itself (`presenterCarry`), so a stage reload without `?lang=` keeps the demo's language. On the presenter's own session (not impersonating) it is ignored, and REQ-829 and REQ-855 are unchanged there.
3. An es-profile presenter who started from /admin?lang=en and opens a fresh /dashboard tab reads "Demo mode · Guiding …", and its Back to the demo goes to /demo/stage?lang=en. /admin in that tab reads "You are guiding … in this browser".
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-presenter-live-lang.test.ts` (7 tests, "REQ-863 p5: …"). It covers the ranking (`?lang=` first, then demo, then profile, then pm_lang, then en; demo only while impersonating), the cookie read and write, and source pins: `pageLangCarry` and `presenterCarry` read `pm_demo_lang`, both middlewares call `recordDemoLang`, and the pill's switch calls `persistDemoLang`.
- integration: `front-end/lib/presenter-chrome-lang.test.tsx` has 1 test, "REQ-863 (dm4 p5): …". It renders the real DemoModeOverlay on /dashboard with an es impersonator and `pm_demo_lang=en`, expects an English pill, and expects the hop to /demo/stage?lang=en. `front-end/lib/admin-gate.int.test.ts` has 2 tests. In the first, the real /admin middleware gets an es profile with `pm_demo_lang=en` and should render an English gate whose Back carries en. In the second, /admin?lang=es should set `pm_demo_lang=es`. `front-end/lib/demo-stage-lang.int.test.ts` has 2 tests. In the first, /demo/stage?lang=en should set `pm_demo_lang=en`. In the second, a reload without ?lang= and with the cookie should be English for an es profile.
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-presenter-live-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-863 (cycle dm4, p5): …"). Hans has an es profile and no pm_lang. He presses Demo on /admin?lang=en and gets an English stage. He then opens a fresh tab in the same browser: /dashboard should show the English pill with no Spanish, and /admin should show the English gate.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm4-presenter-live-lang off origin/demo-fixes 7401e980):**
- RED, with the tests written first: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-presenter-live-lang` gave "Tests: 6 failed, 1 passed, 7 total". `cd front-end && deno test -A --unstable-kv lib/demo-stage-lang.int.test.ts lib/admin-gate.int.test.ts` gave "FAILED | 11 passed | 4 failed": no Set-Cookie, a Spanish stage and gate. `deno test -A --unstable-kv lib/presenter-chrome-lang.test.tsx` gave "FAILED | 6 passed | 1 failed", with the pill reading `lang="es"` "Modo demo · Guiando a Maria Lopez · Volver a la demo · Terminar demo", which is the report's symptom. ## REQ-867 — An item hidden in a closed phone drawer is cued "hidden — open the menu ☰", never "scroll ←" (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue m6) — AMENDMENT of REQ-645 / REQ-843
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9, demo-report.md), issue **m6** "A target hidden in the closed phone drawer is cued as 'scroll ←' though nothing can scroll". The customer was at 390×844 on /dashboard. She opened the drawer, the presenter pointed at "Informes", and she closed the drawer (Escape). Her screen then read "Alex señala a la izquierda — desplázate ←" and the stage read "You · pointing to the left — the customer must scroll ←". At that moment "Informes" was at x=-244, document scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth 390, scrollX 0. RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH, at 7401e980.
**Cause (RCA):** `placeView` (shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts, REQ-645 07f2e1dc) takes the out-of-view direction from geometry alone: the point against `visibleBox`. `cueKey` / `ownCueKey` turn any direction into "scroll" words. Nothing checked whether any scroller, or the document, could actually bring the point into view.
**Requirement:** `scrollRoom(el, styleOf)` returns the ways a scroll can still move the element. It counts every ancestor that scrolls on an axis (overflow auto/scroll/overlay) and still has room that way (`scrollLeft > 0` for left, `scrollWidth − clientWidth − scrollLeft > 0` for right, the same for up/down). It also counts the document (the root, or the body's overflow when the root's is visible), unless a fixed ancestor or the element itself is fixed. A bare box with no scroll metrics leaves every way open, as before. When `placeView` gets a box carrying `room` and the way to the point on either axis cannot be scrolled, it marks the direction `hidden`. `cueKey` then gives `demoMode.pointerHidden` ("{name} is pointing at something hidden — open the menu ☰" / "{name} señala algo oculto — abre el menú ☰"), and `ownCueKey` gives `demoMode.pointerGhostCue.hidden` ("pointing at something hidden — the customer must open the menu ☰" / "señalando algo oculto — el cliente debe abrir el menú ☰", with no {name}).
Both sides honour it:
- The customer's `DemoModeOverlay.placeOnScreen` passes `room: scrollRoom(el, styleOf)` with the visible box.
- The stage replay's `clipOf` returns `room` and `visOnStage` keeps it, so colleagues' pointers and `presenterOnStage` also say hidden.
- The customer's placed report carries it on the wire as `d.h: 1`. `parsePlaced` keeps it and `reportedGhost` turns it back into `hidden`, so the stage's own ghost says hidden too.
A way that can be scrolled keeps its scroll cue unchanged.
**Tests:**
- unit: `front-end/lib/demo-scroll-cue-reachable.test.tsx` ("REQ-867 (demo dm4 m6) unit: …", 5 cases):
  - x=-244 in a fixed off-canvas drawer, with scrollWidth==clientWidth and scrollX 0, gets no `pointerLeft` / `pointerGhostCue.left`; it gets `pointerHidden` / `pointerGhostCue.hidden`.
  - An absolute drawer on a page that cannot scroll sideways is hidden. A page scrolled 300 px right keeps "scroll ←".
  - Below the fold of a scrolling page keeps ↓. An inner scroller with room up keeps ↑. The child of a fixed sheet below the screen is hidden.
  - No metrics means as before.
  - en/es carry both keys: the customer's has {name}, the ghost's has none, neither says scroll, and both point at ☰.
- Amended: `jest/unit/demo-pointer-identity.test.ts` REQ-645 `clipOf` now expects `room` (all ways open on the metric-less fake DOM).
- integration: the same file, 2 cases:
  - DemoModeOverlay, mirror-replay `clipOf` and DemoStage `visOnStage` wire `scrollRoom` / `room` into `placeView`.
  - `placedReport` → JSON → `parsePeerMessage` → `reportedGhost` keeps `hidden`, so `ownCueKey` is the hidden key. A scrollable way has no `h` on the wire.
- e2e: n/a here. The demo loop does not run the browser lane per fix (it needs a two-browser demo session). The next demo cycle re-checks the closed drawer live.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm4-scroll-cue-reachable off origin/demo-fixes 7401e980):**
- RED. `scrollRoom` was stubbed to today's behaviour (every way open). `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/demo-scroll-cue-reachable.test.tsx` gave "FAILED | 1 passed | 5 failed": "Values are not equal" (room.left true; dir with no `hidden`), "en lacks demoMode.pointerHidden", and "DemoModeOverlay placeOnScreen does not read the scroll room". Once those passed, the wire case failed alone ("Values are not equal": `reportedGhost` dropped `hidden`).
- GREEN. The same file gave "ok | 7 passed | 0 failed". `deno test -A lib/demo-*.test.tsx components/demo-mode/` gave "ok | 89 passed | 0 failed". `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-'` gave "Test Suites: 94 passed, 94 total · Tests: 1057 passed, 1057 total". `deno lint` and `deno check` are clean on every touched file, and `deno fmt` changes nothing beyond the diff.

## REQ-865 — The stage's ghost of the customer's pill never cuts words she sees whole: laid out at her px with her pill's own styles, then scaled (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue p1) — AMENDMENT of REQ-372 / REQ-540 / REQ-835
**Source:** Raphael, the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9, demo-report.md), issue **p1** "The stage's ghost of the customer pill truncates 'Alex is guiding you' / 'End the demo with Alex?' with an ellipsis at 1280 and 700 wide" (fleet-rf5fcb8b9-4/stdout:92-93: stage "End the demo with Al…", scrollWidth 134 > clientWidth 132; fleet-0/stdout:74-76: the same in ES). RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH, at 7401e980.
**Cause (RCA):** the ghost's box was the customer's measured box × the frame's scale (`pillGhost`), but its insides were rebuilt in `front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx` with other metrics: a `box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px dashed` (3 px of content width; her pill has no border), the status chip at `padding:1px 4px` with the 13·s font (her STATUS_CHIP is 2px 8px at 11.5px), End as a `1px 5px` chip (EndDemo's BTN is 5px 12px at 12px, border 0). Once End's question was up there was no End-chip slack, and the one-row flow (`ghostFlow(false)`, REQ-835/851) took the few px out of the text and the question with an ellipsis.
**Requirement:** the full ghost lays its words out at the CUSTOMER's px with her pill's own styles — `PILL_BOX_METRICS` (gap 10px, padding 7px 12px, font 13px) and `PILL_STATUS_CHIP`, now one definition in `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts` used by both `DemoModeOverlay`'s pill and the ghost; EndDemo's `END_BTN` (= its BTN) for End and Yes, `END_NO` for Keep going, the ask group's 8px gap — in a box of her width (`g.width / fit.s`, her width when uncut), then `transform:scale(fit.s); transform-origin:0 0`. The dashed edge is an `outline` (offset inward), which takes no layout space. The ghost's copies of End/Yes/No stay inert (`pointer-events:none`). `pillGhost` and `ghostFlow` are unchanged: the ghost's box on screen is the same, and the ellipsis stays only as a safety net for a box cut at the frame. With End's question up, at 1280 and 700 wide, in EN and ES, no ghost element has scrollWidth > clientWidth when none of hers does.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-pill-ghost-no-truncation.test.ts` ("REQ-865 …", 4 cases: the shared metrics and status chip are used by the customer's pill; the ghost has no layout border, an outline instead; its box is `width:${lw}px` with `lw = g.width / fit.s`, `${PILL_BOX_METRICS}`, `transform:scale(${fit.s})`, origin 0 0, no `13/12/5 * fit.s` metrics; status/End/Yes/No use PILL_STATUS_CHIP / END_BTN / END_NO, inert, ask gap 8px; EndDemo's `END_NO` equals Keep going's drawn style).
- integration: n/a — front-end layout only; no endpoint, store or wire change (the face and rect sent to the stage are unchanged).
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-ghost-no-truncation.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-865 (demo-loop cycle dm4, p1): EN — …" and "… ES — …": a super admin presents to Ana at 1280×800; Ana taps End; her pill's words are whole, and no element of the stage's ghost has scrollWidth > clientWidth; then her window narrows to 700 with the question still up, and the same holds).
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm4-ghost-pill-truncation off origin/demo-fixes 7401e980; server `PORT=5467 deno task serve`, `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> BASE_URL=http://localhost:5467 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run <story> -- --no-check`):**

## REQ-861 — The /settings mailing-address street line suggests addresses like every other address field (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue setup-2)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9), issue **setup-2** "No address suggestions or map on /settings address field" (fleet-rf5fcb8b9-2/stdout:40/79: typed "123 Congress Ave" on /settings#address, "no address suggestions or map appeared").
**Cause (RCA, analyst + skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH, at 7401e980):** the tester guessed a missing maps key; that guess is wrong. `AddressEditCard` (front-end/islands/SettingsPage.tsx) was plain `<input type="text">` fields with autosave (49a5d6ca, ad0e8c3b) and never called `suggestAddresses` / `/api/geocode`, so even with MAPBOX_TOKEN set nothing would appear. Harness note (demo-loop/ISSUE-RULES.md): the demo VMs have no MAPBOX_TOKEN, so `/api/geocode` returns no rows there and only the "Use as typed" row can show; real Mapbox rows need a token.

## REQ-862 — The stage's picker chip (date / file) sits on or beside its control, never over the text under it, and is set in the app's font (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue p7) — AMENDMENT of REQ-827
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9), issue **p7** "Stage picker chips (date/file) cover customer-visible text and use a monospace font" (fleet-rf5fcb8b9-4/stdout item 2: the file chip at (271,455.5, 238×26) covered "APP LANGUAGE" (y 465.5–483.4); the date chip at (759,545.6, 145×26) covered the "November 16, 2026" helper line). RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH at 7401e980.
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-827 hung the chip *under* the field: `drawLists` placed it with REQ-638's `place()` (top = the control's bottom, flipped above only off-viewport) plus CHIP_CSS's `margin:4px 0 0`, with no regard for the frame text below it — the next field's label, the date's helper line. CHIP_CSS hard-coded `font:600 13px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif`, a family the app (Inter body / Nunito headings) uses nowhere; on the VMs' headless Linux Chromium system-ui falls back to a monospace-looking face. `drawList` copies the select's computed font; `drawChip` did not.
**Requirement:** the chip for an open date picker or file chooser (front-end/lib/demo-mode/mirror-replay.ts `placeChip`) is vertically centred on its control's own row and placed: on the control, centred, when it fits inside the control's width; else beside it at the right edge + 8 px when that fits in the frame; else at the left edge − 8 px; else centred on the control, clamped inside the frame. It is never dropped below the control onto the next line. Its font is the frame body's computed family (the app's), falling back to `"Inter","Nunito",system-ui,…`; weight 600, 13 px, no margin. Select lists (REQ-638 `drawList` + `place`) are unchanged. REQ-827's "under the field" now reads "on or beside the field".
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-mirror-picker-open.test.ts` — new block "REQ-862 (cycle dm4, p7) …": a 140 px date chip on a 160 px input sits centred on it (left 20, top 22) and clear of the helper line under it; a 238 px file chip by a 120 px label button sits beside it (left 138 = right + 8, top 105) and overlaps none of the page's controls nor the label under it; no room on the right → left edge − 8 (554); no room anywhere → centred, clamped to the frame (left 0); the chip's style carries the frame body's family when it has one, `"Inter",…` when not, and never the system-ui stack. REQ-827's three position assertions amended to the new placement.
- integration: n/a — front-end-only replay drawing; no endpoint, store or protocol change (the recorder's mark and frames are unchanged).
- e2e: `e2e/demo-mode/demo-picker-open.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-827 (cycle dm2, s1) + REQ-862 (cycle dm4, p7): …") — real Chromium, real recorder → real replayer frame, with a "November 16, 2026" helper under the date input and an "APP LANGUAGE" label under the logo button: each chip is centred on its control's row, its rect does not intersect the text under the control (a Range over it), and its computed font-family equals the frame body's and does not start with system-ui.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm4-picker-chip-placement off origin/demo-fixes 7401e980):**

## REQ-860 — The stage's tag and out-of-view cue stay inside the frame; no "You" tag in the frame while his mouse is beside it (demo-loop cycle dm4, issues m5 + p6) — AMENDMENT of REQ-837 / REQ-847
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9), issues **m5** "Stage 'pointing below' cue spills ~30 px past the frame's right edge" (report: cue right edge 1220.7 vs frame right 1190.4; English stage words 333 vs Spanish customer words 244 frame px) and **p6** "Stage 'You' tag drawn inside the frame over the customer footer while presenter's mouse is below the frame" (fleet-rf5fcb8b9-3/stdout: mouse (1000,873), frame bottom 830, tag at ~(1016,816)). dm3 m4 (REQ-848) only partly fixed p6.
**Cause (RCA, analyst + skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH, at 7401e980):** both share one root. `alignTag` (shared/demo-mode/presenter-anchor.ts) applies the customer's reported tag offset and keeps her left edge, and it never clamps to a box. m5: REQ-847 passes the customer's tag to PointerGhost in cue mode too, and her shorter Spanish words leave room that the stage's English words run past. p6: OwnMarker is drawn at his real, unpinned point below the frame, while the customer's tag offset was measured above her arrow, which was pinned inside her window. 873 − 57 lands inside the frame.
**Requirement:** (1) `alignTag(tag, own, at, bounds)` keeps the edge facing the arrow and shifts the placed tag back TAG_EDGE inside `bounds`. A tag beside the arrow (right/left, or above/below on y) that the shift would push over the arrow goes to the arrow's other side. (2) PointerGhost passes `cueBox ?? bounds` for a cue and `bounds` otherwise. (3) OwnMarker passes its `bounds` (the fitted frame). While his point is outside those bounds, it draws no "You" tag, because the chrome-row "Your pointer is off … screen" hint already says so. His marker arrow is still drawn where his mouse is.
**Tests:**
- unit: `front-end/lib/demo-stage-tag-clamp.test.tsx` ("REQ-860 (demo dm4 m5) unit: alignTag keeps a wider label inside the box it is given"; "REQ-860 (demo dm4 p6) unit: inside the frame, his 'You' tag stays where the customer's is, clamped into the frame").
- integration: same file ("REQ-860 (demo dm4 m5) integration: an ES customer's reported cue + the stage's EN words near the right edge stays inside the frame", which renders PointerGhost; "REQ-860 (demo dm4 p6) integration: his mouse at (1000,873) below a frame whose bottom is 830 puts no 'You' tag inside the frame", which renders OwnMarker).
- e2e: n/a. The demo loop does not run the two-browser lane per fix; the next demo cycle re-checks it live.
**Evidence (2026-11-16, Mac host, worktree fix-cdm4-stage-tag-clamp off origin/demo-fixes 7401e980):**

## REQ-864 — /admin's Demo button keeps saying Opening… until the page moves (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue p8) — AMENDMENT of REQ-179
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle dm4 (run rf5fcb8b9), issue **p8** ("'Opening…' on the /admin Demo button lasts ~28 ms, then reverts to 'Demo' before the stage opens"). RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_CONTRADICTION at 7401e980.
**Cause (RCA):** `AdminPage.demo()` cleared `busyId` in `finally` the moment `demoModeClient.start` answered (d226b76f, REQ-179), but leaving /admin is the overlay's job afterwards: `placePresenter` awaits whoami, then `adminClient.impersonate`, then `location.assign(stageHref(…))`. fleet-0 saw "65 ms Opening… (disabled)", "93 ms Demo", "113 ms Demo (disabled)" (the impersonation lock), stage at 321 ms, while the overlay pill said Opening… throughout.
**Requirement:** once Demo is clicked, the row's button reads Opening… (disabled) until the page moves to the stage. It goes back to Demo only when start fails or when the overlay's placing ends without moving (whoami/impersonate failed). Implemented as `openDemo()` in `front-end/lib/demo-mode/open-demo.ts` (AdminPage.demo calls it; no `finally` clear), a new `DEMO_PLACE_FAILED_EVENT = "pm:demo-place-failed"` in `front-end/clients/demo-mode.ts`, dispatched by `placePresenter` in `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx` when it ends without moving. The busy row now outlives the impersonation lock, so the label stays Opening… under it.

## REQ-859 — Opening "What they'll get" never moves the Send dialog: the clicked summary stays under the cursor (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue m4)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." RCA NOT_A_BUG for the pointer, skeptic UPHELD, judge BUG_POLISH, at 7401e980.
**Cause (RCA):** the stage drew her cursor where her mouse really was (the pointer is element-anchored; DemoModeOverlay `replace()` re-sends a still cursor when the page moves under it). Opening "What they'll get" grows it downward only: the summary just clicked stays under the cursor, and the dialog stays on screen. No pointer code changes.

- unit: n/a — the defect is layout (a stylesheet laid out by a browser); a unit test could only grep the CSS text.

## REQ-857 — An ended stage pill keeps only "Demo mode" and "The demo ended" until the hop to /admin (demo-loop cycle dm4, issue p10) — AMENDMENT of REQ-844
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." The pill's live fragment was gated only on `!endAsking`: the "Guiding {name}" span with the customer dot, `<PresenterChips>` and the `{mirrored && …demo-screen…}` label had no `ended` guard, while Use here, Leave, the asking chip and (REQ-844) End did.

The presenting line (and customer dot), the presenter chips and the "{name}'s screen" label are drawn only while the demo is live. Implemented as `stageLiveDetailsShown(ended)` in `shared/demo-mode/stage-chrome.ts`, gating those three in `front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx`.
**Tests:**
- unit: `jest/unit/demo-stage-ended-pill-past-tense.test.ts` ("REQ-857 (dm4 p10) …": `stageLiveDetailsShown` true only while live; the presenting span, `<PresenterChips>` and `data-cy="demo-screen"` sit behind `stageLiveDetailsShown(ended)`; the status chip is not behind it).
- integration: n/a. Front-end only, no endpoint, store or protocol change; `ended` is client state that an SSR render cannot reach.
- e2e: n/a here. The browser lane is not run per fix in the demo loop; the next demo cycle re-checks the pill after "Yes, end it" live.
