## REQ-932 — HR never sends a 0-document packet, and a hire holding one is never stranded (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-18)
**Source:** Raphael, LOOP-007: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q1-18** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION]: HR lets the owner send a 0-document packet; the new hire lands on a dead end. Amends REQ-884a.
**Root cause (RCA at 16e7e33e):** nothing checks for an empty packet at any layer. `createHire` (`backend/src/hr/entrypoints/hr-controllers/mod.ts`) mints `packet: mintPacket(dept, docs)`, which returns `[]` when the department has no docIds or all of them are discarded, stores the hire as "invited" and, with `autoSend` on, `sendTo()` texts and emails the link; `sendTo()` (the Resend path) has no check either. `allDone([])` is false by design, so such a hire can never reach signed and provisioning answers 409 not_signed. `HrNewHirePage` shows the `hr-packet-empty` hint but leaves Create & send enabled; `HrSignPacket` shows the "about five minutes" intro, "· 0 documents" and a disabled Let's go with no explanation. All introduced in a12a9135 (REQ-883..889).
**Requirement:** (a) `POST /hr/hires` into a department whose minted packet is empty (no documents, or only discarded ones) is refused `409 packet_empty`; no hire is stored and no SMS or email goes out. (b) `POST /hr/hires/:id/send` on a hire whose packet is empty is refused `409 packet_empty` and sends nothing. (c) /hr/hires/new keeps `hr-create` disabled while the picked department's packet is empty, and the `hr-packet-empty` hint links to `/hr/departments` or `/hr/documents`. (d) /sign/:token with an empty packet shows an empty state (`data-cy="hrs-empty"`), with no "about five minutes" copy and no disabled Let's go.
**Tests:** unit n/a — `mintPacket` correctly returns `[]`; the defect is the missing guard in the controller and islands, covered at int + e2e · int `backend/src/hr/entrypoints/hr-empty-packet.int.test.ts` ("REQ-932 (q1-18): …" ×3: doc-less department → 409 nothing stored/sent; only-discarded-doc department → 409; legacy empty-packet hire resend → 409 nothing sent) · e2e `e2e/hr-empty-packet/hr-empty-packet.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-932 (q1-18): …" ×2: Create & send disabled + link to add documents; legacy empty packet on /sign shows `hrs-empty`, no five-minutes, no dead Let's go). The fixer must also give IDS a document in `hr.int.test.ts`'s REQ-884c expiry setup (it currently creates Marcus with `packet == []`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-18, cycle 1):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/entrypoints/hr-empty-packet.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (`got 201` / `got 201` / `got 200`, expected 409); `shots run e2e/hr-empty-packet -- --no-check` → both red: "Create & send is disabled while the packet is empty — expected true, got false" and "no 'about five minutes' promise for an empty packet — expected false, got true".
**Fix (cycle 1):** `hr-controllers/mod.ts` gains `assertSendable(packet)` (409 `packet_empty`, "this department has no documents to sign yet"); `createHire` runs it right after `mintPacket` (before anything is stored or sent) and `sendTo()` runs it first, so neither autoSend nor Resend ever sends an empty packet. `HrNewHirePage` disables `hr-create` while the picked department's packet is empty and the `hr-packet-empty` hint links to `/hr/departments` (`hr.new.packetEmptyFix`); `hr.new.err.packet_empty` maps the 409 through `friendlyHr`. `HrSignPacket` replaces the five-minutes intro and document count with `hrs-empty` (`hr.sign.empty`: "Nothing to sign yet. {company} will send your paperwork soon.") and renders no Let's go when the packet is empty. New strings in en + es. `hr.int.test.ts` REQ-884c: IDS now gets the Welcome document before Marcus is hired (it used to assert `packet == []`, which the guard now refuses); the expiry/re-issue/reminder assertions are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-18, cycle 1):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/hr/entrypoints/hr-empty-packet.int.test.ts src/hr/entrypoints/hr.int.test.ts src/hr/domain/business/onboarding/test.ts src/hr/entrypoints/systems-controller/int.test.ts` → `ok | 17 passed | 0 failed` (the 3 REQ-932 tests + REQ-883..889 end-to-end); `deno check` on the controller and both int tests → clean. `SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=400000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/hr-empty-packet -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-932 (q1-18): a department with no documents keeps Create & send disabled, with a link to add documents · 60.1s` and `✓ REQ-932 (q1-18): a legacy hire with an empty packet sees an honest empty state … · 22.2s`. `cd front-end && deno check islands/HrNewHirePage.tsx islands/HrSignPacket.tsx` → clean; `deno lint` → only the existing `react-no-danger` on HrSignPacket's document body, which was already there at HEAD. jest unit `hr-module`, `i18n-dictionary-consistency`, `a2p-panel` → PASS. en/es: 6279 keys each, last key still `comms.a2p.sys.house`.

## REQ-946 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-19: a one-line quote's email names its work
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issue q1-19 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION]: "Single-line quote email has no work description, though its intro promises line items below."
**Root cause:** in `send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` the quote email shows its Job details block only when `quote.description` is set, and its "What we handle" line-item block only when there is more than one line or a line with qty > 1 (P-51, commit 16385a4ab, on the grounds that "the Job details block above already covers the scope"). Assistant and quick-quote flows put the scope in the single line and leave `description` empty, so a one-line qty-1 quote fails both gates: the customer reads "Quick read — line items below…" / "Lectura rápida — las partidas abajo…" and then only the total. The invoice email (`renderInvoiceHtml`) has the same pair of gates.
**Requirement:** when no Job details block renders, the quote and invoice emails still show the line items (the work), so the intro's promise holds; a one-line qty-1 quote with a description keeps its Job details block.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/single-line-scope.test.ts` ("REQ-946 (q1-19) …": es + en, quote and invoice HTML name the line and show the whatWeHandle label; with a description the Job details block stays) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/single-line-scope.int.test.ts` ("REQ-946 (q1-19) send-paperwork-email …": the real send flow's captured htmlBody, quote and invoice, es + en) · e2e `e2e/single-line-quote-email/single-line-quote-email.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-946 (q1-19) …": email the quote to a Spanish customer, open it from the Outbox, the frame names "Cambio de piso de cocina").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-18, at 16e7e33e):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv` on the unit + int files → `FAILED | 2 passed | 8 failed` (`the only line — the whole scope of work — is missing from the email`, `the invoice email for the one-line quote never names the work`, `the sent quote email never names the work "Cambio de piso de cocina"`); the 2 passing are the with-description guards. `shots run e2e/single-line-quote-email -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-946 (q1-19) … expectation failed: the email she got names the work "Cambio de piso de cocina"`.
**Fix:** `renderQuoteHtml` and `renderInvoiceHtml` now compute `hasJobDetails = descLines.length > 0` (the Job details block renders only for real scope text, not a whitespace-only description) and `showLineItems = !hasJobDetails || lines > 1 || some qty > 1`. So a lone qty-1 line is hidden only when the Job details block actually rendered; with no description the line IS the scope and always shows under "What we handle" / "Esto es lo que haremos".
**Test correction (e2e):** the story's last check read the frame's `innerText` for "Esto es lo que haremos", but that label sits in a `text-transform:uppercase` div and Playwright's `innerText` returns the rendered "ESTO ES LO QUE HAREMOS" (screenshot 010-click.png of the run showed the block present). It now compares lowercased text; it still requires the label.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-18):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/single-line-scope.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/single-line-scope.int.test.ts` → `ok | 10 passed | 0 failed`. `BASE_URL=http://localhost:57311 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/single-line-quote-email -- --no-check` (own `PORT=57311 deno task serve`) → `✓ REQ-946 (q1-19) … names its work in the email she gets (opened from the Outbox) · 1.6s` (1 pass · 0 fail). Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/` → `ok | 60 passed | 0 failed`; render-numbers, customer-branding, customer-language, outbox, send-languages-lock int + agents send-quote/ + send-invoice/ + standalone-invoice-doc → `ok | 88 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → 607 suites, 6084 passed, 0 failed. `deno check` + `deno lint` on mod.ts clean.

## REQ-931 — An unchanged quote is never "Updated the quote."; "2 options, she picks one" gets the can't-hold-options answer (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-2)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". Issue q1-2 [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 1: QA2 sent "these are 2 options, she picks one, not both. also add the 30% deposit" on a two-line draft (Total $23,250.00); the reply was "Updated the quote. The deposit isn't set in chat — …" and the card came back unchanged.
**Requirement:** A re-draft that changes no line, price or total — and nothing else the contractor can see — never says "Updated the quote." (REQ-585's promise). An option ask in the contractor's own wording ("2 options", "she picks one", "not both") gets the `revision.noOptions` answer ("A quote can't hold options … make a second quote").
**Root cause (at 16e7e33e):** two REQ-585 heuristics (be4764bb) both miss. `otherChange` in `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/mod.ts` (~3371) is true whenever the model's `summary` differs at all after trim (case included) or the create_quote payload carries any `descriptionByLang` key — even one equal to the stored text — so `describeQuoteRevision` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/mod.ts` ~119) skips `revision.noChange` and returns `revision.updatedNoChange` = "Updated the quote.". And `OPTION_RE` (same file ~33) has "two" but not the digit "2" in English, and its no-letter-after lookahead rejects "picks one", so `revision.noOptions` is never added; only the deposit sentence matched.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/test.ts` ("REQ-931 q1-2 asksForOption …", "REQ-931 q1-2 describeQuoteRevision …") · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/edit-replies.int.test.ts` ("REQ-931 q1-2: … same lines and the same job details …", "REQ-931 q1-2: … headline that differs only in case …") · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/edit-replies.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-931 q1-2 e2e: …", over HTTP on the booted app). Browser e2e story: n/a — the reply text is built server-side and the HTTP e2e asserts the exact message the thread renders.
**Note for the fixer:** the REQ-585 unit test "the same lines with another change (a new summary, job details) still read 'Updated the quote.'" pins a bare "Updated the quote." for `otherChange: true`; if the fix names the change instead, amend that test (AMENDMENT under REQ-585).
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, fix/q1-q1-2):** unit `deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/test.ts` → `FAILED | 10 passed | 2 failed` (`AssertionError: these are 2 options, she picks one, not both. also add the 30% deposit`; `Expected actual: "Nothing on the quote changed — … payment step after you lock the quote in." to contain: "can't hold options"`). int `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/edit-replies.int.test.ts --filter REQ-931` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed`, both `AssertionError: Updated the quote. The deposit isn't set in chat — you'll pick it in the payment step after you lock the quote in.` (the tester's exact reply). e2e `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/chat-controller/edit-replies.e2e.test.ts --filter REQ-931` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed`, same assertion.
**Fix:** `otherChange` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/mod.ts`) now reads what changes on the card: the summary compared case- and whitespace-insensitively, and a payload `descriptionByLang` entry counts only when its text differs from the stored text for that language (falling back to the base `description`). `OPTION_RE` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/mod.ts`) accepts the digits "2"/"3" before options/choices/versions in English, any verb form of choose/pick/decide ("picks one"), "not both" and "one or the other". REQ-585's "a genuinely new summary still says Updated the quote." test is unchanged and green, so no amendment was needed.
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18, fix/q1-q1-2):** unit `deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/test.ts` → `ok | 12 passed | 0 failed`. int `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/edit-replies.int.test.ts` → `ok | 12 passed | 0 failed` (both REQ-931 cases included). e2e `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/edit-replies.e2e.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`. `deno check` on both touched modules → clean. Neighbours, each file run on its own (`deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check <file>`): all 24 `handle-chat-message/*.int.test.ts` files (269 tests, incl. int.test.ts 90, billing-actions 30, price-target 21) and all 13 `chat-controller/*.e2e.test.ts` files (33 tests) → `ok`, 0 failed.

## REQ-945 — LOOP-007 q1-20: the quote email states the deposit and carries the quote PDF
**Source:** Raphael, LOOP-007: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issue **q1-20** [minor / MISSING_IN_FLOW], cycle 1: "Quote email never mentions the deposit and has no PDF" (QA1 email 007, QA2 email 002 `"Attachments": []`).
**Root cause (at 16e7e33e):** `renderQuoteHtml` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`) was written in 30d70e55 as a link-out teaser; its only money output is the "Estimated total" card. It never reads the quote's `payment_terms` term, so a "Deposit 50% + balance" quote's $1,200 deposit appears only on the /q page's Payment schedule (`PaymentScheduleSection`) and in the quote PDF (`render-quote-pdf` `computeMilestones`). Separately, `SendPaperworkEmail`'s quote branch calls `this.email.send` with no `attachments`, though `EmailService` supports them and the signed confirmation already attaches its PDF, so the quote PDF is never sent.
**Requirement:** (a) A quote email on a deposit plan shows the payment schedule — the deposit amount "· Before work starts" and the balance — the same rows /q and the quote PDF show, in the send language (EN/ES). A quote with no deposit plan shows no deposit rows. (b) The quote email attaches the quote PDF (`application/pdf`), best-effort.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/deposit-schedule.test.ts` ("REQ-945 q1-20 …": $2,400 on "Deposit 50% + balance" → "$1,200.00", Deposit / Before work starts / Balance in EN and Depósito / Antes de empezar / Saldo in ES; "Deposit $500 + balance" → $500.00; "Due Now" → no deposit rows) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts` ("REQ-945 q1-20 …": the send captures one `application/pdf` attachment starting `%PDF-` and the body states $1,200.00) · e2e `e2e/quote-email-deposit/quote-email-deposit.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-945 q1-20 …": /q shows the $1,200.00 deposit; the Outbox copy of the sent email states the same amount and "Before work starts"). The attachment has no e2e surface (the Outbox does not record attachments), so it is proven at int level.
**Evidence (2026-11-18, RED):** unit `FAILED | 1 passed | 3 failed` (`to contain: "$1,200.00": the deposit amount is in the email`); int `--filter REQ-945` → `the quote email carries one attachment (got 0)`; e2e `shots run e2e/quote-email-deposit -- --no-check` → `expectation failed: the email states the $1,200.00 deposit the /q page shows: … ESTIMATED TOTAL all in, no surprises $2,400.00 …` (the /q check before it passed).
**Fix:** `render-quote-pdf`'s `computeMilestones` (the PDF's Payment schedule rows, REQ-678 localized) is exported and `renderQuoteHtml` builds its new "Payment schedule" block (`paperworkEmail.quote.paymentSchedule`, en/es) from that same function under the total card. The block shows only for a split plan (2+ rows); a single payment (due now / on completion) or a recurring term shows nothing extra. `SendPaperworkEmail` now injects `RenderQuotePdf` and `LoadBusinessLogo` as optional trailing constructor params. On a quote send it renders the published quote's PDF in the send language with the business name, logo and net days, then passes `attachments: [{ name: "Quote-Q-001.pdf", contentType: "application/pdf", content }]`, the same shape as the signed confirmation. If the render fails, the email goes out without the attachment. No test assertion was changed.
**Evidence (2026-11-18, GREEN):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/deposit-schedule.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`. `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts --filter REQ-945` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed | 28 filtered out`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/` → `ok | 77 passed | 0 failed`. `deno check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts src/paperwork/mod-root.ts` passes. `deno lint` on both touched modules → `Checked 2 files`. e2e: own serve on a free port, then `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:56854 SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/quote-email-deposit -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-945 q1-20: a deposit quote's email states the same deposit the /q Payment schedule shows · 64.7s`, `rc 0`.

## REQ-948 — The customer's decision reaches the contractor by email and text: change-order approve/decline and quote decline (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-21 + q1-22)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA cycle 1 issues **q1-21** [minor/MISSING_IN_FLOW] "Customer approving a change order notifies nobody" and **q1-22** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Customer declining a quote sends the contractor no email or text".
**Requirement:** (a) When the customer approves a change order (`POST /change-orders/:id/approve`), the contractor gets one text and one email naming the customer and the change, and the customer gets one receipt email naming what changed and the new total. (b) When the customer declines a change order (`POST /change-orders/:id/decline`), the contractor gets one text and one email; the customer gets nothing. (c) When the customer declines a quote (`POST /quotes/:id/decline`), the contractor gets one text and one email carrying the customer's name, the reason and the note. (d) A second decision (409 on a change order, `alreadyDeclined` on a quote) sends nothing new. Best-effort, like accept: a failed send never fails the customer's request.
**Root cause (cycle 1, at 16e7e33e):** `approveChangeOrder` and `declineChangeOrder` in `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts` only call `emitChangeOrderDecision`, whose one side effect is `bus.emit(change_order_approved|declined)`; `declineQuote` likewise only `bus.emit(declined)`. The only subscriber, `NotifyOnEvent`, turns each into an in-app bell row, so nothing reaches email, SMS or the comms trail. The sibling handlers do send: `acceptQuote` awaits `SendAcceptedAlert` (contractor text + email) and `SendSignedConfirmation` (customer), `inquireQuote` awaits `SendInquiryAlert` (REQ-031). The decline and change-order handlers predate those alerts (69b4ed4f, 49a5d6ca) and were never brought in line.
**Tests:** int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/decision-alerts.int.test.ts` ("REQ-948 …": CO approve → contractor 1 text + 1 email, customer 1 receipt with the change and $10,450, second approve 409 sends nothing; CO decline → contractor 1 text + 1 email, customer none; quote decline → contractor 1 text + 1 email with the reason and the note, second decline sends nothing; control: quote accept already texts + emails the contractor through the same captured transports) · e2e `e2e/decision-alerts/decision-alerts.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-948 …": the customer approves on /co/:id, and declines on /q/:id with Price + a note, then the comms trail behind /messages gains the contractor's text + email, and the customer's receipt on approve) · unit: n/a — the message wording does not exist yet (a new coordinator's builder is the fixer's to name); its content (customer name, the change, the new total, the reason and the note) is asserted on the real sent messages at the integration level.
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, cycle 1):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/decision-alerts.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 3 failed` (`the contractor got 0 texts after the approval (want 1)`, `the contractor got no text for the declined change order`, `the contractor got 0 texts for the declined quote (want 1)`; the accept control passes). `shots run e2e/decision-alerts -- --no-check` against `PORT=5743 deno task serve` → `0 pass · 2 fail` (`the comms trail did not grow after the approval (0 → 0)`, `the comms trail did not grow after the decline (0 → 0)`).
**Fix (cycle 1):** new coordinator `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-decision-alert/mod.ts` (`SendDecisionAlert`, registered in `paperwork/mod-root.ts`, injected into `PaperworkPublicController`), awaited best-effort (`.catch` + `console.error`) after the bus event in `declineQuote`, `approveChangeOrder` and `declineChangeOrder`, the way `acceptQuote` awaits `SendAcceptedAlert`. `quoteDeclined(id)` texts + emails the contractor (UI language) who declined which quote (`Q-001 · Version n`, the job), the reason chip in words (`publicQuoteActions.reason.*`) and the note, linking `/quotes?open=<id>`. `changeOrderDecided(id)` texts + emails the contractor the decision, the change, the delta and the invoice total after it (`CO-001 on INV-…`, linking `/invoices?open=<id>`); on approve it also emails the customer a receipt in her comms language (REQ-715) under the business's name and logo — what changed, the delta, "Approved by <name> on <date>", the new invoice total, the invoice's public `/i/<id>` link — and texts it when a textable phone is on file (REQ-403 guarded dispatch). Every contractor send lands in the comms trail (`LogPaperworkMessage.run`, self-alert: no paperworkId, P-32); the customer receipt lands in the trail (paperworkType `changeOrder`) and the outbox (REQ-784, kind `changeOrder`). Replay guards, claimed compare-and-set before anything is sent: `Quote.declineNotifiedAt` (via `QuoteStore.updateIf`, compared with `lostAt` so a re-sent and re-declined quote alerts again) and `ChangeOrder.decisionNotifiedAt` (new `ChangeOrderStore.claimDecisionNotice`, compared with `decidedAt` so an edited and re-decided order alerts again). The words are pure builders in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/decision-alert/mod.ts`; 22 `decisionAlert.*` keys in `lang/en.json` + `lang/es.json` (before the trailing `comms.a2p.*` keys). The tests were not changed. ## REQ-947 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-23: the "customer asked a question" alert gives the owner a way to reach the customer (AMENDMENT of REQ-031 / REQ-701)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue q1-23 [minor/BUG_POLISH]: "'Customer asked a question' email says 'Reply directly to the customer' but gives no way to" reach them (outbox 012-email, 013-sms).
**Root cause:** `SendInquiryAlert` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-inquiry-alert/mod.ts`) builds the contractor's email and text from `input.contactBack` alone, the free-text "how should we reach you" field. It loads the quote's customer record (email and phone on file) but uses only its name, and calls `EmailService.send` with no `replyTo`. Its body string `inquiryAlert.email.body` ("Reply directly to the customer — the quote stays open until they sign.", es "Respóndele directamente al cliente …") dates from REQ-031 (6ea474e1), before REQ-701 moved replies into the quote panel. When the customer leaves the field empty, the email and SMS carry no address or phone, pressing Reply writes to the house From, and the copy still says to reply directly.
**Requirement:** (a) The alert works out the reachable contact with the panel's rule (`shared/quote-flow/inquiry-contact.ts`: what the customer typed wins, the customer's email/phone on file fill in the rest) and shows it in the email (mailto:/tel: links) and in the SMS. (b) When the customer has an email (typed or on file), the email's Reply-To reaches the customer (their address, or a `reply+<token>` address like send-paperwork-email / reply-to-inquiry). (c) The body copy in both dictionaries no longer says "Reply directly to the customer"; it matches the REQ-701 flow.
**Tests:** unit — n/a: the contact rule is the pure `contactBackParts` / reply-target helper, already covered; the defect is in the coordinator's wiring · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-inquiry-alert/int.test.ts` ("REQ-947 q1-23 …": no contactBack → email has the on-file email + phone as mailto:/tel: and a Reply-To to the customer; the SMS names a contact; en + es copy drop "Reply directly"; a typed email is the Reply-To and the phone on file fills in) · e2e — n/a: the contractor's alert email is not observable from a browser story (dev-mode EmailService logs only to/subject, and the comms log stores no htmlBody or Reply-To for this self-notification), so the int test on the coordinator is the closest real path.
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-inquiry-alert/int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 4 passed | 4 failed`: "the email body names the customer's email on file"; "the SMS names the customer's phone or email on file: Jose asked about Garage Cleanout: "Can you come Saturday morning instead?" → http://localhost:5280/quotes?open=…#questions"; "(en): stale REQ-031 copy "Reply directly to the customer""; "Reply-To is the typed address (or a reply+ token), got undefined".
**Fix:** `SendInquiryAlert` now resolves where the customer can be reached with the panel's own rule, `inquiryReplyTargets({ contactBack }, customer)` from `shared/quote-flow/inquiry-contact.ts`: what the customer typed wins, and the email and phone on file fill in the rest. The email gets a new "Reach them: <tel link> · <mailto link>" line (key `inquiryAlert.reach`, en "Reach them: {contact}", es "Para contactarle: {contact}") and `replyTo` set to the customer's email (typed or on file). The Reply-To is the customer's own address, not a `reply+<token>`: a reply token routes inbound mail into the customer's thread as if THEY wrote it, which is wrong for the owner's reply. The SMS appends the on-file channels the customer did not type, so it always names a contact. The copy now matches REQ-701: `inquiryAlert.email.body` reads "Answer from the quote (text, email or call), or reply to this email — the quote stays open until they sign." (es "Contesta desde la cotización (texto, correo o llamada), o responde a este correo — …"), and the CTA reads "Answer the question" / "Contestar la pregunta". The comms-trail content is unchanged.
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-inquiry-alert/int.test.ts` → `ok | 8 passed | 0 failed` · `deno check` + `deno lint` on `send-inquiry-alert/mod.ts` → clean · `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --runInBand unit/i18n-dictionary-consistency.test.ts unit/email-i18n.test.ts unit/sms-i18n.test.ts unit/stale-lang-strings.test.ts unit/systems-house-line.test.ts` → `Test Suites: 5 passed, 5 total; Tests: 100 passed, 100 total` · en/es key sets identical, last key still `comms.a2p.sys.house`.

## REQ-950 — LOOP-007 q1-24: an invoice's itemized job details add up to the agreement value it prints (approved change orders itemized)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue **q1-24** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION]: INV-001 shows "AGREEMENT VALUE $24,500.00" but its lines add up to $23,250 (the change order line is missing).
**Root cause:** `GET /invoices/:id/public` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts`, getInvoicePublic) builds `agreementTotal = agreedTotalCents(quote, listByQuote(...))` — the quote plus every approved change order on the quote (REQ-679) — while the same response's `jobDetails.lineItems` is the quote's original `quote.lineItems` and its `changeOrders` is `listByInvoice` (REQ-205), only the change orders attached to the invoice being viewed. CO-001 (+$1,250 Heated floor) is attached to INV-002, so INV-001's /i draws the $24,500 agreement card (`front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` → `JobDetailsSection total={agreementTotal}`) under rows of $9,800 + $13,450 with no change-order row. The invoice PDF (`render-invoice-pdf`) and the invoice email (`send-paperwork-email`) print `agreedTotalCents` under `quote.lineItems` the same way.
**Requirement:** wherever an invoice prints the agreement value under the itemized job details (/i, the invoice PDF, the invoice email), the approved change orders of the quote are itemized too, so the rows add up to the agreement value — on every invoice of the job, not only the one the change order is attached to. The public response carries them either appended to `jobDetails.lineItems` or as `agreementChangeOrders: [{number, description, deltaAmountCents}]`.
**Tests:** int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/agreement-itemized-co.int.test.ts` ("REQ-950 q1-24 …": INV-001 and INV-002 public rows sum to agreementTotal 2,450,000 with a Heated floor row; INV-001 PDF draws the Heated floor $1,250.00 row before AGREEMENT VALUE $24,500.00; INV-001 email itemizes the Heated floor $1,250.00 row) · e2e `e2e/agreement-itemized-co/agreement-itemized-co.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-950 q1-24 …": approve CO-001 on INV-002, open /i/<INV-001>?lang=en, one page.evaluate reads the job-details rows and the card; rows list Heated floor and add up to $24,500.00) · unit n/a — no pure logic to pin: the fix is a projection in the controller/renderers, covered at int level, and the /i render is covered by the e2e (jest has no Preact renderer, a source-regex wiring test would pin a shape, not the behaviour).
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, branch fix/q1-q1-24 off qa-loop 16e7e33e):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/agreement-itemized-co.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 4 failed` (`the itemized rows add up to the agreement value` `- 2325000 + 2450000`; PDF rows "Tile demo & prep $9,800.00 / Tile install $13,450.00 / AGREEMENT VALUE … $24,500.00" with no Heated floor row; email `the approved change order is itemized in the email`). `shots run e2e/agreement-itemized-co -- --no-check` against `FRONTEND_PORT=5913 BACKEND_PORT=5914 deno task serve` → `✗ REQ-950 q1-24 … expectation failed: the approved change order has a row ([{"description":"Tile demo & prep","amount":"$9,800.00"},{"description":"Tile install","amount":"$13,450.00"}])`.
**Fix (2026-11-18):** one rule for the agreement's itemization — `agreementLineItems(lineItems, changeOrders)` in `shared/documents/ledger.ts` (next to `agreedTotalCents`) returns the quote's lines followed by one line per APPROVED change order of the quote ("CO-001 · Heated floor added under the tile", quantity 1, price = its delta; pending/declined excluded, ordered by creation). Every surface that prints the agreement value under the itemized job details now draws it: `GET /invoices/:id/public` appends them to `jobDetails.lineItems` (from the same `listByQuote` set `agreementTotal` uses, so /i's JobDetailsSection lists the row with no front-end change), `render-invoice-pdf` draws them before the AGREEMENT VALUE card, `renderInvoiceHtml` (send-paperwork-email) itemizes them in the email, and `preview-invoice-send` now passes the quote's change orders so the send preview matches the sent email (it previously passed none, so its agreement value also left out approved orders). The per-invoice "Change orders" block on /i (REQ-205) is unchanged. No test was changed.

## REQ-949 — LOOP-007 q1, q1-25 (cycle 1): a change order on an unsent invoice does not cite that invoice to the customer
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue q1-25 [minor/BUG_POLISH] "Change-order emails reference INV-002, which the customer never received", LOOP-007 cycle 1.
**Root cause:** `ApplyChatChangeOrder` attaches a change order to the job's newest unpaid invoice (`isInvoiceLocked` is only `paid`), which after a deposit + balance signing is the SCHEDULED, never-sent balance INV-002. `SendChangeOrderAlert` then builds the customer's subject, doc-ref line and text from `changeOrderRef(co, invoice)` (`doc-render/mod.ts`), which always appends "on <invoice number>" with no `isIssued()` check, and the headline / SMS copy (`changeOrderRequest.email.headline`, `changeOrderRequest.sms.body`) always says "a change to your invoice". The customer is told about a change to an invoice they have never seen.
**Requirement:** when the change order's invoice has not been issued (draft / scheduled, no sentAt), the customer's email subject, body and text do not name that invoice or say "your invoice"; they name the change order and the job (Q-001). An issued invoice keeps REQ-204's "CO-001 on INV-5000".
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/test.ts` ("REQ-949 changeOrderRef …": sent → "CO-001 on INV-002"; scheduled / draft in en + es → no "INV-002") · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-numbers.int.test.ts` ("REQ-949 change-order alert: on an unsent (scheduled) balance invoice …": Q-001 accepted, INV-001 sent, INV-002 scheduled, CO-001 on INV-002 → the customer's subject, htmlBody and SMS carry no "INV-002" / "your invoice" and do name Q-001; the REQ-204 sent-invoice test is kept) · e2e n/a — the output is an email + SMS that the int test captures whole through the real coordinator; the e2e trigger is the LLM chat path, which adds nothing to the defect.
**Evidence (red, 2026-11-18):** unit `FAILED | 1 passed | 2 failed` — `AssertionError: en: an unsent scheduled invoice must not be cited, got "CO-001 on INV-002"`; int `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` — `AssertionError: customer subject cites INV-002, an invoice they never received: A2Z Landscape LLC sent you a change to approve — CO-001 on INV-002`.
**Fix:** `changeOrderRef(co, invoice, lang, job?)` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts`) names the invoice only when `isIssued(invoice)`; otherwise it names the job ("CO-001 on Q-001") or just "CO-001". The owner's copy uses the new `changeOrderOwnerRef` and keeps "CO-001 on INV-002". `SendChangeOrderAlert` loads the job (`co.quoteId ?? invoice.quoteId`, new defaulted `QuoteStore` param) when the invoice is unsent, and switches the customer headline / SMS to the new `changeOrderRequest.email.headlineJob` ("A change to your job" / "Un cambio en tu trabajo") and `changeOrderRequest.sms.bodyJob`. The public /co page (`front-end/routes/co/[id].tsx`) reads "Added to / Credited on the remaining balance ($X → $Y)" (`changeOrderPublic.addedToBalance` / `creditedOnBalance`) instead of "Added to INV-002" when the invoice is a draft or scheduled. The tests were not changed.
**Evidence (green, 2026-11-18):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-numbers.int.test.ts` → `ok | 14 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv` doc-render/test.ts, render-numbers, send-change-order-alert/int, customer-branding, customer-language, outbox, send-languages-lock, public-controller/agreed-total-co, agents apply-chat-change-order/, handle-chat-message/, invoice-removal-intent → `ok | 333 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 607 passed`, `Tests: 6084 passed, 1 skipped`; `deno lint` + `deno check` green on the touched backend files and `front-end/routes/co/[id].tsx`; lang/en.json + es.json valid JSON, same key set, last key still `comms.a2p.sys.house`.

## REQ-954 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-26: one deposit, one deadline — the signed email, /q and the invoice name the same due date
**Requirement (Raphael):** "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue q1-26 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Deposit deadline: 'First invoice due in 7 days' vs 'Before work starts'" (LOOP-007, cycle 1).
**Root cause:** two places describe the deposit deadline and neither reads the invoice. On signing, `send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` bills the first (deposit) invoice with `dueDate` = net-7 (today for Due Now; the completion date for no terms when later — REQ-240). The signed-confirmation email then prints the fixed i18n string `signedConfirm.email.invoiceDue` ("due in 7 days · pay online" / "vence en 7 días · paga en línea") instead of that `dueDate` — wrong outright for Due Now and for no-terms + a later completion. The /q payment schedule (`front-end/components/doc-parts.tsx` `computeMilestones`, deposit role → `quoteDoc.milestone.beforeStart`), the quote PDF and the invoice PDF all label the deposit "Before work starts", ignoring the invoice's `dueDate`. With work starting "Next week", the customer gets two deadlines for one $4,650 deposit.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/deposit-deadline.test.ts` ("REQ-954 (LOOP-007 q1-26) …": the coordinator's email names the deposit invoice's stored dueDate for Deposit + balance starting next week; Due Now never says "7 days" and says today/the date; no terms + completion in 30 days names the completion date, never "7 days") · unit (front-end) `front-end/lib/deposit-due-schedule.test.tsx` ("REQ-954 (LOOP-007 q1-26) [en|es] …": a signed `QuoteDoc` whose projection carries the deposit invoice `dueDate` renders the DEPOSIT schedule card with that date, not "Before work starts" / "Antes de empezar") · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/deposit-deadline.int.test.ts` ("REQ-954 (LOOP-007 q1-26) …": booted backend, KV :memory:, accept Deposit + balance starting in 10 days; `GET /quotes/:id/public` invoices[0].dueDate = `GET /invoices/:id/public` dueDate, and the outbox confirmation email names that date) · browser e2e n/a — /q renders `QuoteDoc` → `PaymentScheduleSection` straight from the `GET /quotes/:id/public` projection, which the front-end render test drives on the projection's shape and the integration test proves over HTTP.
**Evidence (2026-11-18, RED at 16e7e33e):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/deposit-deadline.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` ("the email names the deposit's due date 2026-11-26 (Nov 26); its text: First invoice due in 7 days · pay online $4,650.00"; "must not promise 7 days for a Due Now invoice"; "the invoice is due 2026-12-19, not in 7 days"). `deno test -A --no-check lib/deposit-due-schedule.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` ("must not say \"Before work starts\" when its invoice is due 2026-11-25: \"Deposit$4,650.00Before work starts\""). `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/deposit-deadline.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` ("the confirmation email names the deposit's due date 2026-11-26 (Nov 26); it says: First invoice due in 7 days · pay online").
**Fix:** the stored invoice `dueDate` is the one deadline every surface prints. (1) `send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` keeps the first sent invoice's `dueDate` and passes it to the email renderer, whose due line (`invoiceDueLine`) prints `signedConfirm.email.invoiceDue` = "due {date} · pay online" / "vence el {date} · paga en línea" with the date (`shortDate`), or `signedConfirm.email.invoiceDueToday` ("due today" / "vence hoy") when it is due on the signing day (Due Now). It also hands the date to the attached agreement PDF. (2) `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` `depositDueDateOf` picks the deposit invoice (installment 1, never void) out of the issued bills. `computeMilestones` (front-end `doc-parts.tsx` and both PDF renderers) takes that date and labels the deposit row "Due {date}" / "Vence el {date}". /q passes it from `quote.invoices`, /i from its siblings (whose public projection now carries `dueDate`), and the invoice PDF from the quote's issued installments. (3) Before signing, no invoice exists yet, so the deposit row states the rule that sets the date: "Due a week after signing" / "Vence una semana tras firmar" (`*.milestone.weekAfterSigning`). It replaces "Before work starts", which no stored date backs. The wording is "a week", not "7 days", so the REQ-783 test that forbids a stray "7 days" beside an edited cancellation notice stays green. The net is `SIGNING_NET_DAYS` (7) in linked-view.ts, and the coordinator uses it. Option (c), moving the deposit date to the start date, was not taken: REQ-240's net-7 rule stands.
**Evidence (2026-11-18, GREEN on fix/q1-q1-26):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/deposit-deadline.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/deposit-deadline.int.test.ts` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`. `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/deposit-due-schedule.test.tsx` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`. Neighbours: `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/{send-signed-confirmation,render-quote-pdf,render-invoice-pdf}/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/` → `ok | 167 passed | 0 failed`. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6084 passed`. `deno check` + `deno lint` are clean on every touched module (backend 4, front-end doc-parts/quote-doc/routes/i/[id]/shared linked-view). `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/` has failures, but none comes from this change. Each assertion names a string or file this diff does not touch: ui-glyph-icons (`customerWs.visit.billedShort` "✓ billed"), outbox (the sidebar root row), backdrop-escape, admin-gate, demo-stage-offframe-edge-mark.

## REQ-951 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-27: a first draft keeps a typed removal ("quitar el piso viejo") as its own item
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q1-27** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], LOOP-007 cycle 1: the /assistant Q-002 first draft dropped "quitar el piso viejo"; it came back only after an edit. Contradicts REQ-439 ("first drafts keep every quantity and item the contractor typed") and REQ-266 ("keep every scope item the contractor named").
**Root cause:** the REQ-439 first-draft check in `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` builds its item list with `typedWorkItems` (`shared/quote-flow/typed-coverage.ts`), whose `typedScopeItems` collapses comma parts with `distinctScopeItems` by content terms alone. REQ-400's `FILLER_TERMS` (`option-bullets.ts`) strip "quitar", "cambiar", "viejo" and "materiales", so "quitar el piso viejo con materiales" reduces to ["piso"], which "Cambiar piso de cocina" already had, and the removal is dropped as a reworded repeat. Even if kept, `names()` would count "Cambio de piso de cocina" as covering it (same term). Separately the street address "1820 Elm St Austin TX 78702" survives as a work item, so the one re-ask names only the address, the retry cannot leave out fewer items, and the first draft is kept.
**Requirement:** a typed removal (quitar/retirar/remover/demoler/demo/tear out/remove/haul away) is its own work item, distinct from a replace/install of the same thing; it is covered only by a line that also says removal, in any language; a typed street address is never a work item.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/typed-coverage.test.ts` ("REQ-951 REQ-439 …": typedWorkItems keeps the removal, excludes the address; a replacement-only draft misses the removal and not the address; a line "… y retiro del piso viejo" covers it) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-951 REQ-439 (LOOP-007 q1-27) …": a scripted one-line first draft is re-asked once, the re-ask names "quitar el piso viejo" and not the address, the stored draft has the removal line) · e2e n/a — the browser lane runs the stub LLM, which does not draft from free text, so it cannot produce the dropped-item draft.
**Evidence (2026-11-18) RED:** `cd jest && npx jest unit/typed-coverage.test.ts` → `Tests: 4 failed, 8 passed, 12 total` (keeps removal: `Expected: true Received: false`; address: `Expected: false Received: true`; missed: `+ "1820 Elm St Austin TX 78702"`). `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter "/REQ-951|REQ-439/"` → `FAILED | 2 passed | 1 failed`; log `first draft leaves typed items out — asking again: ["1820 Elm St Austin TX 78702"]`, `AssertionError: the re-ask names the removal`.
**Fix:** `shared/quote-flow/typed-coverage.ts` — `typedScopeItems` now de-duplicates typed parts with `distinctTypedParts`: a part is a reworded repeat only when an earlier part already had all its terms AND the same operation (`scopeOperation`: remove / install / repair, from the verb, EN+ES), so "quitar el piso viejo" stays beside "cambiar piso de cocina". `missedTypedItems`/`names()` require a removal item to be matched by a line that also carries a removal word ("retiro del piso viejo", "demolition", "haul away"…). `isWorkItem` drops a part that is only a street address (street number + `STREET_AFTER` + optional unit/city/state/zip). The REQ-400 filler list is unchanged (still right for matching rewordings).
**Evidence (2026-11-18) GREEN:** `cd jest && npx jest unit/typed-coverage.test.ts` → `Tests: 12 passed, 12 total` (all four REQ-951 cases ✓). `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` (full unit lane, incl. details-corrections) → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6088 passed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/` → `ok | 145 passed | 0 failed`; log `first draft leaves typed items out — asking again: ["quitar el piso viejo con materiales"]`. `deno check` + `deno lint` on typed-coverage.ts → clean.

## REQ-953 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-28: Spanish "mitad al empezar y mitad al terminar" is read as 50/50 (cites REQ-265)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue q1-28 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 1: "Spanish payment terms are not read from the message". On the /assistant payment step (ES), "mitad al empezar y mitad al terminar" got no "From your message" confirm, only a SUGGESTED 50/50. REQ-265 promises "50% / half / 50/50 → 50/50" as a one-tap "From your message" confirm.
**Root cause:** `extractPaymentTerms` (shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts) maps a "half" word to 50/50 only when a DEPOSIT word sits next to it (deposit|down|upfront|anticipo|adelanto|enganche|depósito). The only other 50/50 paths are a literal "50/50" or a run of % figures that adds up to 100 (`extractSplitSchedule`). A "half at start / half at finish" pair with no deposit word and no % matches no rule. So `paymentTerms` is null, `wizardPrefillFor('payment_terms')` returns null, and AsstChat never renders the `wiz-prefill` card. The SUGGESTED highlight comes from the spec's `suggestedOptionId`, not from the message. The English "half at start and half at the end" has the same gap.
**Requirement:** a "half … and half / the other half / the rest …" pair (Spanish or English, start/finish words) reads as 50_50 and is offered as the payment step's "From your message" confirm. A lone "half bath" or "la mitad del piso" still reads as nothing.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-facts.test.ts` ("REQ-953 …": four phrasings → 50_50, the tester's full sentence → 50_50, "half bath remodel" / "quitar la mitad del piso" → null, `wizardPrefillFor('payment_terms', …, 'es')` → `{optionId:'50_50'}`) · int n/a: the facts are derived client-side, and handle-wizard-answer already stores a 50_50 pick · e2e `e2e/quote-prefill/quote-prefill.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-953 …": a Spanish account, a quote description ending "mitad al empezar y mitad al terminar", and on "¿Cuándo quieres recibir el pago?" a visible `[data-testid=wiz-prefill]` saying "De tu mensaje" with 50/50).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-18, 16e7e33e):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/quote-facts.test.ts` gives 6 failures, each `Expected: "50_50" / Received: null`, plus `Expected: {"optionId": "50_50"} / Received: null`. The two null guards pass. `shots run e2e/quote-prefill -- --no-check` against `PORT=5953 deno task serve` fails with `✗ REQ-953 … expectation failed: the payment step shows the 'De tu mensaje' pre-selection … — expected 1, got 0`.
**Fix:** `extractPaymentTerms` (shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts) gains `HALF_PAIR_RE`, checked after the deposit-word half rule: a "half / mitad / 50%" followed within 40 chars by a joiner (`,` / and / y / then / luego) and a second "half / la (otra) mitad / the rest / el resto / balance / 50%", with a start/finish word (empezar/inicio/comenzar/start/begin/now/ahora/terminar/final/acabar/complete/finish/done/end/entrega…) between them or within 25 chars after. That start/finish word guard keeps "half bath remodel", "quitar la mitad del piso", "mitad del piso y mitad del techo" and "remove half the tile and the rest of the grout" at null. No test assertion was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-18):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/quote-facts.test.ts` → `Tests: 28 passed, 28 total` (all 8 REQ-953 cases ✓). Neighbours `npx jest --selectProjects unit trade-fit recurring-billing c4-fact-readers payment-terms-custom wizard-known-facts es-date-format quote-facts dv1-m7-address-email` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6092 passed`. `deno lint` + `deno check` on quote-facts.ts clean; `deno fmt -` unchanged. e2e against `PORT=5953 deno task serve` on a FRESH KV_PATH: `SHOTS_DIR=<private> shots run e2e/quote-prefill -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-953: a Spanish 'mitad al empezar y mitad al terminar' is offered as the 50/50 'De tu mensaje' confirm on the payment step · 6.6s`. Two caveats. (1) The story is not repeatable on a reused KV, because a second run finds the "Juan Pérez" customer from the first run, the customer step shows a "Coincide con lo que escribiste" match card, and the story times out waiting for the create form. Use a fresh KV per run. (2) The REQ-265 story in the same file fails with `the start-date pre-selection shows 12/01/2026`, which is outside this fix. `extractQuoteFacts` on its sentence returns the same `startDate {us:"12/01/2026"}` and `wizardPrefillFor('start_date')` `{optionId:"custom",customValue:"2026-12-01"}` from the HEAD (pre-fix) module and from the fixed module, so the start-date path is untouched by REQ-953.

## REQ-952 — REQ-259 AMENDMENT: a typed itemisation plus its matching stated total keeps the lines (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-29)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue **q1-29** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], LOOP-007 cycle 1: "Assistant merges labor and materials into one line" — on /assistant in Spanish, "…Mano de obra $1,800, materiales $600. Total $2,400" became one $2,400 line, so the contractor's split was lost on the quote and agreement.
**Cause (RCA at 16e7e33e):** `extractPriceLines` (`shared/quote-flow/quick-quote-prefill.ts`, guard from a988e68e4 / REQ-259) returns [] as soon as ANY amount carries a total word ("total", "en total", "todo incluido") or a deposit word, without checking whether the other labelled amounts add up to that total. `extractPriceCents` still picks the total ($2,400), so the picker is right, but on Continue `startQuoteFromRaw` (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`) calls `quoteLineItemsFromPrefill([], 240000, names.line)`, which falls back to ONE summary line. REQ-259's "the total still wins" was about the price only; it never decided to drop lines whose sum equals the stated total.
**Requirement:** When the typed details list at least two labelled priced items AND one amount marked as the total, and the items add up exactly to that total, the quote keeps one line per typed item ("Mano de obra" $1,800 · "Materiales" $600, total $2,400). A total that does not match the items, a deposit, a range, or an unlabelled amount still gives one summary line at the confirmed price, as before. The line labels are the item's own words ("Mano de obra"), not the preceding sentence.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/known-price-itemised.test.ts` ("REQ-952 …": the tester's sentence → two lines + price 240000; the quote built from it has two lines; "labor $1,800, materials $600, total $2,400" and "… $2,400 en total" → two lines; a mismatched total "total $2,500" → [] with price 250000; deposits stay []; a lone total + one amount is not a list) · integration n/a — the defect is client-side extraction; the backend already stores N line items unchanged (REQ-259), and the e2e proves the round-trip through the real API · e2e `e2e/known-price-lines/known-price-lines.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-952 q1-29 …": Spanish account, chip "Ya tengo el precio, redáctalo." → the tester's sentence → picker at 2400 → Continue → the conversation's quote has [Mano de obra 180000, Materiales 60000] and estimatedTotal 240000).
**Evidence (2026-11-18, branch fix/q1-q1-29 off origin/qa-loop 16e7e33e):** RED — `cd jest && npx jest unit/known-price-itemised.test.ts` → 4 REQ-952 cases fail (`Expected [{Mano de obra,180000},{Materiales,60000}]`, `Received Array []`; items `["Instalación de piso", 240000]`), the guard cases and all 19 REQ-259 cases pass; `shots run e2e/known-price-lines -- --no-check` → "expectation failed: the quote keeps the contractor's labor/materials split — expected [[\"Mano de obra\",180000],[\"Materiales\",60000]], got [[\"Instalación de piso\",240000]]" (REQ-259 M23 story still passes).
**Fix:** `extractPriceLines` no longer gives up on the whole list when an amount carries a total word. Deposits, ranges and negatives still give []. When exactly one amount is total-marked, it is left out and the remaining amounts are labelled the usual way. The lines are kept only when there are at least two and they add up EXACTLY to that total; more than one total, or a total that doesn't match, gives [] as before. A second root cause sat in the same sentence: `scanAmounts` split items only at `, ; : \n`, so in "…materiales $600. Total $2,400" the word "Total" also landed in $600's `after`, and $1,800's label swallowed "para Ana López. ". A sentence-ending period (`.` followed by whitespace or the end) is now an item break too (`ITEM_BREAK`/`lastBreak`). `extractPriceCents` is unchanged. `quoteLineItemsFromPrefill` keeps the lines because their sum equals the confirmed price.
**GREEN (2026-11-18):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/known-price-itemised.test.ts` → 26 passed, 0 failed · `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → 607 suites / 6091 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed · `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/suggest-prices/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/ src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/ src/agents/domain/business/chat-billing-intent/` (the backend importers of quick-quote-prefill) → 358 passed, 0 failed · `cd front-end && deno lint ../shared/quote-flow/quick-quote-prefill.ts && deno check ../shared/quote-flow/quick-quote-prefill.ts islands/AsstChat.tsx` → clean; `deno fmt - <` → no diff · e2e: `PORT=57731 deno task serve` (waited until the backend answered — 82 s on the loaded host; a bare `shots run` started the stories against a backend that had not booted yet and got 502 backend_unreachable) then `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:57731 shots run e2e/known-price-lines -- --no-check` → ✓ REQ-259 M23 · ✓ REQ-952 q1-29, 2 pass / 0 fail.

## REQ-936 — A typed deposit amount ("30% deposit up front") is what the payment step's "From your message" offers and stores (LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue q1-3)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue `q1-3` [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "A typed '30% deposit' becomes a 20% deposit marked 'From your message'". Closes REQ-678's "Not covered (follow-up)".
**Cause (RCA at 16e7e33e):** `extractPaymentTerms` (shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts) returns the bare `"deposit_bal"` for any "N% / $X … deposit" match and throws the figure away; `wizardPrefillFor` turns that string into `{ optionId: "deposit_bal" }` with no customValue; the AsstChat prefill row shows "From your message: Deposit + balance" and its "Use this" posts no customValue; `termFromPick` then stores the plain label "Deposit + balance", which `computePaymentSplit` bills at the legacy 20% ($4,650 of $23,250 instead of $6,975).
**Requirement:** a deposit figure stated in the job's text (a share in (0, 100) or a dollar amount above $0) is carried into the payment step's prefill as the REQ-678 term value ("Deposit 30% + balance" / "Deposit $2,000 + balance"); the "From your message" row names it (localized), and its one tap stores and bills that deposit. A deposit with no readable / an out-of-range figure keeps the plain option.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/deposit-prefill-from-message.test.ts` ("REQ-936 …": extractPaymentTerms keeps 30% / 25% / $2,000; a $0 figure stays plain; wizardPrefillFor gives customValue "Deposit 30% + balance"; the prefill through termFromPick + computePaymentSplit bills 697500 / 1627500 of 2325000; the AsstChat prefill row localizes a deposit customValue) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` ("REQ-936 (LOOP-007 q1-3) handle-wizard-answer …": posting the prefill as "Use this" does → pick line "Payment: Deposit 30% + balance", the quote term, the 30% split) · e2e `e2e/deposit-prefill-from-message/deposit-prefill-from-message.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-936 …": the quote's text says "30% deposit up front, rest when done"; the payment step's prefill reads "Deposit 30% + balance" and no 20%; its tap stores "Deposit 30% + balance" and the thread says so).
**Amended (REQ-265/REQ-387 single-figure rules, intent kept):** `jest/unit/quote-facts.test.ts` and `jest/unit/payment-terms-custom.test.ts` — "25% deposit to book" and "10% off labor, 30% deposit" now expect `{ kind: "deposit", pct: 25 | 30 }` instead of the bare `"deposit_bal"`.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-18, branch fix/q1-q1-3 off origin/qa-loop 16e7e33e):** `cd jest && npx jest --no-watchman --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'unit/(deposit-prefill-from-message|quote-facts)\.test'` → `Tests: 5 failed, 20 passed` (`Received has value: "deposit_bal"`; prefill missing `customValue: "Deposit 30% + balance"`; `Expected: "Deposit 30% + balance" Received: "Deposit + balance"`; no `localizeDepositTerm(` in the prefill row). `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv …/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts --filter REQ-936` → `AssertionError: transcript: Payment: Deposit + balance … FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed`. `shots run e2e/deposit-prefill-from-message -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-936 … expectation failed: the prefill names the typed 30%: "From your message: Deposit + balance"`.
**Fix:** `extractPaymentTerms` (shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts) now reads the figure next to the deposit word (`statedDeposit`: "30% deposit", "$2,000 deposit", "deposit of 25%", "depósito del 30%"; the gap may hold no other figure, so "$23,250, 30% deposit" reads 30%, not the total) and returns a new `{ kind: "deposit", pct | cents }` arm of `PrefillPaymentTerms`; a share outside (0, 100) or $0 keeps the bare `"deposit_bal"`. `wizardPrefillFor` turns that arm into `{ optionId: "deposit_bal", customValue: depositTermValue(…) }`, so "Use this" posts "Deposit 30% + balance", which `termFromPick` already stores and `computePaymentSplit` already bills. The AsstChat "From your message" row names a payment customValue through `localizeDepositTerm` ("Deposit 30% + balance" / "Depósito 30% + saldo"), and the suggested "Deposit + balance" option's sub-line names the stated share via `depositBalanceSubVars(total, term)` (front-end/lib/payment-split.ts, new optional `term`; default unchanged) — "30% upfront, rest when done · $6,975 / $16,275", no 20%. A dollar deposit with no total yet shows no sub-line rather than the 20%. No test assertion changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-18, branch fix/q1-q1-3):** `cd jest && npx jest --no-watchman --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'unit/(deposit-prefill-from-message|quote-facts|payment-terms-custom|deposit-pct-picker|deposit)'` → `Test Suites: 5 passed · Tests: 52 passed`; the unit neighbours of every touched file (`npx jest --selectProjects unit $(grep -rlE "quote-facts|payment-split|AsstChat|deposit-term" unit)`) → `Test Suites: 608 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 6089 passed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` → `REQ-936 … ok · ok | 52 passed | 0 failed`; backend tests importing quote-facts / payment-split / terms-wizard-spec (18 files) → `ok | 170 passed | 0 failed`. `cd front-end && deno check` + `deno lint` on islands/AsstChat.tsx, lib/payment-split.ts, ../shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts → clean. e2e (host load ~140, so shots' own serve timed out; served on a high port): `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53917 SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/deposit-prefill-from-message/deposit-prefill-from-message.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-936 (LOOP-007 q1-3): '30% deposit up front' in the message — 'From your message' names Deposit 30% + balance and its one tap stores the 30% ($6,975 of $23,250)` · `1 pass · 0 fail`.

## REQ-955 — LOOP-007 q1-30: a quote card never says "no opens" while it says the quote was opened
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue **q1-30** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Quote card contradicts itself on opens": after one customer open, the /quotes Q-002 card (V1 and V2) shows "OPENED 1×" / "1 open · Jose" and also "No opens recorded yet." / "Sent, but no opens yet. Could be in spam…".
**Root cause:** `front-end/islands/QuoteCard.tsx` takes its headline count `q.opens` from GET /quotes (BuildQuoteCards: views of the quote merged to ≤1 per hour), but its timeline and its reading come from `realOpens`, which is null until a lazy GET /quotes/:id/opens resolves after the card is flipped. The render does `opens = realOpens ?? []`, so "not loaded yet" is the same as "zero opens": the timeline prints `quoteCard.back.noOpens`, and `readingFor` (`front-end/lib/quotes-seed.ts`) hits its `opens.length === 0` branch and returns `quotesSeed.reading.noOpens.text`, whatever `q.opens` says. A failed fetch sets `realOpens` to `[]`, so the contradiction stays. The back face is always in the DOM (opacity 0 when unflipped), so the page text always carries it. Also, `/quotes/:id/opens` lists every raw view, so two loads within the hour give a 2-row timeline under "1 open".
**Requirement:** while a card says it was opened (`q.opens > 0`), no part of it says there were no opens: not before the history loads (a loading state), not after the load fails (an error state), and not in the unflipped back face. `readingFor` takes a not-loaded (`null`) history and reads from `q.opens`/`q.stage`. It returns `reading.noOpens` only when `q.opens === 0`. The timeline has as many rows as the count says (the same ≤1-per-hour merge).
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/quote-card-opens-truth.test.tsx` ("REQ-955 (LOOP-007 q1-30): …": `readingFor` with `[]` and with `null` on an opened quote; the SSR'd card; the live-mounted, flipped card with GET /quotes/:id/opens pending and rejected; a loaded-history harness check that passes) · int `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/opens-agree.int.test.ts` ("REQ-955 …": one customer open → both say 1, which passes today; two loads in the hour → card 1 and timeline 1) · e2e `e2e/quote-card-opens-truth/quote-card-opens-truth.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-955 …": send, open /api/quotes/:id/public once, then on /quotes the card's text unflipped, flipped with /opens held, after release, and on a reload with /opens → 500 never contains the no-opens copy).
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, branch fix/q1-q1-30 off qa-loop 16e7e33e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/quote-card-opens-truth.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 5 failed` (`en/email: q.opens=1 but the reading is "Sent, but no opens yet…"`; `readingFor(q, null) threw — TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'length')`; SSR card `Opens1 open · JoseNo opens recorded yet.`; pending and rejected fetch both render `No opens recorded yet.`; the loaded harness check passes). `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/opens-agree.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`the card says 1 open but its timeline lists 2`). `shots run e2e/quote-card-opens-truth -- --no-check` against `FRONTEND_PORT=36798 BACKEND_PORT=36799 deno task serve` → `✗ … got "unflipped: \"No opens recorded yet\", loading: \"No opens recorded yet\", failed: \"No opens recorded yet\""` (the loaded phase is clean).
**Fix:** the card keeps "not loaded" and "load failed" apart from "no opens". `QuoteCard.tsx` holds the history as `OpenEvent[] | null | "error"`; with no rows to show, the timeline says `quoteCard.back.noOpens` only when `q.opens === 0`, otherwise `quoteCard.back.opensLoading` ("Loading when they opened it…") while it loads or `quoteCard.back.opensError` ("Couldn't load when they opened it.") after a failed load (new en/es keys). `readingFor(q, opens: OpenEvent[] | null, lang)` takes the card's count as the truth about whether it was opened: `reading.noOpens*` only when `q.opens === 0` and the history is empty; an unloaded history only drops the device detail. Backend: one merge rule, `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/merge-opens/mod.ts` (`mergeOpensByHour`: oldest first, the first view of each hour bucket), now read by both BuildQuoteCards (the count) and GET /quotes/:id/opens (the timeline rows), so they cannot disagree. Unit test for the rule: `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/merge-opens/test.ts`.
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18, fix/q1-q1-30):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/quote-card-opens-truth.test.tsx` → `ok | 6 passed | 0 failed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/opens-agree.int.test.ts src/analytics/domain/business/merge-opens/test.ts` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`. `PORT=44101 deno task serve` + `SHOTS_DIR=<own> BASE_URL=http://localhost:44101 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/quote-card-opens-truth -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-955 (LOOP-007 q1-30): a quote opened once — its /quotes card never says 'no opens' next to 'Opened 1×' (unflipped, loading, loaded, failed load) · 24.7s` (1 pass · 0 fail). Neighbours: `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/analytics/domain/business/merge-opens/test.ts src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-quote-cards/ src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/` → `ok | 41 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6084 passed`; front-end `deno lint` + `deno check` on QuoteCard.tsx / quotes-seed.ts / the test → clean; backend `deno lint` + `deno check` on the four touched/new files → clean.

## REQ-956 — A quote the customer has opened is still pending on the dashboard (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-31)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q1-31** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], LOOP-007 cycle 1: "Dashboard says no quotes are pending while /quotes shows one out for response."
**Requirement:** Every dashboard count of quotes that are out with the customer — the QUOTES PENDING tile (`quotes.sent`, `awaitingResponse`, `quotedValueCents`), the money bar's "estimates out" bucket and the "Quotes awaiting signature" panel — counts the same quotes /quotes counts as "Out for response" (`classifyQuoteForPipeline(q) === "awaiting"`): sent **and viewed**, not undelivered (REQ-320/566), not won or lost, never the sample.
**Root cause:** the customer's first open of /q flips the quote `sent → viewed` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts` getQuotePublic). /quotes counts sent, viewed and sentAt as "awaiting" (`shared/quote-flow/pipeline-stats.ts` classifyQuoteForPipeline), but the dashboard's three filters hard-code `status === "sent"`: `compute-dashboard-stats/mod.ts` (`quotes.sent` and `quotedValueCents`, so the tile reads 0 and "—"), `shared/receivables/money-bar.ts` (the estimates bucket, "0 estimates out") and `front-end/islands/DashboardPage.tsx` (the awaiting-signature panel, which then falls to its empty line). The KPI filter dates from 4bfa5c4b/ec59ec6e (P-14/P-15); the money-bar and panel filters from 08b4524a (REQ-798).
**Tests:** unit (coordinator, KV :memory:) `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/compute-dashboard-stats/viewed-pending.int.test.ts` · unit `jest/unit/money-bar-viewed-quote.test.ts` · int `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/dashboard-controller/viewed-pending.int.test.ts` (send → public GET flips to viewed → GET /analytics/dashboard) · e2e `e2e/dashboard-viewed-quote/dashboard-viewed-quote.e2e.test.ts` (customer opens /q in a second context; /quotes "1 quote waiting"; /dashboard QUOTES PENDING 1, "$3,800 1 estimate out", the Dana Ruiz row).

A control copy of the story with the open skipped (status stays sent) passed, so the story's selectors and expected text are right.

## REQ-957 — The dashboard's "Money owed to you" headline never shows $0 beside the real amount (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-32)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issue q1-32 [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 1: the dashboard read "MONEY OWED TO YOU $0" next to "$4,650 1 open invoice" and "OUTSTANDING $4,650".
**Root cause:** the data agrees — `shared/receivables/money-bar.ts` sets `owedCents` = overdue + open, the same items as the tiles — but `front-end/components/MoneyBar.tsx` draws only the headline through `<Ticker value={Math.round(owedCents/100)}/>`, while the tiles are static `fmtMoney(b.cents)`. `front-end/islands/Ticker.tsx` starts at `useState(0)` and climbs over 1400 ms on requestAnimationFrame ticks, restarting from 0 whenever the value changes. So the server render and the first paint say $0; while the lists load (`pending`), DashboardPage builds the bar from empty lists and the headline is a real $0 (the `pending` prop only skeletons the rows); and when the lists land, the headline counts up from $0 beside a tile that already says $4,650. Came in with 08b4524a (REQ-798); REQ-473 (d599bbb4) only fixed the Ticker's "-0".
**Requirement:** the headline shows the real amount from its first render, equal to the overdue + open tiles; while the lists are pending it is a skeleton, never "$0". A count-up from 0 must never stand in for a number.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/components/MoneyBar.test.tsx` ("REQ-957 q1-32: …" — renderToString with INV-001 $4,650 sent, not yet due: the `money-owed` headline equals the open tile "$4,650"; with `pending` the headline is a shimmer skeleton, not "$0") · int n/a — no server contract changes, the stored numbers already agree · e2e `e2e/money-owed-headline/money-owed-headline.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-957 q1-32: …" — one sent invoice due in 7 days; a MutationObserver records headline and open tile at every DOM commit; from the commit where the open tile first shows $4,650 the headline must equal it).
**Evidence (2026-11-18), RED at 16e7e33e:** `deno test -A components/MoneyBar.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`headline "$0" must match the open tile "$4,650"`; `pending headline must not read "$0" (got "$0")`). `shots run e2e/money-owed-headline -- --no-check` → ✗, commits seen `[["$0","$4,650"],["$1,765","$4,650"],["$2,985","$4,650"], … ,["$4,643","$4,650"],["$4,650","$4,650"]]`.
**Fix:** `front-end/islands/Ticker.tsx` starts at `useState(value)` — the server render and first paint show the number — and eases only on a later change of `value`, from the number on screen (a ref) to the new one; no ease at all under `prefers-reduced-motion` or in a hidden tab. This also fixes the hero's "$<Ticker value={thisMonthBilled}/>" in DashSections.tsx. `front-end/components/MoneyBar.tsx` renders a `SkelBlock` (aria-busy) in the `money-owed` headline while `pending`, so the not-yet-loaded $0 never shows; when the lists land the Ticker mounts at the real value. Tests unchanged.
**Evidence (2026-11-18), GREEN:** `cd front-end && deno test -A components/MoneyBar.test.tsx` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A lib/dashboard-receivables.test.ts` → `ok | 11 passed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on Ticker.tsx, MoneyBar.tsx, MoneyBar.test.tsx, DashSections.tsx, DashboardPage.tsx → clean. `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> shots run e2e/money-owed-headline e2e/dashboard-money-owed e2e/money-bar e2e/settings-field-validate -- --no-check` (worktree serve on a random high port) → `5 pass · 0 fail` incl. "✓ REQ-957 q1-32 … · 1.7s". `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → 607 suites, 6084 passed, 0 failed.

## REQ-958 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-33: the /invoices hero never calls overdue money "on the way"
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q1-33** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 1: "Invoices money bar contradicts itself for an overdue invoice" — with one $1,000 invoice past due the hero read "$1,000 on the way across 1 invoice." beside the tile "OUT FOR PAYMENT $0 · 0 on the way".
**Root cause:** the two parts of the money bar sum different invoices under the same words. `invoiceKpiTotals` (front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts) puts overdue only in `overdueCents`; the Out tile shows `outTileCents` (out + claimed) with `invoicesPage.kpi.outSub` "{n} on the way", while the hero's fallback `"outstanding"` mode (from `invoicesHeroMode`, outstandingCount = overdue + out) shows `outstandingCents` (overdue + out + claimed, REQ-566) followed by `invoicesPage.hero.onTheWay` "on the way" / "en camino". So one overdue $1,000 invoice is "$1,000 on the way" in the hero and "$0 · 0 on the way" in the tile. The split dates from REQ-478 (cb6b9011); the hero wording from b6ec538e.
**Requirement:** the hero keeps REQ-566's total of everything still owed, but while that total holds an overdue balance its wording never says "on the way" / "en camino" (the Out tile's phrase); the wording is picked by a helper `invoicesHeroOutstandingKey(overdueCount)` in headline-counts.ts that the island renders through; the hero amount equals the Overdue tile + the Out tile.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/invoices-hero-overdue-wording.test.ts` ("REQ-958 …": one overdue $1,000 → mode "outstanding", tiles $1,000 / $0; the helper exists; its key reads neither "on the way" (en) nor "en camino" (es) with overdue > 0; the island's hero h1 renders through the helper, not `invoicesPage.hero.onTheWay`) · int n/a — pure front-end wording over totals that are already correct · e2e `e2e/invoices-hero-overdue/invoices-hero-overdue.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-958 …": seed one sent invoice due 3 days ago, open /invoices, read the hero h1 and the KPI tiles in one evaluate; the hero must not say "on the way" while the Out tile says "0 on the way", and hero amount = Overdue + Out).

**Fix:** new `invoicesHeroOutstandingKey(overdueCount)` in front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts returns `invoicesPage.hero.stillOwed` ("still owed to you" / "aún te deben") while any overdue invoice is in the total, else `invoicesPage.hero.onTheWay` (then the total is exactly the Out tile's out + claimed, so "on the way" stays true). The `"outstanding"` hero in front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx renders through it. Totals unchanged (REQ-566).
**Evidence (2026-11-18, GREEN):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/invoices-hero-overdue-wording.test.ts` → `Tests: 4 passed, 4 total`. Neighbouring jest unit suites (every unit file naming headline-counts / InvoicesPage / lang JSON / invoicesPage.*) `npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 608 passed, 608 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6088 passed`. `deno lint` + `deno check` on headline-counts.ts and InvoicesPage.tsx → clean; `deno fmt -` stdin diff → none. `shots run e2e/invoices-hero-overdue -- --no-check` against `PORT=5947 deno task serve` → `✓ REQ-958 (LOOP-007 q1-33): one overdue $1,000 invoice — … · 3.2s`.
