## REQ-959 — /invoices "Paid this month" and /payments count the same money: a part payment counts on both (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-34)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue q1-34 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Invoices and Payments pages disagree on this month's money", LOOP-007 cycle 1.
**Root cause:** the two KPIs start from different populations. /invoices "Paid this month" (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`, `paidThisMonth`) keeps only invoices whose stage is "paid" (status "paid" or `paidAt` set) with `paidAt` this month, then sums `paidKpiInvoiceCents`. A part-paid invoice (INV-002, $400 of $1,000) has no `paidAt`, so its stage is "out"/"overdue" and it is dropped. /payments (`PaymentsPage.tsx` `monthTotal`) sums `creditedPayments` over every landed payment received this month, the $400 included. Result: /invoices "$2,490 · 1 cleared" vs /payments "$2,890 showed up this month". The filter predates REQ-202 part payments; REQ-551 unified the per-bill amount but kept the stage filter, breaking its promise that every "paid" KPI counts what was collected.
**Requirement:** both pages compute "paid this month" from one shared helper in `front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts` (`paidThisMonthCents(payments, invoices, monthStart)` → cents, or `{ cents, clearedCount }`), so the /invoices tile equals the /payments hero.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/paid-this-month.test.ts` ("REQ-959 (q1-34): …" ×2 — the shared helper returns 288975 for $2,489.75 paid in full + a $400 part payment; the /invoices reduction equals the /payments sum) · integration n/a — the backend data is correct; the disagreement is front-end aggregation · e2e `e2e/paid-month-agree/paid-month-agree.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-959 (q1-34): …" — INV-001 $2,490 paid in full, a $400 check on INV-002 $1,000; the /invoices "Paid this month" tile equals the /payments hero).
**Evidence (2026-11-18, RED at 16e7e33e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/paid-this-month.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` ("headline-counts.ts exports no paidThisMonthCents"; `- 248975 + 288975`); `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> shots run e2e/paid-month-agree -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-959 (q1-34) … expected "$2,890", got "$2,490"`.
**Fix:** `front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts` gains `paidThisMonthCents(payments, invoices, monthStart)` → `{ cents, overCents, clearedCount }`: every non-reversed payment received on/after the month start, credited through `creditedPayments` (REQ-551 cap, the overpaid rest in `overCents`), plus the count of bills paid in full this month. `PaymentsPage.tsx` takes its hero `monthTotal`/`monthOverpaid` from it; `InvoicesPage.tsx` now loads `GET /payments` with the invoices (and re-reads it in `refreshInvoices`) and its "Paid this month" tile value is the same helper's `cents` (falls back to the fully paid bills only if `/payments` fails). The "n cleared" subline still counts bills paid in full. No lang keys changed.
**Evidence (2026-11-18, GREEN):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/paid-this-month.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `BASE_URL=http://localhost:53817 SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/paid-month-agree -- --no-check` (own `PORT=53817 deno task serve`; shots' self-started server answered `backend_unreachable` before its backend was up) → `✓ REQ-959 (q1-34): a $400 part payment counts on /invoices 'Paid this month' exactly as on the /payments hero · 5.7s`. Neighbours: `deno test -A` over the 11 front-end tests importing headline-counts/InvoicesPage/PaymentsPage → `ok | 74 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit <73 suites naming them>` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total · Tests: 6084 passed, 1 skipped`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the 3 touched files → clean; `deno fmt --check -` on each → clean.

## REQ-961 — Owner screens show one invoice's or payment's amount to the cent (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-35)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." LOOP-007, cycle 1, issue **q1-35** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Owner screens round invoice amounts to whole dollars".
**Requirement:** A single invoice's or payment's amount is shown to the cent on owner screens, the same figure the customer sees on /i/<id>, the PDF and the email: the /invoices card (front and back), the dashboard money bar ("Money owed to you", its bucket columns, segments and per-document rows) and the /payments cards, rows, hero stub and chargeback title. Totals read against an exact document (PAID THIS MONTH, the /payments month total) reconcile to the cent. `fmtMoney` stays for compact rollups such as the forecast copy.
**Root cause:** owner screens format one document's or payment's exact amount with the KPI formatter `fmtMoney` (`front-end/lib/format.ts`), which does `Math.round(|cents| / 100)`, so 248975 becomes "$2,490". The money bar's headline goes further and feeds its own whole-dollar `Math.round(owedCents / 100)` to the Ticker (`front-end/components/MoneyBar.tsx`). The invoice card has used `fmtMoney` since `InvoicesPage.tsx` was created (69b4ed4f), before audit1 #3 split `fmtMoney` / `fmtMoneyExact`; the owner's own drawer already uses `fmtMoneyExact`, so even owner screens disagreed.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/components/MoneyBar.cents.test.tsx` ("REQ-961 q1-35 …": renders MoneyBar with a 248975-cent open invoice: "$2,489.75" present, no "$2,490"; the headline Ticker is not fed 2490) · unit `jest/unit/q1-35-owner-cents.test.ts` ("REQ-961 …": the /invoices card front/back and the six /payments single-amount sites print through `fmtMoneyExact`; PAID THIS MONTH and the month totals are not plain `fmtMoney`) · int n/a — the backend already stores and returns 248975 cents (the story asserts it); the defect is front-end formatting only · e2e `e2e/owner-cents/owner-cents.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-961 q1-35 …": a 248975-cent sent invoice and a paid twin; /i/<id> shows $2,489.75; the /invoices card title, the money-bar owed headline and row, and the /payments card must all read $2,489.75).

**Fix:** single amounts go through `fmtMoneyExact` — the /invoices card front (`qcard__title`) and back (`qcard__back-big`), the forecast breakdown's per-invoice amount, every /payments single-payment site (hero stub, card front/back, claim card, landed row, chargeback title) and the money bar's per-document rows. Totals read against exact documents go through a new `fmtMoneyTotal` (`front-end/lib/format.ts`): whole dollars when the total is whole ("$2,400", "$0"), to the cent otherwise ("$2,489.75") — the money bar's bucket columns/segments and unbilled line, the /invoices KPI tiles (overdue / out / PAID THIS MONTH), the /payments hero month total, overpaid line, weekly flow line, top-payor rows and `PaymentsKpis`. The money bar headline now passes `owedCents` to `<Ticker cents>`; the Ticker's new cents mode (`centsText` in `front-end/lib/ticker-frame.ts`) settles to "2,489.75" (or "2,400" for a whole target). The forecast rollup copy keeps `fmtMoney`.

New unit cases: `front-end/lib/format.test.ts` ("REQ-961 fmtMoneyTotal …") and `front-end/lib/dashboard-receivables.test.ts` ("REQ-961 centsText …").
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18):** `deno test -A front-end/components/MoneyBar.cents.test.tsx front-end/lib/format.test.ts front-end/lib/dashboard-receivables.test.ts` + the other front-end neighbours (ConfirmRow, mark-paid-dialog, customer-link-lang, invoice-detail-actions, c5-preview-ask-textclient, invoice-card, payments-kpis, payment-card) → `ok | 83 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit <the 62 suites touching the changed files>` → `Test Suites: 608 passed, 608 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6095 passed`; `npx jest unit/q1-35-owner-cents.test.ts` → `Tests: 11 passed, 11 total`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on every touched front-end file → clean (`Checked 9 files`); against `PORT=5917 KV_PATH=<fresh> deno task serve`: `shots run e2e/owner-cents -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-961 q1-35 … · 1 pass · 0 fail`; neighbours `shots run e2e/finance-page-css e2e/invoice-card-refresh e2e/money-bar e2e/open-cards e2e/payment-chargeback e2e/owner-cents` → 10 pass, 2 fail: the "$400" pin (amended above; re-run `e2e/invoice-card-refresh e2e/owner-cents` → 4 pass · 0 fail) and REQ-626 open-cards "View as customer" expecting `/i/<id>` but getting `/i/<id>?lang=en` — that href comes from REQ-586's `invoiceLinkPath(inv.id, inv.lang)` (InvoicesPage.tsx, untouched by this fix), pre-existing and unrelated.

## REQ-960 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-36: a /payments card states only what the owner recorded (method, payer, reference)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issue q1-36 [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 1: "Payments card invents how a hand-recorded check was deposited".
**Root cause:** the text line on a /payments card does not come from the payment record. `noteFor(lang, method, daysAgo, client)` in `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` only switches on the method and fills in the payer's first name; `enrich()` never passes `p.reference`. For a check it always returns `paymentsPage.note.check` = "Check from {name}, deposited via mobile." / "Cheque de {name}, depositado por la app." — flavor copy ported as-is from the static design mock (49a5d6ca, made bilingual in b6ec538e). The ach/card/cash notes invent settlement facts the same way ("auto-pay cleared cleanly", "funds settle in 2 days", "logged from the truck"). REQ-018 made payments hand-recorded with an optional reference, which is stored but never shown on the card.
**Requirement:** a landed /payments card's note names the method and payer and, when the owner typed one, the reference (e.g. "1042"); it states no deposit channel or settlement fact nobody entered (no mobile/app deposit, auto-pay, settle-in-N-days, truck), in English and Spanish. `noteFor(lang, method, daysAgo, client, reference?)` takes the payment's reference from `enrich()`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/payments-note.test.ts` ("REQ-960 …": the real `noteFor` lifted from the island and run on both dictionaries — check with ref 1042 contains "1042" and no invented channel; check without ref; ach/card/cash carry the ref and no settlement facts; no `paymentsPage.note.*` value matches mobile/por la app/auto-pay/settle/truck; `enrich()` passes `p.reference`) · int n/a — the backend already stores `reference` (CreatePaymentDto), the bug is front-end copy only; the e2e asserts the stored ref · e2e `e2e/payment-note-facts/payment-note-facts.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-960 q1-36 (en|es) …": Check $400 ref 1042 recorded → the /payments card front and back show "1042" and no "deposited via mobile" / "por la app").

**Fix (2026-11-18):** `noteFor(lang, method, _daysAgo, client, reference?)` now builds the line from the record only: a check with a ref → `paymentsPage.note.checkRef` ("Check {ref} from {name}." / "Cheque {ref} de {name}."); any other method with a ref → its neutral note wrapped in `paymentsPage.note.withRef` ("{note} Ref {ref}." / "{note} Ref. {ref}."); no ref → the neutral note alone. `enrich()` passes `p.reference`. `paymentsPage.note.ach/card/cash/check` rewritten to "ACH payment from {name}." / "Card payment from {name}." / "Cash from {name}." / "Check from {name}." (es: "Pago ACH de …", "Pago con tarjeta de …", "Efectivo de …", "Cheque de …"); `note.cashToday` and `note.transitAch` deleted (nothing in the app uses them; transitAch invented a 2-day settlement). `note.transitCheck` is kept: the island does not use it, but REQ-413's es-copy-plurals-c1 test pins it to the "up to 5 business days" tip, and it invents no channel. The ui-breakdown landed-row / payment-card fixtures (and the generated viewer.html) now carry "Check 1042 from Tom." / "ACH payment from Greenfield." so the mock copy does not come back.
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/payments-note.test.ts` → `Tests: 9 passed, 9 total`. `PORT=5733 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5733 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/payment-note-facts -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-960 q1-36 (en) … · 2.7s`, `✓ REQ-960 q1-36 (es) … · 2.6s`. ## REQ-963 — A part payment recorded by hand gets a receipt, like the same payment told to the assistant (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-37)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q1-37** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "No receipt for a hand-recorded part payment", cycle 1: the customer paid $400 of $1,000 by check, the Record payment dialog flashed "Payment of $400.00 recorded", and no email reached the customer (the outbox's last entry was unchanged).
**Root cause:** the Record payment dialog (`front-end/components/PaymentReceivedForm.tsx`, on /invoices, /payments and the customer page) posts to `PaymentController.create` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/mod.ts`), which stores the payment, runs `ComputeInvoiceBalance` and emits the activity event — nothing else. The only customer email on that path is `MarkInvoicePaid`, which `ComputeInvoiceBalance` calls only when the balance reaches zero (REQ-020), so a part payment leaves the invoice pending and sends nothing. The receipt (PDF, email cc'd to the contractor, text, outbox + comms trail, `receiptSentVia`) lives only inside `ConfirmPayment`, which the claim-confirm and assistant (`RecordPaymentFromUtterance`) paths reach — and the assistant's tool text promises "records the payment and sends the receipt".
**Requirement:** a payment recorded through `POST /payments` that leaves a balance emails the customer one receipt ("Receipt for INV-…", the receipt PDF attached, the contractor cc'd), lists it in the outbox (kind `receipt`) and stamps `receiptSentVia`; the payment that closes the balance still sends exactly one customer email (the PAID invoice), never a receipt on top.
**Tests:** int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/partial-receipt.int.test.ts` ("REQ-963 q1-37: …" — $400 of $1,000 over HTTP → one receipt email, PDF, cc, outbox row, `receiptSentVia: "email"`; the closing payment → exactly one customer email) · e2e `e2e/req-963-partial-receipt/req-963-partial-receipt.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-963 q1-37: …" — /invoices → Record payment, check, $400 → the outbox gains one receipt email and /messages shows a Receipt row) · unit n/a — the defect is missing wiring in the controller; the receipt's rendering (subject, SMS, delivery truth) is already unit-covered by `confirm-payment/receipt-*.test.ts`, and a coordinator that does not exist yet would only fail on its import (the fixer adds its unit test if the receipt step is extracted).
**Evidence (2026-11-18, red):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/partial-receipt.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` — `AssertionError: Values are not equal: one receipt email to the customer; sent: []` (`- 0 + 1`); the closing-payment guard passes (one PAID email today). `SHOTS_JOBS=1 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/req-963-partial-receipt -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-963 q1-37 … expectation failed: the outbox gained one receipt email (outbox: []) — expected 1, got 0`.
**Fix:** the receipt step moved out of `ConfirmPayment` into its own coordinator, `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-receipt/mod.ts` (`SendPaymentReceipt.run(userId, invoiceId, {amount, method, reference?, receivedAt})`: receipt PDF, email to the customer cc'd to the contractor, guarded text, outbox + comms trail, `receiptSentVia` stamp). Its words (`renderReceiptSubject`, `renderReceiptHtml`, `fmtUSD`) moved to `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/payment-receipt/mod.ts` (re-exported from confirm-payment). `ConfirmPayment` builds it from its own collaborators and delegates (claim confirm + assistant paths unchanged). `PaymentController.create` calls it after `ComputeInvoiceBalance` when the returned status is not `paid` — the closing payment keeps only the PAID-invoice email (REQ-020). On a bill with a balance left the stamp is this receipt's own delivery (email > text > none); on a paid bill a PAID email already delivered still wins (REQ-556). Unit: `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-receipt/mod.test.ts` ("REQ-963 SendPaymentReceipt: …" — email + PDF + text + outbox + stamp; contractor cc; nothing on file → "none"; refused email → outbox not-sent + stamp "text"; another owner's invoice → nothing, no throw). The optional "Email the customer a receipt" checkbox and a flash naming where it went were not built (the dialog's flash is unchanged).
**Evidence (2026-11-18, green):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/partial-receipt.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`. `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-receipt/` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`. Neighbours (send-payment-receipt, confirm-payment/*, payment-controller/*, compute-invoice-balance, mark-invoice-paid, record-payment-from-utterance, outbox / customer-language / customer-branding / send-languages-lock / render-numbers int, agents billing-actions int) → `ok | 120 passed | 0 failed`; crm-lead-capture, owner-activity, revisions-controller e2e, invoice-controller paid-method + removal → `ok | 45 passed | 0 failed`. `deno lint` + `deno check` on the touched backend files → clean. e2e against a worktree serve (`PORT=61980 deno task serve`, then `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:61980 SHOTS_JOBS=1 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/req-963-partial-receipt -- --no-check`) → `shots: ✓ REQ-963 q1-37: a $400 part payment recorded in /invoices → Record payment puts a Receipt email to the customer in the Outbox · 3s` (`ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`). (In shots' self-served mode on the loaded host the story sometimes signs in before the backend is up — `backend_unreachable` at 0.6 s, a harness start-up race, not the story.)

## REQ-962 — An invoice is never due before it is issued (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-39)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA loop LOOP-007, cycle 1, issue **q1-39** [major/BUG_HARM]: "Due date before issue date is accepted and sent to the customer" — INV-002 was issued Nov 19 with a due date of Nov 1, went out at once with the subject "— due November 1, 2026" and showed as overdue (demo-loop/runs/r3db0ac6f/fleet-r3db0ac6f-2/stdout:23,110).
**Requirement:** a due date before the issue date is refused at every layer. (a) `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` exports `dueBeforeIssued(issuedDate, dueDate)` (yyyy-mm-dd compare; the same day is fine) and `buildInvoiceBody` never sends a due date before its issue date. (b) The New invoice form refuses it on Issue / Save with an error in both dictionaries (and its Due date input carries `min={issuedDate}`); nothing is created and nothing is sent. (c) `POST /invoices` and `PUT /invoices/:id` answer 422 `{ error: "due_before_issued" }` when due < issued (the issue date defaulting to today on create, the stored one on update) and store nothing. This extends REQ-554's "never due before it is issued" (Send-now re-dating only) to every invoice create and edit.
**Root cause (at 16e7e33e):** nothing checks the order of the dates at any layer. The New invoice form's Due date input (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`, `data-cy="new-invoice-due"`) has no `min` and its onInput stores whatever is typed as custom terms; submit only checks `if (!dueDate)`; `buildInvoiceBody` sends `form.dueDate ?? dueDateFrom(...)` unchanged; the create/update DTOs take both dates as plain optional strings and the POST handler only fills a missing due date with +30 days before `store.create`, as PUT stores the patch. The invoice is then issued, the email subject carries the stored past due date, and the aging rule (dueDate < now) marks it overdue at birth.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/invoice-due-before-issued.test.ts` ("REQ-962 dueBeforeIssued …", "REQ-962 buildInvoiceBody never sends a due date before the issue date …") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/due-before-issued.int.test.ts` ("REQ-962: POST /invoices refuses …", "REQ-962: PUT /invoices/:id refuses …") · e2e `e2e/invoice-due-before-issued/invoice-due-before-issued.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-962 q1-39: New invoice with Issue date 2026-11-19 and Due date 2026-11-01 is refused in the form — an error shows, no invoice is created, the outbox is empty").
**Evidence — RED (2026-11-18, cycle 1 test writer):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/invoice-due-before-issued.test.ts` → `Tests: 2 failed, 2 total` (`typeof dueBeforeIssued` expected "function", received "undefined"; `body.dueDate >= body.issuedDate` expected true, received false). `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/due-before-issued.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (POST: `got 200 {… "dueDate":"2026-11-01" … "issuedDate":"2026-11-19","status":"sent" … "urgency":"overdue15d"}`, expected 422; PUT: got 200 with dueDate 2026-11-01, expected 422). `shots run e2e/invoice-due-before-issued -- --no-check` against `FRONTEND_PORT=5873 BACKEND_PORT=5874 deno task serve` → `✗ … expectation failed: no invoice was created (got [{"number":"INV-001","status":"sent","issuedDate":"2026-11-19","dueDate":"2026-11-01"}]) — expected 0, got 1`.
**Fix (2026-11-19, cycle 1 fixer):** (a) `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` exports `dueBeforeIssued(issuedDate, dueDate)` (yyyy-mm-dd compare, the same day is fine, a blank side is no conflict); `buildInvoiceBody` sends the typed due date only when it is not before the issue date, else the terms' `dueDateFrom(issuedDate, netDays)`. (b) `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` NewInvoiceModal `submit` refuses with `invoicesPage.new.errDueBeforeIssued` (en "The due date can't be before the issue date." / es "La fecha de vencimiento no puede ser anterior a la fecha de emisión.") before anything is posted; the Due date input carries `min={issuedDate}`. (c) `invoice-controller/mod.ts`: `POST /invoices` answers 422 `due_before_issued` before deriving or storing anything when the body's due date is before its issue date; `PUT /invoices/:id` does the same when the patch touches either date, comparing the patch's dates or else the stored ones. **Deviation from (c) as written:** POST compares against the body's `issuedDate` only, not "today" when it is absent. The store never stamps an issue date, so a body without one has no issue date to be before; defaulting to today refused three existing invoice-controller fixtures (`e2e.test.ts` "DELETE removes", "GET ?status=pending", REQ-473 "?status=open") that create `dueDate: "2026-05-01"` with no issue date, and would refuse back-dated records. Every UI path sends `issuedDate` (`buildInvoiceBody`; the assistant stamps one), so the q1-39 path is covered. No assertion of the REQ-962 tests was changed.
**Evidence — GREEN (2026-11-19, cycle 1 fixer):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 608 passed, 608 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6086 passed, 6087 total` (includes `unit/invoice-due-before-issued.test.ts`). `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/due-before-issued.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`. The whole `src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/` dir → `27 passed | 1 failed`; the one was REQ-209's timing assert (`GET /search took 1274 ms`, host load ~100–200, dates valid); alone `--filter "REQ-209 300"` → `ok | 1 passed`. `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:5963 shots run e2e/invoice-numbering e2e/invoice-due-before-issued -- --no-check` against `FRONTEND_PORT=5963 BACKEND_PORT=5964 deno task serve` → `3 pass · 0 fail` (REQ-962 q1-39 ✓, REQ-206 ×2 ✓). `deno lint` + `deno check` of `islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` and `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` are clean; the touched files are fmt-clean via stdin; lang/en.json and es.json are valid JSON with 6277 keys each.

## REQ-937 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-4: "Publish revision" re-sends a quote in the language it last went out in, not the owner's UI language
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue q1-4 [major/BUG_HARM], LOOP-007 cycle 1: Q-002 went out to the customer in Español (V1 email: Spanish subject, `?lang=es`); "Publish revision and notify customer" sent Version 2 in English (`Quote Q-002 … — Version 2 …`, `<html lang="en">`, `?lang=en`).
**Requirement:** Publishing a revision with notify re-sends the document in the language it last went out in (`lastDelivery.lang`), unless the owner makes an explicit per-send pick; the owner's UI language is never sent as that pick.
**Root cause:** `QuoteLedgerSection.publish()` in `front-end/islands/QuotesPage.tsx` always calls `quotesClient.publish(q.id, { notify: true, language: lang })`, and `lang` is the owner's live UI language (`langSignal.value`). The backend (`revisions-controller` `publishOpts` → `notify` → `SendPaperworkEmail.run` / `SendPaperworkSms.run`) treats `language` as the per-send override, which `resolveCommsLanguage` puts ahead of the customer's language and the account default. The publish path also never reads `quote.lastDelivery.lang` (recorded by SendQuote), so even with no `language` in the body the revision goes out in the account default (English), and the publish dialog has no "Sends in" pick.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/publish-revision-language.test.ts` ("REQ-937 …": a pure `publishLanguage(quote, pick?)` in `front-end/lib/quote-panel-send.ts` — `lastDelivery.lang` "es" → "es", an explicit pick wins, never-sent → undefined; QuotesPage's publish call does not pass `language: lang`) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/publish-language.int.test.ts` ("REQ-937 …": a quote sent in es with a pending revision, `POST /quotes/:id/publish {notify:true}` → the email's subject "Cotización Q-001 …", `<html lang="es">`, `?lang=es`; `{notify:true, language:"en"}` still English) · e2e `e2e/publish-revision-language/publish-revision-language.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-937 …": English-UI owner sends Q-001 in Español via send-quote, files Version 2, clicks Publish revision → Publish on /quotes; the outbox's V2 email is language es, subject "Cotización Q-…", `?lang=es`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-18, cycle 1, at 16e7e33e):** int → `AssertionError: Expected actual: "Quote Q-001 from Rafa Castro — Version 2 — Roof Replacement" to match: "/^Cotización Q-001 /"` (`FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed`; the explicit-en guard passes); jest → `Expected: "es" Received: undefined`, `Expected: "en" Received: undefined`, `Expected pattern: not /language:\s*lang\b/ Received string: "quotesClient.publish(q.id, { notify: true, language: lang, }"` (4 failed, 1 passed); e2e → `expectation failed: Version 2's email is Spanish, like V1 — expected "es", got "en"`.
**Fix (2026-11-18, cycle 1):** front-end — new pure `publishLanguage(quote, pick?)` in `front-end/lib/quote-panel-send.ts` (pick → `lastDelivery.lang` → undefined); `QuoteLedgerSection.publish()` in `islands/QuotesPage.tsx` sends `language` only when that resolves, never the UI `lang`. Backend — `revisions-controller` `publishQuote` re-sends with `publishSendLanguage(body.language, quote.lastDelivery?.lang)`, so a body with no language goes out in the language Version 1 went out in (then REQ-715 customer language → account default as before); an explicit pick also becomes `lastDelivery.lang` so the in-app `?lang=` links follow it. Invoices carry no `lastDelivery`, so `publishInvoice` is unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-18, cycle 1):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/publish-language.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/` → `ok | 19 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/publish-revision-language.test.ts` (ran the whole unit project) → `Test Suites: 608 passed, 608 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6089 passed, 6090 total`; `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<own serve> SHOTS_DIR=<private> shots run e2e/publish-revision-language -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-937 (LOOP-007 q1-4) … · 7.4s` (1 pass · 0 fail); neighbours `e2e/quote-revisions quote-revision-* quote-revise-issued` → 8 pass · 1 fail, the fail being REQ-315's "a sent, unsigned quote gets Edit → Version 2" story, which clicks `quote-publish` and waits for `quote-published-note` without the `quote-publish-confirm` step REQ-304 (30840c7a) added — stale story, independent of this fix. `deno lint` + `deno check` green on the touched front-end and backend files; `deno fmt -` clean on each.

## REQ-964 — REQ-627 AMENDMENT (refs REQ-926): "Void & duplicate" must not copy the stale past due date or the chargeback fee (LOOP-007 q1, q1-40, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue q1-40 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION]: on /invoices, INV-002 → Void & duplicate opened draft INV-003 "Due Nov 1" (today Nov 19) carrying the $35 chargeback fee line silently ($1,035).
**Root cause:** `duplicateDraftOf` (shared/documents/removal.ts) copies a fixed COPY_FIELDS list as-is. It includes `dueDate` and the full `lineItems` / `amount` / `subtotalCents`, but not `issuedDate`, and never recomputes the due date from `netDays`. So the fresh draft keeps the voided bill's absolute past due date (the store only defaults a missing one), disagreeing with what Finish + send stamps (today + netDays, REQ-174/554). It also keeps the REQ-926 chargeback fee line with its `chargebackFor` link to a payment that stays on the voided invoice, folded into amount; `ChargebackPayment.undo` only edits the voided original, so undo can never take the copy's $35 away (breaks REQ-926(d)). REQ-926 came six days after REQ-627 and nobody revisited the copy.
**Requirement:** the copy's due date is counted from the day it is made (today + netDays; never before today), and the copy carries no `chargebackFor` fee line nor its cents; undoing the chargeback leaves the copy's amount unchanged.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/invoice-removal/test.ts` ("REQ-964 duplicateDraftOf: …" ×2 — called as `duplicateDraftOf(inv, todayIso)`: dueDate 2026-11-01 + netDays 15 on 2026-11-19 → 2026-12-04; fee line dropped, amount/subtotal 100000) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/removal.int.test.ts` ("REQ-964 void & duplicate: …" — past-due sent invoice, payment, chargeback feeCents 3500, void-duplicate → draft dueDate >= today, no fee line, amount 100000; undo chargeback → draft amount unchanged) · e2e `e2e/invoice-removal-print/invoice-removal-print.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-964: Void & duplicate on a past-due invoice …" — the opened draft card's Due label is not the stale date, dueDate >= today, no fee line).
**Evidence (2026-11-19, RED):** unit `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/invoice-removal/test.ts` → `FAILED | 6 passed | 2 failed` (`- 2026-11-01 + 2026-12-04`; fee line count `- 1 + 0`); int `--filter REQ-964` → `AssertionError: the fresh draft is due 2026-11-01, before today 2026-11-19` (with that line skipped: `the copy holds a chargeback fee line: [{"description":"Chargeback fee",…,"price":3500,"chargebackFor":"…"}]`); e2e `shots run e2e/invoice-removal-print -- --no-check --filter REQ-964` → `✗ … expectation failed: the draft reads "Due Nov 1" — the voided bill's past due date`.
**Fix:** `shared/documents/removal.ts` `duplicateDraftOf(inv, todayIso)` — `dueDate` is off COPY_FIELDS; the copy's due date is `dueDateFrom(todayIso, netDays)`, else the original's span (due − issued) from today, else unset (store default +30). Every REQ-926 fee line (`chargebackFor`) stays on the voided bill and its cents (price × qty) leave `amount` / `subtotalCents` (same arithmetic as `withoutChargebackFee`). The void-duplicate controller passes today. Front end: the Void panel shows `invoice-void-fee-note` ("The chargeback fee isn't copied to the corrected copy — add it back there if it's still owed.", `invoicesPage.remove.feeNote` en+es) when the bill carries a fee line, so leaving the fee off is not silent. The tests were not changed.
**Evidence (2026-11-19, GREEN):** unit `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/invoice-removal/test.ts` → `ok | 8 passed | 0 failed`; int `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/removal.int.test.ts` → `ok | 8 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/chargeback/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/` → `ok | 30 passed | 0 failed`; jest `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6084 passed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on islands/InvoicesPage.tsx, shared/documents/removal.ts, invoice-controller/mod.ts → clean; e2e (own `PORT=57340 deno task serve`, `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:57340 shots run e2e/invoice-removal-print -- --no-check`) → `✓ REQ-964: Void & duplicate on a past-due invoice with a chargeback fee …`, `✓ REQ-627: Void & duplicate …`, `✓ REQ-629 + REQ-627 …`, and `✓ REQ-627: a sent invoice is voided …` (the full-file run lost that one to a shots evidence-dir write error, `writefile … No such file or directory`; it passes alone).

## REQ-966 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-41 + q1-64: the invoice PDF and the CSV export show the status (and the PDF the title) the app shows
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issues, cycle 1: q1-41 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Invoice PDF is titled 'Service Agreement' and says PENDING for an overdue invoice"; q1-64 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "CSV export status 'pending' for an overdue invoice".
**Root cause:** the PDF and the export each print the raw stored `invoice.status` instead of the status the app derives at read time. A part payment makes `ComputeInvoiceBalance` store "pending"; "overdue" is never stored (`invoice-aging` `isOverdue`, `deriveUrgency` via `project()` on GET /invoices, `isPastDue` on /i). `render-invoice-pdf/mod.ts` stamps `(invoice.status ?? "due").toUpperCase()` — English "PENDING" even in a Spanish PDF, no past-due check (9d773fe2) — and its hero title falls through to `t(lang, "renderQuotePdf.heroFallback")` = "Service Agreement" (the quote PDF's key, kept by REQ-710 78344972), while /i falls back to `publicInvoice.jobNameFallback` "Project" and the PDF's own metadata says "Invoice INV-…" (REQ-204). `invoiceExportRow` in `shared/documents/exports.ts` writes `i.status ?? "draft"` into the Status column and `exportCsv` never derives urgency, so a past-due invoice exports as "pending" (partly paid) or "sent"/"viewed" (unpaid), against REQ-208's "exports preserve … statuses".
**Requirement (AMENDMENT to REQ-208's Status column, and to the invoice PDF):** (a) The invoice PDF's status stamp is the /i pill, translated: void, paid, claimed, past due, open — an open invoice past its due date reads "PAST DUE" / "VENCIDA" (or Overdue), never the raw enum. (b) An invoice PDF with no quote summary and no job name is titled like /i: "Project" / "Proyecto", never "Service Agreement" / "Acuerdo de servicio". (c) The CSV export's Status cell is a display status: paid, void, draft (and scheduled) as stored; "overdue" for an open invoice whose dueDate < now (same rule as `isOverdue`); "partly paid" for an open, not-yet-due invoice with paidCents > 0; otherwise its status ("sent"). `invoiceExportRow` takes `now` in its context (the tests also pin the clock). Note for the fixer: the existing REQ-208 int case seeds a "sent" invoice due 2026-11-13, which is past due now, so its expected "sent" becomes "overdue" (AMENDMENT).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/search-and-exports.test.ts` ("REQ-966 q1-64 …": pending + past due → "overdue"; pending + future due → "partly paid"; sent/viewed + past due → "overdue"; paid/void/draft/sent-not-due unchanged) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/int.test.ts` ("REQ-966 q1-41 render-invoice-pdf (en|es) …" past-due partly-paid amount-only invoice: no "PENDING", the past-due label, not "Service Agreement"/"Acuerdo De Servicio", title "Project"/"Proyecto"; "… a paid amount-only invoice is titled 'Project'") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/exports.int.test.ts` ("REQ-966 q1-64 GET /invoices/export.csv?status=all …": part payment over POST /payments, GET /invoices urgency overdue*, the CSV Status cells "overdue") · e2e `e2e/invoice-pdf-matches-page/invoice-pdf-matches-page.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-966 q1-41 …": overdue partly-paid amount-only invoice → /i pill "Past due" and heading "Project" → the /api/invoices/:id/pdf text carries both, no "PENDING", no "Service Agreement"). e2e for the CSV: n/a — a download; the int test covers it over HTTP.
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/int.test.ts --filter REQ-966` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (en: `"en: the raw stored status 'PENDING' is not printed"`, `"… past-due label … is printed"`, `"… not titled 'Service Agreement'"`, `"… falls back to 'Project'"`; es the same four; paid: `"titled 'Service Agreement'"`, `"no /i fallback title 'Project'"`); `exports.int.test.ts --filter REQ-966` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`- ["pending","sent"] + ["overdue","overdue"]`, setup asserts green: stored "pending", urgency overdue*); `npx jest unit/search-and-exports.test.ts -t REQ-966` → `3 failed, 1 passed` (`Expected: "overdue" Received: "pending"`, `Expected: "partly paid" Received: "pending"`, `Expected: "overdue" Received: "sent"`); `shots run e2e/invoice-pdf-matches-page -- --no-check` against `PORT=5966 deno task serve` → `✗ … expectation failed: the PDF does not print the stored status 'PENDING'` (setup green: /i pill "PAST DUE", heading "Project").

## REQ-965 — Every phone a PDF or email prints reads "(512) 555-0702", the one display the web pages use (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-42 + q1-43)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issues q1-42 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "PDFs print phone numbers unformatted" and q1-43 [polish/BUG_POLISH] "Contractor phone unformatted or inconsistent in emails and quote preview", LOOP-007 cycle 1.
**Root cause (at 16e7e33e):** the document renderers draw the stored phone strings as they are. Contractor phones are stored E.164 ("+15125550702"); customer phones are stored as typed ("8435550277", "843-555-0142"). The web pages run both through the shared `fmtPhone` (`shared/identity/phone.ts`), but the PDFs never do: `customerLines()` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts` (BILL TO on the invoice PDF, the customer block on the quote / signed-agreement PDF) puts `c.phoneNumber` in raw; the invoice and quote PDFs' FROM block and the receipt PDF's footer contact line put `contractor?.phoneNumber` in raw; only `render-invoice-print-pdf` formats, through a private copy. The signed-agreement email's From block (`send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts`) prints `escapeHtml(contractor.phoneNumber)` raw ("From Marcus Reyes +15125550701"). And the app has two "one display" formatters: `formatPhoneDisplay` (`shared/quote-flow/format-helpers.ts`, "+1 (512) 555-0700") used by the quote/invoice emails (REQ-719) and the assistant's send preview, against `fmtPhone` ("(512) 555-0700") used by Settings, the public quote and the public invoice.
**Requirement:** every phone printed on a PDF (invoice, quote / signed agreement, receipt, batch print) and in an email (quote, invoice, signed agreement) and in the send preview reads the way Settings and the public pages show it — `fmtPhone`'s "(512) 555-0702"; a non-US number stays as stored; every `tel:` link keeps the dialable E.164. REVISION of REQ-719's display string ("+1 (512) 555-0100" → "(512) 555-0100"); its no-raw-E.164 intent stands, and its `send-paperwork-email/phone-display.test.ts` expectation moves with it.
**Tests:**

- unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/phone-one-format.test.ts` ("REQ-965 (q1-43) the quote email / the invoice email shows the contractor phone as '(512) 555-0700' …")
- int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/phone-format.int.test.ts` (KV :memory: stores: FROM '(512) 555-0702', BILL TO '(843) 555-0142', no '+1512' / '843-555-0142')
- int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/phone-format.int.test.ts` (quote / signed-agreement PDF: '(512) 555-0701', '(843) 555-0277')
- int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-receipt-pdf/phone-format.int.test.ts` (footer contact line '(512) 555-0703')
- int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/phone-format.int.test.ts` (the signed-agreement email's From block: '(512) 555-0701', not '+15125550701' nor '+1 (512) …')
- e2e `e2e/pdf-phone-format/pdf-phone-format.e2e.test.ts` (sign in, a customer typed '843-555-0142', open /i/:id: the page shows the contractor phone '(512) NNN-NNNN'; the PDF its Download link serves prints that same string and '(843) 555-0142')
**Evidence — RED (2026-11-18, fix/q1-q1-42 off 16e7e33e):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/phone.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 3 failed` (`- "843-555-0142" + "(843) 555-0142"`; `- +1 (512) 555-0701 + (512) 555-0701`). The three PDF int files → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed`, the drawn text carrying `843-555-0142` / `+15125550702`, `8435550277` / `+15125550701`, `+15125550703 · marcus@test.dev`. `send-signed-confirmation/phone-format.int.test.ts` → `FAILED`, visible text "… From Marcus Reyes +15125550701 marcus@test.dev". `phone-one-format.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` ("the email shows the '+1 (512) …' form"). `shots run e2e/pdf-phone-format -- --no-check` against `PORT=5737 deno task serve` → ✗ "the PDF's FROM prints '(512) 972-4011' like the page", the PDF text reading `BILL TO / FROM / 843-555-0142 / +15129724011`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** one display string. `formatPhoneDisplay` (`shared/quote-flow/format-helpers.ts`) now returns `fmtPhone`'s "(512) 555-0702" (no "+1 " prefix), so the quote/invoice emails, the send preview, the divider, payment instructions and the clients board agree with Settings and the public pages. `customerLines()` (doc-render) draws `fmtPhone(c.phoneNumber)`; the invoice and quote PDFs' FROM block, the receipt footer and the signed-agreement email's From block go through `fmtPhone`; `render-invoice-print-pdf` drops its private copy for the shared one. `tel:` links are unchanged (still `telHref` → E.164).
