## REQ-984 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-60: the public invoice is never headed "Project", and its headline agrees with the badge after a claim
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". Issue **q1-60** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 1: "Public invoice heading is the placeholder 'Project'". QA3: 'heading is the placeholder "Project" and header still says "INV-001 · Version 1 · Sent" under an "AWAITING CONFIRMATION" badge'. QA5: 'Public invoice with no line items is titled "Project"'.
**Root cause:** two faults on `/i/:id`. (1) The hero `<h1>` in `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` is the job name, else the job summary, else the i18n key `publicInvoice.jobNameFallback` ("Project" / "Proyecto"). An amount-only invoice from the New invoice form has neither a job name nor a summary, so it is always headed "Project", even when it has a service line; the fallback never names the document (its first line, or "Invoice INV-001"). (2) The headline (`data-cy=invoice-headline`) is rendered on the server from `invoice.state` ("… · Sent"). After a successful "Already paid? Tell us how" claim, `front-end/islands/PublicInvoiceClaim.tsx` (UX-35) rewrites only the `[data-status-pill]` badge to "Awaiting confirmation" and the footer; it never touches the headline, so "INV-001 · Version 1 · Sent" sits under the AWAITING CONFIRMATION badge until a reload (after which the server sends `claimed` → "Payment reported").
**Requirement:** (a) The `/i/:id` heading of an invoice with no job name or summary names the document — its first line's description, else the invoice by number (EN and ES) — never "Project" / "Proyecto". (b) When the claim island flips the badge, the headline reads "Payment reported" in the same moment (and "Paid" when the badge flips to Paid), without a reload; after a reload both still agree.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/public-invoice-title.test.tsx` ("REQ-984 (q1-60) …": the real route over a stubbed backend — amount-only EN not "Project" and names INV-001, ES not "Proyecto", one service line → "Gutter cleaning") · int `front-end/lib/public-invoice-title.int.test.tsx` ("REQ-984 (q1-60) int …": the real backend booted in process (KV :memory:), invoices made over its HTTP API, the real route's server render read through `__backendFetch`) · e2e `e2e/public-invoice-title/public-invoice-title.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-984 (q1-60) …": the customer's /i heading; Zelle claim → headline "Payment reported" under "Awaiting confirmation" without a reload, then after one). Unit for the island's DOM patch: n/a — it patches SSR markup outside the island after a real fetch; no DOM library that runs Preact events is in the repo (deno-dom does not dispatch them), so the e2e is the level that reproduces the stale "Sent". `invoiceHeadline` for the claimed state is already right ("INV-001 · Version 1 · Payment reported").
**Evidence (2026-11-18, RED at 16e7e33e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/public-invoice-title.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (`the heading is the placeholder: "Project"` ×2, `"Proyecto"`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check lib/public-invoice-title.int.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`the EN heading is the placeholder: "Project"`; the one-service invoice also renders "Project"); `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/public-invoice-title -- --no-check` → both stories red: `the heading is the placeholder: "Project"` and `without a reload the headline agrees with the badge — "Payment reported", not "Sent": "INV-001 · Version 1 · Sent" under "Awaiting confirmation"`.
**Fix:** (a) a pure `invoiceTitle` in `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` (job name, else summary, else the first line's description, else "Invoice INV-001" / "Factura INV-001") heads `/i/:id` (`front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx`) and the rich invoice email's hero (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`, which also fell back to "Project"); `publicInvoice.jobNameFallback` is no longer read by the app (kept in lang/*.json only because the excluded `front-end/ui-breakdown` copy still names it). The tab title was already "Invoice — <business>" and the invoice subject already "Invoice INV-001 from …", so neither needed a change. (b) the route puts the headline's parts on `[data-cy=invoice-headline]` (`data-headline-number/version/published/due/internal`); `front-end/lib/invoice-headline-flip.ts` rebuilds it with the same shared `invoiceHeadline`, and `PublicInvoiceClaim` calls it with "claimed" after a claim and "paid" on `already_paid`, and `PublicCardPay.markPaid` with "paid", so the headline and badge change together. Extra unit `front-end/lib/invoice-headline-flip.test.ts` ("REQ-984 (q1-60) …": the rebuilt headline is "Payment reported" / "Pago reportado", "Paid · <date>", no parts → no rewrite; `invoiceTitle` order in EN/ES).
**Evidence (2026-11-18, GREEN on fix/q1-q1-60):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/public-invoice-title.test.tsx lib/invoice-headline-flip.test.ts` → `ok | 7 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check lib/public-invoice-title.int.test.tsx` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`; e2e against a worktree serve (`PORT=57611 deno task serve`; the self-started lane serve ran the stories before the cold backend was listening, so `backend_unreachable`) `BASE_URL=http://localhost:57611 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/public-invoice-title -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-984 (q1-60): after 'Already paid? Tell us how' the headline says 'Payment reported' … · 14s` and `✓ REQ-984 (q1-60): the customer's /i/:id for an amount-only invoice is not headed 'Project' · 12.9s` (the summary's other rows belong to parallel agents sharing the session's evidence dir). Neighbours: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `607 passed, 607 total`; backend paperwork + send-invoice tests that render invoice email (`deno test -A --unstable-kv` over 20 files) → `ok | 87 passed | 0 failed`; front-end `lib/{standalone-invoice-doc,invoice-preview-methods,customer-link-lang,site-footer-document}.test.tsx` + the above → `ok | 32 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on every touched file → clean; touched files fmt-clean via stdin (the send-paperwork-email module's pre-existing fmt drift at HEAD is untouched).

## REQ-980 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-61: the invoice email says "Drafted" on a sent invoice; "Ways to pay" lists only Zelle
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue **q1-61** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] (QA3 002, QA5 002, QA4 003), LOOP-007 cycle 1.
**Root cause:** (1) The amount-only invoice email (`renderInvoiceBasicHtml`, the path for a standalone invoice with no quote items) goes through the generic `shell()` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`, which hard-codes `paperworkEmail.shell.draftedLabel` ("Drafted" / "Creada") over the date it is passed. `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` passes the issue date, so the header reads "Drafted November 19, 2026" right above the details row "Issued November 19, 2026" and "Status: Sent". The itemized invoice email labels that slot "Issued". (2) `payWaysEmailHtml` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/pay-ways/mod.ts`) builds its rows only from `payButtons()` (`shared/payments/pay-links.ts`), which emits Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, custom links and Zelle and drops check, cash, ACH and other, although `projectPayMethods()` projects them. The same email's "Payment instructions" (`paymentInstructionsFromMethods`) joins every enabled method, so it reads "Check · Zelle" while "Ways to pay" shows only Zelle.
**Requirement:** a sent invoice email's header labels its date "Issued" / "Emitida", never "Drafted" / "Creada" (the quote email keeps "Drafted"). A block headed "Ways to pay" / "Formas de pago" names every method the business accepts, Check included; or it no longer claims to list every way (amends REQ-630(e)).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/pay-ways/test.ts` ("REQ-980 (q1-61) payWaysEmailHtml: Check + Zelle enabled …", en + es) · unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/header-date-label.test.ts` ("REQ-980 (q1-61) [en]/[es] … header labels its date Issued/Emitida …"; the quote email keeps "Drafted") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/pay-links.int.test.ts` ("REQ-980 (q1-61) the amount-only invoice email …", the real coordinator on a booted app, KV :memory:) · e2e `e2e/invoice-email-header/invoice-email-header.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-980 (q1-61) …": send a standalone invoice by email, open it in the Outbox, read the header and the pay-way rows).
**Evidence (2026-11-18), RED at 16e7e33e:** pay-ways unit `FAILED | 4 passed | 1 failed` — `[en] a block headed "Ways to pay" omits the accepted Check method` (only `data-pay-way="zelle"` rendered); header unit `FAILED | 1 passed | 2 failed` — `the invoice header says "Drafted"` / `"Creada"`; int `FAILED | 3 passed | 1 failed` — `['the header says "Drafted"', 'the header has no "Issued"', "the 'Ways to pay' block leaves out Check, which the business accepts"]`; e2e against `PORT=5617 deno task serve` — `✗ … the sent invoice's header says Drafted: "Ortega Handyman Services\n\n\nINVOICE\nINV-001\n\t\nDRAFTED\nNovember 19, 2026 …"`.
**Fix (REQ-630(e) AMENDMENT):** `shell()` takes an optional `dateLabel` (default stays `paperworkEmail.shell.draftedLabel`, so the quote and every other caller keep "Drafted"); `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` passes `paperworkEmail.invoice.issuedLabel` and `fmtDate(i.issuedDate ?? i.createdAt)`, exactly as the itemized invoice email does, so the header and the "Issued" details row agree. `payWaysEmailHtml` now appends non-tappable rows after the online ones for the offline methods `projectPayMethods()` returns — `data-pay-way="check"` ("Check: mail to {handle}" / "Cheque: envíalo por correo a {handle}", or plain "Check"/"Cheque"), `cash`, `ach` ("Bank transfer: {instructions}") and `other` (its own text). New keys `payLinks.email.check|checkPlain|cash|ach|achPlain` in lang/en.json + lang/es.json. REQ-630's "nothing online → no block" still holds: offline rows only join a block that already has an online row, so a check-only business gets no "Ways to pay" block, just its payment instructions.
**Evidence (2026-11-18), GREEN:** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/pay-ways/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/` → `ok | 58 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/pay-links.int.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`; `… square-pay.int.test.ts` → `ok | 7 passed | 0 failed`; `deno check` on both touched modules → Check ok; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 6084 passed, 1 skipped`; e2e `PORT=7393 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:7393 shots run e2e/invoice-email-header -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-980 (q1-61): a sent standalone invoice email (Check + Zelle) — the header date is 'Issued', not 'Drafted', and Ways to pay names Check as well as Zelle · 3s`. (A first e2e run on 5617 still said "Drafted" because port 5618 was held by another worktree's backend, so the frontend proxied to that agent's code; the run on 7393 had this worktree's backend on 7394.)

## REQ-981 — A discount bigger than the bill never shows or stores more than the subtotal (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-62)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue q1-62 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 1: "Discount bigger than subtotal shows −$100 with Total $0" (New invoice form: Subtotal $0.00 / Discount −$100.00 / Tax $0.00 / Total $0.00).
**Root cause:** `computeTotals` (shared/documents/invoice-form.ts, added in 474f09dc for REQ-198..210/REQ-206) floors the taxable amount at zero (`taxableCents = max(0, subtotal − discount)`) but returns the discount exactly as typed (`discountCents = max(0, round(input.discountCents))`), never clamped to the subtotal. NewInvoiceModal renders that raw discount next to a $0 total, so the lines don't add up; `buildInvoiceBody` posts it unchanged, `POST /invoices` stores it, and the email and PDF print "-$100.00" to the customer. `POST /invoices/:id/discount` adds to the cumulative `discountCents` the same unclamped way.
**Requirement:** the discount shown, posted and stored is never more than the pre-discount subtotal; the shown subtotal − discount + tax always equals the total. The backend refuses (4xx) or caps an overlarge discount on `POST /invoices` and `POST /invoices/:id/discount`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/invoice-discount-cap.test.ts` ("REQ-981 q1-62 …": no amount + $100 → discount 0; $50 + $100 at 8.25% → discount $50, total $0; lines $5 with $9 off → $5; 500 seeded random inputs add up with discount ≤ subtotal; `buildInvoiceBody` never posts discount > subtotal) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/discount-cap.int.test.ts` ("REQ-981 q1-62 …": POST /invoices $0/$100 and $50/$100, POST /:id/discount $100 off $50 — refused or stored ≤ subtotal) · e2e `e2e/invoice-discount-cap/invoice-discount-cap.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-981 q1-62 …": /invoices → New invoice, Discount 100 with no amount shows no −$100.00 and the totals add up; then $50 + 8.25% tax, discount ≤ subtotal and the lines add up).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-18, at 16e7e33e):** jest `Tests: 5 failed, 5 total` (`Expected: 0 / Received: 10000`, `Expected: 5000 / Received: 10000`, `Expected: 500 / Received: 900`); int `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed (3 steps)` (`stored discountCents 10000 > subtotalCents 0 (POST 200)`, `stored discountCents 10000 > subtotal 5000 (POST 200)`, `stored discountCents 10000 on a $50 invoice (discount POST 200)`); e2e `✗ REQ-981 … expectation failed: REQ-981 no −$100.00 discount line with no amount (Subtotal$0.00Discount (USD)−$100.00Tax$0.00Total$0.00)`.
**Fix:** `computeTotals` caps the discount at the subtotal (`discountCents = min(subtotal, max(0, round(typed)))`), so the New invoice totals block, `buildInvoiceBody` and every other `computeTotals` caller always add up and never post more discount than bill. NewInvoiceModal shows an inline note (`[data-cy=new-invoice-discount-capped]`, `invoicesPage.new.discountCapped` en+es: "A discount can't be more than the subtotal ($X) — only $X comes off.") under the discount field whenever the typed discount was capped. Backend: `POST /invoices` answers 422 `discount_exceeds_subtotal` when `discountCents` is more than the sent `subtotalCents` (else the line items' sum); `POST /invoices/:id/discount` caps the discount at the invoice's remaining `amount` (and answers 422 `discount_exceeds_amount` when nothing is left to discount).
**Test change (e2e only, assertions untouched):** the story's second half typed into `new-invoice-amount`, but REQ-921 opens the form with one empty service row and Amount is read-only while a row exists, so `locator.fill` timed out (the red run never reached it — its first expectation already failed). The story now clicks `new-invoice-line-remove-0` first, the same way a user gets the one-amount bill.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-18):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/invoice-discount-cap.test.ts` → `Tests: 5 passed, 5 total`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/discount-cap.int.test.ts` → `ok | 1 passed (3 steps) | 0 failed`; e2e (PORT=5981 serve) `shots run e2e/invoice-discount-cap -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-981 q1-62 … · 2.6s — 1 pass · 0 fail`. Neighbours: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/invoice …` → `Test Suites: 608 passed, 608 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6089 passed`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/` → `ok | 27 passed (3 steps) | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` green on InvoicesPage.tsx, shared/documents/invoice-form.ts, invoice-controller/mod.ts; `deno fmt -` clean on every touched TS file.

## REQ-985 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-63: the overdue invoice card suggests a text for a client with no phone and lists "View as customer" twice
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA loop LOOP-007, cycle 1, issue **q1-63** [polish/BUG_POLISH]: "Overdue card suggests a text for a client with no phone and lists 'View as customer' twice".
**Root cause (RCA at 16e7e33e):** two separate defects on the same /invoices card. (1) The card's `readText` (front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx, overdue branch) always uses `invoicesPage.read.overdue.one/other`, "Past due {n} days. A friendly text usually unsticks it." It never checks `inv.textPhone` / `canTextClient`, which the card already has, so a client with only an email (or no contact at all) still gets advice to text. The overdue footer shows the mute toggle instead of "Text client" / "Add a phone", so the card offers no way to act on that advice. (2) The card back renders its own `<a data-cy="invoice-view-as-customer">` and, right after it, REQ-702's `<InvoiceStageActions showStageCta={false}>` (mounted only for Copy link). That component always renders a second "View as customer" (`invoice-card-open`) and has no prop to hide it.
**Requirement:** (a) The card back shows "View as customer" exactly once. (b) The overdue line suggests a text only when the client has a phone that can take one. With only an email it suggests a reminder without mentioning a text. With no email and no phone it says so and asks for one. Spanish follows the same rules. Contract: a pure `overdueReadText(inv: { daysOverdue, textPhone?, email? }, lang)` in `front-end/lib/invoice-card.ts`, used by the card's overdue `readText`.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/invoice-card-overdue-back.test.tsx` ("REQ-985 (LOOP-007 q1-63) …": one View as customer on the card back, counting the card's own link plus the real `InvoiceStageActions` render with the props the card passes; email-only and no-contact overdue lines don't mention a text in en/es; a textable phone keeps the current text line; the card's readText goes through `overdueReadText`) · int n/a (no backend change: the bug is in front-end copy and markup) · e2e `e2e/invoice-overdue-back-q1-63/invoice-overdue-back-q1-63.e2e.test.ts` (an email-only customer with an invoice 5 days past due: flip the /invoices card, there is one "View as customer" in the back foot, and the overdue line doesn't suggest a text).
**Evidence (red, 2026-11-18):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/invoice-card-overdue-back.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 5 failed` (`card back renders 'View as customer' 1 time(s) itself + 1 via <InvoiceStageActions>` `-2 +1`; `lib/invoice-card.ts exports overdueReadText(inv, lang)`). `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> BASE_URL=http://localhost:20254 shots run e2e/invoice-overdue-back-q1-63 -- --no-check` against `PORT=20254 deno task serve` → `the back lists 'View as customer' once (Send nudge / Open / View as customer / View as customer / Copy link / Payment received / Mute) — expected 1, got 2`. In an earlier run of the same story, with the copy check first: `the client has no phone — the overdue line must not suggest a text ("Past due 4 days. A friendly text usually unsticks it.")`.
**Fix (2026-11-18):** (1) `InvoiceStageActions` takes `showViewLink` (default true); the /invoices card back passes `showViewLink={false}`, so its own `invoice-view-as-customer` link (REQ-626) is the only one and the detail panel keeps the component's link. (2) `overdueReadText(inv, lang)` in `front-end/lib/invoice-card.ts` picks `invoicesPage.read.overdue.*` (text) only when `canTextClient(textPhone)`, `invoicesPage.read.overdueEmail.*` ("A friendly reminder usually unsticks it.") when there is only an email, and `invoicesPage.read.overdueNoContact.*` when there is neither. The card's `readText` uses it, fed by a new `contactEmail` on the enriched invoice (`invoiceContactEmail` in `lib/invoice-text-client.ts`: the linked customer's email, else bill-to / snapshot). An overdue card with no contact also gets an "Add email or phone" link (`invoice-add-contact`, `customerFixHref`) in its back foot. The Spanish text line now says "mensaje de texto" so it is clearly a text, and every new key is in both lang files.
**Test correction:** the unit test's "textable phone" fixture was `+15125550123`. That number is in the fictional 555-01xx block, which REQ-569/REQ-691's `canTextClient` already treats as unable to take a text (the card shows no "Text client" for it). ## REQ-983 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-67: a cancelled public invoice does not thank the customer for prompt payment
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007 QA loop): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". Issue q1-67 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 1.

**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". The English-only REQ-136 dev harness (`islands/SearchSelectDemo.tsx`) pins `lang="en"`. ## REQ-941 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-7: a hand-recorded payment that closes an invoice must not promise a PDF receipt it never emailed
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issue q1-7 [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], LOOP-007 cycle 1: public invoice says "Un recibo en PDF está en tu correo" but the paid email has no attachment.
**Root cause:** a payment recorded by hand that closes the balance (customer page "Registrar pago" → `POST /payments`) runs `ComputeInvoiceBalance` → `MarkInvoicePaid`, which sends only the REQ-020 paid-invoice email (`SendPaperworkEmail` kind "invoice", variant "paid") with no attachment, then records `receiptSentVia: "email"` whenever that send is delivered (REQ-556, 7359499f). `/i` passes that flag to `receivedNoteBody`, which for "email" picks `publicInvoice.received.body` — "A PDF receipt is in your inbox" / "Un recibo en PDF está en tu correo". The only receipt PDF (`RenderReceiptPdf`, `confirmPayment.email.attachmentName`) is attached by `ConfirmPayment`, reached only when the contractor confirms a customer claim. So the page promises a PDF the customer never got.
**Requirement:** every path that closes an invoice keeps /i's promise: when /i says a PDF receipt is in the inbox, the customer's email carried one (`application/pdf`), and a hand-recorded closing payment emails exactly one receipt PDF.
**Tests:**
- unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/mark-invoice-paid/receipt-pdf.test.ts` ("REQ-941 … receiptSentVia 'email' only when the delivered email carried a PDF receipt")
- int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/mark-invoice-paid/receipt-pdf.int.test.ts` ("REQ-941 … a hand-recorded payment that closes the invoice emails the customer a PDF receipt, matching what /i promises": the whole app on KV `:memory:`, `POST /customers` → `POST /invoices` → `POST /payments` for the full amount; the Postmark send captured; the /i?lang=es note built from the public read with the real es.json)
- e2e n/a — an email's attachments are not visible on any browser surface (the outbox stores no attachments; dev-mode EmailService never dispatches), so a story cannot observe the bug; the int test drives the same HTTP routes the customer page uses and reads the same public record /i renders.
**Evidence (red, 2026-11-18, cycle 1):** `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/mark-invoice-paid/receipt-pdf.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/mark-invoice-paid/receipt-pdf.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed`: int `/i says "¡Gracias! Rosa confirmó tu pago el 17 de noviembre de 2026. Un recibo en PDF está en tu correo." (receiptSentVia email), the customer's emails carried 0 PDF(s): [{"subject":"Paid — Invoice INV-001 from Rosa Paid","attachments":[]}]`; unit `receiptSentVia is "email" but the paid email had no PDF attachment`.
- unit (jest) `jest/unit/delivery-truth.test.ts` ("REQ-941 (LOOP-007 q1-7) the paid invoice emailed WITHOUT the PDF receipt never promises a PDF": `receiptSentViaOf("paid_email")`, `receivedNoteBody` for "paid_email" never contains "PDF" in en + es, "email" keeps the es PDF sentence, the paid card still reads "sent automatically", `paperworkEmail.invoice.receiptAttached` in both dictionaries)
**Fix (cycle 1):** the promise is made true. `MarkInvoicePaid` renders the receipt PDF (`RenderReceiptPdf`, the same render ConfirmPayment uses — the invoice, the customer, the business name and logo, the method and reference of the payment that closed it, in the language `SendPaperworkEmail` resolves for that email) and attaches it (`Receipt-<ref>.pdf` / `Recibo-<ref>.pdf`) to the paid-invoice email; `SendPaperworkEmail` gained an `attachments` passthrough to `EmailService` and, when one is a PDF, closes the body with "A PDF receipt is attached for your records." / "Adjuntamos un recibo en PDF para tus registros." (`paperworkEmail.invoice.receiptAttached`). `receiptSentVia` is now "email" only when the delivered email carried the PDF; a delivered paid email without it (the render failed, or ConfirmPayment's path) records the new value "paid_email", which `/i` renders as `publicInvoice.received.bodyPaidEmail` ("We emailed you the invoice marked paid." / "Te enviamos por correo la factura marcada como pagada." — no PDF claim) and the /invoices paid card still reads "Receipt sent automatically". ConfirmPayment passes `{ receiptPdf: false }` through `ComputeInvoiceBalance.run` → `MarkInvoicePaid.run`, because its own receipt email already carries the PDF — the customer never gets two; its `receiptSentVia` ladder is email (PDF) → text → paid_email → none.
**Evidence (green, 2026-11-18, cycle 1):**
- `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/mark-invoice-paid/` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed` (both REQ-941 tests + the three REQ-556 MarkInvoicePaid tests)
- neighbours: `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv` on `mark-invoice-paid/ confirm-payment/ send-paperwork-email/ compute-invoice-balance/ entrypoints/payment-controller/ outbox.int customer-language.int customer-branding.int send-languages-lock.int agents/…/billing-actions.int` → `ok | 139 passed | 0 failed (8m12s)`
- `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/delivery-truth.test.ts unit/public-invoice-received-note.test.ts` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6089 passed, 6090 total` (the unit project ran whole, incl. i18n-dictionary-consistency)
- `cd front-end && deno lint routes/i/[id].tsx ../shared/documents/delivery-truth.ts ../shared/documents/received-note.ts` → `Checked 3 files`; backend `deno lint` on the 4 touched coordinators → `Checked 4 files`
- `cd front-end && deno check routes/i/[id].tsx` → `Check routes/i/[id].tsx`, exit 0

## REQ-990 — LOOP-007 cycle 1 (q1-70, q1-78): one zero-balance word, and the REQ-323 never-billed rule on the customer page and the sidebar (amends REQ-323 / REQ-924)
**Requirement (Raphael's words):** "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issues **q1-70** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Board and customer page disagree for a customer never billed" and **q1-78** [polish/BUG_POLISH] "Three different words for 'paid up'", cycle 1.
**Root cause:** the REQ-323 rule (a zero balance with nothing billed reads "Nothing billed yet", not "Settled") lives only in the board's helper (`balanceDisplay` + `hasBilled` in `front-end/lib/clients-display.ts`). The customer page built later for REQ-924 (`front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx`, Balance KPI `cws-owed-amount`) chooses on `s.owedCents > 0` alone and shows `customerWs.kpi.paidUp` ("All paid up" / "Todo pagado", hint "No open balance") for a customer with no issued invoice, beside its own "Invoices: 0"; the sidebar's `CustomersNav.statusLine` falls back to `customerWs.nav.paid` ("Paid up" / "Al día"). So a zero balance has three words (board "Settled"/"Saldado", sidebar "Paid up"/"Al día", KPI "All paid up"/"Todo pagado") and a never-billed customer is "Nothing billed yet" on the board but "All paid up" on her page. **Fix (2026-11-18):** the one word for "nothing owed" is the board's — **"Settled" / "Saldado"** once an issued, non-void invoice exists, else **"Nothing billed yet" / "Sin facturar"** (REQ-323). `zeroBalanceKey(billed)` + `isIssuedState(state)` in `front-end/lib/clients-display.ts` (the board's `balanceDisplay`/`hasBilled` now call them); `customerNavRows` (`front-end/lib/customer-nav.ts`) marks a zero-balance row `billed: hasBilled(card)` and `CustomersNav.statusLine` words it with `zeroBalanceKey` (sessionStorage cache key bumped to `pm:customers-nav:v2` so old rows without `billed` are not shown); `CustomerWorkspace`'s Balance KPI words a zero balance with `zeroBalanceKey(issuedCount > 0)` — the same issued-invoice count as its "Invoices: N" hint — and its hint reads the new `customerWs.kpi.noInvoicesYet` ("No invoice issued yet" / "Aún no se ha emitido ninguna factura") when never billed. `customerWs.nav.paid` and `customerWs.kpi.paidUp` are retired from en/es. ## REQ-988 — (LOOP-007 q1, q1-71) A deleted customer still names its payments on /payments, and the card's message link does not open the deleted customer
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue q1-71 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION]: "Deleted customer shows as '—' on /payments, and its message link points to the deleted id."
**Root cause:** DELETE /customers/:id is a soft delete (REQ-802; `customer-store/mod.ts` sets `deletedAt` and `list()` drops the row), but the delete prompt promises "Their quotes and invoices stay", and every invoice carries a `customerSnapshot {name, …}` taken when it was issued (`invoice-store/mod.ts`, REQ-204). /payments reads the payer only from the live customer list: `enrich()` in `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` does `(customerId && customers.get(customerId)) || "—"`, so after a delete the card reads "— · INV-001", the note "Check from —, …", the top-payers row "—", and the back's Text client still builds `/clients?open=<deleted id>` because `customerId` is copied onto the card whether or not the customer is on file. The shared helper `invoiceClientName` (`front-end/lib/invoice-client.ts`, REQ-696) falls back to billTo but never to `customerSnapshot`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/req-988-deleted-customer-payer-name.test.ts` ("REQ-988 …": `invoiceClientName` returns the snapshot name / business name when the customer map lacks the id; the live name and the typed BILL TO still win; nothing anywhere stays "—") · int n/a — the backend is already correct (GET /invoices returns `customerSnapshot` after the delete; the e2e asserts the snapshot on the created invoice) · e2e `e2e/req-988-deleted-customer-payments/req-988-deleted-customer-payments.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-988 q1-71 …": customer + invoice + check payment over the API, DELETE the customer, then /payments: the card line, its note and top payers name "Linda Pérez", and Text client is not `/clients?open=<deleted id>`).
**Evidence (2026-11-18, RED):** jest → `Expected: "Linda Pérez" Received: "—"`, `Expected: "Pérez Roofing" Received: "—"` (2 failed; the three guard cases pass). e2e against `PORT=47391 deno task serve` → `✗ REQ-988 … expectation failed: REQ-988: the card names the payer, not "—" (got "— · INV-001") | the card's note names the payer (got "Check from —, deposited via mobile.") | top payers names the payer (got ["—"]) | Text client does not open the deleted customer (got "/clients?open=5ceb312e-…")`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** `invoiceClientName` (`front-end/lib/invoice-client.ts`) falls back, after the live customer and BILL TO, to the invoice's `customerSnapshot` name, then its business name; `Invoice` (`front-end/clients/dashboard.ts`) declares `customerSnapshot`. /payments' `enrich()` (`front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx`) names the payer through that helper and carries `customerId` onto the card only while the customer is still on file, so Text client never opens a deleted id; the Record-a-payment picker and the claim cards (`front-end/lib/payment-claims.ts` `pendingClaims`) use the same helper.

## REQ-989 — AMENDMENT to REQ-924(c): a customer's Messages tab lists every email and text sent to her (LOOP-007 q1, q1-72)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue q1-72 [minor/MISSING_IN_FLOW] "Customer's Mensajes tab shows none of the emails sent to her" — the Outbox listed 2 emails to Linda Pérez; her Mensajes tab showed only "Envía mensajes a tus clientes desde aquí cuando tu negocio tenga una línea telefónica" + "Obtener una línea".
**Root cause:** the REQ-924 workspace (1c0be6f7) built the Messages tab around the phone line only: `Messages` in `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` takes only `phone`, calls `commsClient.line()` first and, with no line, returns the noLine pitch and nothing else; with a line it shows only the SMS thread; with no phone on file it returns "no phone number on file". It never reads the REQ-784 outbox, where every email and text to the customer is stored with her `customerId` — and `GET /outbox` (`backend/src/communication/entrypoints/outbox-controller/mod.ts`) takes only `limit`, so the page could not ask for her entries alone.
**Requirement:** (a) `GET /outbox?customerId=<id>` lists only that customer's entries of the signed-in account, newest first (never another customer's, never another account's). (b) The Messages tab gets the customer's id and always lists her outbox entries — one `data-cy="cws-outbox-row"` per entry with `data-id` = the outbox entry id, naming the document — whatever the line state, and also when she has no phone on file. The "get a line" pitch replaces only the compose box, never the history. (c) New strings in both dictionaries (`customerWs.msg.*`).
**Tests:**
- unit `jest/unit/customer-workspace.test.ts` — "REQ-989 q1-72 the Messages tab lists what was sent to her" (Messages gets `customerId={c.id}`, reads the outbox by customer, renders `cws-outbox-row`, neither the noLine nor the no-phone branch returns in place of the history)
- int `backend/src/communication/entrypoints/outbox-controller/e2e.test.ts` — "REQ-989 q1-72: GET /outbox?customerId= lists only that customer's entries of the caller's account"
- e2e `e2e/customer-messages-outbox/customer-messages-outbox.e2e.test.ts` — "REQ-989 q1-72: with no phone line, a customer's Messages tab lists the emails sent to her (phone on file or not), never another customer's"
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, at 16e7e33e):** int → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`only María's entries` got `INV-003, INV-002, INV-001`); jest → `Tests: 5 failed, 12 passed, 17 total`; e2e against `PORT=5989 deno task serve` → `✗ REQ-989 q1-72 … Linda Pérez …'s Messages tab does not list the email sent to her (outbox …); it shows: "Text customers from here once your business has a phone line.Get a phone line"`.
**Fix (2026-11-18):** `GET /outbox` takes an optional `customerId` (`outbox-controller/mod.ts`); `OutboxStore.listByUser(userId, { customerId })` scans the account's own index newest-first and keeps only entries whose `userId` and `customerId` both match, page by page until `limit` of hers are found (so an older one is never lost behind newer entries to other customers; no new KV keys, so the account wipe is unchanged). Front end: `customerOutboxPath` / `outboxOpenHref` in `front-end/lib/outbox.ts`, `outboxClient.forCustomer`; `Messages` in `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` now gets `customerId={c.id}` and always draws an "Emails and texts sent to this customer" card first, one `cws-outbox-row` link per entry (`data-id` = entry id → `/messages?open=<id>`) with channel icon, document (Invoice INV-001), subject or first line, channel · language · date, and sent / not sent + why (the REQ-784 `outbox*` wording helpers). The phone part follows as its own card: the SMS thread + compose box when there is a line, the get-a-line pitch when there is none, the no-phone note when she has no phone; none of them replaces the history. Five new `customerWs.msg.*` strings in both dictionaries; styles in `static/customer-workspace.css`.
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18):** int `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/communication/entrypoints/outbox-controller/e2e.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; jest `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/customer-workspace.test.ts …` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6089 passed, 6090 total`; e2e `shots run e2e/customer-messages-outbox` against `PORT=6989 deno task serve` → `✓ REQ-989 q1-72 … · 15s`. Neighbours: `deno test … src/communication/` → `125 passed | 1 failed`, the one REQ-123 real-Postmark smoke ("POSTMARK_API_KEY is the real server token here — load ../.env": no .env in the worktree); `front-end/lib/outbox.test.tsx` → `8 passed | 1 failed`, the REQ-784 sidebar row (`NAV`/`viewAt` from nav-tree.ts, untouched here); e2e `customer-workspace` + `outbox` → REQ-924 customers sidebar ✓, REQ-924 Recurring ✗ (waitForResponse timeout) and REQ-784 d12 ✗ (entries recorded `:en` not `:es`) — both fail identically against a pristine 16e7e33e server (:6993). `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched front-end and backend files.

## REQ-991 — On a phone the Outbox shows every column of a message, not 3 of 8 (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-73; AMENDMENT to REQ-784 for phone layout)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue q1-73 [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 1: "Outbox table shows only 3 of 8 columns at 390px" (/messages at 390x844: only Cuándo / Cliente / Canal visible; Idioma, Documento, Asunto, Estado and Abrir off to the right with no scroll hint).
**Root cause:** `OutboxTable` (front-end/components/OutboxView.tsx, added in f3ba1da1 for REQ-784) renders a fixed 8-column desktop table inside a plain `overflow-x:auto` div. The When and What cells are `white-space:nowrap`, Message is `max-width:320px` and Status is `min-width:150px`, so the table is far wider than the ~350px a 390px screen leaves. `.table` in front-end/static/field.css has no responsive rule; the only `@media (max-width:720px)` block reflows `.field-head` and `.task`. So five columns, the status chip and the Open button sit in an inner scroller with no hint.
**Requirement:** at phone widths (≤720px) each Outbox message is a stacked card: every column shown as "label: value" (the label from the column header, in the page's language), the status chip and the Open button inside the viewport, and no sideways scroller in the table. Desktop is unchanged and the `data-cy` hooks stay.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/outbox.test.tsx` ("REQ-991 q1-73 …": the table has the `outbox-table` class and every cell's `data-label` is its column header in en and es; field.css has a max-width:720px rule for `.outbox-table` with `td::before { content: attr(data-label) }`) · int n/a — front-end layout only, no backend change · e2e `e2e/outbox/outbox.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-991 q1-73 …": at 390x844 after a quote is sent, every cell, the status chip and the Open button end inside the viewport, and the wrapper's scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-18, at 16e7e33e):** unit `FAILED | 8 passed | 4 failed`, the three REQ-991 tests: `the table has the outbox-table class (class="table")` (en, es) and `a @media (max-width:720px) block styles .outbox-table`; the fourth is REQ-784's "Outbox is a root row", already red at HEAD. e2e `✗ REQ-991 q1-73 … expectation failed: REQ-991 every column is on screen at 390px — off-screen: outbox-row-language, outbox-row-what, outbox-row-message, outbox-row-status ([["outbox-row-when",214],["outbox-row-customer",299],["outbox-row-channel",376],["outbox-row-language",462],["outbox-row-what",566],["outbox-row-message",657],["outbox-row-status",807]])`. (REQ-784's own story in the same file is red at HEAD on the stored message language, en not es — not this issue.)
**Fix:** `OutboxTable` gives the table the `outbox-table` class, a `data-label` (the column header, in the page's language) on every cell, and moves its inline sizing (nowrap When/What, max-width Message, min-width Status, the wrapper's `overflow-x:auto`) into `.outbox-wrap` / `.outbox-table__*` classes in front-end/static/field.css, so a phone rule can reset them. In the `@media (max-width: 720px)` block, the thead is hidden, each row is a block card, each cell a two-column `label | value` grid printing `td::before { content: attr(data-label) }`, nowrap/min/max widths are reset, the wrapper no longer scrolls sideways, and the Open button is full-width at the card's foot. Desktop is unchanged; every `data-cy` hook stays.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-18):** `deno test -A front-end/lib/outbox.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 11 passed | 1 failed`: all three REQ-991 tests pass; the one red test is REQ-784's "Outbox is a root row", red at HEAD before this change. `FRONTEND_PORT=5731 BACKEND_PORT=5732 PORT=5731 KV_PATH=<fresh> deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5731 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/outbox -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-991 q1-73: at 390x844 the Outbox shows every column of a row — status chip and Open on screen, nothing hidden in a sideways scroller · 9.3s`, `✓ REQ-944 q1-13 …`; REQ-784's story is still red on en vs es, as at HEAD. `cd front-end && deno lint components/OutboxView.tsx && deno check components/OutboxView.tsx` → clean. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 6084 passed, 1 skipped`. Both touched files are already `deno fmt -` clean.

## REQ-992 — The customer form refuses an absurd State and ZIP (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-74)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". Issue **q1-74** [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 1: customer page → More ▾ → Edit details → State "Texasssss", ZIP "ABCDE" → "Cliente guardado", and the 📍 line read "1200 Barton Springs Rd, Austin, Texasssss ABCDE".
**Requirement:** A customer's State and ZIP are checked when the customer is saved, on both sides. The customer form (`CustomerFormDialog` / `CustomerFields`) shows a message under State and under ZIP and does not save; `POST /customers` and `PUT /customers/:id` answer 400 naming `customer.invalidState` / `customer.invalidZip` and store nothing. ZIP: the REQ-352 rule (5 digits, or ZIP+4). State: a USPS 2-letter code or a full state name, any case. Blank stays valid. Both dictionaries carry `customerForm.err.stateInvalid` and `customerForm.err.zipInvalid`. AMENDS REQ-352 (the format rules now cover the customer address) and REQ-625 (the address parts are no longer free text).
**Root cause (RCA at 16e7e33e):** the customer address parts have no format check anywhere. `shared/customer-form/mod.ts` `validateCustomerForm` — the only source of the form's errors — checks name, phone and email only; `CustomerForm.tsx` draws State and ZIP as plain text inputs; `backend/src/crm/dto/customer.ts` declares `state`/`zip` as bare `@IsOptional() @IsString()` and `parseCreateCustomer`/`parseUpdateCustomer` only run `assertContact` (phone + email). `addressWrite` then joins the parts with `composeAddress` unchanged, into the one `address` every invoice, quote and PDF reads. The ZIP rule (`zipError`/`isValidUsZip`, `shared/quote-flow/business-fields.ts`) and the state list (`front-end/lib/us-states.ts`) exist but are used only by onboarding.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/customer-address-rules.test.ts` ("REQ-992 …": `validateCustomerForm` refuses ZIP ABCDE/7870/787041/78704-12 and state Texasssss/Txx/ZZ/Narnia; accepts TX, tx, Texas, New York, 78704, 78704-1234, blank; both dictionaries carry the two messages) · unit `backend/src/crm/dto/customer-address.test.ts` ("REQ-992 q1-74 …": both parse functions throw 400 `customer.invalidZip` / `customer.invalidState`; real and blank parts parse) · int `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/address.int.test.ts` ("REQ-992 q1-74 …": POST with ZIP ABCDE / state Texasssss → 400 with the key, nothing stored; PUT Texasssss/ABCDE → 400, the stored address stays "1200 Barton Springs Rd, Austin, TX 78704") · e2e `e2e/customer-form-validation/customer-form-validation.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-992 q1-74: Edit details refuses …": /customers/<id> → More → Edit details, State Texasssss (or a picker without it), ZIP ABCDE, Save → each field flagged with its message, the form stays open, no "Customer saved", the stored and shown address unchanged).
**Fix (2026-11-18):** one shared rule, run on both sides. `shared/customer-address/rules.ts` `addressPartErrors` / `addressPartError` / `stateCode`: ZIP reuses REQ-352's `isValidUsZip`; State is a USPS code or full name (any case, against the US state table, which moved from `front-end/lib/us-states.ts` to `shared/customer-address/us-states.ts` — the front-end file now re-exports it). `validateCustomerForm` adds `state` / `zip` = "invalid", so `CustomerFormDialog` blocks Save and `CustomerFields` shows `customerForm.err.stateInvalid` / `zipInvalid` under the field (`aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` → the message's id); the new-invoice "New client" submit refuses them too. `parseCreateCustomer` / `parseUpdateCustomer` run `assertAddressParts` after `assertContact`: 400 `customer.invalidState` / `customer.invalidZip` before `addressWrite` composes the address, and a full name is stored as its code ("Texas" → "TX"). State stays a text input (a legacy stored value still prefills); the dialog shows a backend `customer.invalid*` refusal through the dictionary. New keys in en + es: `customer.invalidState`, `customer.invalidZip`, `customerForm.err.stateInvalid`, `customerForm.err.zipInvalid`.
**Evidence (2026-11-18):** RED as recorded above. GREEN — `cd jest && npx jest unit/customer-address-rules.test.ts` → `Tests: 15 passed, 15 total`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/crm/dto/customer-address.test.ts src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/address.int.test.ts` → `ok | 15 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test … src/crm` → `ok | 108 passed | 0 failed`; `deno run -A scripts/test-lane.ts unit` → deno `ok | 1804 passed | 0 failed`, jest `Test Suites: 608 passed`, `Tests: 1 skipped, 6099 passed, 6100 total`; `scripts/test-lane.ts int` → `1330 passed | 1 failed`, the one REQ-803 square-pay (the known parallel-lane flake; alone `ok | 7 passed | 0 failed`). E2E against `PORT=6847 KV_PATH=<scratch> deno task serve`: `shots run e2e/customer-form-validation` → `✓ REQ-992 q1-74 … · 4.8s`, `✓ REQ-352 M38 onboarding`, `✗ REQ-352 setup-m15` ("Add is pressable with an empty name — expected false, got true": pre-existing — `disabled={busy || !values.name.trim()}` is in CustomerForm.tsx at 16e7e33e line 402, untouched here); `shots run e2e/customer-form e2e/open-cards` → REQ-625 ×2 and REQ-626 client/payment/quote ✓, REQ-626 invoice ✗ on `/i/<id>?lang=en` vs `/i/<id>` (invoice link, not touched). `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on CustomerForm.tsx, InvoicesPage.tsx, WelcomeWizard.tsx, lib/us-states.ts, the shared files and `backend/src/crm/dto/customer.ts`.

## REQ-993 — LOOP-007 q1, q1-75: a stale customer page says she is gone instead of opening a blank invoice form
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issue q1-75 [minor/BUG_POLISH], LOOP-007 cycle 1: "Stale customer page after delete in another tab opens a blank invoice form silently."
**Root cause:** `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` reads the workspace once, on mount (`load()` in a `useEffect` on `customerId`), and never re-checks that the customer still exists. When she is deleted in another tab and Send invoice is clicked, `openInvoiceForm()` fetches a fresh `dashboardClient.customers()` list (she is not in it) and opens `NewInvoiceModal` anyway with `customerId={c.id}`; the modal's REQ-924 prefill (`InvoicesPage.tsx`, `if (customers.some((c) => c.id === customerId)) pickCustomer(customerId);`) silently skips, so the client select and Bill to stay empty with no message. The existing "Customer not found" view (`loadErr === "missing"`, `[data-cy=cws-missing]`) is only reached by a full reload. Came in with 1c0be6f7 (REQ-924).
**Requirement:** when Send invoice finds the customer is no longer in the fetched list, the page does not open the new-invoice form; it shows the "Customer not found" view (and the sidebar drops her row).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/customer-workspace-gone.test.ts` ("REQ-993 …": pure `invoiceFormTarget(customers, id)` in `front-end/lib/customer-nav.ts` → "open" / "missing") · int n/a — the backend already returns 404 for a deleted customer's workspace (covered by `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/clients-controller/workspace.int.test.ts`; the e2e also asserts it) · e2e `e2e/customer-workspace-gone/customer-workspace-gone.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-993 …": open /customers/<id>, DELETE /api/customers/:id, click Send invoice → `[data-cy=cws-missing]` and no `[data-cy=new-invoice-modal]`).
**Evidence (2026-11-18), RED at 16e7e33e:** jest → `Expected: "function" Received: "undefined"` (2 failed; the helper does not exist yet). e2e → `expectation failed: no new-invoice form opens for a deleted customer (client chosen: "") — expected false, got true` (the blank form opened, the bug).
**Fix:** `invoiceFormTarget(customers, id)` ("open" | "missing") in `front-end/lib/customer-nav.ts`; `CustomerWorkspace.openInvoiceForm()` checks it on the freshly fetched list and, when she is gone, re-reads the workspace (404 → the existing "Customer not found" view `[data-cy=cws-missing]`) and dispatches `CUSTOMERS_CHANGED` so the sidebar drops her row, instead of opening the form. The island also re-reads on `visibilitychange` → visible (a tab you return to notices the delete before any click), and New quote re-reads on failure. Tests unchanged.

Note: a shots-managed serve in this worktree ran the stories before the backend finished booting (~95 s cold) → `backend_unreachable`; hence the own serve + BASE_URL.

## REQ-999 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-77: the customer page's "Más ▾" caret is an SVG, never a missing-glyph box
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue **q1-77** (LOOP-007, cycle 1, polish/BUG_CONTRADICTION): on the customer page's action row at phone size, "Más" is followed by a red missing-glyph box instead of ▾.
**Root cause:** REQ-924's customer workspace (commit 1c0be6f7) writes the More menu caret as a literal U+25BE — `{tFor(lang, "customerWs.act.more")} ▾` in `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` (button `data-cy="cws-more"`) — instead of `<Icon name="chevron-down">`. The app's web fonts (Nunito/Inter, latin + latin-ext) carry no Geometric Shapes, so Chromium falls back per character and, in the tester's browser, drew a tofu box: the same mechanism REQ-407 fixed on "Adjust invoice ▾". This breaks REQ-366/REQ-407 (a UI icon is an inline SVG, never a glyph), and their guard `front-end/lib/ui-glyph-icons.test.tsx` was already red at 16e7e33e with 7 hits (CustomerWorkspace ▾ and ✏️, SatelliteMeasurePage ▲▼◀▶, HrSignPacket ✓).
**Requirement:** the More button's caret is `<Icon name="chevron-down" />`; no literal Dingbat / Geometric Shapes character (U+2700–27BF, U+25A0–25FF) in it. (AMENDMENT-in-spirit of REQ-366/REQ-407; the fixer clears the guard's other hits too.)
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/customer-workspace-more-caret.test.tsx` ("REQ-999 (q1-77): …" — the cws-more button's JSX has no such glyph and uses `<Icon name="chevron-down">` imported from components/ui/Icon.tsx; the icon renders as `<svg data-icon="chevron-down">`), plus the existing `front-end/lib/ui-glyph-icons.test.tsx` REQ-366 guard · e2e `e2e/customer-more-caret/customer-more-caret.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-999 (q1-77): …" — 390x844, Spanish, `/customers/<id>`: `[data-cy=cws-more]` text has no U+25A0–25FF/U+2700–27BF character and holds one `svg[data-icon=chevron-down]`; markup, not pixels, since the box depends on the browser's fonts) · integration n/a — front-end markup only, no backend path.
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, at 16e7e33e):** `deno test -A --no-check lib/customer-workspace-more-caret.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`- ["▾"] + []`; the button source is `{tFor(lang, "customerWs.act.more")} ▾`); `shots run e2e/customer-more-caret -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-999 (q1-77) … no glyph the web fonts lack in the button's text — it draws as a tofu box ("Más ▾") — expected null, got "▾"`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` draws the More caret as `<Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} />` and the menu's Edit item's ✏️ as `<Icon name="pencil">`; the guard's other hits are cleared the same way — the Repeat-visit chips' "✓ done/billed" (`customerWs.visit.doneShort`/`billedShort`, en + es) lose the ✓ from the copy and render `<Icon name="check" size={12}>` beside it (`.cws-vis__st`), SatelliteMeasurePage's ▲▼◀▶ nudge buttons are `<Icon name="chevron-up|down|left|right">` (new `chevron-up` path in `components/ui/Icon.tsx`), and HrSignPacket's done mark is `<Icon name="check" size={40}>`.
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-19):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/customer-workspace-more-caret.test.tsx lib/ui-glyph-icons.test.tsx` → `ok | 7 passed | 0 failed` (REQ-366 guard green again); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5477 shots run e2e/customer-more-caret -- --no-check` against `PORT=5477 deno task serve` → `✓ REQ-999 (q1-77) … 82.7s · 1 pass · 0 fail` (shots' own serve could not come up: host load avg 150–185, Vite "transport was disconnected"); neighbour `shots run e2e/customer-workspace` (SHOTS_JOBS=4) → `✓ REQ-924: Recurring on her page …` (opens the More menu and shows the done-visit chip); the other stories in that run "did not finish" under the same host load. `deno check` on the 4 touched tsx files clean; `deno lint` → 1 problem, the pre-existing `react-no-danger` at HrSignPacket.tsx:210 (untouched line); en/es valid JSON with identical key sets.

## REQ-943 — A payment can't be recorded as received after today, and /payments never counts a future-dated one as today or this month (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-8 + q1-9)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." LOOP-007 cycle 1, issues **q1-8** [major/BUG_HARM] "Payment can be recorded with a future date and is emailed to the customer" and **q1-9** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Payments page shows a future-dated payment as 'Hoy', counts it this month, and reports 194d average days to pay".
**Root cause (at 16e7e33e):** nothing compares the received date to today. `validatePaymentReceived` (front-end/lib/payment-received.ts) only checks the YYYY-MM-DD shape; the dialog's date input has no `max`; `CreatePaymentDto.receivedAt` / `UpdatePaymentDto.receivedAt` are only `@IsString()` and `PaymentController.create/update` store them unchanged (even "not a date"). `ComputeInvoiceBalance` then closes the invoice with `paidAt` = the future day and `MarkInvoicePaid` emails the customer "PAGADA 1 de junio de 2027". On /payments (front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx) `daysAgo` is `Math.max(0, …)` so a future day reads "Today", "this month" is only bounded below (`receivedAt >= 1st of the month`), and the average days to pay includes it (194d), while `cashFlowWeeks` drops it — the hero, the rows and the cash-flow card disagree.
**Requirement:** (a) A received date after today (the business's local day) is refused: the dialog shows `invoicesPage.pay.errFutureDate` (both dictionaries) and sends nothing, and its date input carries `max` = today; (b) `POST /payments` and `PUT /payments/:id` answer 422 `future_date` for a receivedAt after today (about a day of time-zone slack is fine) and refuse an unparseable one — nothing stored, the invoice stays open, no PAID email; the form shows that 422 as the same localized reason; (c) /payments never labels a future-dated payment "Today", leaves it out of "showed up this month" and out of the average days to pay.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/payment-future-date.test.tsx` ("REQ-943 (q1-8) …": tomorrow / +200 days / 2027-06-01 / 2099-01-01 → errFutureDate; today and earlier ok; both dictionaries; 422 `future_date` → the localized reason; the date input's `max`) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/future-date.int.test.ts` ("REQ-943 (q1-8) …": POST future → 422, no row, invoice open, no PAID message in the outbox; unparseable refused; PUT future → 422; control: today records and the PAID message is in the outbox) · e2e `e2e/payment-future-date/payment-future-date.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-943 (q1-8)": customer page → Record payment → a day +195 → inline reason, no POST, nothing stored; "REQ-943 (q1-9)": /payments with a payment served as +200 days → no "Today · INV-…", hero not $1,250, avg not 200d). Unit for the /payments partition: n/a — it is inline in a data-loading island with no pure helper yet; the e2e story covers it through the real page (the fixer may add a pure helper with its own unit test).
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, on 16e7e33e):** unit `deno test -A lib/payment-future-date.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 4 failed` (`ok: true` for 2026-11-19; the key is untranslated; `future_date` shown raw; `max` null) · int `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/future-date.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 3 failed` (`receivedAt=2027-06-01T12:00:00Z → 200`, `"not a date"` → 200, PUT → 200 with `2027-06-01`) · e2e `shots run e2e/payment-future-date -- --no-check` → 0 pass · 2 fail (`no POST /payments for a future day — expected 0, got 1`; `no 'Today · INV-…' line … (got "TODAY · INV-001")`).
**Fix (2026-11-18):** one rule in `shared/documents/received-day.ts`. `receivedAtProblem` refuses an instant later than now + 24 h (`future_date`) and one that does not parse (`invalid_date`); the slack covers time zones, since the form sends noon local, which is at most ~14 h ahead of the server's clock. `isAfterLocalToday` and `localIsoDay` serve the form. `PaymentController.create` and `update` answer 422 `{ ok:false, error, reason }` before anything is stored, so the invoice never closes on a future day and no PAID email goes out. The other receivedAt writers (ConfirmPayment for chat, voice and photo, and card payments) always stamp `new Date()`, so they cannot store a future day. The client side has three parts. `validatePaymentReceived` returns `invoicesPage.pay.errFutureDate` (en/es). `paymentErrorText` maps `future_date`/`invalid_date` to the localized reasons. The dialog's date defaults to the LOCAL day with `max` = that day; it used `toISOString().slice(0,10)`, the UTC day, which is tomorrow every evening in the Americas and would now be refused. /payments: new pure `front-end/lib/payments-partition.ts`. `calendarDaysAgo` counts local calendar days and is not clamped, so a future day is negative and its label is its date, not "Today". `isThisMonthSoFar` runs from the 1st to the end of today. `daysToPayOf` returns null for a day after today. These match the rule `cashFlowWeeks` already used.
**Test correction:** `front-end/lib/payment-record-option.test.tsx` ("REQ-587 M27: 'Recibido el' …") built its expected default date as `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)`, the UTC day. That locked in the UTC-default bug above and failed every evening (ET) once the default became the local day. It now expects `localIsoDay()`, and the assertion is otherwise unchanged. Added unit tests: `front-end/lib/payments-partition.test.ts` (REQ-943 q1-9) and `jest/unit/received-day.test.ts` (REQ-943 q1-8).
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/payment-future-date.test.tsx` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`. `deno test -A lib/payment-received.test.tsx lib/payment-record-option.test.tsx lib/payments-partition.test.ts lib/overpayment.test.tsx lib/payment-future-date.test.tsx lib/payments-kpis.test.tsx lib/payment-card.test.ts lib/mark-paid-dialog.test.tsx` → `ok | 48 passed | 0 failed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/future-date.int.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`; together with overpayment/chargeback/e2e in that folder → `ok | 15 passed | 0 failed`. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --runTestsByPath unit/received-day.test.ts unit/owner-write-announce.test.ts unit/customer-workspace.test.ts unit/payment-claims.test.ts unit/paid-how.test.ts` → `5 passed, 53 tests`. `shots run e2e/payment-future-date -- --no-check` (BASE_URL to a PORT=57431 worktree serve) → `2 pass · 0 fail`. deno lint and deno check are clean on the touched front-end files.

## REQ-995 — AMENDMENT to REQ-708: the New repeat visit form on /field/subscriptions says an empty address in-app, under the field; no browser bubble (LOOP-007 cycle 1, issue q1-80)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue q1-80 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 1: "Spanish recurring-visit form uses a US-style address example and the browser's English required bubble".
**Cause:** the New repeat visit `<form class="modal" onSubmit={submit} data-cy="subs-form">` (front-end/islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx:830) has no `noValidate`, and its address input is `required` (:908). It dates from REQ-137..143 (fd52cfa2), and REQ-708's noValidate sweep left it out. With an empty address, Chromium's constraint validation blocks the submit before `submit()` runs, so the user sees only the browser's own bubble in the browser's locale ("Please fill out this field." in headless en-US). The in-app check (:462-464) is never reached, and it is wrong too: it sets `err` to `t("field.subs.addressPh")`, the placeholder example "Ej: 123 Main St, Springfield", not a message saying the address is needed. No `field.subs.addressRequired` key exists. The "123 Main St, Springfield" example itself is deliberate (REQ-734) and stays.
**Requirement:** the subs-form is noValidate; an empty service address shows `field.subs.addressRequired` ("Enter the service address." / "Escribe la dirección de servicio.") under the address input, which gets `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`; nothing is posted.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/form-novalidate-fields.test.ts` ("REQ-995 …" ×3: the subs-form is noValidate; `field.subs.addressRequired` in en and es, not the placeholder; the placeholder key is never used as an error) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change · e2e `e2e/form-novalidate-fields/form-novalidate-fields.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-995 (LOOP-007 q1-80): /field/subscriptions?new=1 in Spanish …").
**Evidence (2026-11-18), RED:** `npx jest unit/form-novalidate-fields.test.ts` → `Tests: 3 failed, 8 passed` (`Expected pattern: /\bnoValidate\b/ Received string: "<form class=\"modal\" onSubmit={submit} data-cy=\"subs-form\">"`; `Expected: "string" Received: "undefined"`; `Expected substring: "\"field.subs.addressRequired\""`). `shots run e2e/form-novalidate-fields -- --no-check` against `PORT=23741 deno task serve` → `3 passed | 1 failed`, the REQ-995 story: `expectation failed: the New repeat visit form is novalidate — no native bubble — expected true, got false`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** `front-end/islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx` — the subs-form `<form>` gets `noValidate`, so the browser's own bubble never pre-empts `submit()`; the empty-address branch stops writing the placeholder example into the top `err` and sets `addressErr: t("field.subs.addressRequired")`, rendered as `<span class="field-error" role="alert" id="subs-address-error" data-cy="subs-address-error">` under the input, which gets `aria-invalid="true"` + `aria-describedby="subs-address-error"`; typing in the address clears it, and so does the next Add. New key `field.subs.addressRequired` in `lang/en.json` ("Enter the service address.") and `lang/es.json` ("Escribe la dirección de servicio."). The missing-customer message stays where it was (`subs-error`, `field.subs.pickCustomer`), because REQ-152's e2e waits on it. A killed earlier fixer had moved it under the picker with a new `customerRequired` key; that is outside q1-80 and would break that story, so it was dropped.
**Evidence (2026-11-19), GREEN:** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` (ran the whole unit lane) → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total` · `Tests: 1 skipped, 6087 passed, 6088 total`, including the 3 REQ-995 tests and REQ-734 `field-modal-foot`. `deno lint islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx` → `Checked 1 file`; `deno check` clean; `deno fmt --ext tsx -` over the file → no diff; en/es both valid JSON with 6277 keys. `shots run e2e/form-novalidate-fields -- --no-check` against `PORT=23961 deno task serve` (run twice, host load ~180) → `✓ REQ-995 … 'Escribe la dirección de servicio.'` both times, and the REQ-708 /contact and /field/workers stories pass too. The one red story is REQ-708 "New invoice → + New client", which fails at `until` "the action never took" because `page.locator("[data-cy='new-invoice-client']").selectOption("__new__")` targets what has been a `<div>` (SearchSelect) since e7ce02f45 (2026-11-13). That predates this branch, which touches neither InvoicesPage.tsx nor that story.

## REQ-996 — LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-81: the batch header says what a click does ("Clear all" / "Select all")
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q1-81** [minor/BUG_POLISH], LOOP-007 cycle 1: "Batch 'Select all' label doesn't select anything" (/field/batches: "Both checkboxes stay unchecked and Send stays disabled").
**Root cause:** the header checkbox on /field/batches toggles select-all/deselect-all, but its label is always `field.lt.selectAll`. Since REQ-608, a batch opens with every draft ticked: `pull()` ticks the pulled drafts, and mount and `openBatch` tick them through `defaultBatchChecks`. So `allChecked` is true and the header box is already ticked. Clicking the "Select all" text clicks the wrapped input. Its onChange reads `checked=false` and calls `setChecked(new Set([]))`, so every draft is unticked and `lt-send` is disabled (`checked.size === 0`). The label (fd52cfa2, REQ-137..143) predates REQ-608 pre-ticking and was never updated.
**Requirement:** while every draft of the open batch is ticked, the header control reads **"Clear all"** / "Quitar todas" (`field.lt.clearAll`, both dictionaries), and a click clears every draft. Otherwise it reads "Select all", and a click ticks every draft. REQ-608's default ticks stay.
**Tests:**
- unit `front-end/lib/field-batches-select-all.test.tsx` ("REQ-996 …"): both dictionaries carry `field.lt.clearAll`, and a seeded batch whose draft opens ticked has "Clear all" in its header and not "Select all". The click round-trip can't be unit-tested here because `deno test` compiles islands with jsx "precompile", which renders to a string only. The e2e story covers it.
- integration: n/a, island state only, with no backend or wire change.
- e2e `e2e/batch-select-all-label/batch-select-all-label.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-996 …"): pull a batch, check that the header reads "Clear all" and Send is enabled, then click that text. The header should then read "Select all", lt-check should be unticked and Send disabled. Clicking "Select all" should tick lt-check, enable Send and bring back "Clear all".
**Evidence (RED, 2026-11-18, at 16e7e33e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/field-batches-select-all.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`- undefined + "Clear all"`; `header was: "Batch Nov 10, 2026 → Nov 17, 2026 1 invoiceSelect allSend selected"`). `shots run e2e/batch-select-all-label -- --no-check` against `PORT=5733 deno task serve` → `✗ … expectation failed: everything ticked → the header offers "Clear all" (header: "Batch Nov 18, 2026 → Nov 18, 2026 1 invoice Select all Send selected")`.
**Fix:** `front-end/islands/FieldBatchesPage.tsx`: the header label now reads `t("field.lt.clearAll")` while `allChecked` and `t("field.lt.selectAll")` otherwise. The header box shows `indeterminate` through a ref when some drafts are ticked but not all, and it carries `data-cy="lt-check-all"`. `field.lt.clearAll` is added to `lang/en.json` ("Clear all") and `lang/es.json` ("Quitar todas"), next to `field.lt.selectAll`, so the trailing `comms.a2p.*` keys are unchanged. REQ-608's default ticks are unchanged.
**Test correction:** in the unit test, the `key()` helper walked nested objects (`d.field.lt.clearAll`), but `lang/*.json` are flat dictionaries keyed by the dotted string (`"field.lt.selectAll": …`), so it returned `undefined` for every key, real ones too. It now reads `d[k]`. The assertions (`"Clear all"` / `"Quitar todas"`) are unchanged.
**Evidence (GREEN, 2026-11-18):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/field-batches-select-all.test.tsx` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`. `shots run e2e/batch-select-all-label -- --no-check` against `PORT=5847 deno task serve` (fresh KV_PATH) → `✓ REQ-996 (LOOP-007 q1-81): the batch header reads 'Clear all' when every draft is ticked, and flips to 'Select all' after clearing · 9.3s` (green on two runs). Neighbours: `shots run e2e/c4-batch-checks-note-flash` → `✓ REQ-608 … drafts are still ticked after a reload, and Send selected is enabled` (2 pass · 0 fail); `shots run e2e/field-ssr-first-paint` → both REQ-730 /field stories ✓; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 607 passed, 607 total; Tests: 6084 passed, 1 skipped`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on both touched front-end files → clean; `lib/field-ssr.test.tsx` → 10 passed (`--no-check`; its type-check errors are already in its own fixtures: `crews`/`absences` missing, untouched here).

## REQ-994 — AMENDMENT to REQ-140/365: a zone has one name per language on every screen (LOOP-007 cycle 1, q1-83)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA loop LOOP-007, cycle 1, issue **q1-83** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION]: "Zone named 'Zona A' on Assignments and Tasks but 'Zone A' on Repeat visits in an English account" — /field/assignments card "Zona A" + map "Zona A · Mike Carter"; /field/tasks "Mike Carter · Zona A"; /field/subscriptions "Zone A · no worker".
**Root cause:** the server stores zone names in Spanish only (`backend/src/field/domain/business/regions/mod.ts` `regionName()` → `Zona A`, REQ-140). English comes from a client rewrite, `zoneName(name, lang)` (`^Zona ` → `Zone `), which exists twice (a private copy in `FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx` and an export in `front-end/lib/field-worker-errors.ts`) and is called only by /field/subscriptions, /field/workers and the worker-error text. `FieldAssignmentsPage.tsx` prints `r.name` raw (map label, map popup, card name, the worker picker's aria-label); `FieldTasksPage.tsx` titles a task with `workerZoneLabel(x)` (`front-end/lib/field-task-groups.ts`, no language parameter, also used by `groupTasks`) and prints the unstaffed chip as `{s.regionName}` raw. So an English account sees "Zone A" on one screen and "Zona A" on the next.
**Requirement:** every screen that names a zone prints it through one localized helper: English "Zone A", Spanish "Zona A". `workerZoneLabel(x, lang)` and `groupTasks(tasks, lang)` take the language; the Assignments cards, aria-labels, map labels and popups, the Tasks hints, group titles and unstaffed chips all use it; no private `zoneName` copy remains.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/q1-83-zone-name.test.ts` ("REQ-994 …": `zoneName` en/es; `workerZoneLabel({workerName:'Mike Carter', regionName:'Zona A'}, 'en')` → "Mike Carter · Zone A", 'es' keeps "Zona A", no zone → worker alone; `groupTasks(…, 'en')` titles; the Assignments island has no raw `r.name`, the Tasks island no `workerZoneLabel(x)` / raw `{s.regionName}`, the Subscriptions island no private `zoneName`) · integration n/a — the backend's Spanish storage is REQ-140's documented behaviour and the API passes the name through; the defect is client rendering only · e2e `e2e/q1-83-zone-name/q1-83-zone-name.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-994 …": EN account, two weekly visits in two zones, Mike Carter on zone A → /field/subscriptions chip "Zone A", /field/assignments cards + pickers "Zone A", "Zone B" and no "Zona" on the page, /field/tasks "Mike Carter · Zone A" and no "Zona").

## REQ-997 — LOOP-007 cycle 1 (q1-84): Assignments counts are singular for one, and the page says repeat visits, not subscriptions (amends REQ-743's out-of-scope line)
**Requirement (Raphael's words):** "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." Issue **q1-84** [polish/BUG_POLISH] "Wrong plural '1 zones', and 'subscriptions' vs 'repeat visits'", cycle 1.
**Root cause:** the /field/assignments count strings are single strings with the plural noun baked in (`field.asg.eyebrow` "Assignments · {n} zones", `crewLoad` "{zones} zones", `unstaffedCrews` / `unstaffedCount` "{n} zones with no crew/worker", `regrouped` "Re-grouped: {n} zones", `load` "{zones} zones · {subs} subscriptions"; es the same with "zonas" / "suscripciones"), and `front-end/islands/FieldAssignmentsPage.tsx` renders them with `t()` instead of the `tn()` `.one`/`.other` helper (`front-end/lib/i18n.ts`), so one zone reads "1 zones", "1 zones with no worker", "1 ZONES · 1 SUBSCRIPTIONS". The keys date from fd52cfa2 (REQ-137..143); the REQ-609 / REQ-743 rename to "repeat visits" listed `field.asg.title/subs/empty/load/noRegions` as out of scope, so this is the last page still saying "subscription(s)". Fix: split the count keys into `.one`/`.other` (load into a zones half and a repeat-visits half), call `tn()`, and reword the `field.asg.*` copy to repeat visit(s) / visita(s) repetida(s) in en + es.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/field-tasks-jargon-copy.test.ts` ("REQ-997 …" — no `field.asg.*` key says subscri / suscrip; eyebrow, crewLoad, unstaffedCrews, unstaffedCount, regrouped each have `.one` + `.other` and no bare key; each `.one` says zone / zona, not zones / zonas; the worker load chip built from the `field.asg.load*` halves reads "1 zone · 1 repeat visit" / "2 zones · 3 repeat visits" / "1 zona · 1 visita repetida", and the island calls `tn()` for them) · int n/a — no backend change, the regions API is correct, only the front-end copy is wrong · e2e `e2e/assignments-plural/assignments-plural.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-997 (LOOP-007 q1-84) …" — one customer, one repeat visit, one zone, one worker: the worker chip reads "Luis Herrera 1 zone · 1 repeat visit", the eyebrow "Assignments · 1 zone", no "1 zones" and no "subscription" on the page; unstaffed, the alert reads "1 zone with no worker").
**Evidence (2026-11-18):** RED — `cd jest && npx jest unit/field-tasks-jargon-copy.test.ts` → `Tests: 4 failed, 9 passed, 13 total` (10 `field.asg.*` hits saying subscription/suscripción; `field.asg.eyebrow` `.one` is `undefined`; the island still calls `t("field.asg.eyebrow"`); e2e against `PORT=5871 deno task serve` → `expectation failed: the worker chip is singular and says repeat visit — expected "Luis Herrera 1 zone · 1 repeat visit", got "Luis Herrera 1 zones · 1 subscriptions"`.
**Fix:** `lang/en.json` + `lang/es.json` — `field.asg.eyebrow/crewLoad/unstaffedCrews/unstaffedCount/regrouped/subs` split into `.one`/`.other` (bare keys gone); `field.asg.load` replaced by `field.asg.loadZones.one/.other` ("{n} zone(s)" / "{n} zona(s)") + `field.asg.loadVisits.one/.other` ("{n} repeat visit(s)" / "{n} visita(s) repetida(s)"); `field.asg.title/empty/noRegions` reworded from subscription(s) / suscripción(es) to repeat visit(s) / visita(s) repetida(s). `front-end/islands/FieldAssignmentsPage.tsx` imports `tn` and renders all six counts with `tn()`; the worker chip joins the two load halves with " · ". Neighbour tests that pinned the old shape were updated, not weakened: `jest/unit/field-services-copy.test.ts` (REQ-839..842) listed the bare `field.asg.crewLoad` / `field.asg.unstaffedCrews` keys, which REQ-997 removes — it now lists their `.one`/`.other`; `e2e/field-tasks/field-tasks.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-841) asserted the buggy "1 zones with no crew" — now "1 zone with no crew", and its gone-check is "with no crew" (matches both forms).
