## REQ-1018 — LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-1: a Spanish rate × quantity slipped by ×10 is saved at rate × quantity ("200 pies cuadrados … $9 por pie cuadrado" is $1,800, never $18,000) (failing tests)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-1** [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 2: on /assistant (ES), "Cotización para Rosa Delgado: cambiar el piso de la cocina, 200 pies cuadrados de porcelanato, $9 por pie cuadrado con material y mano de obra." was drafted at $18,000.00 (one line, 1 ea), and the public /q showed "VALOR DEL ACUERDO $18,000.00". Expected $1,800.00, ideally shown as 200 sq ft × $9.00.
**Root cause:** gpt-4o-mini sent create_quote with one line at amountCents 1,800,000 (×10). REQ-651's guard `fixRateSlips` (backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/mod.ts) should have set it to rate × quantity, but the rate and the quantity read in different unit families in Spanish: `RATE_UNIT_RE` knows only a bare `pies?|metros?`, so "$9 por pie cuadrado" captures "pie" and `unitFamily("pie")` → "ft" ("cuadrado" is never read), while `QTY_RE` + `quantitiesIn` read "200 pies cuadrados" as "sqft". `fixRateSlips` looks the quantity up under "ft", finds none, and returns undefined; `settleLines` has no stated total, no draft and $18,000 is over the floor, so the line is saved as is, and handle-chat-message stores it as quantity 1 "ea" so the 200 × $9 math is never visible. English ("$9 per sq ft" + "200 sq ft") is corrected, which is why REQ-651's English-only tests passed.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/undershoot.test.ts` ("REQ-1018 q2-1 fixRateSlips: '$9 por pie cuadrado' + '200 pies cuadrados' …" — the exact message, quantity in the line and in the message → 180000; "REQ-1018 q2-1 fixRateSlips: Spanish square units … 'el pie cuadrado', '/pie²', 'por metro cuadrado'"; "REQ-1018 q2-1 settleCreateQuote: the Spanish first draft at $18,000 is saved at $1,800") · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/price-undershoot.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1018 q2-1: … saves $1,800 — never the model's ×10": ES user, customer Rosa Delgado, the exact message through the real HandleChatMessage with the stub LLM returning the ×10 line; the stored quote's lines and estimatedTotal are 180000, the reply never says 18,000) · e2e n/a — the defect is the backend's price settlement; a shots story cannot script the server's LLM (stories only intercept the page's own fetches), so it would have to mock the very create_quote result under test; the int test drives the real coordinator and the QuoteStore that the card and /q read.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/undershoot.test.ts` → `FAILED | 8 passed | 3 failed` (`Actual undefined / Expected 180000`; `Values are not equal: '$9 el pie cuadrado'` undefined vs 180000; settleCreateQuote `{"kind":"keep"}` vs `save`); `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/price-undershoot.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 2 passed | 1 failed` (`Actual 1800000 / Expected 180000`).
**Fix:** `stated-price/mod.ts` now reads a rate's unit and a quantity's unit with one shared `UNIT` vocabulary, used to build both `RATE_UNIT_RE` and `QTY_RE`, so the two cannot drift apart again. Square units are matched first ("pie(s) cuadrado(s)", "pie²", "ft²", "sq ft", "metro(s) cuadrado(s)", "m²", "yarda(s) cuadrada(s)", "sq yd"). `unitFamily` maps any "cuadrad"/²/sq capture to "sqft", "sqm" or "sqyd", so a metre rate never pairs with a sq ft quantity. Spanish quantities that had no unit before ("40 horas", "3 días", "pies lineales", "yardas") now pair with their rates. `quantitiesIn` no longer special-cases "cuadrados".
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-1):** `cd backend && deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/undershoot.test.ts` → `ok | 11 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/price-undershoot.int.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/ …/handle-chat-message/{price-target,price-undershoot,price-question,named-quote-change,locked-offer-reprice}.int.test.ts ../shared/quote-flow/` → `ok | 95 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on stated-price/mod.ts are clean.
**Not in this fix:** the RCA's step 2 is a separate feature: persisting quantity, unit and unit price on create_quote lines so the card and /q show "200 sq ft × $9.00" instead of "1 ea". Its step 3, a reply that acknowledges the correction, is also not in this fix.

## REQ-1019 — LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-2: two "pick one" options are never billed as one quote, even when the model repeats the first option's price
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-2** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: on /assistant the tester typed "… 2 options: basic porcelain tile $8,400 or upgrade with niche + glass door $11,200. 30% deposit". Q-001 was saved with two $8,400 lines and three $0 lines, at $16,800. The $11,200 upgrade was dropped. "total should not be 16,800" changed nothing. Expected: one option per quote, or the assistant asks which option to use. This breaks REQ-942's promise that options are never added together in one quote.
**Root cause:** the coordinator reads both alternatives (`typedAlternatives` → 840000 / 1120000) and tells the model to draft only the first. The real model ignored that and put $8,400 on the base line and on the upgrade line. Neither guard caught it. `settleCreateQuote` (stated-price/mod.ts) only folds $0 lines when the total was typed, and `keepOnePrice` needs exactly one typed price. REQ-942's `firstAlternativeLines` (shared/quote-flow/alternatives.ts) treats a line as the other option only if one of these holds: its description has the other option's first two label words (`/\bupgrade\s+with\b/`, which "Upgrade: tile niche and glass door" does not match), or it has the other option's exact price ($11,200), or the total is at least the sum of both options (16,800 < 19,600). A line at the first option's price is never counted as the other option, so the $16,800 draft was saved as the model sent it. On the correction turn, alternatives are read only from the current message (handle-chat-message/mod.ts ~2629, `typedAlternatives(asked)`), so "total should not be 16,800" gets no options guard, and the re-sent lines are saved again.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/req-942-typed-alternatives.test.ts` ("REQ-1019 …": the q2-2 message reads as 840000/1120000; `firstAlternativeLines` narrows [tear-out $0, base $8,400, "Upgrade: tile niche and glass door" $8,400, vanity $0, cleanup $0] and ["Basic porcelain tile option" $8,400, "Upgrade option with niche + glass door" $8,400 + $0 lines] to $8,400 with no niche/glass-door line) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/alternatives.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1019 …": the stub LLM answers the 2×$8,400 + 3×$0 draft, and the saved quote must total one option, never 1680000, with a reply that names the option. A correction turn "total should not be 16,800", after a turn-1 draft at $8,400, where the stub re-sends the $16,800 lines: no quote may be saved at 1680000) · e2e n/a — the trigger is the real model's answer, and the browser e2e server runs the echo stub. The int test drives the same coordinator and stores with the model's exact answer scripted.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/alternatives.int.test.ts --filter REQ-1019` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`a saved quote totals $16,800 — the first option billed twice (estimatedTotal 1680000, …)`; `after "total should not be 16,800" a saved quote still totals $16,800 (estimatedTotal 1680000, …)`).
**Fix:** `firstAlternativeLines` (shared/quote-flow/alternatives.ts) now decides by words and by price. (1) A line belongs to an option when it carries that option's own content words (words no other option shares, e.g. upgrade/niche/glass/door) and carries more of them than of any other option's. A two-word label prefix is no longer required. (2) A draft with more than one line at an option's price, whose total is neither option's price, carries options: the first option's price repeated on the upgrade line no longer passes. Narrowing keeps the first option's lines, so the saved total is $8,400. The $0 shared lines stay because they add up to it. In handle-chat-message/mod.ts, while the bound quote is still a draft (or none is bound), the options typed in one of the last 6 earlier user turns are carried into a correction turn ("total should not be 16,800"). Carried options only narrow a draft that mixes them (`{ carried: true }`: a draft whose total is one option's price, either one, is the contractor's pick and is left alone; the "total ≥ two options" rule is not applied). They never suppress a stated total, never add the model note, and add the "You gave 2 options…" reply line only when they narrowed the draft.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/alternatives.int.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed` (both REQ-1019 tests and both REQ-942 tests) · `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --runTestsByPath unit/req-942-typed-alternatives.test.ts` → `Tests: 11 passed, 11 total` · neighbours: `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/` → `ok | 277 passed | 0 failed` · `deno check` + `deno lint` on the two touched modules are clean, and `deno fmt -` leaves them unchanged.

## REQ-1023 — A first draft keeps every priced item the contractor typed: "mano de obra 4200 materiales 1350" is never saved without the $1,350 (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-3)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-3** [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 2: on /assistant (ES) the message "…mano de obra 4200 materiales 1350. 50% de anticipo. y tambien arreglar la cerca de madera 18 pies lineales $900" was drafted and saved as Q-002 at $5,100. The $1,350 materials only appeared after the owner wrote "falta el material de 1350" (fleet-r66a3e3fc-1 stdout:29/36).
**Root cause:** the draft's lines come only from the model's create_quote, and every deterministic guard after the model reads typed money through `moneyAmounts` (shared/quote-flow/money-amounts.ts). That reader only recognises an amount with a "$", a currency word or a k/mil/thousand scale, so in this message it sees only "$900". As a result `statedTotalCents` finds no total. `settleCreateQuote`/`keepOnePrice` (backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/mod.ts) see lines [$4,200, $900], which are neither a split of $900 nor a repeated $900, so they return `keep`. REQ-439's first-draft coverage check (`typedWorkItems`) drops price clauses on purpose. Nothing compares each typed priced item against the lines. The likely reason the model dropped the line is the REQ-261 "PRIVATE COSTS" rule in prompts.systemQuote, which calls "material costs" private.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/typed-price-coverage.test.ts` ("REQ-1023 q2-3 …": `labelledAmounts` in money-amounts.ts reads 4200/1350/900 and never the phone, street, zip or 18 ft; "materials: 1,350" and "falta el material de 1350" are read; a bare labelled "total 5,550" is a stated total; `settleCreateQuote` on the $5,100 lines re-asks naming materiales $1,350, then saves a $1,350 materials line, total $6,450; a re-ask that adds the line is saved as written; a draft that already has it is kept with no re-ask) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/typed-price-coverage.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1023 q2-3 …": with a stub LLM that always answers the $5,100 create_quote, the saved quote and the card total $6,450, there is a materials line, and a re-ask names "materiales" and "1,350"; a $6,450 answer is saved unchanged) · e2e n/a — the bug is the real model leaving a line out. The dev server's stub LLM only echoes and has no hook a browser story can use to script a create_quote, and the int test already drives the same coordinator and the card's totalCents.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/typed-price-coverage.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 5 failed` (`shared/quote-flow/money-amounts.ts exports labelledAmounts(text)` ×2; statedTotalCents `- undefined + 555000`; settleCreateQuote `Values are not equal: got {"kind":"keep"}` ×2). `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/typed-price-coverage.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`AssertionError: a $1,350 materials line — got 420000,90000`). Side note seen in the int run: the REQ-439 first-draft re-ask fires on this message for `["905 calle del sol san antonio tx 78207"]`, so it treats the street address as a typed work item.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `labelledAmounts(text)` in shared/quote-flow/money-amounts.ts: every `moneyAmounts` amount plus a BARE number right after a price label (mano de obra / labor / labour / materiales / material(s) / suministros / supplies / total / precio / price), with an optional ":", "=", "-" or one linking word ("de", "of", "is", "es"), each carrying its label. The number must be followed by the end, punctuation, another label, a joining word or a currency, so "total 2 rooms", "materials 10%", "18 pies", phones, streets and zips are never read. "cerca" is left out on purpose because in Spanish "cerca de 1000" means "about 1000". (2) stated-price `statedTotalCents`: a bare "total 5,550" is the stated total. (3) stated-price `missedTypedPrices` + `coverTypedPrices`, run by `settleCreateQuote` on a first draft with no stated total: a labelled typed price that no line carries (not one line, not a few lines together, and not one line folding it with other typed items) is re-asked once, naming it ("materiales $1,350 … 135000 cents"). If it is still missing, a line is added in code at the typed amount under the typed label. Totals, deposits ("de anticipo"), rates, recurring prices, "X or Y" alternatives and amounts after a cost cue ("cost me", "me cuesta", "pago", "charges") are never lines. (4) lang en/es `prompts.systemQuote` + `prompts.systemTerms`: PRIVATE COSTS now covers only a cost the contractor PAYS (a sub's fee or an amount with a cost cue). A labor/materials amount listed as the price ("mano de obra 4200 materiales 1350") is a billed line, at exactly that amount. Content test: `backend/src/agents/domain/business/llm-prompts/test.ts` "REQ-1023 q2-3 quote and terms prompts …" (en + es, both prompts). No test assertion was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-3):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/typed-price-coverage.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/typed-price-coverage.int.test.ts` → `ok | 8 passed | 0 failed`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/ src/agents/domain/business/llm-prompts/ src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/` → `ok | 412 passed | 0 failed (28m32s)`. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit <22 suites touching money-amounts/quote-facts/alternatives/quick-quote-prefill/private-cost>` → `Test Suites: 644 passed, 644 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6335 passed`. `deno lint` on the touched .ts files: clean. `deno check shared/quote-flow/money-amounts.ts` (front-end config): clean.

## REQ-1027 — A revision with a stated total lands that total; a "too much" ask never raises the price (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-4; amends REQ-315 / REQ-377)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-4** [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 2: in the Q-002 chat, "jorge dijo que es mucho. haz una version 2 de Q-002 sin la cerca, solo la pintura, total 5,550" saved Version 2 at $6,900 ("quité Reparación de cerca…; Pintura exterior $4,200 → $5,550. Total $6,450 → $6,900"): $1,350 over the total he typed and $450 more than the v1 he called too much.
**Root cause:** no code learns that "total 5,550" is the job's total. `parseTargetTotalChange` (change-order-intent/mod.ts, REQ-377) needs exactly one "$" amount, so the bare "5,550" reads as undefined and the REQ-377 pre-route in handle-chat-message is skipped. `statedTotalCents` (REQ-445) reads nothing from it either, and it only runs when create_quote is offered (drafts). The model's only tool for an issued quote, `revise_quote`, has no new-total field (`amountCents` is "the line's NEW total"), so it put 555000 on "Pintura exterior" and removed "cerca". `ReviseQuote.run` applies `reviseLineItems` as sent (Materiales $1,350 kept → 690000) and writes it with `quotes.setPending` as Version 2. Nothing checks the result against the stated total, and nothing checks whether a "cheaper" ask raised the total.
**Requirement:** a total word next to a bare number ("total 5,550", "total de 5550", "en total 5,550", "5,550 total", "new total 5550") is the job's new total, with or without "$". On an issued or bound quote, a revision with a stated total either lands exactly that total (here Pintura $4,200 + Materiales $1,350 = $5,550, Materiales untouched, fence gone) or writes nothing and asks, naming both totals. A message saying the price is too high ("es mucho", "más barato", "too expensive", "cheaper") whose revision would raise the total writes nothing.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/bare-total.test.ts` ("REQ-1027 q2-4 parseTargetTotalChange …": the tester's exact sentence → 555000 + Q-002; the bare-number variants ES + EN) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/target-total.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1027 q2-4 …": real stores, sent Q-002, model's Pintura→555000 + remove cerca with `targetTotalCents: 555000` → Version 2 at 555000 with Materiales 135000, or an ask with nothing written; a "más barata" ask that raises the total writes nothing) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/target-total-revision.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1027 q2-4 …": the full chat turn, model stubbed to the tester's revise_quote) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/target-total-revision.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1027 q2-4 e2e …": booted app, scripted model, POST /agents/chat on the Q-002 conversation → GET /quotes/:id pendingRevision.estimatedTotal). Browser e2e n/a: the browser lanes stub the model, so a story adds nothing beyond the HTTP e2e.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv <unit + both int files>` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 5 failed` (`parseTargetTotalChange` → `undefined` vs `555000`; ReviseQuote `Values are not equal: Version 2 must be the $5,550 he typed … -690000 +555000`; the "más barata" case saved `estimatedTotal: 690000`; the chat turn's reply is the tester's own "…Total $6,450 → $6,900. Queda como Versión 2 de Q-002…"); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/target-total-revision.e2e.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` with the same $6,900 reply.
**Fix (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** (1) `parseTargetTotalChange` reads a total word next to a BARE number ("total 5,550", "total de 5550", "en total 5,550", "new total 5550", "5,550 total") when no "$" is typed and exactly one such phrase is there. (2) `revise_quote` gets `newTotalDollars` (the job's new total, never a line's amountCents; lang `prompts.tools.reviseQuote.newTotalDollars`, en + es), parsed to `targetTotalCents`; handle-chat-message passes it to ReviseQuote, and tells the model the stated total for an issued quote (`revisionTotalNote`). The REQ-377 change-order pre-route is skipped when the message also takes a line off (`namesLineRemoval`: "sin", "quita", "drop", "without"…), because a change order can only append a line. (3) `ReviseQuote.run` lands a stated total (the tool's, or else the one read from the words) with `settleToTotal` (quote-line-revision): a line repriced to exactly the total is the model's slip and keeps its price; if the total is still off, the one repriced line (or, with none, the largest line left) absorbs the difference. If it cannot land (more than one reprice, a price the user typed would be overridden, or a line would go ≤ 0), nothing is written and the reply names both totals (`chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.targetMismatch`). With no stated total, a "too much / cheaper" message (`saysTooExpensive`: "es mucho", "más barato", "too expensive", "cheaper"…) whose revision would raise the total writes nothing and asks (`chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.wouldRaise`). Both asks are the new outcome `ask_total`, which the chat links to its quote (front-end/lib/chat-quote-link.ts; jest `quote-revise-issued.test.ts` lists it). The tester's turn now saves Version 2 at Pintura $4,200 + Materiales $1,350 = $5,550, with the fence gone.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/bare-total.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/target-total.int.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/target-total-revision.int.test.ts src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/target-total-revision.e2e.test.ts` → `ok | 6 passed | 0 failed (2m28s)`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/business/{change-order-intent,quote-line-revision,openai-tools,stated-price,llm/base}/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/{revise-quote,handle-chat-message}/` → `ok | 450 passed | 0 failed`. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 644 passed, 644 total; Tests: 6335 passed, 1 skipped`. `deno lint` (7 backend files) and `deno check` on the touched modules are clean; front-end `deno lint` + `deno check lib/chat-quote-link.ts` are clean.

## REQ-1026 — AMENDMENT to REQ-201 / REQ-948: publishing a revision of a declined quote reopens it, so the Version 2 the customer is told about can be signed (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-5)
**Source:** Raphael (QA loop): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". Issue q2-5 [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], LOOP-007 cycle 2: "Revising a DECLINED quote is a dead end: customer texted that v2 is 'ready' but can't sign it" — Q-002 was declined, the contractor published Version 2 with "Publish revision and notify customer", Jorge got SMS 012 "… (Q-002 · Versión 2) está lista", and /q read "Q-002 · Versión 2 · Rechazada" with no signing section.
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** publishing a revision never reopens a declined quote. POST /quotes/:id/decline (public-controller) stamps `status: "lost"` + `lostAt` (+ declineReason/declineNote/declinedName). `RevisionsController.publishQuote` refuses only a signed quote (`isQuoteLocked`, accepted only) and calls `QuoteStore.publishRevision` → `publishNumbered` → `applyRevision` (shared/documents/versions.ts), which builds `next = {...doc, ...pendingPatch, version+1}`; the pending patch is content only and the quote store passes no `finish` hook, so "lost", lostAt and the decline fields carry into Version 2. The send path's `publishPendingQuote` has the same gap, and the send stamps set status "sent" only when `!sentAt`. `notify()` then sends the ordinary "ready" message, while `quoteState` gives "declined" (the "Rechazada" headline), `deriveQuoteView` gives mode "declined" with no signing section, and `acceptQuote` answers 409 `declined`. That breaks REQ-948's own copy ("revise the quote and send it again") and its declineNotifiedAt-vs-lostAt re-alert guard, which assumes a re-sent quote can be declined again.
**Requirement:** a published revision (Publish revision, with or without notify, and the send path's publish-pending) of a declined quote is open again: status "sent", no lostAt/declineReason/declineNote/declinedName on the live version (the filed Version 1 keeps them), headline state "revised", /q shows the signing section, accept of that version succeeds, and a second decline is a new decision that alerts the contractor again.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/declined-revision.test.ts` ("REQ-1026 …": `QuoteStore.publishRevision` and `publishPendingQuote` on a declined quote with a pending revision → Version 2 status "sent", no decline fields, `quoteState` "revised", `deriveQuoteView` mode "open"; filed Version 1 stays "lost") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/declined-revision.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1026 …": send → decline → PUT a line → POST /quotes/:id/publish {notify:true} → the customer is texted, GET /quotes/:id/public reads state "revised" with no signRefusal, POST accept {version:2} is 200; a second decline is not `alreadyDeclined` and texts + emails the contractor again) · e2e `e2e/declined-quote-revision/declined-quote-revision.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1026 …": the same flow, then the customer's /q/<id>?lang=es headline reads "Versión 2" without "Rechazada" and the signing section is visible).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-5 at 240a6443):** unit `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/declined-revision.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`a published revision of a declined quote is open again, not still 'lost'` — `- lost + sent`, both tests); int `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/declined-revision.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`the published Version 2 is no longer 'lost' (status lost, lostAt …)`; `Version 2's decline is a new decision, not 'already declined'` — `- true + undefined`); e2e `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/declined-quote-revision -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1026 … expectation failed: Version 2 is not declined: "Q-001 · Versión 2 · Rechazada · 19 nov 2026"`.
**Fix:** new pure `reopenDeclined(next)` in `shared/documents/versions.ts` — a "lost" quote becomes status "sent" with lostAt/declineReason/declineNote/declinedName dropped (declineNotifiedAt kept, so REQ-948's `declineNotifiedAt >= lostAt` guard re-alerts on the later second decline). `QuoteStore.publishRevision` passes it as `publishNumbered`'s `finish` hook, the one write shared by POST /quotes/:id/publish and the send path's `publishPendingQuote`; the filed Version 1 record keeps the decline.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-5):** unit + int `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/declined-revision.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/declined-revision.int.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`; e2e `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=~/Library/Caches/deno/npm/registry.npmjs.org/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/declined-quote-revision -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1026 (LOOP-007 q2-5): a declined quote revised and re-sent with notify opens on /q as 'Versión 2' with the signing section … · 26s`. Neighbours: quote-store base-lang/job-name-lang/price-guard/smk/translations/signed-lock (each `ok`), `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/private-pricing.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/soft-delete.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/` → `ok | 25 passed | 0 failed`; `deno check` quote-store/mod.ts + publish-pending/mod.ts clean; `deno lint` on both touched files clean; `deno fmt -` no diff; jest unit lane `npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Tests: 1 skipped, 6335 passed, 6336 total`.

## REQ-1024 — LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-6 + q2-42: a revision's "what changed" names the line that was really removed, and removing a line drops it from the job details
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues, cycle 2: **q2-6** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Customer-facing v2 still describes the removed fence, and its 'what changed' banner contradicts the line items"; **q2-42** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "'Unpublished changes' summary disagrees with what the assistant said it changed". Amends REQ-248 / REQ-395 (named change summaries) and REQ-315 (revise_quote).
**Root cause:** two faults. (A) `versionChanges` (`shared/documents/versions.ts`, REQ-248 d4c8797a, "matched by position") pairs `before[i]` with `after[i]` and reports the leftover tail as removed/added. Q-002 v1 was [Pintura exterior $4,200, Reparación de cerca $900, Materiales $1,350]; v2 removed the middle line and repriced the first, so the diff read "Removed: Materiales ($1,350) · Changed: … Reparación de cerca → Materiales ($900 → $1,350)". The owner's Unpublished-changes summary (`pendingRevisionChanges` → `versionChangeLine`, QuotesPage.tsx), the version history and the customer's /q banner (`changesFromPrevious` in public-controller, rendered by quote-doc.tsx) all read it. (B) The `ReviseQuote` coordinator (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/mod.ts`, REQ-315) patches `{ lineItems, estimatedTotal }` only, so a removed line's job-details bullet ("También incluye la reparación de la cerca…") stays in `description`/`descriptionByLang` and is published in Version 2.
**Requirement:** lines are matched by identity (same description), not position: removing the middle line reports that line removed and nothing else shifted; a pure reorder is no change; a middle insert is one line added; a same-count rename in place still reads as one change. Removing a line through revise_quote also drops its bullet from the pending revision's job details in every language.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-revision-line-identity.test.ts` ("REQ-1024 …": [A,B,C]→[A',C] → removed [B], changed [A→A']; es banner never "Eliminado: Materiales"; `pendingRevisionChanges` summary names the fence; reorder = no change; middle insert = one added; rename-in-place guard) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/revision-changes.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1024 q2-6: GET /quotes/:id/public changesFromPrevious names the removed MIDDLE line …") and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/remove-line-job-details.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1024 q2-6: removing the fence line … drops the fence bullet …") · e2e `e2e/quote-revision-line-identity/quote-revision-line-identity.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1024 q2-42 + q2-6: …": owner's `quote-pending-changes` text, then after publish the /q `public-doc-changes` banner). The job-details half has no e2e: it runs through the LLM's revise_quote tool call, so it is pinned at the coordinator integration level.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/quote-revision-line-identity.test.ts` → 5 failed, 1 passed (`Received string: "Total $6,450.00 → $6,900.00 · Eliminado: Materiales para pintura ($1,350.00) · Cambiado: Pintura exterior ($4,200.00 → $5,550.00), Reparación de cerca de madera (18 pies lineales) → Materiales para pintura ($900.00 → $1,350.00)"`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/revision-changes.int.test.ts` → 1 passed, 1 failed (removed = Materiales 135000, expected the fence 90000); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/remove-line-job-details.int.test.ts` → `AssertionError: Version 2's job details still describe the removed fence`; `shots run e2e/quote-revision-line-identity -- --no-check` → `expectation failed: the Unpublished-changes summary names the fence as removed — … got "… Removed: Materiales para pintura ($1,350.00) …"`.
**Fix (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** (A) `versionChanges` (`shared/documents/versions.ts`) now pairs lines through `matchLines`. Lines with the same normalised description (case, accents and spacing ignored) pair first, in any position, and a pair counts as "changed" when its qty, unit or price differs. The lines left over pair in order only when both sides have the same number left (a rename in place). Anything still unpaired counts as added or removed. This one function feeds the owner's Unpublished-changes summary, the version history and the customer's /q banner, so all three are fixed. `effectivePendingRevision` keeps its positional "any difference?" check, because a reorder is still a change to publish. (B) New pure `dropRemovedLineBullets` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/mod.ts`). `ReviseQuote` calls it whenever `remove` takes a line off, unless this same turn already rewrote the job details (`jobDetailsUpdated`). It drops every job-details bullet that names a removed line, matching on the name the user said, the line's description or its translations, and adds the result to the same pending/draft patch as `description` + `descriptionByLang`. A translation whose bullets line up one-to-one with the base text loses the same rows. A translation that does not line up has its own matching bullets dropped, or is cleared as stale when it has none, and the next translate run refills it. A bullet that also names a line that stays is not dropped. The reply then says so through the new `chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.jobDetailsCheck` key (en + es), so the owner reviews it instead of the bullet being published silently. No prompt change: the coordinator now keeps the bullets in step deterministically, so the model does not also need to call update_job_details. Extra unit tests for the helper are in `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts` ("REQ-1024 dropRemovedLineBullets: …", 3 cases: every language, unsure bullet kept, stale translation cleared). No test assertion was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/quote-revision-line-identity.test.ts` → `Tests: 6 passed, 6 total` · full jest unit lane `npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 645 passed, 645 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6341 passed` · `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/revision-changes.int.test.ts src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/` → `ok | 17 passed | 0 failed` (remove-line-job-details + revision-changes included) · `deno test -A src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts` → `ok | 15 passed | 0 failed` · neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check` on public-controller revision-changes/co-what-changed/owner-change-feed, handle-chat-message named-quote-change/edit-replies/details-corrections/multi-tool/co-correction, quote-store/, core/i18n/ → `ok | 61 passed | 0 failed` · `PORT=5937 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/quote-revision-line-identity -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1024 q2-42 + q2-6: removing the middle line names THAT line as removed … · 42.4s — 1 pass · 0 fail` · `deno check` revise-quote/mod.ts, quote-line-revision/mod.ts, shared versions.ts + linked-view.ts → clean · `deno lint -` on the touched modules → clean.

## REQ-1025 — One chat turn makes one change order: the reply never says both "CO-001 added … tap Send CO-001" and "I didn't change anything yet", the Send CO-001 button it promises is drawn, and "send CO-001 to maria by email" sends it (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-7)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-7** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "change order for maria gonzalez master bath Q-001: she wants to add a recessed shampoo niche and a frameless glass door, add $2,800" got one reply that said CO-001 was added (tap Send CO-001) AND asked how much to add ("I didn't change anything yet"); no Send CO-001 button; the follow-up "send CO-001 to maria by email" got "Got it — what would you like me to do with that?".
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** `parseChangeOrderRequest` (business/change-order-intent) reads Q-001 and $2,800 but no description, so the code-only change order (handle-chat-message/mod.ts ~2065) is skipped and the model answers — with two `change_order` calls (niche, door). `planToolCalls` runs every edit (REQ-444), and `applyEditCalls` runs `ApplyChatChangeOrder.run()` per call: the first makes CO-001 unsent ("tap Send CO-001"), the second's amount isn't what the user typed so `reconcileChangeOrderDelta` asks ("… I didn't change anything yet"); the texts are joined into one reply and `payload.changeOrder` keeps only the last outcome (`needs_amount`), so `liveChangeOrderSendId` / `chatChangeOrderLink` (front-end/lib/chat-quote-link.ts) draw no Send button. Separately, `parseSendChangeOrderAsk` (business/change-order-delivery) hands the text to `parseSendInvoiceAsk`, whose name pattern needs a capitalised name, so "send CO-001 to maria by email" / "email CO-001 to maria" are not a send and fall to `noActionFallback`.
**Requirement:** (a) the change_order calls of one turn on one quote make at most one change order, at the amount the user typed; once a change order is made the reply carries no ask-amount / "didn't change anything" text, and `payload.changeOrder` is that unsent CO (`kind:"change_order"`, `sent:false`) so the Send button is drawn (REQ-652). (b) QA's message is read in code: a description naming both items, Q-001, +$2,800. (c) A message naming a CO number and saying send/email it to a name in any case is a send of that CO.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-delivery/test.ts` ("REQ-1025 q2-7 parseSendChangeOrderAsk: …" — "send CO-001 to maria by email", "email CO-001 to maria", "send CO-001 to maria gonzalez", plus the capitalised control) and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts` ("REQ-1025 q2-7 parseChangeOrderRequest: QA's message → …") · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/multi-change-order.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1025 q2-7: …" ×2 — the stub model returns QA's two change_order calls (niche $2,800, door $1,400) on a signed, invoiced Q-001, unbound and bound thread: one CO, no contradiction, payload offers the unsent CO, lowercase follow-up sends it) · e2e `e2e/chat-change-order-no-autosend/chat-change-order-no-autosend.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1025 q2-7 …": QA's message → `msg-co-send` reads "Send CO-00N", then "send CO-00N to maria by email" reports "Sent CO-00N to Maria Gonzalez by email"). The local stub LLM can't emit two tool calls, so the contradiction half is pinned at int level; the e2e covers the button and the send wording.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-7 at 240a6443):** unit `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/change-order-delivery/test.ts src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts --filter REQ-1025` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 4 failed` (the three lowercase sends → `undefined`; `description names both items (got undefined)`); int `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/multi-change-order.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed`, both `the reply both made CO-001 and said nothing changed: Change order CO-001 added to Q-001 Master bath remodel: Recessed shampoo niche ($2,800.00). It has not been sent to Maria Gonzalez yet — tap Send CO-001 … How much should Frameless glass door add to Q-001 Master bath remodel? … — I didn't change anything yet.`; e2e `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5838 shots run e2e/chat-change-order-no-autosend/… -- --no-check --filter REQ-1025` → `✗ … expectation failed: the lowercase follow-up sends it (got Got it — what would you like me to do with that?)`.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-7):** (a) `mergeChangeOrderCalls` (business/change-order-intent) — run by `applyEditCalls` before its loop — makes the change_order calls of one turn on one quote ONE call when they were priced together (one amount typed and the calls' deltas are not each a typed amount, or the deltas add up to a typed amount): the items joined ("Recessed shampoo niche and frameless glass door"), the typed amount. Calls each priced as typed ("niche $500 and door $1,200"), a new total (REQ-377) or nothing typed stay apart. As a backstop, once a change order was made this turn a later call's `needs_amount` / `needs_description` ask is left out of the reply and never overwrites `payload.changeOrder`. (b) `parseChangeOrderRequest` drops a "she wants to add" lead-in (`WANTS_LEAD_RE`) and the "…, add" left before the cut amount (`DANGLING_VERB_RE`), so QA's message is read in code (Q-001, "Recessed shampoo niche and a frameless glass door", +$2,800) and never reaches the model; REQ-455's narrative "Karen signed but now she wants…" still is not. (c) `parseSendChangeOrderAsk` (business/change-order-delivery): when the message names a CO number, a lowercase "to maria (gonzalez)" / "a maria" is read as the customer (`TO_LOWER_NAME_RE` → "to her" / "a ella" before `parseSendInvoiceAsk`); "to me", "to maria later/tomorrow" and "to maria about the tile" are still not a send. Extra unit tests: "REQ-1025 q2-7 mergeChangeOrderCalls: …" ×3 in change-order-intent/test.ts.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-7):** unit `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts src/agents/domain/business/change-order-delivery/test.ts` → `ok | 61 passed | 0 failed` (REQ-1025 ×4 sends, parse, merge ×3 included); int `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/multi-change-order.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours — every test file in handle-chat-message/, apply-chat-change-order/, chat-billing-intent/, change-order-*/, tool-calls/ and every test importing change-order-intent or change-order-delivery (37 files) → `ok | 415 passed | 0 failed (18m38s)`; e2e `PORT=5838 deno task serve` (own KV) + `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:5838 shots run e2e/chat-change-order-no-autosend/chat-change-order-no-autosend.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1025 q2-7 (LOOP-007 cycle 2): QA's master bath change order on Q-001 draws one 'Send CO-00N' button … and 'send CO-00N to maria by email' sends it · 9.5s`. Not this fix: in the same file `REQ-652 M8` fails on `expected "Open CO-001 as customer", got "View CO-001 as customer"` (lang `asstChat.customerLink.open` = "View as customer"; no front-end or lang file is touched here), and stories from other files shots pulled into the run (REQ-197/494/785/1008) did not finish under host load / an evidence-dir write error.

## REQ-1031 — The customer page's Remind sends the invoice's reminder nudge, never the original invoice email again (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-8; amends REQ-924(d))
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-18 (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-8** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Customer-page Remind re-sends the original invoice email word for word instead of a reminder" — same subject, same body; the /invoices card's "Send a nudge" does send the reminder copy (REQ-477).
**Root cause:** REQ-924(d) (commit 1c0be6f7) wired the customer workspace's Remind — the header's `cws-remind` and every invoices-table row's Remind — to the `remind` modal in `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` (~line 1053), which renders the generic `InvoiceSendDialog` and whose `onSend` calls `dispatchInvoice(inv.id, pick)` (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` ~3401). That POSTs the first-send endpoints `/api/invoices/:id/email|text` with only `{language, to}` (`invoiceDispatchBody`), so the backend renders the ordinary invoice email again and logs an ordinary send, while the page toasts "Reminder sent for INV-001". The reminder path that exists — `doSendNudge` on /invoices, POST `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` `{invoiceId, day: manualReminderDay(…)}` → SendPaymentReminder, reminder copy, reminderHistory, `nudgeNote` "Nudge sent" (REQ-021 / REQ-477 / REQ-704) — is never called from the customer page.
**Requirement:** Remind on /customers/<id> (header and row) sends the invoice's reminder nudge through `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` (the same cadence and day as /invoices' "Send a nudge"), never `/api/invoices/:id/email|text`; the confirmation is the nudge's own result ("Nudge sent", or its no-recipient / already-nudged / failed wording). REQ-924(d) reads "Remind = the invoice's reminder nudge (REQ-021/477)".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/loop7-q2-8-customer-remind-nudge.test.ts` ("REQ-1031 q2-8 …": the remind modal never calls `dispatchInvoice` / `/api/invoices/${id}/email|text`; it posts `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` directly or through an imported helper whose body does) · int n/a — the backend reminder endpoint is already pinned by `jest/integration/invoice-nudge.int.test.ts`; the bug is front-end wiring only · e2e `e2e/customer-remind-nudge/customer-remind-nudge.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1031 (LOOP-007 q2-8) …": an emailed, 10-days-past-due invoice; /customers/<id> → `cws-remind` (and the sheet's Send if one opens) POSTs `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` and no `/api/invoices/*/email|text`; the Outbox's one new email to her is `kind: "reminder"` with a subject different from the first send).
**Evidence (2026-11-19, RED at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/loop7-q2-8-customer-remind-nudge.test.ts` → `Tests: 2 failed, 2 total` (`expect(block).not.toMatch(/\bdispatchInvoice\s*\(/)`; `"calls": "invoiceSendContact, setModal, async, dispatchInvoice, if, changed, tFor, setToast, dispatchFailureCopy", "postsReminder": false`); `shots run e2e/customer-remind-nudge -- --no-check` → `✗ … expectation failed: Remind must not re-send the invoice: it POSTed ["/api/invoices/eb2d7d73-…/email"] (the first-send /api/invoices/:id/email|text), not /api/cron/invoice-reminder`.
**Fix:** new `front-end/lib/invoice-nudge.ts` — `sendInvoiceNudge(invoiceId, day)` (POST `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` `{invoiceId, day}` → `nudgeNote`), `previewInvoiceNudge` (`/api/cron/reminder-preview`, sent to nobody) and `nudgeDayFor` (`manualReminderDay`, REQ-704) — the one nudge sender: /invoices' `doSendNudge` now calls it, and so does the customer page. The workspace's `remind` modal renders the new `front-end/components/InvoiceNudgeDialog.tsx` instead of `InvoiceSendDialog`: in the house send-sheet shape (`send-dialog` / `send-cancel` / `send-keep`) it names the invoice and customer ("Send a payment reminder for INV-001 to Rosa?"), shows the backend's reminder preview for today's step, asks first on a claimed invoice (REQ-250: "says they already paid … Send anyway"), and its Send posts the nudge. A delivered nudge re-reads the page (the reminder shows in Activity) and toasts "Reminder sent for INV-001" — now true; any other reply toasts the nudge's own wording (no recipient / muted / already nudged / failed, errors in red). `dispatchInvoice` / `dispatchFailureCopy` / `invoiceSendContact` are no longer imported by the workspace. New keys `customerWs.remind.title|send|claimedAsk` (en + es).
**REQ-924(d) AMENDMENT (REQ-1031):** "Remind = the invoice's reminder nudge (REQ-021/477)", not the invoice send sheet.
**Tests adjusted (they pinned the old wiring, not a requirement):** `jest/unit/customer-workspace.test.ts` "the actions reuse the app's flows" pinned `InvoiceSendDialog` in the workspace (REQ-924(d)'s old Remind) → now pins `InvoiceNudgeDialog` + `sendInvoiceNudge(`; `jest/unit/delivery-truth.test.ts` "the overdue card's nudge reads nudgeNote" read `nudgeNote(` inside `doSendNudge` → now accepts `sendInvoiceNudge(` there and pins `return nudgeNote(body)` in the helper (same REQ-556 behaviour, one place). Added unit `jest/unit/loop7-q2-8-invoice-nudge-helper.test.ts` (stubbed fetch: POSTs `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` with `{invoiceId, day}` and never `/api/invoices/:id/email|text`; maps sent / no_recipient / already_fired / HTTP 500 / network error; REQ-704 rungs; the preview hits only `/api/cron/reminder-preview`).
**Evidence (2026-11-19, GREEN):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit -- loop7-q2-8 customer-workspace.test delivery-truth claimed-nudge-confirm nudge-past-due-q114` → `Tests: 50 passed, 50 total` (6 suites PASS); full unit lane `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 646 passed, 646 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6341 passed`; `shots run e2e/customer-remind-nudge -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1031 (LOOP-007 q2-8): the customer page's Remind sends the reminder nudge … · 74.7s` (1 pass · 0 fail); neighbours `shots run e2e/claimed-nudge e2e/invoice-nudge-out-c3 e2e/nudge-past-due-q114 e2e/reminder-cadence-c5 e2e/customer-invoice-lang -- --no-check` → 5 pass · 0 fail (REQ-250, REQ-477, REQ-704, REQ-934, REQ-938); `cd front-end && deno lint lib/invoice-nudge.ts components/InvoiceNudgeDialog.tsx islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` → `Checked 4 files`; `deno check` same 4 files → clean.

## REQ-1028 — A part-paid invoice's email headlines the balance due, and its Estado is the /i page's Spanish invoice word (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-9 + q2-20)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues, cycle 2: **q2-9** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Reminder for a part-paid invoice asks for the full amount and shows the English word 'Pending' in a Spanish email" (INV-001 $1,190.75 with $500 paid → Remind → Email only, Español: "Monto a pagar $1,190.75", "Estado Pending", and "Pagado $500.00 · Saldo $690.75" only at the bottom); **q2-20** [polish/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Invoice email says 'Estado Enviado' (masculine) while the /i page says 'Enviada'".
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** the customer page's Remind re-sends the invoice email (REQ-924 d: `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` → `dispatchInvoice` → POST /api/invoices/:id/email). `renderInvoiceHtml` and `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` (send-paperwork-email/mod.ts) take `const amount = i.amount` — the full total, never minus `i.paidCents` — for the money card and the preheader, and `invoiceAmountLabel` says "Monto a pagar" for any unpaid bill; the reminder coordinator's `composeReminderCopy` (send-payment-reminder/mod.ts) prints `invoice.amount` too. The Estado row calls `invoiceStatusLabel(i.status, lang)` (shared/quote-flow/email-format.ts), whose STATUS_LABELS table copies the QUOTE "status.*" family (masculine: "Enviado", "Pagado", "Visto") and has no "pending" — the status ComputeInvoiceBalance stores after a part payment — so it falls back to the capitalised raw enum "Pending" even in Spanish. REQ-966 moved the PDF/CSV to the /i pill; the email was never moved. REQ-712 is the same masculine-quote-word-on-a-factura bug, fixed for the chat chip only.
**Requirement:** (a) every customer-facing invoice email (itemized and basic) and the payment reminder ask for the open balance (`amount − paidCents`) in the money card and preheader once part is paid; the total may stay in the facts line. (b) The Estado row uses the invoice family's words (/i's `public.doc.state.*` / `invoices.state.*`: "Enviada", "Pagada", "Vista", "Anulada"), and no invoice status — "pending" included — ever comes back as its raw English enum in Spanish. Existing tests that lock the masculine word (jest/unit/email-i18n.test.ts P-29, jest/integration/email-content.int.test.ts:174, preview-invoice-send/int.test.ts:216) flip with the fix.

The agreement-context comparison keeps the invoice total. `send-payment-reminder/mod.ts` `composeReminderCopy` prints the open balance in the email and the text. Not changed: the customer activity line `customerWs.act.invoiced` ("Invoice INV-001 sent — $1,190.75") — it records the bill being issued, and its total is correct there.

## REQ-1029 — AMENDMENT of REQ-277 / REQ-626: the board's "Send a kind reminder" sends the app's own reminder and never texts a phone that can't take texts (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-10)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-10** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Board 'Send a kind reminder' does nothing on desktop and tries to text an untextable number". Customer Rosa Delgado, 843-555-0111 + an email, owes money; clicking "Enviar un recordatorio amable →" on /customers did nothing visible, opened no dialog, and put nothing in the Outbox.
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** the board card's CTA handler `onCta` (`front-end/islands/ClientsBoard.tsx`, REQ-626 e8b435f1 + 7b8351c4) handles every message verb, "reminder" included, by setting `globalThis.location.href = messageHref(c, body)`. `messageHref` (`shared/card-actions/mod.ts`) returns `sms:<e164>` whenever the phone has digits and never asks `phoneCantReceiveTexts` (`shared/quote-flow/sms-number.ts`, REQ-569); `messageHrefFor` / `nudgeActionFor` (`front-end/lib/client-actions.ts`, REQ-277) prefer the phone the same way. So for a fictional 555-01xx phone the reminder is an `sms:` hand-off: nothing on desktop, and a text to a number the app's own send sheet says can't receive texts. The in-app reminder (InvoiceSendDialog → `dispatchInvoice`, as on the customer page, `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` "remind") is never used, so no Outbox entry is made.
**Requirement:** (a) the board card's "Send a kind reminder" runs the app's own invoice reminder — the send sheet for the customer's open invoice (email recommended for an untextable phone), whose Send goes through `dispatchInvoice` and lands in the Outbox; with no invoice to remind about it opens the card. (b) For the other message verbs and the panel's Message, `messageHref` / `messageHrefFor` skip a phone `phoneCantReceiveTexts` flags: `mailto:` when there is an email, else nothing (the card opens).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/board-reminder-untextable-q210.test.ts` ("REQ-1029 …": `messageHref` and `messageHrefFor` with 843-555-0111 + email → `mailto:`, without email → null; `nudgeActionFor` opens the card; `onCta` handles "reminder" through the in-app send, before any `location.href` hand-off) · int n/a — the send endpoint (`POST /api/invoices/:id/email`) and its Outbox write are unchanged and covered by their own int tests; the fault is front-end routing only · e2e `e2e/clients-pages/clients-pages.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1029 (LOOP-007 q2-10) …": a customer with 843-555-0111 + email and a sent invoice; the board's nudge opens `[data-cy='send-dialog']` with email recommended and picked, Send adds one email row to `/api/outbox`, the page never goes to `sms:`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-10 at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern board-reminder-untextable` → `Tests: 5 failed, 1 passed, 6 total` (`messageHref` `Expected: "mailto:rosa@blackhole.postmarkapp.com"` `Received: "sms:+18435550111"`; no-email `Received: "sms:+18435550111"`; `messageHrefFor` `Received: "sms:+18435550111"`; `nudgeActionFor` got `{kind:"message", href:"sms:+18435550111"}`; `onCta` has no "reminder" branch); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5731 shots run e2e/clients-pages -- --no-check --filter REQ-1029` → `expectation failed: the reminder opened the in-app send sheet (no [data-cy='send-dialog'] after clicking "Send a kind reminder →"; page http://localhost:5731/customers)`.
**Note for the fix:** `jest/unit/card-actions.test.ts` (REQ-626) and `jest/unit/client-card-actions.test.ts` (REQ-277) pin `sms:` for "(512) 555-0101" — itself a fictional 555-01xx number — so they must move to a textable number (e.g. 555-3150) when (b) lands.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-10):** `ClientsBoard.tsx` `onCta` handles "reminder" first: `reminderInvoiceFor(c.documents)` (`front-end/lib/client-actions.ts` — the oldest issued invoice not paid/void, a "claimed" one last) → `onRemind` → the board renders `InvoiceSendDialog` (contact from `invoiceSendContact`, so an untextable phone gets email recommended), whose Send runs `dispatchInvoice` (→ Outbox) and shows "Reminder sent for …" (`customerWs.remind.sent`) or `dispatchFailureCopy`, then reloads the cards; no open invoice → the card's sheet. `messageHref` (`shared/card-actions/mod.ts`) and `messageHrefFor` (`front-end/lib/client-actions.ts`) skip a phone `phoneCantReceiveTexts` flags → `mailto:` or null (so `nudgeActionFor` opens the card).
