## REQ-1044 — LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-28: the Square and Stripe merchant previews follow a business rename without a reload
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-28** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "After renaming the business, the Square payment card shows the old payee name until reload" — on /settings › Pagos en línea the header and sidebar take the new name (REQ-737) but the Square card's "A quién le pagan tus clientes en la página de Square" and the Stripe card's "Lo que tus clientes ven en la página de pago" keep the old one until a reload.
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** `SquarePaymentsCard` and the Stripe card `CardPaymentsCard` (front-end/islands/SettingsPage.tsx) fetch their status once on mount and again only on `CARD_PROVIDER_EVENT` (connect/disconnect). They compute `merchantName = status?.merchant.name || snapshot.identity?.businessName || …` and `logoFileId = status?.merchant.logoFileId ?? snapshot.identity?.logoFileId`, so the cached server copy wins over the live `snapshot` that `saveIdentity` updates through `onSaved` at once. The backend builds `merchant.name` from the same identity fields (`ConnectStripe.merchant`: businessName → legalName → user.name; Square hands off to it), so the cached copy adds nothing and goes stale on a rename (and on a new logo).
**Requirement:** after a saved rename (or a new logo) on /settings, both merchant previews show the new name/logo at once, with no reload. A pure helper `merchantPreview(snapshot, status)` in `front-end/lib/merchant-preview.ts` → `{name, logoFileId}` lets the live snapshot win (businessName → legalName → user.name, trimmed, then the status copy) and both cards use it.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/merchant-preview-rename.test.ts` ("REQ-1044 …": the helper — snapshot name and logo beat a stale status, fallbacks; both cards stop putting `status?.merchant` first and call `merchantPreview(snapshot, status)`) · int n/a — the backend is correct (status returns the current identity name; a reload already shows it) · e2e `e2e/merchant-preview-rename/merchant-preview-rename.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1044 q2-28: …": fake Square connected, rename on /settings, identity PUT OK, sidebar follows, then with no reload `[data-cy=square-merchant]` and `[data-cy=stripe-merchant]` read the new name).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-28 at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern merchant-preview-rename` → `Tests: 7 failed, 7 total` (helper missing; both cards `Received: ["merchantName = status?.merchant.name ||", "logoFileId = status?.merchant.logoFileId ??"]`; `merchantPreview(snapshot, status)` absent); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5733 shots run e2e/merchant-preview-rename/merchant-preview-rename.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` (against `PORT=5733 deno task serve`) → `expectation failed: the Square merchant preview reads the new name "Reyes Tile & Bath LLC" (got "Who your customers pay on Square's checkoutReyes Tile & Bath") | the Stripe merchant preview reads the new name "Reyes Tile & Bath LLC" (got "What your customers see on the card pageReyes Tile & Bath")`.
**Fix:** new pure helper `front-end/lib/merchant-preview.ts` → `merchantPreview(snapshot, status)` (live snapshot businessName → legalName → user.name, trimmed, then the cached `status.merchant.name`; logo `snapshot.identity.logoFileId ?? status.merchant.logoFileId`). `CardPaymentsCard` and `SquarePaymentsCard` in `front-end/islands/SettingsPage.tsx` both destructure `{ name: merchantName, logoFileId }` from it — no extra request.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-28):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern merchant-preview-rename` → `Tests: 7 passed, 7 total`; neighbours `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'card-pay-tabs|square-pay|stripe-settings|merchant-preview-rename'` → 4 suites PASS, `Tests: 39 passed, 39 total`; `PORT=5733 KV_PATH=<scratch> deno task serve` + `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:5733 shots run e2e/merchant-preview-rename/merchant-preview-rename.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1044 q2-28: renaming the business on /settings updates the Square and Stripe merchant previews without a reload · 95s`; `cd front-end && deno lint lib/merchant-preview.ts islands/SettingsPage.tsx` → `Checked 2 files`; `deno check` on both → clean; `deno fmt -` (stdin) leaves both unchanged.

## REQ-1045: An unsent draft quote's card offers no "Resend" / "Reenviar" (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-29)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-29** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: on /quotes (ES) › En borrador › Q-001 the card's reading says "Aún sin enviar — termina de escribirlo, y luego envíalo." but its back offers "Reenviar".
**Root cause:** in `front-end/islands/QuoteCard.tsx`, the back face renders the Resend button (`data-cy="qcard-resend"`, `onClick={onResend}` → `resendQuote()` → POST `/api/quotes/:id/email` + `/text`) under `{!q.isSample && …}` only. REQ-360 added that gate to hide the button on the onboarding sample. The button never checks `q.stage`. When REQ-626 (7b8351c46) made Resend real, the front CTA got a per-stage table (`quoteCta('draft')` in `shared/card-actions/mod.ts` → finishSend/resume), but the back face got no stage check. So a draft that was never sent shows "Reenviar", and pressing it sends the unfinished quote by email and text without the send preview. The paperwork-email controller has no draft guard either.
**Requirement:** the back face of a draft quote's card has no Resend button (EN "Resend", ES "Reenviar"). Quotes at stage `sent` and `undelivered` keep it.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/quote-card-draft-resend.test.tsx` ("REQ-1045 q2-29 (en|es): …" renders the real QuoteCard island flipped. A draft reads "Not sent yet" / "Aún sin enviar" and has no Resend and no `[data-cy=qcard-resend]`. `sent` and `undelivered` keep Resend.) · int n/a: the defect is the label/button on the card; a backend draft guard is an optional defence-in-depth for the fixer, and if one is added it gets its own int test · e2e `e2e/open-cards/open-cards.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1045 (LOOP-007 q2-29): …" ES user, a quote never sent from the app, /quotes?lang=es. Flip the card: the reading says "Aún sin enviar" and there is no `[data-cy=qcard-resend]` and no "Reenviar").
**Note for the fix:** the existing story "REQ-626: quote card → Open quote … Resend answers on the card" in the same e2e file clicks `qcard-resend` on a draft card ("a quote never sent from the app is a draft"). It has to move to a quote at stage sent/undelivered, or check the draft's replacement action.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, at 240a6443):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/quote-card-draft-resend.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 4 passed | 2 failed` (`Values are not equal: draft back actions: Abrir cotización | Reenviar | Copiar enlace | Ver como cliente | Eliminar`, EN the same with "Resend"). `BASE_URL=http://localhost:6743 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/open-cards -- --no-check --filter REQ-1045` → `expectation failed: a never-sent draft offers no Resend (actions: Abrir cotización Reenviar Copiar enlace Ver como cliente Eliminar) — expected 0, got 1`.
**Fix:** `front-end/islands/QuoteCard.tsx` renders the back-face Resend only when `!q.isSample && q.stage !== "draft"`. A draft goes forward through its front CTA (`quoteCta('draft')` → finishSend/resume). `undelivered` keeps Resend as a retry. There is no backend draft guard: `POST /quotes/:id/email|text` is also the first-send path (the send coordinators stamp status + sentAt there), so refusing drafts would break the real send. That makes int n/a. Per the note above, the REQ-626 quote story in `e2e/open-cards/open-cards.e2e.test.ts` still checks "Finish + send" on the draft, then marks the quote sent (`PUT /api/quotes/:id {status:"sent"}`, REQ-572) before it tries Resend on the back. Its assertions are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/quote-card-draft-resend.test.tsx lib/quote-card-sample.test.tsx` → `ok | 8 passed | 0 failed`. On a fresh-KV `PORT=6857 deno task serve`, `BASE_URL=http://localhost:6857 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/open-cards -- --no-check` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed` (REQ-1045 and all four REQ-626 stories). `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 644 passed, 644 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6335 passed`. `deno lint` (QuoteCard.tsx + the test) → `Checked 2 files`. `deno check islands/QuoteCard.tsx` → clean. `deno fmt -` (stdin) → no diff on both touched files.

## REQ-1046 — One quote, one name: the signed email and the /quotes panel never carry the summary's "— <customer>" tail (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-31 + q2-45)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues, cycle 2: **q2-31** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Signed email and subject repeat the customer's name inside the job title" (outbox 005: "Signed: Master bath redo — Maria Gonzalez — countersigned PDF + first invoice · Q-001", while the approval email for the same quote says "approved your quote for Master Bath Redo"); **q2-45** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Same quote titled three ways; customer Details show 'Language —' after English documents were sent".
**Root cause:** the chat model writes a quote's `summary` as "<job> — <customer>" (REQ-576 reads that tail via `customerNameFromSummary` to bind the customer) and a separate Title Case `jobName` that never names the customer. Every other email and the PDF name the job by `jobNameByLang[lang] ?? jobName`. `send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` predates that convention: the subject (`summary: quote.summary ?? fallback`, REQ-204) and the "{biz} and {who} are locked in on {summary}" subhead (`const summary = (quote.summary ?? …)`, which strips only a leading "Quote:") print the raw summary, so the customer's name sits inside the job title and Spanish readers get the English summary. `front-end/islands/QuotesPage.tsx` titles the open panel `quoteJobTitle()` ("Master Bath Redo") and prints `summaryText` (the raw summary, "Master bath redo — Maria Gonzalez") as a line under it (REQ-394), breaking REQ-579 "one job, one name". The "Language —" half of q2-45 is the intended "Not set" state of REQ-715 (an owner call, not a defect) and is not tested here.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/q2-31-job-title-no-customer.test.ts` ("REQ-1046 …": `summaryWithoutCustomerTail` exported from shared/quote-flow/customer-dedupe.ts — "Master bath redo — Maria Gonzalez" → "Master bath redo", en-dash/hyphen tails, "Deck — 2 lines of work" unchanged; send-signed-confirmation names the job by jobNameByLang/jobName, not `quote.summary`; QuotesPage's `summaryText` goes through `summaryWithoutCustomerTail`) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/job-label.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1046 …": EN subject is exactly "Signed: Master Bath Redo — countersigned PDF + first invoice · Q-001" and the subhead is "locked in on <strong>Master Bath Redo<"; ES customer gets jobNameByLang.es "Remodelación del baño" in subject + subhead; with no jobName the summary fallback drops the tail) · e2e `e2e/signed-email-job-name/signed-email-job-name.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1046 …": the quote is seeded through the API — the summary text comes from the model, so a live LLM can't script it — the customer signs via /accept, then the outbox `signedCopy` subject, and the owner's /quotes?open=<id> panel has no line under the title carrying "Maria Gonzalez").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/job-label.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (`Signed: Master bath redo — Maria Gonzalez — countersigned PDF + first invoice · Q-001` vs expected `Signed: Master Bath Redo — …`; ES `"Firmado: Master bath redo — Maria Gonzalez — PDF refrendado + primera factura · Q-001"`); `cd jest && npx jest unit/q2-31-job-title-no-customer.test.ts` → `Tests: 6 failed, 6 total` (`summaryWithoutCustomerTail` `Received: "undefined"`; `usesJobName: false`; `Received string: "const summaryText = q.summaryByLang?.[lang]?.trim() || q.summary;"`); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:47201 shots run e2e/signed-email-job-name -- --no-check` (own `PORT=47201 deno task serve`, fresh KV) → `✗ REQ-1046 (q2-31) … got "Signed: Master bath redo — Maria Gonzalez — countersigned PDF + first invoice · Q-001"` and `✗ REQ-1046 (q2-45) … no line under the title carries the customer's name — expected "[]", got "[\"Master bath redo — Maria Gonzalez\"]"`.
**Fix:** new `summaryWithoutCustomerTail()` in shared/quote-flow/customer-dedupe.ts (next to `customerNameFromSummary`, same tail regex; drops a name-shaped "— <Name>" tail only). send-signed-confirmation derives one job label (`signedJobLabel`: `jobNameByLang[lang] ?? jobName`, else the summary in the reader's language without the tail and without a leading "Quote:", else the fallback copy) for both the subject and the "locked in on …" subhead. The summary fallbacks in send-accepted-alert, send-decision-alert and send-inquiry-alert go through the same stripper. The /quotes open panel's line under the title (`summaryText`) drops the tail and is hidden when it only repeats the title (case-blind). The "Language —" half of q2-45 is an owner call per REQ-715 (language is owner-set; no requirement says a send records it), so it is unchanged here.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/job-label.int.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest unit/q2-31-job-title-no-customer.test.ts` → `Tests: 6 passed, 6 total`; own `PORT=6731 KV_PATH=<fresh> deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:6731 shots run e2e/signed-email-job-name/signed-email-job-name.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1046 (LOOP-007 q2-31) …` and `✓ REQ-1046 (LOOP-007 q2-45) …`. Neighbours: send-signed-confirmation completion-schedule/delivery-truth/deposit-deadline/milestone/phone-format/recurring/sms-guard, send-accepted-alert/int, send-inquiry-alert/int → all `ok … 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit <suites touching the changed files>` → `Test Suites: 645 passed`, `Tests: 1 skipped, 6341 passed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on QuotesPage.tsx, customer-dedupe.ts and the four coordinators → clean.

## REQ-1048 — AMENDMENT of REQ-954: every surface names the deposit's one net-7 deadline (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-32)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-32** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Deposit timing contradicts itself: '30% upfront' vs 'Due a week after signing' vs 'pay now'". The payment step says "30% upfront, rest when done". The quote, email and PDF say "Due a week after signing". After signing, the banner says "Next: pay the $2,520.00 due →" with no date, while the deposit row says "Due Nov 26".
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** three surfaces word the deposit deadline independently, and only one of them reads the invoice. REQ-954 (0ef13e5a) made the deposit invoice's stored due date (signing + `SIGNING_NET_DAYS` = 7, `shared/documents/linked-view.ts`) the one deadline in `computeMilestones` (`front-end/components/doc-parts.tsx`) and in both PDF renderers. Before signing those print "Due a week after signing"; after signing they print "Due {date}". The payment step's "Deposit + balance" option still uses `termsWizard.paymentTerms.depositBalance.sub/subAmounts` (`shared/quote-flow/wizard-terms.ts`, emitted by `localizeOptions` in the backend terms wizard). The same wording is in the AsstChat fallback keys `asstChat.terms.payment.depositBalanceSub/SubAmounts`, in `assistantDemo.wiz.optDepositSub`, and in the 50/50 subs (`…fiftyFifty.sub`, `asstChat.terms.payment.fiftyFiftySub`, `assistantDemo.wiz.optHalfSub`). All of these say "{pct}% upfront" / "por adelantado", which means at signing. The signed banner (`front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx`, `quoteDoc.signedBanner.next`, REQ-311 e82c179d) prints "Next: pay the {amount} due →" with no date, although the `payNow` invoice it links to has its own `dueDate`.
**Requirement:** (a) No payment-step sub-line for the deposit or for 50/50 says "upfront" / "por adelantado", in either language. They name the deposit with the same net-7 timing the documents print. (b) The signed banner's pay link names the linked invoice's due date, the same date the schedule's deposit row shows, in en and es. The net-7 rule itself is unchanged. Billing at signing would be an owner call that reverses REQ-954.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/deposit-timing-wording.test.tsx` ("REQ-1048 (LOOP-007 q2-32) [en|es]: …": the wizard's deposit_bal/50_50 subs and the AsstChat/demo keys contain no "upfront"/"por adelantado", while computeMilestones' pre-sign deposit row reads `quoteDoc.milestone.weekAfterSigning`; a signed QuoteDoc whose invoice is due 2026-11-26 has `quote-signed-banner-pay` naming "Nov 26" / "26 nov", like the schedule) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/deposit-timing.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1048 … [en|es]": TransitionToTerms → HandleWizardAnswer on KV :memory: reach the payment step; the emitted deposit_bal and 50_50 subs do not say "upfront"/"por adelantado") · e2e `e2e/deposit-timing-wording/deposit-timing-wording.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1048 …": a Deposit 30% + balance quote on /q reads "Due a week after signing" before signing; the customer signs; the schedule row and `quote-signed-banner-pay` both name the deposit invoice's due date). The payment-step chat walk is not driven in the browser because the int test covers the same emitter without an LLM.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-32 at 240a6443):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/deposit-timing-wording.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 4 failed` (`deposit_bal.subAmounts = "30% upfront, rest when done · $2,520 / $5,880"`, `50_50.sub = "Half upfront, half when done"`, es `"30% por adelantado, …"`; `the banner's next step names the deposit's due date "Nov 26" … it says: "Next: pay the $2,520.00 due →"`, es `"26 nov" … "Siguiente: paga los $2,520.00 pendientes →"`). `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/deposit-timing.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`deposit_bal: "20% upfront, rest when done · $1,680 / $6,720"`, `50_50: "Half upfront, half when done"`, es the same with "por adelantado"). `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:6913 shots run e2e/deposit-timing-wording -- --no-check` → `expectation failed: the banner's next step names the same deposit due date Nov 26 as the schedule ("DEPOSIT $2,520.00 Due Nov 26"); it says "Next: pay the $2,520.00 due →"`.
**Note for the fix:** the REQ-491 int test (`handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts`, "REQ-491 m60 …") pins the old exact sub `"20% upfront, rest when done · $90 / $360"` and must follow the new wording. `asstChat.depositPick.question` ("How much upfront?") is the same timing word and should be checked too.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (a) `lang/en.json` + `lang/es.json`: the deposit sub-lines (`termsWizard.paymentTerms.depositBalance.sub/subAmounts`, `asstChat.terms.payment.depositBalanceSub/SubAmounts`, `assistantDemo.wiz.optDepositSub`) now read "{pct}% deposit due a week after signing, rest when done" / "{pct}% de anticipo a una semana de firmar, el resto al terminar"; the 50/50 subs (`termsWizard.paymentTerms.fiftyFifty.sub`, `asstChat.terms.payment.fiftyFiftySub`, `assistantDemo.wiz.optHalfSub`) read "Half due a week after signing, half when done" / "Mitad a una semana de firmar, mitad al terminar"; `asstChat.depositPick.question` is "How big a deposit?" / "¿De cuánto es el anticipo?". (b) `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` `payNowTarget` carries the invoice's stored `dueDate`; `front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx`'s signed banner prints the new `quoteDoc.signedBanner.nextDue` "Next: pay the {amount} due {date} →" / "Siguiente: paga los {amount}, vence el {date} →" (date = `shortDate(dueDate, lang, false)`, the schedule row's own format), `quoteDoc.signedBanner.nextDueToday` when the due date is today, and the old undated `quoteDoc.signedBanner.next` only for an invoice with no due date. "Pay now {amount}" stays as the call to action. Net-7 itself is unchanged.
**Older tests that followed the new wording (not weakened, same assertions, new strings):** `backend/src/agents/domain/business/terms-wizard-spec/test.ts` ("REQ-491 m60 localizeOptions …") and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` (REQ-491 sub `"20% deposit due a week after signing, rest when done · $90 / $360"`) pinned the exact old "upfront" copy; `e2e/deposit-pct-picker/deposit-pct-picker.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-678) matched the question by `/how much upfront/i` and now matches `/how big a deposit/i`.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-32):** `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/deposit-timing-wording.test.tsx lib/signed-next-step.test.tsx` → `ok | 10 passed | 0 failed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/deposit-timing.int.test.ts src/agents/domain/business/terms-wizard-spec/test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` → `ok | 70 passed | 0 failed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/deposit-deadline.int.test.ts` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/accept-quote/signed-chat.int.test.ts` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`. `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/deposit-due-schedule.test.tsx lib/invoice-headline-flip.test.ts` → `ok | 6 passed | 0 failed`. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` (whole unit lane, after the lang edits) → `Test Suites: 644 passed, 644 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6335 passed`. `deno lint` + `deno check` on `components/quote-doc.tsx` and `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` → clean. `PORT=6913` serve (fresh KV_PATH) + `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:6913 shots run e2e/deposit-timing-wording e2e/deposit-pct-picker -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1048 (LOOP-007 q2-32) … · 22.4s`, `✓ REQ-678 (demo-loop cycle 5, c3-m60) … · 54s`, rc 0.

## REQ-1047 — A quote's service address is stored tidy, whatever the model returned (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-33)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-33** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 2: "Q-002 service address kept raw lowercase on the customer /q page" ("905 calle del sol san antonio tx 78207"), while Q-001's was formatted ("1418 Oak Hollow Dr, Austin, TX 78745"). Both were typed all lowercase.
**Root cause:** nothing normalizes a quote's service address. `extractServiceAddress` (shared/quote-flow/quick-quote-prefill.ts) needs capital letters in every branch (capitalized street-name words, `calle <Cap> <number>`, an `[A-Z]{2}` state), so it returns null for both lowercase sentences. The coordinator (backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/mod.ts, `serviceAddress = extracted || acceptModelServiceAddress(...)`) then stores the model's value, and `acceptModelServiceAddress` only checks grounding and returns it untouched. The tool schema (`prompts.tools.createQuote.serviceAddress`) says "copied as typed". On Q-001 the model reworded the address anyway; on the Spanish Q-002 it copied it raw. The stored casing therefore depends on the model (origin REQ-263 extraction, REQ-418 grounding guard).
**Requirement:** a quote's stored `serviceAddress` is tidy whichever source supplied it: lowercase words title-cased (Spanish connectors like "del" kept lower inside a name), the 2-letter state upper case, the ZIP kept, ", " before city and state where readable; an already-formatted or mixed-case address is unchanged. Suggested home: a pure `tidyServiceAddress(s)` in shared/customer-address/mod.ts, run on the final serviceAddress in handle-chat-message.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/q2-33-service-address-tidy.test.ts` ("REQ-1047 …": `tidyServiceAddress` on both typed addresses and on formatted ones; the extract → model-fallback → tidy pipeline on the exact typed sentences) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-1047 q2-33 …": the stub model returns the raw lowercase Q-002 / Q-001 address and the stored quote.serviceAddress is tidy; a formatted model address is stored unchanged) · e2e n/a — the browser lane's stub LLM drafts no quote from free text (same as REQ-418); the int test drives the real coordinator.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/q2-33-service-address-tidy.test.ts` → `Tests: 5 failed, 5 total` (`typeof tidyServiceAddress` `Expected: "function" Received: "undefined"`; `Expected pattern: /^905 Calle del Sol,? San Antonio,? TX 78207$/ Received string: "905 calle del sol san antonio tx 78207"`; `Expected: "1418 Oak Hollow Dr, Austin, TX 78745" Received: "1418 oak hollow dr austin tx 78745"`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter "/REQ-1047|REQ-418/"` → `FAILED | 4 passed | 2 failed` (`AssertionError: stored serviceAddress: "905 calle del sol san antonio tx 78207"`; `- 1418 oak hollow dr austin tx 78745 / + 1418 Oak Hollow Dr, Austin, TX 78745`).
**Fix:** `tidyServiceAddress(s)` in shared/customer-address/mod.ts. It is pure. Lower-case words are title-cased. The connectors de/del/of/the/y/in/en/at stay lower inside a name. NE/NW/SE/SW/PO are upper-cased. A 2-letter state (checked with `stateCode`) that comes before the ZIP, or after a final comma, is upper-cased. For an all-lower-case address with no commas, ", " goes before the state, and before the city when a street-type word (Dr/St/…) or a type-first "Avenue F" marks where the street ends. Words already in mixed or upper case, and numbers, are never changed. The coordinator (handle-chat-message, the `serviceAddress` chain) now runs it on the final value, whichever source won: the extractor, the model fallback or the customer's record. The customer-step prefill reads the stored quote.serviceAddress, so it gets the tidy value too. `extractServiceAddress` was left unchanged: the tidy runs after it, so any source is covered.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/q2-33-service-address-tidy.test.ts` → `Tests: 5 passed, 5 total`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter "/REQ-1047|REQ-418/"` → `ok | 6 passed | 0 failed | 88 filtered out`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts src/crm/domain/business/customer-address/test.ts` → `ok | 103 passed | 0 failed`. The full jest unit project (`npx jest --selectProjects unit`) → `Test Suites: 645 passed, 645 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6340 passed`. `deno lint` + `deno check` on both touched files → clean. `deno fmt -` on both → no diff.

## REQ-1049 — The owner's "Ready to send" review card lists a quote's priced lines even when it has job details (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-34)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-34** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Owner 'Ready to send' preview for a multi-line quote shows no line items or amounts". Q-002's preview showed only the job-details description; the customer /q showed three priced lines ($4,200 / $900 / $1,350).
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** `reviewJobDetails()` (`shared/quote-flow/review-job-details.ts`, from 1cb2a685, REQ-237 / M17) returns description-only rows (no `amountCents`) as soon as `descriptionByLang[previewLang] ?? lockedDescription ?? description` has a line, and falls back to the line items with their amounts only when there is no description. AsstChat's review card (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` ~7776 `jobDetailRows = reviewJobDetails(...)`, Job details section ~8451-8496) builds its whole "Job details" from that result and has no other line-item list (the computed `lineItems` feed only the TOTAL, ~8877). A quote whose job details were picked (a description) and which has priced lines therefore hides its lines on the owner preview, while the customer document (`front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx:396`, `localizeLineItems(quote.lineItems)`) and the chat's action card (AsstChat ~10475) show them. REQ-237's "a description still wins" was about chat-drafted quotes with no description; quotes with both were never handled.
**Requirement:** the review card always lists the quote's priced lines, each with its amount (as /q does), in addition to the job-details description; a single-line "I know my price" quote still shows its description, and an empty quote still shows "Add the job details".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/review-job-details.test.ts` ("REQ-1049: a description plus 3 priced lines gives rows carrying all 3 amounts (420000/90000/135000)", "REQ-1049: the description is still shown (its lines come first, without amounts)") · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-1049 q2-34 handle-chat-message integration: a 3-line quote that gets job details, locked, gives the review card its 3 priced lines" — chat create_quote with 3 lines → chat update_job_details writes the description → LockQuote → resolver) · e2e `e2e/review-job-details/review-job-details.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1049 q2-34: a quote with job details AND 3 priced lines — the review card lists the 3 amounts, matching /q").
**Note for the fixer:** the REQ-237 case "a description still wins … in the preview language first" in `jest/unit/review-job-details.test.ts` asserts description-only rows with a priced line present; it encodes the bug and must be updated with the fix.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-34, at 240a6443):** jest `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern unit/review-job-details` → `Tests: 2 failed, 5 passed` (`Expected [420000, 90000, 135000]` / `Received []`; `Expected: 5 Received: 2`); int `deno test -A --unstable-kv --filter REQ-1049 src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`review rows: [{"text":"Pintar el exterior de la casa, dos capas"},{"text":"También incluye la cerca del patio"}]`, expected the 3 priced rows, actual `[]`); e2e `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:5743 shots run e2e/review-job-details -- --no-check` (against `PORT=5743 deno task serve`) → `✗ REQ-1049 … expectation failed: the review card shows the 3 priced lines' amounts (got []; card: "… DETALLES DEL TRABAJO Pintar el exterior de la casa, dos capas También incluye la cerca del patio … TOTAL A PAGAR $6,450.00 …") — expected 3, got 0`; the REQ-237 neighbour stays `✓`.
**Fix:** `reviewJobDetails()` (`shared/quote-flow/review-job-details.ts`) no longer returns early on a description. It returns the description's scope lines first (no amounts), then every non-blank line item with its `amountCents`, the same lines the customer /q renders. A line item whose text only repeats a description line (case-insensitive) is not listed twice; its amount goes onto that description row. A quote with no description still gets its line items alone (REQ-237), and an empty quote still gets `[]` ("Add the job details"). AsstChat's review card needed no change: its Job details section already renders a mixed list (an amount only on rows that have one) once any row has an amount.
**Test amended (why):** the REQ-237 case "a description still wins (the 'I know my price' flow), in the preview language first" in `jest/unit/review-job-details.test.ts` expected description-only rows while a priced line was present, which is the q2-34 bug. Its expectations now append `{ text: "Line", amountCents: 100 }` after the description rows. The precedence it guards (preview language → locked copy → stored description) is still asserted unchanged. Added unit case "REQ-1049: a line that only repeats a description line is not listed twice — its amount lands on that row".
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-34):** jest `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'unit/(review-job-details|job-details-content)'` → `Tests: 34 passed, 34 total` (review-job-details 8/8 incl. the 3 REQ-1049 cases); int `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` → `ok | 92 passed | 0 failed` (incl. "REQ-1049 q2-34 handle-chat-message integration …"); front-end `deno test -A lib/job-details-pencil.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check shared/quote-flow/review-job-details.ts` → clean; e2e `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:5861 shots run e2e/review-job-details -- --no-check` (against `PORT=5861 deno task serve`) → `✓ REQ-1049 q2-34: a quote with job details AND 3 priced lines — the review card lists the 3 amounts, matching /q · 44.6s` and `✓ REQ-237: a chat-drafted quote's review card shows its line item under Job details …`; neighbour `shots run e2e/edit-job-details-lang` → `✓ REQ-400 M5: preview in Español → Edit job details → add an English line …`.

## REQ-1051 — AMENDMENT of REQ-337: a job name keeps every area the job covers; the SMS and /q title match the assistant card (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-35)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-35** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Job name shrinks between the assistant card and the SMS/customer title (fence dropped)". The Q-002 card read "Pintura exterior y reparación de cerca — Jorge Ramirez"; the SMS read "Tu Cotización + Acuerdo para Pintura exterior (Q-002) está lista".
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** the card shows `payload.summary`, while the SMS (`smsJobName`) and /q title read `quote.jobName`. `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` keeps the model's `jobName` only if `isValidJobName` passes, so an over-budget name ("Pintura exterior y reparación de cerca", 38 chars) is dropped whole instead of being fitted to the budget. `QuoteStore.create` then falls back to `summarizeJobName(source, lang)` with its default `maxWords = 3`, not `JOB_NAME_MAX_WORDS = 5`. The Spanish path takes [Pintura, exterior, y] and trims the connector, which leaves "Pintura exterior". `fitJobNameToBudget` cuts by length too ("Pintura exterior y reparación"), so it also loses the second area. Both the gate and the 3-word default came from a51e7c5e (REQ-337).
**Requirement:** every job-name path (the model's over-budget name, QuoteStore's derived fallback, fitting to the budget) gives a name within 5 words / 30 chars that still names each area the job covers. For example, "Pintura exterior y reparación de cerca" becomes something like "Pintura exterior y cerca", never "Pintura exterior". The SMS and /q title then name the fence the card names.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/job-name-two-areas.test.ts` ("REQ-1051 …": the 5-word derivation of the summary and `fitJobNameToBudget` of the 38-char model name are both valid and contain "cerca") · unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/job-name-areas.test.ts` ("REQ-1051 …": QuoteStore.create with that summary, no jobName, es → a valid jobName containing "cerca") · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/job-name-areas.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1051 …": the chat turn's create_quote, (1) with the over-budget model jobName and (2) with none, stores a valid jobName containing "cerca", and the real SendPaperworkSms body contains "cerca") · e2e n/a — the browser lane runs the stub model, which never produces this summary; the int test drives the real coordinator, stores and SMS coordinator.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-35 at 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/job-name-areas.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/job-name-areas.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (`Expected actual: "pintura exterior" to contain: "cerca": the stored jobName "Pintura exterior" dropped the fence`, ×2; QuoteStore `Expected actual: "pintura exterior" to contain: "cerca".`). The SMS sent in the int test reads "Tu Cotización + Acuerdo para Pintura exterior (Q-001) está lista", the same as QA's outbox.
`cd jest && ./node_modules/.bin/jest --watchman=false --ci --selectProjects unit unit/job-name-two-areas.test.ts` (this ran the whole unit lane) → `Test Suites: 1 failed, 644 passed` / `Tests: 2 failed, 1 skipped, 6335 passed`. The only failures are the two REQ-1051 tests: `Expected substring: "cerca"` / `Received string: "pintura exterior y reparación"`, once each.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-35):** `shared/quote-flow/job-name.ts` gains `compactAreas`: a name that lists areas joined by "y"/"e"/"and"/"&"/"+" and is over budget gets each area after the first shortened, last first, to the object it names after "de"/"del"/"of" (articles dropped). So "Pintura exterior y reparación de cerca" (38 chars) becomes "Pintura exterior y cerca" (24 chars). The first area is never shortened because it says what the job is. That keeps REQ-434's "Renovación de cocina y limpieza" → "Renovación de cocina", since "limpieza" has no object to shorten to. `fitJobNameToBudget` tries `compactAreas` before cutting by length. The Spanish `summarizeJobName` path also tries it before its maxWords cut, and may use the full JOB_NAME_MAX_WORDS budget only when that keeps every area. This covers QuoteStore's no-jobName fallback (still the ≤3-word default, so a one-area summary such as "El patio de adoquines de María Nguyen" stays "Patio de adoquines"), the polish fallback and the chat composer. `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` now fits an over-budget model jobName with `fitJobNameToBudget` and no longer drops it. QuoteStore was left unchanged: the shared derivation fixes its fallback, and widening its default to 5 words would have let one-area Spanish summaries pick up the customer's name.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/job-name-areas.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/job-name-areas.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`. `cd jest && ./node_modules/.bin/jest --watchman=false --ci --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'job-name|quick-quote-prefill|title-casing'` → `Test Suites: 6 passed, 6 total` / `Tests: 79 passed, 79 total` (includes job-name-two-areas, job-name, ux-job-name-es, c4-job-name-consistency). Neighbours: `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/polish-job-details/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-sms/` → `ok | 313 passed | 0 failed`. Each generate-job-options test file (int, role-words, slot-lang.int, version-qualifier.int) exits 0. `deno lint` on both touched files is clean, and `deno fmt -` (stdin) leaves both unchanged.

## REQ-1050 — AMENDMENT of REQ-342 (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-36): the signed confirmation's /i and /q links carry the send language
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-36** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "English signed email links to /i and /q without ?lang, so a Spanish browser shows a Spanish invoice for an English job" — the English customer email (005) "Pay the first invoice →" opened "Factura" / "PENDIENTE".
**Root cause:** `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` builds the signed confirmation's customer links bare — `invoiceUrl = ${APP_URL}/i/${invoiceId}` and `agreementUrl = ${APP_URL}/q/${quote.id}` (renderSignedConfirmationHtml, ~:799-800) and the signed text's `url: ${APP_URL}/q/${quote.id}` (~:489) — although the coordinator has already resolved the send language `lang` (REQ-715, ~:174). Every other customer-link builder wraps its URL in `withSendLang(url, lang)` (shared/quote-flow/share-link.ts, REQ-342/REQ-586); the REQ-342 and REQ-586 sweeps missed this coordinator (lines 799/800 predate them: 69b4ed4f7, 1a5208144). /i and /q resolve ?lang → pm_lang cookie → the document's language (shared/quote-flow/public-lang.ts resolvePublicLang; front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx), so with no ?lang a visitor's pm_lang=es cookie beats the English invoice.
**Requirement:** every link in the signed confirmation — the email's "Pay the first invoice" (/i/<id>) and "View the agreement online" (/q/<id>), and the signed text's /q link — carries `?lang=<send language>`, so an English job opens in English in any browser.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/send-lang-links.test.ts` ("REQ-1050 (q2-36, REQ-342) …": for en and es customers, the email's /i and /q hrefs and the text's /q link end in `?lang=<lang>`) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/signed-links-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1050 (LOOP-007 q2-36, REQ-342) …": signed through the real POST /quotes/:id/accept, the outbox's English signed-copy email links to `/i/<invoiceId>?lang=en` and `/q/<quoteId>?lang=en`) · e2e `e2e/signed-email-links-lang/signed-email-links-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1050 q2-36 (REQ-342) …": the English job's signed email links, opened by a browser carrying pm_lang=es, render `<html lang="en">` and "Invoice", not "Factura").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/send-lang-links.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 6 failed` (`every /i link carries ?lang=en: ["http://localhost:5280/i/<id>"]` actual `""` expected `"?lang=en"`; same for /q and es; text `…tu primera factura: http://localhost:5280/q/<id>` missing `?lang=es`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/signed-links-lang.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`emailInvoice: ["/i/<id>"]` expected `["/i/<id>?lang=en"]`, `emailAgreement: ["/q/<id>"]` expected `["/q/<id>?lang=en"]`); `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/signed-email-links-lang -- --no-check` → `expectation failed: 'Pay the first invoice →' of an English job opens the invoice in English … expected "href=/i/<id>?lang=en html=en Invoice=true Factura=false", got "href=/i/<id> html=es Invoice=false Factura=true"`.
**Fix:** `send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` wraps all three links in the house `withSendLang(url, lang)` (shared/quote-flow/share-link.ts) with the send language it already resolves: the email's `invoiceUrl` (/i) and `agreementUrl` (/q), and the signed text's /q `url`. The same sweep closes the remaining bare customer links grep found: `render-invoice-pdf/mod.ts` (the PDF's "pay online" /i line and the signed-agreement /q line, in the PDF's language) and `send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` (the invoice email's pay-ways `payUrl` /i). ## REQ-1054 — A business with no online pay way gets no "pay online" / "Pay now" promise on the signed email and the signed /q (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-37)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-37** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Signed email and /q say 'pay online' but /i says to contact the contractor (no online payment set up)". Email 005 said "First invoice due Nov 26 · pay online" and /q said "Pay now $2,520.00", but /i said "Contacta a tu contratista para coordinar el pago".
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** the signed-confirmation email builds its due line in `invoiceDueLine()` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts`) from the fixed strings `signedConfirm.email.invoiceDue` = "due {date} · pay online" and `invoiceDueToday` = "due today · pay online" (en and es). `SignedHtmlOpts` has no input saying whether the business takes anything online. The suffix has been there since b6ec538e, and REQ-954 kept it. On /q, `payNowTarget()` (`shared/documents/linked-view.ts`) only checks for an accepted status and an open balance, and `quote-doc.tsx` shows "Pay now {amount}" (`data-cy=quote-pay-now`) and "Next: pay the {amount} due →" (`quote-signed-banner-pay`) whenever it gets a target. /i does check: it uses `cardPayWay` plus `acceptedMethods`, and with neither it shows `claim-no-methods`. REQ-630's invoice SMS and email check too (`payWaysSmsLine` returns null and `payWaysEmailHtml` returns "").
**Requirement:** one check, using the same inputs as /i (`payWayNames(projectPayMethods(methods), { card })`, where card means Stripe or Square is connected or a card pay link exists), decides whether the customer can pay online. When they cannot: (a) the signed email's due line names the date with no "· pay online" / "· paga en línea" (new offline keys in en and es); (b) the public quote payload `GET /quotes/:id/public` carries `payOnline: false`, and the signed /q still links the open invoice but its button and banner never say "Pay now" / "pay" / "Pagar ahora". When they can (for example with Venmo), both stay as they are and `payOnline` is `true`.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/pay-online-gate.test.ts` ("REQ-1054 …": no methods → names the date, no "pay online"; cash and check only → no "pay online"; es → no "paga en línea"; Venmo → still "pay online") · unit `front-end/lib/q2-37-pay-online.test.tsx` ("REQ-1054 …": QuoteDoc with `quote.payOnline: false` → no "Pay now" on `quote-pay-now` and no "pay" on `quote-signed-banner-pay`, also in es; `payOnline: true` → "Pay now $2,520.00") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/pay-online-gate.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1054 …": sign over HTTP on an account with no methods → `/invoices/:id/public` acceptedMethods [] and `/card` unavailable, the outbox email has no "pay online", `/quotes/:id/public` has `payOnline === false`; a Venmo account → "pay online" and `payOnline === true`) · e2e `e2e/q2-37-pay-online-gate/q2-37-pay-online-gate.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1054 …": /i shows claim-no-methods, /q has no "Pay now"; after adding Venmo, /i drops the fallback and /q says "Pay now $2,520.00").

## REQ-1055 — After a change order is approved, /co and the receipt say which total they show: the job's and the invoice's (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-39)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-39** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 2: after approving CO-001, /co read "tu total ahora es $11,200.00" while the receipt email read "Your new invoice total: $8,680.00". The two totals differ and neither says which total it means.
**Root cause:** the two surfaces take their total from different sources and label it differently. /co's approved intro (`changeOrderIntro`, shared/quote-flow/change-order-view.ts) uses `co.jobNewAmount ?? co.newAmount`, the JOB total (REQ-398 m25: quote total + approved COs, from `changeOrderJobTotals` in the public controller), and renders `changeOrderPublic.introApproved` = "your total is now {total}" / "tu total ahora es {total}", with no "job". The receipt (`changeOrderDecided` in backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-decision-alert/mod.ts) passes `invoice.amount`, the linked invoice only, as `newTotalCents` to `buildChangeOrderReceipt` (decision-alert/mod.ts), which renders `decisionAlert.coReceipt.newTotal` "Your new invoice total: {total}" (SMS the same), and never the job total. On a deposit + balance job ($8,400 quote, INV-001 $2,520, INV-002 $5,880 → $8,680, CO +$2,800 → job $11,200) the two always differ. REQ-689 (intro) and REQ-948 (receipt) each picked a total without matching the other's wording.
**Requirement:** the /co approved intro names the job total when it shows the job total ("Your job total is now …" / "el total del trabajo ahora es …") and the invoice's total when there is no linked quote; the customer's receipt (email and text) shows the job total, labeled as such, together with the linked invoice's new total, in English and Spanish.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/change-order-total-labels.test.ts` ("REQ-1055 …": the approved intro with `jobNewAmount` reads "job total … $11,200.00" / "total del trabajo … $11,200.00"; without it, names the invoice / factura and not the job) · unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/decision-alert/mod.test.ts` ("REQ-1055 (q2-39) …": `buildChangeOrderReceipt` with `jobTotalCents: 1_120_000`, `newTotalCents: 868_000` renders a labeled job total $11,200.00 and the invoice's $8,680.00 in the email and the text, en + es) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/change-order-receipt-total.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1055 (LOOP-007 q2-39) …": approve CO-001 +$2,800 on an $8,400 30%-deposit job over HTTP; GET /change-orders/:id/public `jobNewAmount` = 1,120,000 and INV-002 = 868,000; the captured receipt email carries "job total … $11,200.00" / "total del trabajo … $11,200.00" and $8,680.00) · e2e `e2e/change-order-receipt-total/change-order-receipt-total.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1055 (LOOP-007 q2-39) …": approve on /co in a browser → the intro's number equals the co-job-total figure and says "job total"; the outbox receipt email shows that same $11,200.00 labeled as the job total next to $8,680.00).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/change-order-total-labels.test.ts` → `Tests: 4 failed, 4 total` (`Expected pattern: /job total[^$]*\$11,200\.00/i — Received string: "You approved this change on Nov 18, 2026 — your total is now $11,200.00."`; es `"…; tu total ahora es $11,200.00."`; no-quote variant `Expected pattern: /invoice/i`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/decision-alert/mod.test.ts` → `FAILED | 8 passed | 2 failed` (`the email has a labeled job total of $11,200.00: … Your new invoice total: $8,680.00. …`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/change-order-receipt-total.int.test.ts` → both FAILED (`the receipt shows the job total /co heads with ($11,200.00): … Your new invoice total: $8,680.00. …`; `el comprobante nombra el total del trabajo $11,200.00: … El nuevo total de tu factura: $8,680.00. …`); `SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=400000 shots run e2e/change-order-receipt-total -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1055 … expectation failed: the two surfaces name their totals — expected "", got "the /co intro says which total it is — the job total (got "You approved this change on Nov 19, 2026 — your total is now $11,200.00.") | the receipt shows the job total /co shows ($11,200.00) … | the receipt labels $11,200.00 as the job total"`.
**Note for the fix:** REQ-689's `jest/unit/change-order-intro.test.ts`, `e2e/change-order-intro` and REQ-948's receipt test pin the old exact wording ("your total is now", "Your new invoice total: $10,450.00."); update them with the new wording.

The receipt: `SendDecisionAlert.changeOrderDecided` computes the job total with the same `changeOrderJobTotals` helper GET /change-orders/:id/public uses (quote via `co.quoteId ?? invoice.quoteId`, same owner, its COs via `listByQuote`) and passes `jobTotalCents` plus `invoiceLabel` (only for an issued invoice, same rule as `changeOrderRef`) to `buildChangeOrderReceipt`, which then renders "Job total: $11,200.00." + "Invoice INV-002 total: $8,680.00." (es "Total del trabajo: …" + "Total de la factura INV-002: …"), and the text uses new `decisionAlert.coReceipt.smsJob` with both. With no job total the receipt keeps the single "Your new invoice total" line (REQ-948 test unchanged). New keys in en + es: `introApprovedInvoice`, `decisionAlert.coReceipt.jobTotal|invoiceTotal|invoiceNoun|smsJob`, before the trailing comms.a2p.* keys. Superseded REQ-689 wording updated in `jest/unit/change-order-intro.test.ts` (job: "your job total is now $20,050.00", no-quote: "your invoice total is now $10,450.00") and `e2e/change-order-intro` (regex "your job total is now \$20,050") — same assertions, new words only.

## REQ-1056 — LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-41: a reply that says which button to tap quotes the label that is on the owner's screen
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-41** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 2: the assistant (Spanish) tells the owner to tap "Publicar revisión", but the button under the reply reads "Open Q-002 → Publish revision".
**Root cause:** the reply text and the pill under it get their language from different places. `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` sets `replyLang = messageLang(content) ?? uiLang ?? contractor.language` (REQ-438: answer in the language the owner typed). `revise-quote/mod.ts` (issued quote → `chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.publishHint`) and the change-order coordinator (`chatCoordinator.changeOrder.pendingRevision` / `pendingRevisionRepriced`) render in `replyLang`, and the en/es strings hard-code their own language's label ("Publicar revisión"). The pill (`AsstChat.tsx`, `tFor(lang, "asstChat.openQuotePublish")`) and the /quotes button (`quotes.ledger.publish`, "Publish revision and notify customer") use the UI language. With an English UI and a Spanish message, the sentence names a label that is nowhere on screen. The hint came in with ce9a7adf (REQ-315), before REQ-438 split the reply language from the UI language.
**Requirement:** whatever language the sentence is in, the button label it quotes is one the owner can see: the UI-language `quotes.ledger.publish` (passed into the strings as `{button}`), or the pill's label.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-revise-issued.test.ts` ("REQ-1056 q2-41 …": en/es `publishHint`, `pendingRevision`, `pendingRevisionRepriced` take `{button}` and do not hard-code the label) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/publish-label-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1056 q2-41 …": English UI, Spanish revise_quote on sent Q-002 and a Spanish change order on the same unsigned quote → the reply is Spanish, contains the en `quotes.ledger.publish`, and does not contain "Publicar revisión") · e2e `e2e/chat-publish-label-lang/chat-publish-label-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1056 q2-41 …": English UI, Spanish change order typed into the chat → one evaluate reads the bubble and the `msg-quote-link` pill; the quoted label must be in the pill or the /quotes `quote-publish` button).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern quote-revise-issued` → `Tests: 6 failed, 14 passed, 20 total` (`Expected substring: "{button}"`, `Received string: "Queda como Versión {version} de {job} — abre la cotización y toca \"Publicar revisión\" …"`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/publish-label-lang.int.test.ts` → `0 passed | 2 failed` (`the Spanish reply quotes "Publicar revisión", a label nowhere on the English screen (pill: "Open Q-002 → Publish revision", /quotes button: "Publish revision and notify customer")`); `shots run e2e/chat-publish-label-lang -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1056 … expectation failed: the Spanish reply quotes "Publicar revisión" under the English pill "Open Q-001 → Publish revision"`.
**Fix:** the three strings take a `{button}` variable (en/es `chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.publishHint`, `chatCoordinator.changeOrder.pendingRevision`, `pendingRevisionRepriced`). `ReviseQuoteInput` and `ChatChangeOrderInput` gain an optional `screenLang` (defaults to `lang`), and both coordinators fill `{button}` with `t(screenLang, "quotes.ledger.publish")`, the label the /quotes button really carries. `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` computes `screenLang = input.uiLang ?? contractor.language` next to `replyLang` and passes it to every `reviseQuote.run` / `changeOrder.run` call, including the ones inside `applyEditCalls`. The sentence stays in the language the owner typed (REQ-438); the button it names now reads exactly as it does on screen. The pill keeps the UI language (the "alternative" in the RCA), so the pill, the /quotes button and the quoted label all share one language. The `quotesPage.edit.*` strings, which are rendered on /quotes in the UI language, are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern quote-revise-issued` → `Tests: 20 passed, 20 total`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/publish-label-lang.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/chat-publish-label-lang -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1056 q2-41: English UI, a Spanish change order on a sent quote … · 63.3s`, `tests finished rc 0`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv` on revise-quote/, apply-chat-change-order/, handle-chat-message/{int,co-correction,co-correction-flipped,named-quote-change,change-order-edit,misroute,price-undershoot,billing-actions,publish-label-lang}.int.test.ts and chat-controller/{change-order,co-correction}.e2e.test.ts → `ok | 170 passed | 0 failed`; full jest unit project → `Test Suites: 644 passed, 644 total`, `Tests: 1 skipped, 6341 passed`; `deno lint` on the 3 touched backend modules is clean, and `deno fmt -` (stdin) leaves them unchanged.

## REQ-1053 — A declined quote's /quotes panel offers nothing to invoice (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-43)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-43** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: a declined quote (Q-002) still shows "Remaining to invoice $6,450.00" and a "Create next invoice" button.
**Root cause:** `ledgerSummary()` in `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` treats every status but "draft" as issued (`const issued = l.quote.status !== "draft";`, from a179ea54, REQ-686, which only hid the ledger on unsent drafts). A customer decline (`POST /api/quotes/:id/decline`, public-controller) stores `status: "lost"` + `lostAt`, so the declined quote keeps the `remaining` row (`remainingToInvoiceCents` = max(0, agreement − invoiced) = the full total) and `canCreateNextInvoice: true`; `front-end/islands/QuotesPage.tsx` then renders the live `<a data-cy="quote-create-next-invoice" href="/invoices?new=1&quoteId=…">`. The invoice form's `CLOSED_QUOTE` (shared/documents/invoice-form.ts) and `quote-lock.ts` already treat "lost" as closed — the app contradicts itself.
**Requirement:** a quote that is declined or void (status lost / declined / void / canceled / cancelled, or a `lostAt` stamp) shows no "Remaining to invoice" row and no live "Create next invoice"; the disabled reason is `quotes.ledger.declinedNoInvoice` ("Declined — nothing to invoice" / "Rechazada — nada que facturar"), not "fully invoiced". An open (sent) quote keeps both. Extends REQ-686.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-panel-declined-ledger.test.ts` ("REQ-1053 …": each closed status and a lostAt stamp → no `remaining` row, `canCreateNextInvoice` false; the reason key is `quotes.ledger.declinedNoInvoice`; a sent quote keeps the row) · int n/a — the decline endpoint already stores status "lost" correctly (the e2e asserts it too); the fault is the pure ledger projection · e2e `e2e/quote-panel-declined/quote-panel-declined.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1053 …": send a $6,450 quote, decline it through the public POST /api/quotes/:id/decline, open /quotes?open=<id> → no `ledger-remaining` row, no "Remaining to invoice" text, no `a[data-cy=quote-create-next-invoice]`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/quote-panel-declined-ledger.test.ts` → `Tests: 7 failed, 1 passed, 8 total` (`Expected value: not "remaining"` / `Received array: ["quoted", "invoiced", "paid", "invoicedUnpaid", "remaining"]`; `Expected: "quotes.ledger.declinedNoInvoice"` / `Received: "quotes.ledger.fullyInvoiced"`); `shots run e2e/quote-panel-declined -- --no-check` → `expectation failed: no 'Remaining to invoice' row on a declined quote (got "Remaining to invoice\n$6,450.00")`.
**Fix:** `shared/documents/ledger.ts` exports one `CLOSED_QUOTE_STATUSES` set (lost / declined / void / canceled / cancelled) + `isClosedQuote({status, lostAt})`, and `buildQuoteLedger` now carries the quote's `lostAt`. `ledgerSummary()` (`shared/documents/linked-view.ts`) computes `closed = isClosedQuote(l.quote)`: no `remaining` row, `canCreateNextInvoice` false, and `fullyInvoicedKey: "quotes.ledger.declinedNoInvoice"` — so QuotesPage's existing disabled-button branch renders the disabled "Create next invoice" with "Declined — nothing to invoice." / "Rechazada — nada que facturar." (new keys in lang/en.json + lang/es.json). The invoice form's prior-billing list (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`) drops its private `CLOSED_QUOTE` copy for the shared set, so the two can't drift apart. Tests unchanged.

## REQ-1057 — LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-44: the known-customer card confirms the customer the lock prompt just named, never asks "Who is this for?"
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-44** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Assistant confirms the customer, then immediately asks 'Who is this for?'" — on /assistant (Q-003) the lock prompt read "Quote locked! This one's for Maria Gonzalez — let's set the terms." and the next thing on screen was "Who is this for?" above "Use Maria Gonzalez / Change".
**Root cause:** with a bound customer, `lock-quote/mod.ts` (~150-166, REQ-331) writes `lockQuote.cta.lockedPromptKnown` naming the customer, and `transition-to-terms/mod.ts` (~170-174) posts the first wizard step as `termsWizard.customer.questionKnown`. The island throws that text away for the customer step (`AsstChat.tsx` ~9717, `isCustomerStep` hides `m.content`), and `CustomerStepPanel`'s known-customer branch (`if (known && !changed)`, ~11836-11843, added by 715e7877 REQ-331) prints the fixed heading `asstChat.customerStep.whoFor` = "Who is this for?" / "¿Para quién es esto?", the same open question the unknown-customer pick list asks. So the confirmation is followed by the open question, against REQ-331's "never re-asks a customer … already told".
**Requirement:** when the customer step opens on the known-customer card ("Use <name> / Change"), its heading confirms that customer (names them, e.g. "Send this to {name}?" / "¿Se lo enviamos a {name}?") or there is no heading; it never reads "Who is this for?" / "¿Para quién es esto?". The unknown-customer pick list (and the views reached through Change) keeps "Who is this for?".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/customer-step-known-heading.test.ts` ("REQ-1057 …": the known branch does not use `asstChat.customerStep.whoFor`; its heading key, resolved in en/es with name "Maria Gonzalez", names her and is not the open question; the default view still uses `whoFor`) · int n/a — the backend already emits the confirming lock prompt and `termsWizard.customer.questionKnown` (REQ-331 int test); the fault is the island's heading only · e2e `e2e/customer-step-known-heading/customer-step-known-heading.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1057 q2-44 (en|es) …": saved customer Maria Gonzalez, draft "Regrout" $400 bound to her, locked; the CTA reads "This one's for Maria Gonzalez" / "Es para Maria Gonzalez"; after Continue no `h3.wiz__step-q` asks "Who is this for?" / "¿Para quién es esto?", and the known card's heading names her or is absent).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, at 240a6443):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/customer-step-known-heading.test.ts` → `Tests: 2 failed, 1 passed, 3 total` (`expect(knownBranch()).not.toContain("asstChat.customerStep.whoFor")` fails; `"key": "asstChat.customerStep.whoFor", "lang": "en", "shown": "Who is this for?"`); `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> shots run e2e/customer-step-known-heading -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1057 q2-44 (en) … expectation failed: no step heading asks the open question once Maria Gonzalez is known (got headings ["Who is this for?"])` and `✗ REQ-1057 q2-44 (es) … (got headings ["¿Para quién es esto?"])` — the lock-prompt assertion before it passed in both languages.
**Fix (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` `CustomerStepPanel`'s known-customer branch (`if (known && !changed)`) now heads the card with the new key `asstChat.customerStep.confirmKnown` = "Send this to {name}?" / "¿Se lo enviamos a {name}?", fed `{ name: k.name }`, instead of `asstChat.customerStep.whoFor`. `whoFor` stays on the unknown-customer pick list and the create views reached through Change. The keys were added to `lang/en.json` and `lang/es.json` beside `asstChat.customerStep.change` (well before the trailing `comms.a2p.*` keys; en/es key sets are identical and the last key is unchanged). No backend change: the lock prompt and `termsWizard.customer.questionKnown` were already right. The tests were not changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, cycle 2):** `cd jest && npx jest --ci --selectProjects=unit --runTestsByPath unit/customer-step-known-heading.test.ts unit/customer-step-kind.test.ts unit/customer-step.test.ts unit/step-composer.test.ts unit/wizard-steps.test.ts unit/price-pick-line.test.ts` → `Tests: 48 passed, 48 total` (6 suites PASS) · REQ-920 lang-order neighbours `unit/settings-systems-tab.test.ts unit/house-line-panel.test.ts unit/systems-house-line.test.ts` → `Tests: 11 passed, 11 total` · `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=400000 shots run e2e/customer-step-known-heading -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1057 q2-44 (en) … · 131.3s` and `✓ REQ-1057 q2-44 (es) … · 126.1s`, exit 0 · `cd front-end && deno lint islands/AsstChat.tsx` → `Checked 1 file`; `deno check islands/AsstChat.tsx` → clean; `deno fmt --check - < islands/AsstChat.tsx` → exit 0.

## REQ-1060 — AMENDMENT of REQ-267: a revision reply never says a typed deposit "isn't set in chat" when the payment step already picked it up (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-46)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-46** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Assistant says the deposit isn't set in chat, but the payment step already picked it up" — the reply to message #1 ("… 30% deposit") said "The deposit isn't set in chat — you'll pick it in the payment step", while the payment step showed "From your message: Deposit 30% + balance".
**Root cause:** `describeQuoteRevision` (backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/mod.ts) appends `chatCoordinator.revision.depositLater` ("The deposit isn't set in chat …" / "El anticipo no se fija en el chat …", lang/en.json + es.json) whenever the user's text matches `DEPOSIT_RE`, with no look at whether the deposit was read. That line is from REQ-267 (15e4d9d6, 2026-11-11), written when create_quote "carries no deposit field" (its header comment still says so). REQ-258 added `create_quote.paymentTerms`, which handle-chat-message saves to `conv.termsPrefill.payment_terms`, and REQ-936 (7680d25d) made `extractPaymentTerms`/`wizardPrefillFor` (shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts) offer the typed "30% deposit" as the payment step's "From your message" row. The reply was never updated, so on the bound-draft revision path (handle-chat-message → describeQuoteRevision with `input.content`) one message produces both claims.
**Requirement:** when the revision message states a readable deposit (extractPaymentTerms finds one, or the model's paymentTerms is saved), the reply confirms it and names the figure ("30%"), EN and ES, and never says "isn't set in chat" / "no se fija en el chat". A deposit word with no readable amount still points at the payment step ("payment step" / "paso de pago") without claiming the deposit "isn't set".
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/test.ts` ("REQ-1060 q2-46 …": QA's exact message → confirms 30%, no "isn't set in chat" (EN); "anticipo del 30%" → 30%, no "no se fija en el chat" (ES); a bare deposit word → payment step, no "isn't set"/"no se fija") · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-1060 q2-46 handle-chat-message integration: …": bound draft, no-prose create_quote with paymentTerms "deposit_bal", "… 30% deposit" → termsPrefill.payment_terms stored AND the reply names 30% without "isn't set in chat") · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/edit-replies.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1060 q2-46 e2e: …": the booted app over HTTP, POST /agents/chat on a bound draft) · browser story n/a — the reply is built server-side from a scripted model turn the browser lane cannot script; the payment step's "From your message: Deposit 30% + balance" row is already covered by REQ-936's `e2e/deposit-prefill-from-message`.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 2, branch fix/q2-q2-46 off origin/qa-loop 240a6443):** `cd backend && deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/test.ts` → `FAILED | 12 passed | 3 failed` (`AssertionError: the payment step already holds the typed deposit; reply: Nothing on the quote changed — … The deposit isn't set in chat — you'll pick it in the payment step after you lock the quote in.`; ES `… El anticipo no se fija en el chat — …`); `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter "/REQ-1060|REQ-267|REQ-258/"` → `FAILED | 6 passed | 1 failed` (`the reply contradicts the payment step's prefill: Nothing on the quote changed — its lines and total are the same. The deposit isn't set in chat — …`; the termsPrefill assertion before it passed); `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/edit-replies.e2e.test.ts` → `FAILED | 3 passed | 1 failed` (same reply).
**Fix:** `describeQuoteRevision` no longer appends a fixed "isn't set in chat" line. A new `depositNote(lang, userText, saved)` (quote-revision-reply/mod.ts) reads the deposit the same way the payment step does — `extractPaymentTerms(userText)` (shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts, REQ-936), falling back to the model's `create_quote.paymentTerms` that handle-chat-message saves to `termsPrefill` (REQ-258; passed as `opts.paymentTerms`) — and says: a readable figure ("30% deposit", "$2,000 down", "half upfront" → 50%) → `chatCoordinator.revision.depositNoted` ("Noted the 30% deposit — it's pre-selected in the payment step after you lock the quote in." / "Anoté el anticipo del 30% — ya viene seleccionado en el paso de pago …"), the figure named via `depositAmountText` (deposit-term.ts, the same text inside the "Deposit 30% + balance" term); a stated schedule (30/30/40, custom splits) → `chatCoordinator.revision.scheduleNoted`; a deposit word with no readable amount → `chatCoordinator.revision.depositLater`, reworded to "You'll pick the deposit amount in the payment step after you lock the quote in." / "El monto del anticipo lo eliges en el paso de pago …" (no "isn't set" / "no se fija"). revise-quote keeps its call: the default reads `input.userText`, the same chat text the front end's payment-step prefill reads. The stale "create_quote carries no deposit field" header comment is corrected. No test was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, branch fix/q2-q2-46):** `cd backend && deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/test.ts` → `ok | 15 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts --filter "/REQ-1060|REQ-267|REQ-258/"` → `ok | 7 passed | 0 failed | 85 filtered out`; `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/edit-replies.e2e.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/` → `ok | 276 passed | 0 failed`; `… src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `… src/agents/domain/business/quote-revision-reply/ src/agents/domain/business/terms-edit/` → `ok | 34 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` (ran the whole unit project, incl. i18n-dictionary-consistency) → `Test Suites: 644 passed, 644 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6335 passed`; `deno check` + `deno lint` on quote-revision-reply/mod.ts and handle-chat-message/mod.ts clean; lang/en.json + es.json valid JSON, keys in sync.

## REQ-1058 — AMENDMENT of REQ-210 (follows REQ-360 / REQ-474): the New work order Quote picker never offers the onboarding sample quote (LOOP-007 cycle 2, q2-47)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q2-47** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 2: "Work order Quote picker lists the onboarding sample quote as real, under a raw hex id" — /work-orders → New work order → Quote offered "No quote" and "#43DE4E2D · Paver Patio Installation", with no Sample tag, while /quotes badges the same quote SAMPLE.
**Root cause (at 240a6443):** `NewWorkOrderModal` in `front-end/islands/WorkOrdersPage.tsx` (~:337) builds the Quote options as `lists.quotes.filter((q) => !customerId || q.customerId === customerId)` — never checking `isSample` — so with no customer picked the onboarding sample (P-15, `isSample: true`) is offered. REQ-256 gives the sample no Q- number, so `label()` (~:343) falls back to `#<first 8 of the id, upper case>`, the raw hex QA saw; the `<option>` (~:443) has no sample marker. The New invoice picker already drops it (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` `!q.isSample`, REQ-474), and REQ-360 swept the same leak out of search / the Drafting track / QuoteCard, but this picker came in earlier (474f09dc, REQ-198..210) and was never updated. The backend doesn't stop it either: POST/PUT `/work-orders` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/work-order-controller/mod.ts`) take any quoteId the account owns, sample included.
**Requirement:** (a) the New work order Quote picker never lists a quote with `isSample: true`, with or without a customer picked; picking a customer still narrows to their quotes. (b) POST and PUT `/work-orders` refuse a `quoteId` that is the account's sample quote with a 400; a real quote still links.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/work-order-quote-picker-sample.test.ts` ("REQ-1058 …": runs the modal's own `const quotes = …` over [sample, real, other] — the sample is dropped with no customer and when it carries the picked customer's id; a customer still narrows the list) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/work-order-controller/sample-quote.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1058 q2-47 …": the sample made by POST /agents/conversations/sample-quote → POST /work-orders with its quoteId → 400, a real quote links; PUT re-link to the sample → 400) · e2e `e2e/work-order-sample-quote/work-order-sample-quote.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1058 (LOOP-007 q2-47) …": a new owner with the sample and one real quote opens New work order; the Quote picker lists the real quote, not the sample, and no option reads `#XXXXXXXX`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-47 at 240a6443):** jest `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/work-order-quote-picker-sample.test.ts` → `Tests: 2 failed` (`Expected value: not "43de4e2d-…" Received array: ["43de4e2d-…", "a1b2c3d4-…", "b1b2c3d4-…"]`; with the picked customer `+ "43de4e2d-…"`), the customer-narrowing control passes · int `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/work-order-controller/sample-quote.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`a work order linked to the sample quote must be refused, got 200 … - 200 + 400`; `re-linking a work order to the sample quote must be refused, got 200 … - 200 + 400`) · e2e `BASE_URL=http://localhost:56147 shots run e2e/work-order-sample-quote/work-order-sample-quote.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` (against `PORT=56147 deno task serve`) → `✗ REQ-1058 … expectation failed: the sample quote is not offered (["No quote","#335B5BEE · Paver Patio Installation","Q-001 · Retaining wall 8289445"])`.
**Fix:** the picker rule moved into a pure shared helper `workOrderQuoteOptions(quotes, customerId)` (`shared/documents/work-order-quotes.ts`: drops `isSample`, narrows by customer — the same rule as the New invoice picker's `!q.isSample`), and `NewWorkOrderModal` (`front-end/islands/WorkOrdersPage.tsx`) builds `const quotes` from it. The backend `WorkOrderController` POST/PUT (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/work-order-controller/mod.ts`) runs `refuseSampleQuote` after `assignWorker`: a `quoteId` that is the account's sample quote → 400 `{ ok:false, reason:"invalid", detail:"quoteId is the onboarding sample quote, not a real quote" }`. Tests unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q2-q2-47):** unit `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --runTestsByPath unit/work-order-quote-picker-sample.test.ts unit/invoice-form.test.ts` → `Test Suites: 2 passed · Tests: 22 passed`; whole unit project `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 645 passed, 645 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6338 passed` · int `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/work-order-controller/` (sample-quote.int + worker-view.int + e2e.test) → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed` · e2e `PORT=56247 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:56247 shots run e2e/work-order-sample-quote/work-order-sample-quote.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1058 (LOOP-007 q2-47): New work order's Quote picker does not offer the onboarding sample, and no option is a raw '#XXXXXXXX' id · 56.3s` · `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the three touched source files.

**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green".
