## REQ-1090 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-17: the customer page's "Billed (lifetime)" count covers the same invoices as its amount
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-17** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Customer KPI 'Billed (lifetime)' amount excludes the scheduled invoice, but the count includes it" — on /customers/<id> Overview, after a deposit + balance agreement was signed, the tile read "$850.10 · Invoices: 2" (INV-002 sent $850.10 + INV-003 scheduled $3,400.40), as if two invoices added up to the billed amount.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the amount and the count use two different rules for "billed". The backend's `workspaceSummary` (`backend/src/analytics/domain/business/customer-workspace/mod.ts`) adds `billedCents` only over `BILLED = {sent, viewed, claimed, pending, paid}`, so a scheduled balance invoice that has not gone out adds $0. `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` works out `issuedCount` on the client with `isIssuedState(i.state) && status !== "void"`, and `isIssuedState` (`front-end/lib/clients-display.ts`) is true for every state but draft and void, so "scheduled" is counted. The tile's `customerWs.kpi.invoices` hint shows `issuedCount` next to `moneyTotal(s.billedCents)`. Introduced by REQ-924 (1c0be6f7, inline `state !== "draft" && status !== "void"`), carried over unchanged by REQ-990 (c1f62d89).
**Requirement:** the "Billed (lifetime)" tile's "Invoices: N" / "Facturas: N" counts exactly the invoices summed into its amount; a scheduled (not yet sent) installment is in neither.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/customer-workspace/test.ts` ("REQ-1090 q3-17 workspaceSummary — …": sent $850.10 + scheduled $3,400.40 + draft + void → `billedCents` 85010 and `billedCount` 1) · int n/a — no store or route rule is wrong; the amount rule is the pure summary and the count is the island · e2e `e2e/customer-billed-count/customer-billed-count.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1090 q3-17 (en|es): …": sign a $2,400 50/50 quote on /q → deposit sent + balance scheduled; /customers/<id> `[data-cy='cws-billed']` read in one evaluate reads "$1,200" · "Invoices: 1" / "Facturas: 1").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-17 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --no-check src/analytics/domain/business/customer-workspace/test.ts --filter REQ-1090` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`- undefined + 1`, "the summary carries the count of the invoices summed into billedCents"); `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:57431 shots run e2e/customer-billed-count -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1090 q3-17 (en) … expected {"billed":"$1,200","hint":"Invoices: 1"}, got {"billed":"$1,200","hint":"Invoices: 2"}`, `✗ REQ-1090 q3-17 (es) … expected {"billed":"$1,200","hint":"Facturas: 1"}, got {"billed":"$1,200","hint":"Facturas: 2"}`. (Run against a separately started `PORT=57431 deno task serve`: under host load the backend took ~75 s to boot, and shots' own serve answered on the frontend first, so every sign-in was `backend_unreachable`.)
**Fix (2026-11-19):** the backend is the one source of the tile's count. (1) `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/customer-workspace/mod.ts` `WorkspaceSummary` gains `billedCount`, incremented in the same `BILLED.has(i.status)` branch that adds to `billedCents`, so the amount and the count cover one set of invoices by construction; it rides `GET` customer workspace through the existing `summary` DTO (`backend/src/analytics/dto/customer-workspace.ts` re-exports the type) and is declared on the client in `front-end/clients/customer-workspace.ts`. (2) `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` renders `customerWs.kpi.invoices` with `s.billedCount` instead of the client-side `issuedCount`. (3) `front-end/lib/clients-display.ts` `isIssuedState` now also excludes `"scheduled"`, matching shared `isInvoiceIssued` (REQ-481: a scheduled installment has not gone out) — so a customer whose only invoice is a scheduled installment reads "Nothing billed yet", not "Settled", on the customer page (`zeroBalanceKey(issuedCount > 0)`) and on the board (`hasBilled`) alike. Test change, not a weakening: the REQ-924 "a new customer: everything zero" unit test asserts the whole summary object, so it now lists the new `billedCount: 0`.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && NO_COLOR=1 deno test -A --no-check src/analytics/domain/business/customer-workspace/test.ts --filter REQ-1090` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/domain/business/customer-workspace/test.ts src/analytics/entrypoints/clients-controller/workspace.int.test.ts src/analytics/domain/coordinators` → `ok | 135 passed | 0 failed`; `PORT=57431 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:57431 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/customer-billed-count -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1090 q3-17 (en) … Invoices: 1`, `✓ REQ-1090 q3-17 (es) … Facturas: 1` (2 pass · 0 fail); neighbour `shots run e2e/customer-money-cents` → `✓ REQ-1072 q2-61` (1 pass); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit <18 customer/clients-display suites>` (ran the whole unit lane) → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed`; `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/zero-balance-label.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the touched front-end files clean; `deno check` on the backend module + DTO clean.

## REQ-1084 — One revision of a sent quote can add a line and remove another (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-18; amends REQ-315 / REQ-375 / REQ-444)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-18** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Revising a sent quote (add one line + remove another) fails with 'I changed nothing'". On the sent Q-002 ("Pintura interior (3 cuartos y sala, paredes y techos)" $2,300 + "Reparación de drywall en la cocina" $380), ES "Jose quiere agregar pintar el pasillo por $450 y quitar el drywall. hazme una nueva versión" → "No encontré una partida llamada "Pintura interior (pasillo)" en Q-002 …, así que no cambié nada."; EN "add a new line: hallway painting $450. and remove the drywall line. make it version 2" → "I couldn't find a line called "Pintura interior (pasillo)" on Q-002 …, so I changed nothing."
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the `revise_quote` tool cannot add a line (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/mod.ts` schema: only `lines[{match,description,amountCents}]`, `remove[]`, `newTotalDollars`; `prompts.tools.reviseQuote.description` says it changes lines "ALREADY on" the quote), and `ReviseQuote` refuses the whole revision when any named line is missing. Asked for ONE new Version that adds + removes, the model sends a single `revise_quote` with the new hallway line in `lines[]` (`match: "Pintura interior (pasillo)", amountCents: 45000`) and drywall in `remove[]`. `findLine` (`quote-line-revision/mod.ts`) misses it on exact / contains / every-word, `reviseLineItems` is all-or-nothing and returns the base lines (the valid drywall removal is dropped too), and `ReviseQuote.run` (`revise-quote/mod.ts` ~349-364) answers `chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.noSuchLine` with outcome `no_such_line`. Nothing turns an unmatched, priced `lines[]` entry in an "add / agregar / new line" message into an addition, and there is no `add` path through `handle-chat-message` (~3463) either. Dates from REQ-315 (ce9a7adf).
**Requirement:** one revision of a sent, unsigned quote can add new lines, remove lines and reprice lines together, saved as the next Version (REQ-375, REQ-444). `revise_quote` takes `add: [{description, amountCents}]`; and a model that still puts the new line in `lines[]` (an unmatched entry that carries a price, in a message that says add / agregar / añade / new line / nueva partida, matching no existing line) gets an addition, never "I changed nothing". On the tester's Q-002 the pending Version 2 is $2,300 + $450 = $2,750 with no drywall line (ES and EN).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts` ("REQ-1084 q3-18 reviseLineItems: add 'Pintura del pasillo' $450 + remove drywall on Q-002 → … $2,750") and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/test.ts` ("REQ-1084 q3-18 TOOL_DEFS: revise_quote has an `add` array …", "REQ-1084 q3-18 parseToolCall: revise_quote keeps `add` lines …") · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/add-line.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1084 q3-18 ReviseQuote (ES|EN, the tester's payload) …", "REQ-1084 q3-18 ReviseQuote (the `add` field) …": issued Q-002, outcome pending_revision, nextVersion 2, pending lines = painting $2,300 + hallway $450, total 275000, no drywall) · e2e (booted app over HTTP, the real POST /agents/chat route with the model scripted to the tester's tool call) `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/add-line-revision.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1084 q3-18 e2e (ES|EN|add field) …": reply never "changed nothing / no cambié nada" and includes 2,750; GET /quotes/:id pendingRevision $2,750, two lines, no drywall; live total still $2,680) · browser e2e n/a — the served app's stub LLM only echoes "(stub) …" and cannot be scripted from a shots story, so the model's revise_quote call (the trigger) can only be driven in-process; the add + remove outcome is a server reply + stored pendingRevision, both asserted over HTTP above.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-18 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/test.ts --filter REQ-1084` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (TOOL_DEFS `add` type `- undefined + "array"`; parse drops `add`: `+ add: [{ amountCents: 45000, description: "Pintura del pasillo" }]`; reviseLineItems returns only the painting line, `+ ["Pintura del pasillo", 45000, 1]` missing); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/add-line.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (ES `the reply refuses the add + remove: No encontré una partida llamada "Pintura interior (pasillo)" en Q-002 Pintura interior y drywall, así que no cambié nada.`; EN `… I couldn't find a line called "Pintura interior (pasillo)" on Q-002 Pintura interior y drywall, so I changed nothing.`; add field `two lines: [{"description":"Pintura interior (3 cuartos y sala, paredes y techos)",…}] - 1 + 2`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/add-line-revision.e2e.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (same ES/EN refusals through /agents/chat; add field: one line left).
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-18):** `revise_quote` takes `add: [{description, amountCents}]` (schema + parse in `openai-tools/mod.ts`, payload type in `llm/base/mod.ts`, new `prompts.tools.reviseQuote.add|addDescription|addAmountCents` in en + es; `prompts.tools.reviseQuote.description|lines` and `prompts.termsPriceChange.issued|open` now say a new line in the same Version goes in `add`, never in `lines`). `reviseLineItems(base, changes, remove, add = [])` appends each added line (qty 1, unit "ea") after the reprices and removals; `settleToTotal` passes `add` through. `ReviseQuote.run` takes `add` and, as the safety net for a model that still puts the new line in `lines[]`, `splitAdditions` (`quote-line-revision/mod.ts`) turns an entry into an added line only when it names no line on the quote (`findLine` < 0), carries a price the user typed, and the words ask to add (`saysAddLine`: add / agregar / añade / new line / nueva partida …) — a misspelled reprice with no add verb still gets `no_such_line`. `handle-chat-message` passes `p.add` on both revise_quote paths; its two change_order→reprice paths pass `repriceOnly: true` so a change order is never turned into an added line. Extra unit test: "REQ-1084 q3-18 splitAdditions: …" (`quote-line-revision/test.ts`). No test assertion was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-18):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts --filter REQ-1084` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/test.ts --filter REQ-1084` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/add-line.int.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/add-line-revision.e2e.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/business/{quote-line-revision,openai-tools,llm-prompts,llm}/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/{revise-quote,handle-chat-message}/ src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/` → `ok | 442 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` (lang + prompt suites incl. reopen-quote-button, a2p-panel) → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the touched backend files clean.

## REQ-1095 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-19 + q3-20: a revision never folds a removed line's price into another line, a turn's revise + change order make one Version with one publish tip, and Version 2's title drops a removed line
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues, cycle 3: **q3-19** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Version 2 folds the removed drywall $380 into the painting line, overcharging $380" — "add hallway painting $450 to Q-002" turned Pintura interior $2,300 → $2,680 and the total $3,130 (expected $2,750); the reply said the drywall was "removed" while the /quotes panel showed a rename "Reparación de drywall en la cocina → Pintura del pasillo ($380.00 → $450.00)", and the reply said "open the quote and tap Publish revision" twice. **q3-20** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "The overcharged Version 2 reaches the customer, still titled for the removed drywall" — email "Cotización Q-002 … — Versión 2 — Pintura interior y drywall", SMS "Tu Cotización + Acuerdo para Pintura interior y drywall (Q-002 · Versión 2)".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** one chat turn ran revise_quote {remove drywall, newTotalDollars 2680 — the quote's CURRENT total echoed by the model} and change_order {Pintura del pasillo $450}. `ReviseQuote.run` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/mod.ts`, REQ-1027's `statedTotal = input.targetTotalCents ?? parseTargetTotalChange(userText)`) trusts the model's target although the owner's words carry no total, so `settleToTotal` (`quote-line-revision/mod.ts`) makes the largest remaining line absorb it: Pintura $2,300 → $2,680. The change order then adds $450 to that pending revision ($3,130), and each tool pushes its own reply with a publish tip (`chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.publishHint` + `chatCoordinator.changeOrder.pendingRevision`). `matchLines` in `shared/documents/versions.ts` pairs leftover lines by position whenever both sides have the same count, so an unrelated removed+added pair reads as a rename. Separately, the pending patch is `{ lineItems, estimatedTotal }` (+ REQ-1024's job-details bullets) and never touches `jobName`/`jobNameByLang`/`summary`/`summaryByLang`, so `publishPendingQuote` publishes the V1 title "Pintura interior y drywall" and every email/SMS reader names the job from it.
**Requirement:** a revise_quote total is applied only when the owner stated it — a model total the owner never typed (above all the current total echoed while lines are removed) is ignored, and no line is repriced to absorb a removed line; revise_quote and change_order on the same issued quote in one turn produce one Version with one publish tip; a removed line and an unrelated added line show as removed + added, never a rename; removing a line drops its name from Version 2's job name and summary in every language (or asks the owner when it can't tell).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-revision-drywall-hallway.test.ts` ("REQ-1095 q3-19 …": versionChanges / pendingRevisionChanges report drywall removed + hallway added, not a rename) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/drywall-folded.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1095 q3-19: … Pintura stays $2,300, Version 2 is $2,300" with targetTotalCents 268000 and "add hallway painting $450 to Q-002"; "REQ-1095 q3-20: … the pending and the published job name / summary (every language) no longer name drywall") and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/drywall-folded.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1095 q3-19: revise_quote(remove drywall, echoed total $2,680) + change_order(hallway $450) in one turn — Version 2 is $2,750 … 'tap Publish revision' once") · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/drywall-folded.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1095 q3-19/q3-20 e2e: …": booted app over HTTP, POST /agents/chat with the scripted model → GET /quotes/:id pendingRevision.estimatedTotal 275000, Pintura 230000, V2 title without drywall, one publish tip). Browser story n/a — browser lanes stub the model, so the HTTP chat-controller lane with a scripted model is the end-to-end path.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-19 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/drywall-folded.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`Pintura interior must stay $2,300 … - 268000 + 230000`; `Version 2's job name still names the removed drywall: "Pintura interior y drywall"`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/drywall-folded.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (reply reproduces the tester's verbatim: "Pintura interior $2,300 → $2,680 … Open the quote and tap … Total $2,680.00 → $3,130.00"; `- 268000 + 230000`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/drywall-folded.e2e.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (same); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern quote-revision-drywall-hallway` → `Tests: 2 failed` (`linesChanged: 1` instead of removed+added; `"Total $2,680.00 → $2,750.00 · Changed: Reparación de drywall en la cocina → Pintura del pasillo ($380.00 → $450.00)"`). The fixer must keep REQ-1024's `jest/unit/quote-revision-line-identity.test.ts` green (a same-count rename of a related line).
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/mod.ts` `ownerStatedTotalCents` — a revision's target total is only one the owner's words carry: the total `parseTargetTotalChange` reads, a typed amount, or the current total moved by a typed amount ("take $500 off"); the model echoing the CURRENT total is ignored unless he typed it. `ReviseQuote.run` uses it in place of `input.targetTotalCents ?? parseTargetTotalChange(...)`, so `settleToTotal` never runs on "add hallway painting $450" and no line absorbs the removed drywall's $380. (2) One publish tip per turn: `HandleChatMessage` tracks the quotes a tool already landed a pending revision on this turn (`publishHintSaidFor`); `ReviseQuote` / `ApplyChatChangeOrder` then say "it's in the same Version N" (`chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.sameVersion`, `chatCoordinator.changeOrder.pendingRevisionSame` / `pendingRevisionRepricedSame`) instead of a second "open the quote and tap …". Both coordinators name the job by its pending title. (3) `shared/documents/versions.ts` `matchLines` — same-count leftover lines pair as a rename only when `relatedLines` (same price, or a ≥4-letter word in common / prefix, e.g. "Reparación de cerca" → "Reparación de cerca (18 pies)"); otherwise removed + added. (4) `quote-line-revision/mod.ts` `retitleAfterRemoval` — removing a line drops the title/summary parts (split on ",", "and", "y", "e", "plus", "&", "+"; the "— customer" tail kept) that name only the removed line, in the base text and every language; a translation the base changed in but that can't be fixed is cleared (stale); a part naming a kept line too, or a title that is only the removed line, is left and the reply asks (`chatCoordinator.reviseQuote.titleCheck`). `ReviseQuote` adds the result to the same pending/draft patch. No test was changed. Gap left: a model `amountCents` on a line the owner never named or priced still passes through `reviseLineItems` unchecked (not this turn's mechanism).
**Tests added with the fix:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/owner-total.test.ts` ("REQ-1095 q3-19: …" ×4) and `backend/src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision/test.ts` ("REQ-1095 q3-20 retitleAfterRemoval: …" ×3).
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && NO_COLOR=1 deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/drywall-folded.int.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/drywall-folded.int.test.ts src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/drywall-folded.e2e.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/quote-revision-drywall-hallway.test.ts unit/quote-revision-line-identity.test.ts` (ran the whole unit lane) → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6533 passed`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/domain/coordinators src/agents/entrypoints src/agents/domain/business/quote-line-revision src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent` → `ok | 836 passed | 0 failed`; wider `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents src/paperwork` → `2162 passed | 2 failed`, the 2 being REQ-937 `publish-language.int.test.ts` (`Cannot read properties of null (reading 'code')` — the OTP lookup under the parallel run), which alone → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the touched files clean; lang/en.json + lang/es.json valid JSON, same 4 new keys at the same position.

## REQ-1096 — AMENDMENT to REQ-942 / REQ-1019: a lone "option 2: … $X" add-on and a "good/better" request are options the customer picks from, never one summed total (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-21)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-21** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: on /assistant the tester typed "…exterior $4,850, fence $1,275.50. option 2: also pressure wash driveway $325. 30% deposit" and the draft card read three lines, "Total $6,450.50", no option choice (expected $6,125.50 / $6,450.50 options or a question); then "…materials around 600 labor 1400. also she asked about the gutters - clean them 175. give her a good/better: good = deck only, better = deck + gutters" and the draft read "Total $3,575.00" with the gutters on the same quote (expected Good $2,000 / Better $2,175). Breaks REQ-942's promise that options the contractor types are never added into one total the customer signs.
**Root cause:** the REQ-942/1019 guard only acts on what `typedAlternatives()` (shared/quote-flow/alternatives.ts) recognises: two or more priced MARKER matches ("option|opción|alternative|choice" + a-d/1-4/one-three), or a CUE ("two options", "options:") followed by priced parts joined by "or". Message 1 has only one marker ("option 2" — option 1 is implied by the lines before it) and no cue; message 2 uses good/better tier words, which are in neither MARKER nor CUE, and its tiers name lines instead of carrying prices. Both return undefined, so handle-chat-message/mod.ts never adds `alternativesNote` ("the customer picks ONE … Never add them together") to the model's context and skips the `firstAlternativeLines` narrowing after create_quote; the model's summed lines are saved as sent. `prompts.systemQuote`'s ALTERNATIVES rule only shows "option A … option B …" / "X or Y", so the model has no other cue. The labor counted twice in the deck draft ($1,400) is a separate mechanism (q3-22).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/req-942-typed-alternatives.test.ts` ("REQ-1096 …": the add-on message reads as 612550/645050; the good/better message reads as Good 200000 / Better 217500; a one-job message and tier words used as plain English stay undefined; `firstAlternativeLines` narrows [exterior $4,850, fence $1,275.50, driveway $325] to $6,125.50 without the driveway, and [deck $2,000, gutter cleaning $175] to $2,000 without the gutters) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/alternatives.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1096 …": stub LLM replays the real model's summed create_quote; no saved quote totals 645050 or holds the driveway line, the model is told the customer picks ONE, and the reply names the option; no saved quote totals 357500 or carries deck + gutters at neither tier's price, and the reply names good/better) · e2e n/a — as REQ-942: the e2e server runs the echo stub LLM, so a browser story cannot script the model's summed create_quote; the int test drives the real coordinator and stores.

**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `shared/quote-flow/alternatives.ts` — `typedAlternatives` falls back to two new readers when the labelled/"N options" readers find fewer than two: `loneSecond()` reads ONE priced "option 2/B/two/dos" after priced lines as option 1 = the amounts typed before it (a single typed "total" wins), option 2 = that plus the add-on when its words say so ("also", "add", "plus", "extra", "+", "también", "agrega…", "más", "adicional"; tagged `extraCents`), else its own price; `tiered()` reads good/better/best (bueno/mejor/el mejor) tiers defined with "=" / ":" / " - " ("in good shape, better to stain it" stays plain English): a tier with its own price keeps it, a tier naming lines is priced from the amounts typed before the tiers — "$X" / labelled amounts plus bare clause-final costs ≥ $50 ("materials around 600", "clean them 175"; never 14x20, "6 boards", a %, or a zip) — where an amount whose own words name a tier word ("the gutters - clean them 175") goes to the tiers naming it and an amount naming none goes to every tier; tiers that can't be told apart (equal prices) stay undefined. `TypedAlternative.extraCents` is what an option adds over the first; `firstAlternativeLines` treats a draft line at exactly that price as the other option's line, so [exterior, fence, driveway $325] keeps $6,125.50 and [deck $2,000, (labor), gutters $175] keeps the deck. (2) `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` `alternativesLine` names an add-on option by what it adds ("Option 2 (+$325)") instead of a summed price the contractor never typed — the int test's "reply never names $6,450.50" holds. With `typedNow` set, the existing REQ-942 path now runs for both messages: the "customer picks ONE … never add them together" note reaches the model, the summed draft is narrowed to the first option, and the reply says the other needs its own quote. (3) `prompts.systemQuote` ALTERNATIVES rule (lang/en.json + lang/es.json, identical) adds both phrasings as examples. No test was changed. Not done: asking "which option should I draft first?" when tiers can't be priced (the detector returns undefined then, as before).

## REQ-1097 — A hedged typed price ("materials around 600 labor 1400") is never billed twice: a draft whose one line already folds the labor is kept, not re-asked into a separate labor line (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-22; amends REQ-1023)
**User's words:** "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". Issue q3-22 [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 3: "Messy deck description charges labor twice (+$1,400)". /assistant Q-003: "…materials around 600 labor 1400. also she asked about the gutters - clean them 175…" was saved as Deck $2,000 + "Labor for deck refinishing" $1,400 + Gutter $175 = $3,575; expected deck $2,000 in total ($2,175 with gutters).
**Root cause:** REQ-1023's guard (b20e1f00) reads typed prices through `labelledAmounts` (shared/quote-flow/money-amounts.ts), whose `LABEL_LINK` allows only ":", "=", "-" or one linking word between a label and a bare number, so "materials around 600" is not read and only "labor 1400" is. `missedTypedPrices` (backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/mod.ts) then cannot see that the $2,000 deck line folds labor + materials (its fold check only subtracts OTHER LABELLED items, and there are none), reports labor $1,400 as missed, and `coverTypedPrices` re-asks "same lines plus a line for it … Do not change the other lines' prices". The model adds a $1,400 labor line next to the $2,000 that already holds it, and that answer passes the guard and is saved.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/hedged-typed-price.test.ts` ("REQ-1097 q3-22 …": `labelledAmounts` reads materials 60000 + labor 140000 from the tester's sentence, 175 unlabelled; `missedTypedPrices([deck 200000, gutters 17500])` → [] for "materials around 600", "materials ~600" and Spanish "materiales unos 600 mano de obra 1400"; `settleCreateQuote` keeps the $2,175 draft with no re-ask) · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/hedged-typed-price.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1097 q3-22 …": stub LLM answers create_quote [200000, 17500] and, only to the REQ-1023 typed-price re-ask, the double-billed lines; the saved quote and card total 217500, no labor line, no typed-price re-ask) · e2e n/a — the trigger is the real model's draft; the browser lane's stub LLM only echoes and cannot script a create_quote, and the int test drives the same coordinator, store and card.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, 0a71387e):** unit 0 passed | 5 failed (`materials 60000 — got [["labor",140000]]`; re-ask "The contractor typed \"labor $1,400\" — it is a billed line …"); int 0 passed | 1 failed (same re-ask; with that assertion removed the saved lines are deck 200000 + gutters 17500 + "Labor for deck refinishing" 140000).
**Fix (amends REQ-1023):** (1) `shared/quote-flow/money-amounts.ts` — `LABEL_LINK` now takes one hedge word between a price label and its number (`LABEL_HEDGE`: around, about, roughly, approx./approximately, like, maybe, est./estimated, "~", unos/unas, como, aprox./aproximadamente, alrededor de; still never "cerca"), so "materials around 600" / "materials ~600" / "materiales unos 600" are read and REQ-1023's fold rule sees 2000 = 1400 + 600. (2) `backend/src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/mod.ts` `missedTypedPrices` — the fold check also accepts a line that holds the labelled item plus any plain number typed elsewhere in the message (`typedNumbers`, alone or with other labelled items), so a price the label reader cannot read still counts as folded instead of triggering a "add a line for it" re-ask that bills it twice. The scan only ever ACCEPTS a fold; it never adds a line. REQ-1023's q2-3 case (mano de obra 4200 materiales 1350, lines [4200, 900]) still reports materiales $1,350 missed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/hedged-typed-price.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/hedged-typed-price.int.test.ts` → ok | 6 passed | 0 failed · neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/business/stated-price/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/ src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/` → ok | 422 passed | 0 failed · `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → 679 suites passed, 6531 tests passed (1 skipped) · `deno check` + `deno lint` on both touched files clean.

## REQ-1098 — AMENDMENT of REQ-1025: one chat turn makes one change order, even when each item is priced (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-23)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-23** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "One chat turn still makes two change orders (two emails, two approvals)". On the Q-001 conversation, "maria wants to add painting the detached garage $1,150 and replacing 3 rotten fence boards $95.50. make a change order and send it to her" made and sent CO-001 ($1,150) and CO-002 ($95.50). The customer got two emails, the owner got two alerts, and the chat linked only CO-002.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `parseChangeOrderRequest` reads that message as `{deltaAmountCents:115000}` with no description, so the code-only path is skipped and the model answers with two `change_order` calls (garage 115000, boards 9550). `HandleChatMessage.applyEditCalls` runs `mergeChangeOrderCalls(edits, userText)` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/mod.ts`). The REQ-1025 fix (df097c6f) added an exception there, `if (deltas.every((d) => typed.includes(Math.abs(d)))) continue;` (`backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/mod.ts`), which keeps calls "each priced as typed" apart. The loop then runs `ApplyChatChangeOrder.run` once per call. Because the message says "send it to her" (`asksToSendChangeOrder`), each run sends its own CO. `payload.changeOrder` is overwritten by the last outcome, so only CO-002 is linked. That exception contradicts REQ-1025 (a): "the change_order calls of one turn on one quote make at most one change order".
**Requirement:** the change_order calls of one turn on one quote make at most one change order, even when each item carries its own typed price. The amount is the sum ($1,245.50), and the description names every item. Calls stay apart only when the owner explicitly asks for separate change orders. QA's message is read in code: both items, delta = sum. When "send it to her" is in the message, the customer gets one email and the payload names that one CO.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts` ("REQ-1098 (REQ-1025 AMENDMENT q3-23) parseChangeOrderRequest: …" and "… mergeChangeOrderCalls: two calls each priced as typed … make ONE call at the sum …"). The fixer must also invert the REQ-1025 q2-7 test "items each priced as typed, a new total, or nothing typed stay apart", whose first assertion pins the old behaviour. · int `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/multi-change-order.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1098 (REQ-1025 AMENDMENT q3-23): … makes and sends ONE change order at $1,245.50 …": the stub model returns the two calls on a signed, invoiced, quote-bound Q-001; the test expects one CO at 124550 naming both items, one alert (SendChangeOrderAlert = customer email+text + owner alert), and payload.changeOrder = that sent CO) · e2e `e2e/chat-change-order-no-autosend/chat-change-order-no-autosend.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1098 (REQ-1025 AMENDMENT q3-23): … one 'Sent CO-00N' and one customer email in the Outbox").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-23 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts --filter REQ-1098` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`delta must be $1,150 + $95.50 (got {"deltaAmountCents":115000})` `- 115000 + 124550`; `one change order, not 2`). `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/multi-change-order.int.test.ts` → `2 passed | 1 failed` (`one change order for $1,150 + $95.50, not 2`, actual `[["CO-001",115000],["CO-002",9550]]`). `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/chat-change-order-no-autosend -- --no-check --filter REQ-1098` → `expectation failed: one 'Sent CO-00N' in the reply (… Sent CO-001 to Maria Lopez by email … Sent CO-002 to Maria Lopez by email …) — expected 1, got 2`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/mod.ts` — `mergeChangeOrderCalls` no longer keeps calls "each priced as typed" apart: when every delta is its own typed amount (a multiset match — one typed $500 never prices two calls) they merge at the SUM, each item keeping its price in the description ("Painting the detached garage ($1,150.00) and replacing 3 rotten fence boards ($95.50)"). They stay apart only when the owner asks for separate change orders (`asksForSeparateChangeOrders`: "two/separate change orders", "separately", "each its own", "por separado", …) or when the target makes no change order (option `keepEachPricedApart` — on a draft / unsigned quote, items are separate LINES, REQ-444). `parseChangeOrderRequest` reads "X $A and Y $B" in code (`parsePricedItems`): both items, delta = the sum, `items` per item, and a named lead-in "maria wants to add" gives the customer. `reconcileChangeOrderDelta` accepts the sum of the typed amounts. (2) `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/apply-chat-change-order/mod.ts` — target resolution extracted to `findTarget`; new `makesChangeOrder` (the target has an open invoice). (3) `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/mod.ts` — the code path emits one change_order call per parsed item; `applyEditCalls` asks `makesChangeOrder` per call and merges them into ONE change order on an invoiced job (one alert, one email, `payload.changeOrder` = that CO), lines on a draft. Backstop: when more than one CO is still made (separate ones asked for), `payload.changeOrders` carries all of them, and `front-end/lib/chat-quote-link.ts` `chatEarlierChangeOrderLinks` + `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` (`data-cy="msg-co-open-earlier"`) link every one, not only the last.
**Test changes (2026-11-19):** the REQ-1025 q2-7 unit test "items each priced as typed … stay apart" is inverted as the test writer required: its first assertion now expects ONE call "Niche ($500.00) and glass door ($1,200.00)" at 170000, and a new assertion pins that "… as two separate change orders" keeps them apart. The e2e story's `expect.eq` on an array and on an object was a test bug: the shots `expect.eq` compares with `!==`, so `[124550]` vs `[124550]` failed with equal values ("expected [124550], got [124550]"); both sides now go through `JSON.stringify` — same assertion, comparable values. New jest unit `jest/unit/chat-change-order-link.test.ts` ("REQ-1098 chatEarlierChangeOrderLinks …") for the backstop.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && deno test -A --no-check src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts --filter REQ-1098` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed | 42 filtered out`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/multi-change-order.int.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/` → `ok | 728 passed | 0 failed` (incl. REQ-444 "two priced items in one message are both added" on a draft) and `src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-quote-cards/unsent-change-order.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed`; e2e (serve on PORT=53917, backend 53918) `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53917 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/chat-change-order-no-autosend -- --no-check` → `3 pass · 0 fail` (REQ-1098 ✓ 1.8s, REQ-652 ✓, REQ-1025 ✓); neighbour stories `chat-change-order-sent quote-change-orders quotes-unsent-change-order change-order-surfaces change-order-page` → 6 pass, 1 fail — REQ-462 M26 dies in its setup on `DELETE /api/invoices/… → 409 must_void` (invoice-controller, untouched by this fix; the story never uses chat); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit -t REQ-1098 chat-change-order-link` → `3 passed`, whole unit lane `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total`; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on the touched backend files and on `front-end/lib/chat-quote-link.ts islands/AsstChat.tsx`.

## REQ-1099 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-24: a change order on an unsent invoice names the job everywhere the customer looks (/co, the approval receipt), never that invoice
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue q3-24 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Change-order messages name different documents for the customer (Q-001) and the owner (INV-002)", LOOP-007 cycle 3.
**Root cause:** after a deposit + balance signing a change order hangs on the SCHEDULED, never-sent balance INV-002. REQ-949 hid INV-002 only in the approval-request email + SMS. (1) /co: `changeOrderIntro` (`shared/quote-flow/change-order-view.ts`) returns `changeOrderPublic.intro` ("…an adjustment to your invoice") for every pending order, and GET /change-orders/:id/public (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts`) always returns `invoice: {number: "INV-002", url: "/i/<id>", status}`, which `front-end/routes/co/[id].tsx` renders as the `co-invoice-link` with no draft/scheduled check. (2) Approving calls `invoices.publishRevision` → `applyRevision` (`shared/documents/versions.ts`) stamps `publishedAt` while the status stays "scheduled"; `isIssued` (`doc-render/mod.ts`) treats any `publishedAt` as issued, so the receipt's `changeOrderRef(co, invoice, coLang)` in `send-decision-alert/mod.ts` (no job passed) reads "CO-001 on INV-002". (3) The owner copies use `changeOrderOwnerRef`, which always names INV-002 (REQ-949 design) — so owner and customer name different documents.
**Requirement:** when a change order's invoice has not reached the customer (draft / scheduled, never sent — a CO-approval revision's `publishedAt` does not count), no customer surface names that invoice or links /i/<it>: the /co intro speaks of the job, /co shows no invoice link, the public projection carries no invoice number/url, and the approval receipt's subject, html and text name the job (Q-001). An issued invoice keeps REQ-204's "CO-001 on INV-002".
**Tests:**
- unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/test.ts` ("REQ-1099 changeOrderRef: a SCHEDULED invoice carrying a CO-approval publishedAt stamp (never sent) is still not named")
- unit `jest/unit/change-order-intro-on-job.test.ts` ("REQ-1099 pending + onJob → an intro with no 'invoice' / 'factura' (en + es)"; REQ-689 pending wording kept)
- int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/co-unsent-invoice.int.test.ts` (Q-001 accepted, INV-001 sent, INV-002 scheduled, CO-001 on INV-002; en + es: GET /change-orders/:id/public has no invoice number/url and no /i/<balance>; approve over HTTP → INV-002 still scheduled, the customer's receipt subject, htmlBody and SMS carry no "INV-002" / no /i/<balance>, subject names Q-001)
- e2e `e2e/co-unsent-invoice/co-unsent-invoice.e2e.test.ts` (/co/<id> for a pending CO on a scheduled balance: [data-cy=co-intro] has no "invoice", no [data-cy=co-invoice-link], the page never names the INV number, still names the Q number)
**Evidence (red, 2026-11-19, at 0a71387e):** unit doc-render `FAILED | 3 passed | 1 failed` — `AssertionError: en: a scheduled, never-sent invoice must not be cited after a CO revision, got "CO-001 on INV-002"`; jest `Tests: 1 failed, 1 passed` — `Expected pattern: not /invoice/i  Received string: "Your contractor proposed an adjustment to your invoice. Review it below and approve to update your total."`; int `FAILED | 0 passed | 4 failed` — `GET /change-orders/:id/public hands the customer a link to INV-002 … {"number":"INV-002","url":"/i/…","status":"scheduled"}` and `customer receipt subject cites INV-002 …: Your approved change for Hans Builder — CO-001 on INV-002` (es: `… — CO-001 en INV-002`); e2e `expectation failed: the intro speaks of an invoice the customer never received (got "Your contractor proposed an adjustment to your invoice. …")`.
**Fix:** one predicate, "has this invoice reached the customer?", everywhere. (1) `isIssued` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts`) no longer counts a bare `publishedAt`: only `sentAt` / `acceptedAt` or an issued status (not draft / scheduled / omitted, REQ-550) — a CO-approval revision stamps `publishedAt` without sending; on a real send `publishedAt` is `sentAt`. (2) `send-decision-alert/mod.ts`: the customer's approval receipt loads the job (`co.quoteId ?? invoice.quoteId`) and names it ("CO-001 on Q-001"), shows no invoice label, and links `/co/<id>` instead of `/i/<unsent invoice>`; the owner's decision alert uses `changeOrderOwnerRef` (REQ-949: the owner always sees INV-002). (3) GET /change-orders/:id/public returns, for an unsent invoice, only `invoice: {id, status}` (the id keeps the logo + live refresh) plus `onJob: true` — no number, no /i/ url. (4) `changeOrderIntro` (`shared/quote-flow/change-order-view.ts`) takes `onJob`: pending → new key `changeOrderPublic.introJob` ("…a change to your job…" / "…un cambio a tu trabajo…"); approved without job totals → the plain line, never "your invoice total". (5) `front-end/routes/co/[id].tsx`: no `co-invoice-link` unless the invoice reached her; the "This invoice, now/before/after/proposed" rows read "Remaining balance, …" (new keys `changeOrderPublic.balance*`, en + es) for an unsent invoice. **Owner/customer split kept (REQ-949):** the owner's copies still say "CO-001 on INV-002" — they can open their own scheduled invoice; the customer's say "CO-001 on Q-001". Both name the same job; the owner just also sees the invoice it hangs on.
**Test correction:** `e2e/change-order-page/change-order-page.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-398) created its invoice with no status (= a draft, REQ-550, never sent) yet expected /co to read "Added to INV-…". That contradicts REQ-949/REQ-1099 (the request email already named Q-001 for that invoice). The story's point is the invoice line under the job headline, so its seed now creates the invoice `status: "sent"`; every assertion is unchanged.
**Evidence (green, 2026-11-19):**

## REQ-1100 — A change-order receipt never points the customer at an unsent (scheduled) balance invoice, and /i of a scheduled invoice is not payable (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-25)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-25** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "CO receipt links to the final balance invoice, payable now, before the work has started" — the 016 approval receipt ("Your approved change for Whitfield Painting & Fences — CO-001 on INV-002", "View your invoice") opened /i of the SCHEDULED balance INV-002, showing "Balance due $5,665.35" and a Zelle pay block while its own schedule said "Balance … On completion".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** three links. (1) `approveChangeOrder` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts` ~642) lands the delta through `invoices.publishRevision`, whose `applyRevision` (`shared/documents/versions.ts` ~238-245) stamps `publishedAt` and version 2 but leaves `status: "scheduled"`; `isIssued` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts:42`) returns true on `publishedAt` before looking at status, while the status-based `isInvoiceIssued` still says false — so `changeOrderRef` and the receipt's `invoiceLabel` name "INV-002". (2) `SendDecisionAlert.changeOrderDecided` (`send-decision-alert/mod.ts` ~228, REQ-948) always sets the receipt URL to `/i/<co.invoiceId>` with the CTA "View your invoice", whatever the invoice's status. (3) `/i/[id].tsx` renders PayByCard + PublicInvoiceClaim for any unpaid, unclaimed invoice, scheduled included, and `getInvoicePublic` serves it to anyone with the link. This breaks REQ-949 ("the customer hears about an invoice only once it has reached them") and REQ-697 (a scheduled invoice is the owner's reminder).
**Requirement:** a draft/scheduled invoice revised by a change-order approval is still not issued; the customer's approval receipt (email + text, en + es) for a change order on such an invoice never links to `/i/<that invoice>`, never names its number or says "your invoice"/"tu factura", and names the job (Q-001); a logged-out customer on /i of a scheduled invoice gets no pay-by-card, no pay buttons and no claim form, and a "not due yet" note (`data-cy=invoice-not-due-yet`) instead.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/test.ts` ("REQ-1100 isIssued: a SCHEDULED balance invoice revised by a change-order approval …", "REQ-1100 changeOrderRef: after the approval revision, the scheduled INV-002 is still not named …" — runs the real `applyRevision`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/scheduled-balance-co-receipt.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1100 (LOOP-007 q3-25): approving CO-001 on the SCHEDULED balance INV-002 → … — en|es": app booted on KV :memory:, Q-001 accepted, INV-001 sent, INV-002 scheduled, CO-001 on INV-002, POST /change-orders/:id/approve, captured receipt email + text) · e2e `e2e/scheduled-invoice-not-payable/scheduled-invoice-not-payable.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1100 (LOOP-007 q3-25): a logged-out customer on /i of a SCHEDULED balance invoice …": Zelle business, a sent invoice as control shows the claim UI, the scheduled one must not).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-25 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/test.ts` → `FAILED | 3 passed | 2 failed` (`a scheduled invoice the customer never received reads as issued: {"status":"scheduled","version":2,…}` `- true + false`; `en: the receipt names the unsent scheduled INV-002, got "CO-001 on INV-002"`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/scheduled-balance-co-receipt.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`the receipt links to the unsent final-balance bill /i/<id>: http://localhost:5280/i/<id>?lang=en` and `…?lang=es`); `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/scheduled-invoice-not-payable -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1100 … expectation failed: a scheduled, unbilled balance must not be payable (… BALANCE DUE … $5,665.35 PAY ONLINE Z Zelle … ALREADY PAID? TELL US HOW …) — expected "", got "the pay buttons (Zelle) are offered | the 'I paid' claim form is offered | no 'not due yet' note (invoice-not-due-yet)"`.
**Fix:** (1) `isIssued` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts`) — `sentAt`/`acceptedAt` still mean issued, but a `"scheduled"` or `"draft"` status now returns false BEFORE `publishedAt` is consulted: the change-order approval's `applyRevision` stamps publishedAt + version 2 on an invoice it never sends, so a revision no longer counts as issuing it (every caller — `changeOrderRef`, the receipt, `customerOnDocument` — agrees with the status-based `isInvoiceIssued`). (2) `SendDecisionAlert.changeOrderDecided` — for an unsent (draft/scheduled) invoice the customer receipt names the job (`changeOrderRef(co, undefined, lang, quote)` → "CO-001 on Q-001", as REQ-949's request did), links to the change order `/co/<id>?lang=…` not `/i/<invoice>`, and is built by the new `invoiceUnsent` branch of `buildChangeOrderReceipt` (job total only, "Nothing is due for this change yet …", CTA "View your change"/"Ver tu cambio", text `coReceipt.smsUnbilled`); the contractor's own alert now uses `changeOrderOwnerRef` so it keeps "CO-001 on INV-002" (REQ-949: the owner sees her scheduled invoices). (3) `/i/[id].tsx` — an external viewer of a `"scheduled"` invoice (not paid, not claimed) gets no PayByCard and no PublicInvoiceClaim; instead a `data-cy=invoice-not-due-yet` note ("Not due yet — {business} hasn't billed this yet …"), a neutral "Not due yet" pill and a "Not billed yet" balance label with no due-date line. The pill override lives in the route only: the shared `invoiceStatusPill` (also the PDF stamp) keeps REQ-729/REQ-558's pinned behaviour, and the customer is still never told "Scheduled" (REQ-558). The owner's preview (`internal`) is unchanged. New keys in en+es before `comms.a2p.*`. No test assertion was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-25):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/scheduled-balance-co-receipt.int.test.ts` → `ok | 7 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/e2e.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/business/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/ src/core` → `ok | 753 passed | 0 failed`; e2e (dev serve on a random port, warmed, then) `SHOTS_DIR=<private> BASE_URL=http://localhost:56417 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/scheduled-invoice-not-payable e2e/public-invoice-state -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1100 … · 60.6s`, `✓ REQ-558 (demo m42) … · 71s` (2 pass · 0 fail); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 679 passed`, `Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed`; `cd front-end && deno lint routes/i/[id].tsx && deno check routes/i/[id].tsx` → clean. Host note: a cold `shots run` self-serve on this loaded host ran the story before the backend finished booting (~114 s) → `backend_unreachable`; serving first and passing `BASE_URL` (and a private `SHOTS_DIR`, since parallel agents share the default evidence dir) is what ran it.

## REQ-1102 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-26: the quote PDF emailed to the customer is stamped as sent, in the send language, never "DRAFT"
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-26** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Quote PDF emailed to the customer is stamped 'DRAFT' (in English even on a Spanish quote)". The outbox files 002-Quote-Q-001.pdf and 006-Cotizacion-Q-002.pdf both read "… DRAFT", while the email and /q say "Q-001 · Version 1 · Sent".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** there are two defects. (1) `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` loads the quote with `publishPendingQuote` while its status is still "draft" (`dto/quote.ts`: "status stays "draft" and sentAt unset until Send") and captures that object as `quotePdfFrom`. It renders the REQ-945 attachment (`quotePdfAttachment` → `RenderQuotePdf.run`, 40250954) from that pre-send quote, and only writes `{status:"sent", sentAt}` after `email.send` succeeds. (2) `render-quote-pdf/mod.ts` draws the stamp as `isAccepted ? localized signed label : (quote.status ?? "DRAFT").toUpperCase()` (1a520814). That is the raw English DB enum, never passed through `t(lang, …)`, so a Spanish PDF says DRAFT/SENT/DECLINED in English.
**Requirement:** the PDF attached to a quote send is the customer's copy as delivered. It is stamped with the localized sent word (`renderQuotePdf.status.sent` in lang/en.json + lang/es.json) and never "DRAFT". Every non-accepted status stamp goes through `renderQuotePdf.status.<status>`, so a Spanish PDF never carries a raw English status ("SENT", "DRAFT", "DECLINED"). A failed send must not mark the quote sent: render the attachment from `{ ...quote, status: "sent", sentAt }` and do not stamp the stored quote early.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/status-stamp.test.ts` ("REQ-1102 (LOOP-007 q3-26) …": sent/es draws `t(es,"renderQuotePdf.status.sent")` with no SENT/DRAFT; sent/en draws the en word and no DRAFT; draft/es draws no raw DRAFT; declined/es draws no raw DECLINED) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts` ("REQ-1102 q3-26 send-paperwork-email: the quote PDF attached to a first en|es send is stamped sent …": a first send of a fresh draft quote, then decode the captured application/pdf attachment and check it has no "DRAFT" and does have the localized sent word) · e2e n/a — the Outbox does not record attachments (REQ-945), so no browser surface shows the PDF.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-26 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/status-stamp.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 4 failed` (`the Spanish sent PDF says raw English SENT: … COTIZACIÓN Y ACUERDO · Q-002 / SENT`; `lang/en.json has no "renderQuotePdf.status.sent"`; `the Spanish draft PDF says raw English DRAFT`; `the Spanish declined PDF says raw English DECLINED`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts --filter REQ-1102` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`the en PDF emailed to the customer is stamped DRAFT`, `the es PDF emailed to the customer is stamped DRAFT`).
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` renders the attachment from `{ ...quote, status: "sent", sentAt }` when the quote has no `sentAt` yet (the same condition that stamps the stored quote), using one `sentAtStamp` for both; the stored quote is still stamped only after `result.ok`, so a failed send is never marked sent. (2) `render-quote-pdf/mod.ts` draws the stamp through `quoteStatusStamp(lang, status)` → `t(lang, "renderQuotePdf.status.<status>")` for draft/sent/viewed/accepted/declined/expired/lost (unknown status draws nothing, never a raw enum); new keys in lang/en.json (DRAFT, SENT, VIEWED, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, EXPIRED, LOST) and lang/es.json (BORRADOR, ENVIADA, VISTA, ACEPTADA, RECHAZADA, VENCIDA, PERDIDA), placed after `renderQuotePdf.heroFallback`.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-26):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/status-stamp.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts --filter REQ-1102` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed | 34 filtered out`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/` → `ok | 126 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv` render-numbers, send-languages-lock, outbox, customer-branding, customer-language int tests + `send-signed-confirmation/` → `ok | 112 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` (incl. i18n-dictionary-consistency) → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed`; `deno check` + `deno lint` on both touched mod.ts → clean.

## REQ-1104 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-27: a signed agreement's relative start ("Next week") names the concrete day it means (amends REQ-575's "reads as the contractor said it"; extends REQ-659)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-27** [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 3: "Signed agreement freezes the relative start date 'Next week'" — after signing, /q Terms reads "Start date: Next week" (ES "FECHA DE INICIO La próxima semana"), and so does /i INV-001; once the document is signed nobody can tell which week "next week" means.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the terms wizard stores the start preset as its English option label, not a date — `termFromPick` (`shared/quote-flow/wizard-terms.ts`) saves `t("en", "termsWizard.startDate.nextWeek")` = "Next week" (the chat's "la próxima semana" lands on the same preset via `quote-facts` → `wizardPrefillFor` optionId next_week, REQ-575). Nothing anchors that value when the quote is sent or signed, and every reader prints it as a literal through `localizeTermValue` (exact map "Next week" → "La próxima semana" in ES, unchanged in EN): the /q agreement (`front-end/components/doc-parts.tsx` `expandTermValue`), the agreement PDF (`render-quote-pdf/mod.ts`), and the /i term grid and invoice PDF, where `invoiceTerms` (REQ-659) keeps a relative start on a bill issued before the day it points to — which includes the deposit invoice raised at signing. The app does know the concrete day: `startFromTerm(value, sentAt)` (`shared/quote-flow/completion-schedule.ts`) resolves it to sent + 7 for invoice scheduling, but no customer surface shows it.
**Requirement:** a relative start term ("Right away", "Next week", "Next month", and their ES forms) is shown on every customer surface of the agreement and its invoices with the concrete day it resolves to, anchored to the day the quote went out (`sentAt ?? createdAt`, the anchor the invoice schedule uses): "Next week" sent 2026-11-19 names Nov 26, 2026 / 26 nov 2026; "Right away" the send day; "Next month" a month after. The contractor's words may stay alongside the date. TBD and a picked date are unchanged.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/relative-start.test.ts` ("REQ-1104 (LOOP-007 q3-27) signed agreement PDF: …" — RenderQuotePdf on a signed quote sent 2026-11-19: "Next week" → "Nov 26, 2026" EN / "26 nov 2026" ES; "Right away" → Nov 19, 2026; "Next month" → Dec 19, 2026 / 19 dic 2026; TBD and an ISO pick unchanged) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/signed-relative-start.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1104 (LOOP-007 q3-27): signed through POST /quotes/:id/accept …" — UsersModule+PaperworkModule over HTTP on KV :memory:, a "Next week" + "Deposit + balance" quote sent today, signed via the real accept; GET /quotes/:id/pdf and GET /invoices/<deposit>/pdf must both name `formatTermDate(startFromTerm("Next week", sentAt))`) · e2e `e2e/signed-relative-start/signed-relative-start.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1104 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-27) en|es: …" — the owner walks the wizard (start_date → next_week, 50/50), sends, the customer signs; the Start date row of `.ctr__terms-grid` on `/q/<id>?lang=…` and on the deposit `/i/<id>?lang=…` must contain sent + 7 as "Nov 26, 2026" / "26 nov 2026"). Front-end jest unit n/a — the jest lane does not render components; the /q and /i rendering is covered by the e2e story.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-27 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/relative-start.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/signed-relative-start.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 4 failed` (PDF text "03 Terms START DATE Next week …" `to contain: "Nov 26, 2026"`; ES "FECHA DE INICIO La próxima semana" `to contain: "26 nov 2026"`; "START DATE Right away" `to contain: "Nov 19, 2026"`; int: `agreement PDF: Start date should name Nov 26, 2026, got "Next week …"` and `deposit invoice PDF: Start date should name Nov 26, 2026, got "Next week …"`); `BASE_URL=<own serve> shots run e2e/signed-relative-start -- --no-check` → `✗ … en: … /q Start date reads "Next week"; /i deposit Start date reads "Next week"`, `✗ … es: … /q Start date reads "La próxima semana"; /i deposit Start date reads "La próxima semana"`. (shots' own serve gave up before the backend listened (~85 s boot) → `backend_unreachable`; the run used a `deno task serve` started on PORT 51327 and BASE_URL.)
**Fix:** new pure helper `shared/quote-flow/start-term.ts` — `relativeStartIso(value, anchorAt)` resolves a RELATIVE start term ("Right away" / "Next week" / "Next month" and their ES words) through the same `startFromTerm` the invoice schedule uses, anchored to `sentAt ?? createdAt`; `anchoredStartTerm(value, anchorAt, localized, lang)` keeps the contractor's (localized) words and adds the day in parentheses, the REQ-771 deadline style: "Next week (Nov 26, 2026)" / "La próxima semana (26 nov 2026)". A picked date, TBD and free text are returned unchanged. Wired into every customer surface of the start row: the agreement PDF (`render-quote-pdf/mod.ts`), the invoice PDF (`render-invoice-pdf/mod.ts`), and the shared `expandTermValue`/`TermGrid` (`front-end/components/doc-parts.tsx`, new `startAnchor` prop) used by /q (`quote-doc.tsx`, `quote.quotedAt ?? createdAt`) and /i (`routes/i/[id].tsx`, `invoice.quotedAt`); the public payloads carry the anchor as `quotedAt` (`public-controller/mod.ts`: `redactQuote` and the quote-linked invoice projection, both `sentAt ?? createdAt`). No data migration — the stored term is unchanged, so REQ-659's stale-start drop on later invoices still applies. The sent-quote email's "Work starts next week" step (send-paperwork-email) is read at send time and is left relative. No new lang keys. No test changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-27):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/relative-start.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/signed-relative-start.int.test.ts` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`; `PORT=51427 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:51427 shots run e2e/signed-relative-start -- --no-check` → `✓ … en: … /q and the deposit /i Terms name the concrete start day`, `✓ … es: …` (2 pass · 0 fail). Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/` → `ok | 47 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/` → `ok | 100 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` (the 53 files referencing the touched modules; ran the full unit project) → `Test Suites: 679 passed, Tests: 6531 passed, 1 skipped`; `cd front-end && deno lint` + `deno check` on doc-parts.tsx, quote-doc.tsx, routes/i/[id].tsx, shared/quote-flow/start-term.ts → clean.

## REQ-1101 — AMENDMENT of REQ-682's scope: the signed-agreement email states the agreement's start instead of promising to "lock in a start day" (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-28)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-28** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Signed email says the owner will reach out to set a start date that the agreement already states" — outbox 'Dana se comunicará contigo para fijar la fecha de inicio.' while the attached agreement's FECHA DE INICIO reads 'La próxima semana'; EN 'Dana will reach out to lock in a start day'.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `renderSignedConfirmationHtml` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` builds its body paragraph from the fixed i18n string `signedConfirm.email.bodyBase`, which always ends "{who} will reach out to lock in a start day." / "{who} se comunicará contigo para fijar la fecha de inicio." It passes only `{invoiceClause}` and `{who}` and never reads `quote.startDate` or the quote's `start_date` term, so every signed email says the start is still to be set even when the agreement it carries states one. The string dates from the original template (b6ec538e, 2026-06-08). REQ-682 (m28) fixed the same contradiction in the quote email (`quoteEmailSteps` step 3 in `send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`) but did not touch the signed confirmation.
**Requirement:** the signed-agreement email's closing sentence follows REQ-682's start rule: an ISO `startDate` (or ISO start term) → "Work starts <date>" / "El trabajo empieza el <date>"; a preset or custom start term ("Next week") → "Work starts <when>" (ideally resolved to a real date against the signing day, q3-27); only no start or TBD keeps "{who} will reach out to lock in a start day." / "… fijar la fecha de inicio." en and es together.
**Tests:** unit n/a — `renderSignedConfirmationHtml` is module-private; the integration test drives it through the real coordinator with a captured EmailService, which is the same pure render · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/start-line.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1101 (q3-28) …": KV :memory:, real `SendSignedConfirmation.run`; start term "Next week" en/es and ISO `startDate` 2026-12-07 en/es → no reach-out sentence and the start stated; no start / "TBD" en/es → reach-out sentence kept) · e2e n/a — the email is server-rendered HTML no browser surface shows; the int test captures the exact HTML the coordinator sends.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-28 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/start-line.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 4 failed` (`the agreement already states the start, yet the email says: " Dana will reach out to lock in a start day."`; `… " Dana se comunicará contigo para fijar la fecha de inicio."`; `the agreement states a start date, yet the email says: " Dana will reach out to lock in a start day."`; `… " Dana se comunicará contigo para fijar la fecha de inicio."`). The no-start/TBD guard passes.
**Fix:** the start rule moved out of `quoteEmailSteps` into the exported `quoteStartWhen(q, lang)` in `send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` (`{date}` for an ISO `startDate`/ISO start term, `{when}` for a preset/custom term — presets lower-cased mid-sentence — `null` for none/TBD); `quoteEmailSteps` step 3 now reads it, and `renderSignedConfirmationHtml` builds its paragraph as `bodyBase` (now ending at `{invoiceClause}.`) + one start sentence: new keys `signedConfirm.email.bodyStartsOn` "Work starts {date}." / "El trabajo empieza el {date}.", `bodyStarts` "Work starts {when}." / "El trabajo empieza {when}.", and `bodyReachOut` "{who} will reach out to lock in a start day." / "{who} se comunicará contigo para fijar la fecha de inicio." only for no start / TBD (en + es together). A preset like "Next week" is stated as the term ("Work starts next week"), not yet resolved to a date against the signing day — that is q3-27's scope.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-28):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/start-line.int.test.ts` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/` → `ok | 168 passed | 0 failed` (incl. REQ-682 `next-steps.test.ts`); `deno check` + `deno lint` on both touched mod.ts → clean; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `679 passed` suites, `6531 passed, 1 skipped`; lang/en.json + lang/es.json parse, keys in sync, comms.a2p.* still last.

## REQ-1105 — The payment step shows one "Suggested" option, the one the message stated (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-29; cites REQ-258 / REQ-265 / REQ-672)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-29** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Two 'Suggested' badges on the payment step". On Q-001, whose message ended "30% deposit", both "30/30/40" and "Deposit + balance" were tagged Suggested, and 30/30/40 was also titled "From your message".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the payment step's "Suggested" tag has two independent sources and no tie-break. The tag condition in `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` (~10242) is `(showPrefill && prefillOpt.id === opt.id) || payload.suggestedOptionId === opt.id`, and the `wiz-opt--suggested` class and the "From your message" title (~10125) follow `payload.suggestedOptionId` alone. The front end's own parse (`wizardPrefillFor` → `extractPaymentTerms`, REQ-265/936) reads "30% deposit" as `deposit_bal`. The backend's suggestion is the model's create_quote `paymentTerms`, stored verbatim as `conv.termsPrefill.payment_terms` (`handle-chat-message/mod.ts` ~3914) and sent as `suggestedOptionId` (`terms-prefill/mod.ts`). The tool description `prompts.tools.createQuote.paymentTerms` (lang/en.json, es.json) has no rule for a non-50% "N% deposit", so the model picked `30_30_40`. f4639eeb (REQ-672) put the visible tag on both paths without reconciling them.
**Requirement:** the payment step tags at most ONE option as Suggested / "From your message". For a stated "N% deposit" (N not 50), that option is "Deposit + balance" (`deposit_bal`), never 30/30/40. The backend stores what the contractor's words say, not a contradicting model pick, and the tool description (en + es) maps "N% deposit" to `deposit_bal` and keeps `30_30_40` for three stated payments.

## REQ-1107 — The /quotes Monster tip body speaks the page language, not the account's (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-31 + q3-104)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues **q3-31** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Spanish /quotes 'Consejo del monstruo' tip text is in English", and **q3-104** (duplicate of q3-31, kept for id stability; its "1 trabajo" fragment is fine).
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the tip's heading and body take their language from two places. `QSideTip` (`front-end/components/QuotesSections.tsx`) renders the heading with `tFor(lang, "quotesTip.title")` in the PAGE language (`resolveSsrLang`: ?lang= > account language > pm_lang), but renders the body as the backend's finished sentence (`text ?? …`). GET `/analytics/quotes/insight` (`backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/mod.ts` `insightRoute`) builds that sentence in `uiLangOf(signedIn)`, the ACCOUNT language only; neither the SSR seed (`front-end/lib/quotes-ssr.ts`) nor the client refetch (`quotesClient.insight()`) passes the page language. So an English-account owner on /quotes?lang=es (or pm_lang=es) sees "Consejo del monstruo" over "Most quotes are accepted within the first 48 hours…", although `lang/es.json` has the Spanish `quotesInsight.staticFallback`. The P-59 test (cypress chrome-misc-polish) only covered an account whose language is es.
**Requirement:** on a Spanish /quotes page the tip body is Spanish (e.g. "La mayoría de las cotizaciones se aceptan en las primeras 48 horas…") whatever the account's saved language, in the first HTML and after the island refetches; on an English page it stays English.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/components/QSideTip.lang.test.tsx` ("REQ-1107 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-31): QSideTip on a Spanish page shows the static-fallback insight in Spanish, even when the backend built it in English" — renders QSideTip with the exact EN-account payload `{text: <en fallback>, kind: "static_fallback"}` and lang="es"; plus the en control) · int `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/insight-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1107 …: GET /analytics/quotes/insight?lang=es for an EN account never answers the English 48-hour sentence" — text is absent or the Spanish fallback; plus the no-?lang en control) · e2e `e2e/quotes-tip-lang/quotes-tip-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1107 …: an English-account owner on /quotes?lang=es sees the Monster tip body in Spanish…" — the SSR HTML, then the browser after the insight refetch: heading "Consejo del monstruo", body /primeras 48 horas/, never /within the first 48 hours/). The unit test pins the safer fix (the tip builds its sentence from `kind` in the page language); the int test accepts either a kind-only answer or a ?lang=-honouring text.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-31 at 0a71387e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check components/QSideTip.lang.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`AssertionError: the tip body leaks the English fallback on a Spanish page: "Most quotes are accepted within the first 48 hours after the customer first opens them."`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/insight-lang.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`AssertionError: the Spanish page's insight is the English sentence: {"text":"Most quotes are accepted within the first 48 hours after the customer first opens them.","kind":"static_fallback"}`); `SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/quotes-tip-lang -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1107 … · expectation failed: the first HTML of /quotes?lang=es does not carry the English 'within the first 48 hours' tip body`.
**Fix:** the tip's heading and body now come from ONE language, the page's. (1) `QSideTip` (front-end/components/QuotesSections.tsx, new `insightTipText`) builds the body itself with `tFor(lang, …)` from the insight's `kind` (`static_fallback` → `quotesInsight.staticFallback`, `open_count` + `avg` → `quotesInsight.openCount`); the backend's `text` is used only for a kind the page has no sentence for, so a later language toggle can never leave a stale body. (2) `ComputeQuoteInsight` now also returns `avg` on `open_count` (InsightResponseDto gains optional `avg`). (3) `GET /analytics/quotes/insight` takes `?lang=en|es` and prefers it over the account language (`uiLangOf`, still the default — REQ-631); the /quotes route resolves its page lang before seeding and `loadQuotesSeed(sid, get, lang)` + `quotesClient.insight(lang)` send it, so the SSR seed in the first HTML carries no English sentence either. No test changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-31):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check components/QSideTip.lang.test.tsx lib/quotes-ssr.test.tsx lib/quote-limit.test.tsx` → `ok | 13 passed | 0 failed`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/entrypoints/quotes-controller/ src/analytics/domain/coordinators/compute-quote-insight/` (incl. insight-lang.int.test.ts) → `ok | 20 passed | 0 failed`; e2e against a live `PORT=51494 deno task serve` (shots' own serve answered `backend_unreachable` before the backend finished booting): `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:51494 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/quotes-tip-lang -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1107 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-31): an English-account owner on /quotes?lang=es sees the Monster tip body in Spanish, not the English 48-hour fallback · 3.8s` (1 pass · 0 fail). `deno lint` + `deno check` green on the 5 touched front-end files, `deno lint` green on the 3 touched backend files, `deno check` green on quotes-controller; touched files fmt-clean via stdin.

## REQ-1106 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-32: the /quotes hero's line under a waiting change order is not "Every quote you have sent is decided"
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". (`quotesHero.coWaiting.one`) instead of `quotesHero.settledTitle`, but the `<p class="qph__sub">` under it is always `quotesHero.settledSub`, copy written for "Nothing is waiting on a client right now." **Fix:** `QuotesHero`'s settled branch (`front-end/components/QuotesSections.tsx`) now renders title and sub as a pair: under a waiting change order the h1 `quotesHero.coWaiting.*` is followed by the new `quotesHero.coWaitingSub.one` (en "Your quotes are all decided.
