## REQ-1108 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-33: the More menu's text item follows the line and the phone, and "Send a text" lands visibly (amends REQ-924(c) / REQ-1076)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-33** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "More → 'Send a text' with no phone line is a dead end or does nothing visible".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** REQ-924 (1c0be6f7) built the customer workspace's More menu with a fixed `💬 Send a text` item whose onClick is only `setTab("messages")` (`front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx`). The workspace never asks whether the business has a phone line: only the Messages child calls `commsClient.line()`, after the tab mounts, and shows the static noLine card. So the item reads the same with or without a line and with or without a customer phone. `setTab` only sets state and calls `history.replaceState`: no scroll, no focus. The window click listener closes the menu, and the Messages body opens below the full-width `.cws-money` KPI grid, so the click can look dead. REQ-1076 fixed the no-phone card only and left the item ungated.
**Requirement:** the workspace looks up the line itself (a 409 counts as no line). The More item: no line → "Get a phone line to text" (`customerWs.act.getLineToText`, en+es), a link to /communications; a line but no customer phone → "Add a phone to text" (`customerWs.act.addPhoneToText`, en+es), opening the edit dialog; a line and a phone → "Send a text", which switches to Messages, scrolls the tab body into view and focuses the composer.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/customer-workspace.test.ts` ("REQ-1108 …": the workspace calls `commsClient.line(`; the menu block uses `customerWs.act.getLineToText` + an `/communications` href, `phoneNumber` + `customerWs.act.addPhoneToText`; the item is no longer `onClick={() => setTab("messages")}` and the island has `scrollIntoView(` and `.focus(`; en+es carry both keys) · int n/a — front end only, no backend change · e2e `e2e/customer-more-send-text/customer-more-send-text.e2e.test.ts` (1280x720; "REQ-1108 q3-33 …": no line + phone → item reads "get a phone line" and its href starts /communications; stubbed `/communications/line` + thread, phone → More → Send a text → `cws-messages` top inside the viewport and the `.cws-compose` input focused; stubbed line, no phone → item reads "Add a phone" and opens `customer-form[data-mode=edit]`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-33 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/customer-workspace.test.ts -t REQ-1108` → `Tests: 5 failed, 1 passed` (`Expected pattern: /commsClient\.line\(/`; `/customerWs\.act\.getLineToText/`; `/phoneNumber/`; `not /onClick=\{\(\)\s*=>\s*setTab\("messages"\)\}/`; key `Received: "undefined"`); `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53921 shots run e2e/customer-more-send-text -- --no-check` (against `PORT=53921 deno task serve`) → `✗ … no phone line … expectation failed: with no line the item tells the owner to get a phone line (got "💬 Send a text")`, `✗ … with a line and a phone … expectation failed: the composer has focus (active element: BODY.)`, `✗ … with a line but no customer phone … expectation failed: with no phone the item says to add a phone (got "💬 Send a text")`.
**Fix:** `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` asks `commsClient.line()` once on mount into `hasLine` (true/false/null; a 409 or any failure is `false`, caught quietly). The first More item is now three-way: `hasLine === false` → `<a href="/communications">💬 Get a phone line to text</a>`; no `c.phoneNumber` → `💬 Add a phone to text`, which opens the edit dialog; otherwise `💬 Send a text` → `setTab("messages", { land: true })`. `land` bumps a counter that is passed to `Messages`. Once the thread state leaves "loading", Messages runs `scrollIntoView({ block: "start" })` on the thread wrapper `.cws-msgs__thread`, which has `scroll-margin-top: 64px` in customer-workspace.css to clear the sticky `.cws-tabs`, and then focuses the compose input with `preventScroll`. It does this once per bump. New keys `customerWs.act.getLineToText` / `customerWs.act.addPhoneToText` are in en+es after `customerWs.act.text`. No test was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-33):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/customer-workspace.test.ts` → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6537 passed` (the whole unit lane, including the 6 REQ-1108 tests). `cd front-end && deno lint islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` → `Checked 1 file`; `deno check islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` → clean; `deno fmt --ext=tsx -` → no diff. e2e against `PORT=53921 KV_PATH=<scratch> deno task serve`: `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53921 shots run e2e/customer-more-send-text -- --no-check` → `✓ … with no phone line … leads to /communications` (43.5s), `✓ … with a line and a phone … focuses the composer` (62.4s), `✓ … with a line but no customer phone … opens the edit dialog` (62.9s). ## REQ-1110 — The receipt PDF states the money received, not the invoice total (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-34; extends REQ-963 + REQ-1071 to the PDF)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-34** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Part-payment receipt PDF states the full invoice amount as 'AMOUNT RECEIVED'" — a $400.25 check on INV-002 ($1,000.50) got a receipt email saying "payment of $400.25 … Balance still due: $600.25 of $1,000.50" with a PDF attached reading "AMOUNT RECEIVED $1,000.50" and no balance.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `RenderReceiptPdf` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-receipt-pdf/mod.ts`) was written when a receipt only went out for a fully paid bill, so its amount card draws `fmtMoney(invoice.amount ?? 0)` (8b4823c02) under "AMOUNT RECEIVED" (b6ec538ed), and `RenderReceiptPdfInput` has no field for the payment at all. REQ-963 started sending that PDF for part payments from `SendPaymentReceipt`, which has `payment.amount` but cannot pass it; REQ-1071 added the payment, the balance and the total only to the email HTML. `MarkInvoicePaid` (closing payment after part payments) renders the same PDF with the last payment's method/reference but the invoice total as the amount.
**Requirement:** the receipt PDF's "AMOUNT RECEIVED" is the payment it is for ($400.25), never the invoice total, and a part-payment receipt PDF shows the balance still due of the total ($600.25 of $1,000.50), in en and es; the closing payment's receipt PDF shows that payment ($600.25).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-receipt-pdf/amount-received.test.ts` ("REQ-1110 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-34) receipt PDF: …" ×3 — renders with invoice.amount 100050 + amount 40025 / totalCents / balanceCents; the line after "AMOUNT RECEIVED" is "$400.25"; "$600.25" and "$1,000.50" drawn; es draws "$400.25" and "$600.25") · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/receipt-pdf-amount.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1110 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-34): …" ×2 — POST /payments $400.25 on a $1,000.50 invoice → the captured receipt email's PDF reads AMOUNT RECEIVED $400.25 + $600.25; the closing $600.25 payment's PAID-invoice email attaches a receipt PDF reading AMOUNT RECEIVED $600.25) · e2e n/a — the receipt PDF exists only as an email attachment: the Outbox does not record attachments (REQ-945/REQ-1079) and no page or API serves a receipt PDF, so the browser has no surface to read it; the integration test drives the same POST /payments path the Record payment dialog calls (REQ-963's e2e covers the dialog).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-34 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-receipt-pdf/amount-received.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (`the amount received is the $400.25 paid — got "$1,000.50"`; `to contain: "$600.25": the balance still due`; es: `MONTO RECIBIDO $1,000.50`, no $400.25); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/receipt-pdf-amount.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`- $1,000.50 + $400.25`; `- $1,000.50 + $600.25`).
**Fix:** `RenderReceiptPdfInput` gains a required `amount` (cents received) plus `totalCents`/`balanceCents`; the amount card draws `amount`, and a balance above zero adds "Balance still due: $X of $Y" (new key `receiptPdf.balanceDue`, en + es). `SendPaymentReceipt` computes total/balance before the render and passes `payment.amount` with them (the same figures as its email); `MarkInvoicePaid` passes the closing payment's amount (`last.amount`, else the invoice total) and balance 0. The three existing direct renders in tests (render-numbers, phone-format, load-business-logo) pass the now-required `amount` (their full-payment invoice amount); no assertion changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-34):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-receipt-pdf/amount-received.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/receipt-pdf-amount.int.test.ts` → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours — every backend test file referencing RenderReceiptPdf / SendPaymentReceipt / MarkInvoicePaid (21 files) → `ok | 121 passed | 0 failed`; `deno check` on the 3 touched modules + 5 touched/target tests → clean; `deno lint` touched files → `Checked 6 files`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` (incl. i18n-dictionary-consistency) → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total; Tests: 6531 passed, 1 skipped`; lang/en.json + lang/es.json 6462 keys each, same key set, last key still `comms.a2p.sys.house`.

## REQ-1109 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-35: customer-facing money never drops the trailing cent zero (invoice text, reminder 007, nudge 009, Remind preview)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-35** [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 3: "Invoice text, reminder and nudge drop the trailing cent zero ('$1,035.5', '$225.3', '$1,000.5')".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** three backend formatters for money the customer (or owner) reads call `(cents/100).toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })`, and with min 0 / max 2 Intl strips trailing zeros one digit at a time, so 103550 → "$1,035.5", 22530 → "$225.3", 100050 → "$1,000.5". (1) `send-payment-reminder/mod.ts` `composeReminderCopy` `amount` (REQ-1028's open balance) feeds the reminder/nudge email "Amount due:" line and `smsBody`, which is also what POST /cron/reminder-preview (the Remind dialog) and POST /cron/invoice-reminder (Send nudge) send; (2) `send-paperwork-sms/mod.ts` `fmtUSD` → `renderInvoiceBody` "your invoice is ready ({amount})"; (3) `record-payment-from-utterance/mod.ts` `moneyStr` (owner chat payment candidates). The invoice email (`send-paperwork-email`, min 2) and the shared `whole ? 0 : 2` helpers already follow REQ-961's house rule: whole dollars ("$1,000") or full cents ("$1,035.50"), never one decimal place.
**Requirement:** every money amount in paperwork text, email and preview is whole dollars when the cents are a multiple of 100, otherwise exactly two decimals — "$1,035.50", "$225.30", "$1,000.50", "$1,000".
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/cent-zero.test.ts` ("REQ-1109 (LOOP-007 q3-35) …": composeReminderCopy en/es with 103550 → "$1,035.50" in the email and "$1,035.50 (INV-" in the text; a part-paid $225.30 balance on the day-7 nudge; 100000 stays "$1,000", not "$1,000.00"; renderInvoiceBody 100050 → "($1,000.50)"; a source scan that fails on `minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2` under backend/src/paperwork) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/reminder-cent-zero.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1109 (LOOP-007 q3-35) int: …": app booted, a $225.30 overdue invoice; POST /cron/reminder-preview smsBody and the /outbox body of the email POST /cron/invoice-reminder sent both read "$225.30") · e2e `e2e/reminder-cent-zero/reminder-cent-zero.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1109 (LOOP-007 q3-35): …": a sent $1,000.50 invoice on /invoices, the flipped card's reminder preview and the Outbox body of the sent nudge read "$1,000.50").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-35 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/cent-zero.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 5 failed` (`the reminder email drops the cent zero: $1,035.5` en+es; `the nudge email reads $225.3`; `the invoice text drops the cent zero: "Hi Ana, your invoice is ready ($1,000.5). …"`; `formatters that print "$X.5": domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-sms/mod.ts, domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts, domain/coordinators/record-payment-from-utterance/mod.ts`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/reminder-cent-zero.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`the Remind dialog preview drops the cent zero: "… $225.3 (INV-001) …"`, `the sent nudge email drops the cent zero: $225.3`); `BASE_URL=<worktree serve> shots run e2e/reminder-cent-zero -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1109 … expectation failed: the reminder preview reads $1,000.50 (Hi Ana, friendly reminder — your invoice from Cadence Roofing is due soon. $1,000.5 (INV-001) — …)`.
**Fix:** new `shared/quote-flow/money-text.ts` `formatUsdCents(cents)` — the REQ-961 rule (whole dollars compact, otherwise exactly two decimals). `send-payment-reminder/mod.ts` (`amount` for reminder 007, nudge 009 and the Remind preview), `send-paperwork-sms/mod.ts` (`fmtUSD` → invoice text) and `record-payment-from-utterance/mod.ts` (`moneyStr`, owner chat payment reply) all format through it; no `minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2` remains under backend/src/paperwork.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-35):** `cd backend && NO_COLOR=1 deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/cent-zero.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/reminder-cent-zero.int.test.ts` → `ok | 7 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours (every test file under send-payment-reminder/, send-paperwork-sms/, record-payment-from-utterance/, cron-controller/, plus every backend test importing those three modules) → `ok | 197 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the four touched files clean; `PORT=52817 KV_PATH=<file> deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:52817 shots run e2e/reminder-cent-zero -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1109 (LOOP-007 q3-35): a $1,000.50 invoice's reminder preview and the sent nudge email read $1,000.50, never $1,000.5 · 4.1s` (1 pass · 0 fail).

## REQ-1111 — Reminder and nudge emails name the due date in the long form, never ISO (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-36)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-36** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Reminder and nudge emails print raw ISO dates (EN and ES)". Outbox captured "Amount due: $1,035.5 · Due 2026-11-19" and "Monto a pagar: $820.67 · Vence 2026-12-19".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `composeReminderCopy` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts` (~line 484) builds the due line as `t(lang, "paymentReminder.dueSuffix", { dueDate: invoice.dueDate })`. That puts the stored `YYYY-MM-DD` straight into " · Due {dueDate}" / " · Vence {dueDate}" without formatting it. Every cadence reminder (before-due, due-today, day 3, day 7) and the manual "Send nudge" / customer-page Remind (day 14) go through this one function, so every reminder email prints the ISO date in EN and ES. The line dates from 8b4823c0 (invoice v1) and b6ec538e (bilingual). The shared long-date formatters (`fmtPaperworkDate` in `shared/quote-flow/email-format.ts`, `formatLongDate` in `shared/quote-flow/format-helpers.ts`) came later and were never wired into it.
**Requirement:** a reminder or nudge email names the due date in the long form the other paperwork emails use: en "November 19, 2026", es "19 de noviembre de 2026". It never shows a `YYYY-MM-DD` date in its visible text.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/due-date-format.test.ts` ("REQ-1111 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-36) reminder <en|es> day <-3|0|3|7|14> …": composeReminderCopy with dueDate 2026-11-19 → emailHtml contains the long date and no ISO date outside the CTA URL) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/past-due-nudge.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1111 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-36): the <en|es> Send nudge email reads the due date …": `runForInvoice` on the manual-nudge day with an en / es customer; the captured `htmlBody` text names "November 1, 2026" / "1 de noviembre de 2026", never 2026-11-01) · e2e `e2e/reminder-long-date/reminder-long-date.e2e.test.ts` (two stories: /customers/<id> → Remind for an English customer, and /invoices overdue → Send nudge for a Spanish customer; reads the reminder email body from /api/outbox/:id and expects the long date with no ISO date).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-36 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/due-date-format.test.ts` → all 10 FAILED (`the en reminder email prints a raw ISO date: "Due 2026-11-19"`, `the es reminder email prints a raw ISO date: "Vence 2026-11-19"`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/past-due-nudge.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 3 passed | 2 failed` (`the en nudge email prints a raw ISO date: "Due 2026-11-01"`, `the es nudge email prints a raw ISO date: "Vence 2026-11-01"`); e2e against a manual `PORT=53736 KV_PATH=<file> deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53736 SHOTS_DIR=<private> shots run e2e/reminder-long-date -- --no-check` → `✗ … /invoices' Send nudge … expectation failed: the es reminder email prints the raw ISO due date: "Vence 2026-11-09 Ver factura Luis"`, `✗ … the customer page's Remind … expectation failed: the en reminder email prints the raw ISO due date: "Due 2026-11-09 Open invoice Luis"`. Under host load (~60), shots' own serve started the stories before the backend was up (`backend_unreachable`). Serving manually and waiting for the backend port avoids this.
**Fix:** `composeReminderCopy` now formats the due date with the shared `fmtPaperworkDate(invoice.dueDate, lang)` (`#quote-flow/email-format.ts`, the formatter the other paperwork emails use; it reads a bare `YYYY-MM-DD` as noon UTC so the day cannot slip) before it goes into `paymentReminder.dueSuffix`. The lang templates are unchanged. The SMS body has no date, so it is unaffected.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-36):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/customer-branding.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/outbox.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/customer-language.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-languages-lock.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/business/email-html-lang.test.ts` → `ok | 78 passed | 0 failed` (includes all 10 due-date-format unit tests and both REQ-1111 nudge int tests). `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/reminder-cadence-c5.test.ts unit/old-origin.test.ts` → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed`. `deno check` + `deno lint` on mod.ts → clean. E2E: `PORT=53836 KV_PATH=<file> deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53836 SHOTS_JOBS=2 shots run e2e/reminder-long-date -- --no-check` → `✓ … /invoices' Send nudge emails a Spanish reminder …`, `✓ … the customer page's Remind emails an English reminder …` — `2 pass · 0 fail · 0 skipped`.

## REQ-1112 — Every /invoices nudge shows its preview and asks before it sends (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-37; amends REQ-477, follows REQ-704 / REQ-1031)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-37** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "'Send nudge' on the overdue card emails the customer in one click with no preview". The customer page's Remind shows a confirm with "What Greg Pruitt will get:"; the board button does not.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** in `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` the reminder preview lives only on the card's back face: the effect that fetches `/api/cron/reminder-preview` runs only while `flipped`, and the preview block draws only on the back. The overdue card's front primary `invoice-cta-overdue` and the back primary `invoice-back-cta-overdue` both call `ctaAction`, whose overdue branch is `if (inv.stage === "overdue") return doSendNudge(e);` (d18efdfe, REQ-021). `doSendNudge` calls `sendInvoiceNudge` → POST `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` at once. The back face's `invoice-nudge` asks first only for claimed (REQ-250), and the detail panel's `runStageAction` calls `dispatch.doSendNudge` directly. REQ-1031 built `front-end/components/InvoiceNudgeDialog.tsx` (preview + Send / Cancel) but wired it only into `CustomerWorkspace.tsx`, so the same nudge is one-tap on /invoices and confirmed on the customer page.
**Requirement:** every /invoices entry point that sends an invoice's reminder nudge (the overdue card's front "Send nudge", the back face's stage CTA, the back face's "Send a nudge", the detail panel's nudge) first opens InvoiceNudgeDialog with the backend reminder preview. Cancel sends nothing. Send sends exactly one reminder. REQ-477's "sends the reminder straight away" now reads "asks first, with the preview".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/loop7-q3-37-invoices-nudge-confirm.test.ts` ("REQ-1112 q3-37 …": InvoicesPage.tsx imports and renders InvoiceNudgeDialog; ctaAction's overdue branch, the `invoice-nudge` onClick and `runStageAction` never call doSendNudge / sendInvoiceNudge directly) · integration n/a — front-end wiring only; `/api/cron/reminder-preview` and `/api/cron/invoice-reminder` are already pinned by `jest/integration/invoice-nudge.int.test.ts` · e2e `e2e/invoices-nudge-confirm-q3-37/invoices-nudge-confirm-q3-37.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1112 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-37): … front …" and "… back …": an emailed invoice 10 days past due; tapping `invoice-cta-overdue` / `invoice-back-cta-overdue` POSTs nothing and opens `send-dialog` with `invoice-nudge-preview` "… will get"; Cancel → no POST and the Outbox is unchanged; again + `send-keep` → exactly one new reminder email in the Outbox). The fixer must also update tests that pin the one-tap send, e.g. `e2e/invoice-nudge-out-c3` (REQ-477) and any overdue-CTA stories that expect an immediate POST.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-37 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern loop7-q3-37` → `Tests: 5 failed, 5 total` (`Expected pattern: /import\s+InvoiceNudgeDialog\s+from …/`; ctaAction overdue / invoice-nudge / runStageAction each `- "sendsDirectly": false  + "sendsDirectly": true`); `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/invoices-nudge-confirm-q3-37 -- --no-check` → `expectation failed: the front 'Send nudge' must not email the customer in one tap — it POSTed /api/cron/invoice-reminder 1x with no preview — expected 0, got 1` and the same for the back.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-37):** `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` — `useInvoiceDispatch` gains `askNudge(e)`, which sends nothing: it hands an `InvoiceNudgeSheet` ({inv, send}) to `onNudgeSheet`. The page (for every card) and the detail panel each hold a `nudgeSheet` and draw `InvoiceNudgeSheetDialog` → REQ-1031's `InvoiceNudgeDialog` outside the transformed cards (as REQ-727's send sheet). Its Send runs the card's own `doSendNudge(null, day)` for the step the dialog previewed (same busy / "Nudge sent" / fail note); Cancel sends nothing. `ctaAction`'s overdue branch (front `invoice-cta-overdue` + back `invoice-back-cta-overdue`), the back face's `invoice-nudge` for non-claimed cards and `runStageAction`'s nudge all call `askNudge`. A claimed card keeps REQ-250's inline ask naming the claim (its "Send anyway" is the confirm; the back face shows the preview above it). Stories that pinned the one-tap send now press the dialog's Send: `e2e/invoice-nudge-out-c3` (REQ-477) and `e2e/nudge-past-due-q114` (REQ-938) — their assertions (200, email channel, "Nudge sent", one new Outbox reminder) are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'loop7-q3-37|claimed-nudge-confirm|delivery-truth|loop7-q2-8|nudge-past-due|invoice'` → `Test Suites: 51 passed · Tests: 414 passed`; full lane `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6536 passed`; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/invoice-detail-actions.test.tsx lib/invoice-card-nudge.test.ts lib/invoice-send-sheet.test.tsx` → `14 passed | 0 failed`; `deno check islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` clean; `deno lint islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` → `Checked 1 file`; `deno fmt --ext=tsx - < islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` → no diff. e2e (`PORT=5471 deno task serve`, `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> SHOTS_JOBS=4 BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5471 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/invoices-nudge-confirm-q3-37 e2e/invoice-nudge-out-c3 e2e/nudge-past-due-q114 e2e/claimed-nudge e2e/confirm-row-style e2e/invoice-overdue-back-q1-63 e2e/invoice-detail-actions-c5 e2e/customer-remind-nudge -- --no-check`) → ✓ REQ-1112 front · ✓ REQ-1112 back · ✓ REQ-477 · ✓ REQ-938 · ✓ REQ-250 · ✓ REQ-707 · ✓ REQ-985 · ✓ REQ-1031 · ✓ REQ-702 card-back; 9 pass · 1 fail. ## REQ-1113 — The reminder preview names the channel that will actually go; an untextable phone gets no text preview, no doomed text, and an email-only toast (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-38; amends REQ-704 + REQ-1031)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-38** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Remind dialog previews a text, but only an email with different wording goes" — /customers/<id> → Recordar for a customer with an email and a reserved 843-555-0142 phone: the dialog showed the SMS body under "Lo que recibirá Lucía Gómez:", the toast said "Recordatorio enviado para INV-001", and the Outbox showed the reminder email (different wording) plus a NOT TEXTED row.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** nothing between preview, send and toast is told which channel will really be used. `SendPaymentReminder.preview()` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts`) returns `smsBody` and `phone` for any phone on file — no `phoneCantReceiveTexts` check (`shared/quote-flow/sms-number.ts`) — and never returns the email body or a channel list. `front-end/components/InvoiceNudgeDialog.tsx` (REQ-1031, copied from the /invoices card's REQ-704 preview in `InvoicesPage.tsx`) renders only `preview.smsBody` and names no channel (`front-end/lib/invoice-nudge.ts` `NudgePreview` drops email/subject). `runForInvoice` emails, then tries the SMS, which `SmsService` refuses as `fictional` and logs to the Outbox as not sent, so the reply is `channels: ["email"]`. `nudgeNote` (`shared/documents/delivery-truth.ts`) turns any non-empty channels into `invoicesPage.nudge.sent`, which `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` words as "Reminder sent for INV-001".
**Requirement:** for a customer whose phone can't take texts (`phoneCantReceiveTexts`), the reminder preview and the send agree: the preview answers `channels: ["email"]`, `textSkip: "fictional"`, the email's `emailSubject` and a plain-text `emailText`, and no `smsBody`; `runForInvoice` never calls `sms.send` for that phone, leaves no refused text in the Outbox, and replies `textSkip: "fictional"`. The Remind dialog (and the /invoices card preview) names the channel ("by email to …"), shows the email (subject + body) and the `asstChat.send.cantText` line, never a text that won't go. The toast says the reminder went by email only (`nudgeNote` → `invoicesPage.nudge.sentEmailOnly`, en + es, "email"/"correo").
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/untextable-phone.test.ts` ("REQ-1113 (LOOP-007 q3-38): preview … names only the email channel …", "… runForInvoice never attempts the doomed text …") and `jest/unit/loop7-q3-38-nudge-email-only.test.ts` ("REQ-1113 q3-38 nudgeNote … email-only note", "… worded in en and es", "… email + text both delivered still reads as the plain 'sent'") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/untextable-reminder.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1113 (LOOP-007 q3-38) int: …" — POST /cron/reminder-preview → channels ["email"], no smsBody, emailSubject + emailText; POST /cron/invoice-reminder agrees; GET /outbox?customerId= → exactly `email:sent`) · e2e `e2e/remind-untextable-phone/remind-untextable-phone.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1113 (LOOP-007 q3-38): Remind … previews the email that goes, not a text, and the toast says email only").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-38 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/untextable-reminder.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/untextable-phone.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (`preview must say only email goes (got {…"phone":"843-555-0142","emailSubject":"Personal note from your contractor · INV-001","smsBody":"Hi Lucía, wanted to follow up personally …"})`; `no sms.send for a number the app already knows can't take texts (tried ["843-555-0142"])`; `the preview names the one channel that will go (got {…"smsBody":"Hi Lucía, …"})`) · `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/loop7-q3-38-nudge-email-only.test.ts` → `Expected: "invoicesPage.nudge.sentEmailOnly" Received: "invoicesPage.nudge.sent"`; `Expected pattern: /email/i Received string: "Nudge sent"` (the rest of the unit lane: 679 suites passed) · e2e (own serve: backend booted directly with the stub LLM, `BASE_URL=http://localhost:<rand>`; `deno task serve`'s backend never comes up without OPENAI_API_KEY) `shots run e2e/remind-untextable-phone -- --no-check` → `✗ … expectation failed: the dialog names the channel: by email to lucia@… (preview: "What Lucia Untextable … will get:\nHi Lucia, following up on your invoice from Remind Untextable Story … $820.67 (INV-001) — …/s/… — Remind")`; a soft-assert probe of the same story showed every later check red too: no cantText line, backend smsBody present, preview lacks the email subject "Following up: invoice from Remind Untextable Story · INV-001", Outbox `text:not_sent (fictional)` + `email:sent`, toast "Reminder sent for INV-001".
**Fix (2026-11-19):** one rule decides the channels, and preview, send and toast all read it. (1) `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts` `compose()` runs REQ-569's `phoneCantReceiveTexts` on the phone on file: a reserved 555 number is not a text recipient (`toPhone` undefined, `textSkip: "fictional"`). `preview()` now answers `channels` (`["email"]` / `["email","sms"]` / `["sms"]`, in send order), `emailSubject` + `emailText` (new `composeReminderCopy().emailText`, the email's greeting/tone, amount + due line, link and signature as plain text) only when an email goes, `smsBody` only when a text goes, the phone on file, and `textSkip`. `runForInvoice` never calls `sms.send` for that phone and never logs a refused text; its reply carries `textSkip` ("fictional", or "failed" when a text was tried and refused while the email went). A phone-only customer with a reserved number answers `reason: "not_delivered"` + `textSkip`, not "no_recipient". (2) `shared/documents/delivery-truth.ts` `nudgeNote`: channels without "sms" plus a `textSkip` → `invoicesPage.nudge.sentEmailOnly`; `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` words it as `customerWs.remind.sentEmailOnly` ("Reminder emailed for {number} — the text couldn't go"). New keys in en + es: `invoicesPage.nudge.sentEmailOnly`, `invoicesPage.nudge.byEmail`, `invoicesPage.nudge.byText`, `customerWs.remind.sentEmailOnly`. (3) `front-end/lib/invoice-nudge.ts` `NudgePreview` carries channels/email/phone/emailSubject/emailText/textSkip; `front-end/components/InvoiceNudgeDialog.tsx` exports `NudgePreviewBody`, used by the Remind dialog AND the /invoices card's back face (`InvoicesPage.tsx`, REQ-704). It shows "By email to …" with the subject and email words, "By text to …" with the text only when one goes, and `asstChat.send.cantText` when the phone is a reserved number.
**Tests amended (why):** (a) `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/reminder-preview.int.test.ts` (REQ-704) asserted `preview.smsBody` includes "Hi Ana" for a customer with an email and NO phone, which is the same bug: a text preview for a text that never goes. It now asserts `channels ["email"]`, no `smsBody`, and the same "Hi Ana" / "is due soon" words in `emailText`. (b) `e2e/remind-untextable-phone` waited for `cws-toast` after the Send click. The toast lives 4 s, and under host load the harness's post-click screenshot took longer than that, so the wait timed out on a toast that had already shown "Reminder emailed for INV-001 — the text couldn't go" (it is visible in the click screenshot). The story now arms `textContent({timeout})` on the toast before the click. All assertions are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/untextable-phone.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/untextable-reminder.int.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller` → `ok | 32 passed | 0 failed` (`--no-check` because type-checking stalled at host load ~115; typecheck done separately: `deno check` on mod.ts + the three test files is clean, `deno lint` is clean) · `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/loop7-q3-38-nudge-email-only.test.ts …` (it ran the whole unit lane) → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6534 passed` · e2e (own serve on :57731/:57732, file KV) `BASE_URL=http://localhost:57731 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/remind-untextable-phone e2e/customer-remind-nudge e2e/reminder-cadence-c5 -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1113 (LOOP-007 q3-38) … · 1s`, `✓ REQ-1031 (LOOP-007 q2-8) … · 2.7s`, `✓ REQ-704 … · 94.3s`. The other rows in that shared evidence index came from other worktrees' parallel runs. `cd front-end && deno check` + `deno lint` on InvoiceNudgeDialog.tsx, InvoicesPage.tsx, CustomerWorkspace.tsx, lib/invoice-nudge.ts and shared/documents/delivery-truth.ts are clean.

## REQ-1115 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-39: a reminder sent well before the due date does not say "due soon" / "vence pronto"
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-39** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Reminder says 'vence pronto' for a bill due in 30 days" — customer page (ES) → Recordar → Enviar recordatorio on an invoice due 2026-12-19, sent 2026-11-19: "Hola Lucía, un recordatorio amistoso — tu factura de Ortiz Painting & Fence vence pronto." then "Monto a pagar: $820.67 · Vence 2026-12-19", subject "Próximo vencimiento: factura de …".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the customer page's Recordar (REQ-1031) and the /invoices "Send a nudge" pick the step with `manualReminderDay` (`shared/quote-flow/reminder-settings.ts`), which maps ANY date before the due date to step -3 (`if (d < 0) return -3`), and POST /cron/invoice-reminder hands that day straight to `runForInvoice`, skipping the sweep's `stepReached` 3-days-before gate. `composeReminderCopy` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts`) then chooses its tone and subject from the step number alone — `day < 0` → `paymentReminder.tone.beforeDue` ("…is due soon." / "…vence pronto.") and `paymentReminder.subject.beforeDue` ("Coming up: …" / "Próximo vencimiento: …") — copy REQ-704 wrote for the sweep step that fires three days before the due date. So a reminder sent 30 days early says "due soon". Mapping dates from ecaf8a82 (REQ-704); REQ-938 (2d86c342) changed only the past-due branch. Side effect, same mechanism: the early manual send records `day: -3`, so an opted-in -3 sweep step never fires later.
**Requirement:** a before-due reminder sent more than three days before the due date names the due date instead of saying "due soon" / "vence pronto", and its subject is not "Coming up" / "Próximo vencimiento"; three days or fewer before the due date it keeps the REQ-704 "due soon" copy. Email, SMS and the Remind preview agree (one `composeReminderCopy`). The explicit Remind before the due date stays available (REQ-1066).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/upcoming-wording.test.ts` ("REQ-1115 (LOOP-007 q3-39): …": `composeReminderCopy({ day: -3, invoice due 2026-12-19, now 2026-11-19 })` in es/en has no "vence pronto"/"is due soon" in email or SMS, no "Próximo vencimiento"/"Coming up" subject, and the SMS names the due date; with now 2026-12-16 it still says "vence pronto"/"is due soon" — the fix threads `now` into the copy) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/upcoming-wording.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1115 …": real stores on KV :memory:, a Spanish-reading customer, `runForInvoice(manualReminderDay(due, today))` 30 days out → the sent email lacks "vence pronto" and the "Próximo vencimiento" subject; 3 days out it keeps both) · e2e `e2e/remind-upcoming-wording/remind-upcoming-wording.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1115 …": owner + customer in Spanish, invoice issued today due in 30 days, /customers/<id>?lang=es → Recordar → Enviar recordatorio, the newest /api/outbox reminder's body has no "vence pronto" and its subject is not "Próximo vencimiento").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-39 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/upcoming-wording.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 3 failed` (`email body says "vence pronto" 30 days out: <p …>Hola Lucía, un recordatorio amistoso — tu factura de Ortiz Painting & Fence vence pronto.</p>`; `email body says 'is due soon' 30 days out`; `en SMS 30 days out names the due date (got "Hi Lucía, friendly reminder — your invoice from Ortiz Painting & Fence is due soon. $820.67 (#I-1) — Marco")`); `… upcoming-wording.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`30 days out the email says "Hola Lucía, un recordatorio amistoso — tu factura de tu contratista vence pronto."`); `shots run e2e/remind-upcoming-wording -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1115 … expectation failed: an invoice due in 30 days must not be "vence pronto" (email says "Hola Lucía, un recordatorio amistoso — tu factura de Marco Ortiz vence pronto.")`.
**Fix:** `composeReminderCopy` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/mod.ts`) takes the send time `now`; `runForInvoice` and `preview` thread it through `compose`. For a before-due step (`day < 0`) sent more than three calendar days before the due date (`daysFromDue(dueDate, now) < -3`) the tone is the new `paymentReminder.tone.upcoming` (en "friendly reminder — your invoice from {businessName} is due on {dueDate}." / es "un recordatorio amistoso — tu factura de {businessName} vence el {dueDate}.", the date via `formatLongDate` in the reminder's language) and the subject the new `paymentReminder.subject.upcoming` (en "Upcoming invoice from {businessName}" / es "Recordatorio: factura de {businessName}"). Three days or fewer out it keeps the REQ-704 `beforeDue` copy. Email, SMS and the Remind dialog preview share the one function. Keys added to `lang/en.json` + `lang/es.json` in sync (before the trailing `comms.a2p.*`). Not changed: `manualReminderDay` still maps an early nudge to step -3, so it is still recorded as `day: -3` in `reminderHistory`.
**Older tests corrected (they pinned the bug):** `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/reminder-preview.int.test.ts` (REQ-704 m60) previewed step -3 on an invoice due in 10 days and expected "is due soon". Its due date is now 3 days out, where REQ-704's "due soon" copy still applies, and every other assertion is unchanged. `e2e/reminder-cadence-c5/reminder-cadence-c5.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-704) expected "is due soon" in the nudge preview for an invoice due in 14 days. It now expects the due date to be named ("is due on") and no "due soon".
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-39):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/upcoming-wording.test.ts` → 4 passed. `… upcoming-wording.int.test.ts` → 2 passed. Neighbours: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/cron-controller/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-reminder/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/{outbox,customer-branding,customer-language,send-languages-lock}.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/business/email-html-lang.test.ts` → `ok | 73 passed | 0 failed`. `shots run e2e/remind-upcoming-wording -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1115 (LOOP-007 q3-39): Recordar on a Spanish invoice due in 30 days … · 97.2s`. `shots run e2e/reminder-cadence-c5 -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-704: reminders can go out before the due date … · 263.2s`; its first run, in the same shots batch, failed at sign-in with `backend_unreachable` (a boot race; the story's sign-in has no retry) and passed when re-run alone. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → 679 suites, 6531 passed, 1 skipped. `deno lint` + `deno check` on the touched backend module are clean.

## REQ-1116 — Confirming a customer's claim that closes the bill sends ONE customer email, not "Paid — Invoice …" plus "Receipt for …" (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-40; amends REQ-963 + REQ-941)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-40** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Confirming a claimed payment sends two separate 'paid' emails" — after the customer's full Zelle claim and the owner's "Okay, I got it" → "Mark as paid", the outbox gained "Paid — Invoice INV-001 from Whitfield Fence & Deck" and "Receipt for INV-001" in the same second (outbox 003 + 004).
**Root cause:** `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/mod.ts` `ConfirmPayment.run` (POST /invoices/:id/confirm-payment, also the assistant's RecordPaymentFromUtterance) first calls `ComputeInvoiceBalance.run(…, { receiptPdf: false })`; when the claim closes the balance that flips the invoice to paid and runs `MarkInvoicePaid`, which emails the customer the REQ-020 PAID invoice (no PDF). It then calls `SendPaymentReceipt.run` unconditionally, which emails "Receipt for INV-…" with the receipt PDF. The hand-recorded path (`PaymentController.create`) only sends the receipt when `balance.status !== "paid"`; REQ-963 (34f60c31) added that guard to the controller but not to ConfirmPayment, and REQ-941 (76222fd1) only stopped the PDF being attached twice, not the second email.
**Requirement:** a confirmed claim that closes the balance sends the customer exactly one email — the PAID invoice — carrying the receipt PDF, records one customer email in the outbox and stamps `receiptSentVia: "email"`; a confirmed claim that leaves a balance still sends one "Receipt for …" email with the PDF.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/one-email.test.ts` ("REQ-1116 (LOOP-007 q3-40) …": stubbed ComputeInvoiceBalance reporting paid → no "Receipt for …" email from ConfirmPayment and balance.run not told `receiptPdf: false`; pending → one receipt email) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/one-email.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1116 (LOOP-007 q3-40) …": the booted app on KV :memory:, public Zelle claim for the whole $1,000 → POST /invoices/:id/confirm-payment → one customer email, one application/pdf, +1 customer email outbox row, receiptSentVia "email"; a $400 claim → one "Receipt for" email) · e2e `e2e/req-1116-claim-one-email/req-1116-claim-one-email.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1116 (LOOP-007 q3-40) …": customer's claim via the public POST /i makes, owner clicks /invoices "Okay, I got it" → "Mark as paid" → the outbox gains exactly one customer email for the invoice).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-40 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/one-email.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`exactly one customer email when the claim closes the bill; sent: [{"to":"dana.customer@test.dev","subject":"Paid — Invoice INV-001 from Sam Whitfield"},{"to":"dana.customer@test.dev","subject":"Receipt for INV-001"}]` `- 2 + 1`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/one-email.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 2 failed` (`- ["Receipt for INV-001"] + []`; `calls: [{"receiptPdf":false}]`); `PORT=<random> deno task serve` then `BASE_URL=… SHOTS_JOBS=1 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/req-1116-claim-one-email -- --no-check` → `✗ … the outbox gained exactly one customer email (new: ["receipt:email","invoicePaid:email"]) — expected 1, got 2`.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-40):** `ConfirmPayment.run` now calls `ComputeInvoiceBalance.run(invoiceId, userId)` with the default options, so when the claim closes the bill `MarkInvoicePaid` attaches the receipt PDF to the PAID invoice email and records `receiptSentVia: "email"` (REQ-941). It keeps the ledger result and passes `{ email: ledger.status !== "paid" }` to `SendPaymentReceipt.run`, which has a new `ReceiptOptions.email` (default true): with `email: false` it neither renders the receipt PDF nor sends the "Receipt for …" email, but still sends the receipt **text** (REQ-523/556, so a customer with only a phone still hears about it), writes the outbox/comms rows for the text, and stamps `receiptSentVia` (a delivered PAID email still counts as "email"). A claim that leaves a balance is unchanged: one receipt email with the PDF, plus the text. The hand-recorded closing path (`PaymentController.create`) is unchanged and still sends no text; that parity gap was there before and is out of scope here. Doc comments in `confirm-payment/mod.ts`, `mark-invoice-paid/mod.ts` (which said ConfirmPayment "keeps its receipt on top" and passes `receiptPdf: false`) and `send-payment-receipt/mod.ts` now describe this.
**Existing tests changed (they assumed the old two-email behaviour):** `confirm-payment/reference.int.test.ts` (REQ-930), `confirm-payment/reply-to.int.test.ts` (REQ-1017), `customer-language.int.test.ts` (REQ-715 receipt), `send-languages-lock.int.test.ts` (REQ-925 receipt) and `outbox.int.test.ts` (REQ-784 d12 receipt) all checked properties of the "Receipt for …" email (owner reference, Reply-To, Spanish/English, outbox kind `receipt` email+text) after a **full-amount** claim, which only passed because that email went out on top of the PAID email (the bug). Each now confirms a **part-payment** claim, where the receipt email is still the email that goes out, so every assertion they make is unchanged. The closing case is covered by the REQ-1116 tests.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-40):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/one-email.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/one-email.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; `PORT=57461 deno task serve` then `BASE_URL=http://localhost:57461 SHOTS_JOBS=1 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/req-1116-claim-one-email -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1116 (LOOP-007 q3-40) / REQ-963: confirming a customer's full Zelle claim on /invoices (Okay, I got it → Mark as paid) puts exactly ONE customer email in the Outbox · 63.9s`, `1 pass · 0 fail`. Neighbours: all 28 backend test files that use ConfirmPayment / SendPaymentReceipt / MarkInvoicePaid / ComputeInvoiceBalance (confirm-payment/*, mark-invoice-paid/*, send-payment-receipt, compute-invoice-balance, outbox, customer-language, customer-branding, send-languages-lock, render-numbers, part-paid-balance, payment-controller partial-receipt, invoice-controller exports + paid-email-lang, public-controller delivery-truth / linked-invoice-refresh / owner-change-feed / receipt-channel, revisions-controller e2e, notify-on-event, notification-controller e2e, agents billing-actions) → all `ok`, 0 failed; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the 8 touched files are clean.

## REQ-1114 — The 'Paid' invoice email shows no payment instructions (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-41; extends REQ-933)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-41** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Paid-invoice email still shows payment instructions". The "Paid — Invoice INV-001" email tells a customer who has already paid how to pay ("Payment instructions — Zelle: dana@whitfieldfence.com").
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `invoiceFactsHtml(i, quote, lang, tz)` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` (~683-733) has no `paid` parameter. Whenever `i.paymentInstructions` is set, it always renders the localized "Payment instructions" heading and the `data-payment-instructions` paragraph. Both renderers also call it on the paid path: `renderInvoiceHtml` (~1779, quote-linked) and `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` (~2137, standalone, called twice). `paid=true` (MarkInvoicePaid → SendPaperworkEmail `variant: "paid"`) controls the subject, the money card, the due line, `payWays` (set to '' as "none on a paid email") and REQ-933's intro, preheader and CTA. It never reaches the facts block. The block came in with 474f09dc3 (REQ-206/202) and was localized by 783449726 (REQ-710). REQ-933 listed only the preheader, intro and button, and its fixtures had no `paymentInstructions`, so the block was missed.
**Requirement:** the paid invoice email (quote-linked and standalone, EN and ES) shows no payment instructions: no `data-payment-instructions` block, no "Payment instructions" / "Instrucciones de pago" heading, and none of the instruction text. Unpaid and part-paid emails keep them.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/paid-copy.test.ts` ("REQ-1114 (q3-41) standalone|quote-linked paid invoice email (en|es) shows no payment instructions", plus the "REQ-1114 (q3-41) control: the unpaid invoice email still shows the payment instructions" control) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/int.test.ts` ("REQ-1114 (q3-41) send-paperwork-email integration: the paid quote-linked|standalone invoice email (en|es) shows no payment instructions": SendPaperworkEmail.run variant 'paid' on a stored invoice with `paymentInstructions`, reading the captured htmlBody) · e2e n/a: this is email content only and no page renders it (like REQ-020/933).

## REQ-1117 — AMENDMENT of REQ-980 / REQ-1032: each payment way appears once in the invoice email (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-42)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-42** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Invoice email lists the payment method twice" — QA3 002 read "Payment instructions: Zelle: dana@whitfieldfence.com" and then "Ways to pay: Zelle: send to dana@whitfieldfence.com".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the invoice email prints the ways to pay from two independent sources. The invoice's `paymentInstructions` is frozen at creation by `paymentInstructionsFromMethods()` (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`) from the business's accepted methods ("Zelle: <handle>"), and `invoiceFactsHtml()` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`) always renders it under "Payment instructions" (`data-payment-instructions`). The coordinator also builds `payWaysEmailHtml()` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/pay-ways/mod.ts`) from the same `acceptedPaymentMethods` and both `renderInvoiceHtml` and `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` print the facts and then the "Ways to pay" block, with no check that the instructions only repeat it. REQ-980 (e56fef70) added the offline methods to the block so every method now appears twice, and REQ-1032 (bc3043c3) recorded "The doubled Zelle line … stays as REQ-980 chose" — this entry amends that sentence.
**Requirement:** each payment way appears once in the invoice email. When a Ways-to-pay block is rendered, a Payment instructions text that only repeats the accepted methods is not printed; any text the owner wrote beyond the method list stays; with no Ways-to-pay block (e.g. check only, REQ-630) the Payment instructions print as before. EN and ES.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/pay-ways-once.test.ts` ("REQ-1117 (q3-42) …": itemized + basic, en + es — Zelle handle once and no `data-payment-instructions`; the owner's note kept with the handle once; check-only keeps Payment instructions) · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/pay-links.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1117 (q3-42) the en/es invoice email sent through the coordinator names the Zelle handle once …") · e2e `e2e/req-1117-pay-ways-once/req-1117-pay-ways-once.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1117 (q3-42): a sent invoice email for a Zelle business names the Zelle handle once …", opened in the Outbox iframe). The fixer must also update REQ-1032's int test in `pay-links.int.test.ts`, which asserts the doubled `data-payment-instructions` line exists.

**Fix (2026-11-19):** `invoiceFactsHtml()` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`) now takes the Ways-to-pay block and the business's accepted methods; both `renderInvoiceHtml` and `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` pass them. When a block is rendered, `instructionsBesidePayWays()` filters the frozen text through the new `paymentInstructionsBeyond()` (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`, split on lines and " · " as `localizePaymentInstructions` reads it): a "<label>" / "<label>: <detail>" part goes when its method has a `data-pay-way` row in the block; the business's own "other" text goes when the "other" row shows it; a card part keeps its detail unless the block prints it (the card row only says "Pay by card"). ## REQ-1118 — /i heads a Zelle-only pay block with a neutral heading, never "Pay online" (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-43)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-43** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "/i calls a Zelle send-to card 'Pay online'" — nothing is paid online; the customer copies a handle and sends money from their own bank.
**Root cause:** `front-end/islands/PublicInvoiceClaim.tsx` `payButtonsBlock()` prints the one fixed heading `tFor(lang, "payLinks.page.heading")` ("Pay online" / "Paga en línea", `lang/en.json:5301`, `lang/es.json:5302`) whenever `payButtons()` returns anything. `payButtons()` (`shared/payments/pay-links.ts`) returns both `link` buttons (Venmo, Cash App, PayPal.me, the business's own links) and `copy` rows (Zelle, a PayPal email) in one list; the heading never checks the kinds, so a Zelle-only business gets "Pay online" over a "Zelle / Send to {handle} / Copy" card. It came in with REQ-630 (1f330efc, written for link buttons) and moved into `payButtonsBlock` with REQ-805 (5a7c48a6). REQ-630(d) only names the app and link buttons "Pay online".
**Contract:** "Pay online" / "Paga en línea" heads `link` buttons only. A block of copy rows only still has a heading, a neutral one (e.g. "Ways to pay" / "Formas de pago"). Venmo + Zelle keeps "Pay online" over the link button(s).
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/q3-43-pay-heading.test.tsx` ("REQ-1118 …": renders `PublicInvoiceClaim` with `acceptedMethods=[zelle]` → `[data-cy=pay-buttons]` has no "Pay online", es no "Paga en línea", its first child is a non-empty heading that is not "Pay online"; `[venmo, zelle]` → "Pay online" still present) · e2e `e2e/q3-43-pay-heading/q3-43-pay-heading.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1118 …": a Zelle-only business, its sent invoice's `/i/:id?lang=en` and `?lang=es` pay blocks read no "Pay online" / "Paga en línea") · integration n/a — the heading is decided entirely in the front-end island; no backend payload changes.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-43 at 0a71387e):** unit `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/q3-43-pay-heading.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 3 failed` ("only a Zelle send-to card (nothing paid online), yet the block reads: \"Pay onlineZZelleSend to (512) 555-0700Copy\""; es "pero el bloque dice: \"Paga en líneaZZelleEnvía a (512) 555-0700Copiar\""; "a neutral heading heads the Zelle card, got: \"Pay online\""); e2e → `expectation failed: en: only a Zelle send-to card, nothing paid online, yet the pay block reads "PAY ONLINE Z Zelle Send to (512) 555-0700 Copy" — expected false, got true`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** `front-end/islands/PublicInvoiceClaim.tsx` `payButtonsBlock()` now splits `payButtons()` by kind: the `link` buttons (Venmo, Cash App, PayPal.me, the business's own links) sit under "Pay online" / "Paga en línea" (`data-cy=online-pay-heading`), and the `copy` rows (Zelle, a PayPal email) sit under their own neutral heading, new key `payLinks.page.sendHeading` "Send payment" / "Envía tu pago" (`data-cy=send-pay-heading`, `lang/en.json` + `lang/es.json`). Each heading shows only when its group has a button, so a Zelle-only page reads "Send payment" over the Zelle card and never "Pay online"; Venmo + Zelle reads "Pay online" over Venmo, then "Send payment" over Zelle. The button markup moved unchanged into `renderPayButton()`. **Amends REQ-630(d):** "Pay online" names the app and link buttons only; copy rows get the "Send payment" heading. No test was changed.

## REQ-1121 — AMENDMENT of REQ-1054: the invoice email and the part-payment receipt ask for payment only when the customer can pay online (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-44)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-44** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Receipt and invoice emails say 'Pagar saldo' / 'Ver y pagar factura' when there is no way to pay online" — QA5's 002 invoice email read "Ver y pagar factura →" and its 003 receipt "Pagar saldo →", while /i read "Contacta a tu contratista para coordinar el pago."
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** REQ-1054 added `hasOnlinePayWay` (`shared/payments/pay-links.ts`) — true only for a card (the business's own Stripe/Square or a card pay link), a Venmo / Cash App / PayPal / Zelle handle, or a custom link — and wired it into exactly two places: `SendSignedConfirmation.payOnline` and the public /q payload. The invoice email picks its button from `paid` alone (`send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` rich template `L.cta`, basic template `ctaLabel`), so every unpaid invoice gets `paperworkEmail.invoice.cta` "View & pay invoice" / "Ver y pagar factura" even when the Ways-to-pay block (`payWaysEmailHtml`, "" exactly when nothing is online) is empty. The part-payment receipt added by REQ-1071 (ae10e217) renders `confirmPayment.email.payCta` "Pay the balance →" / "Pagar saldo →" (`payment-receipt/mod.ts`) whenever `balanceCents > 0 && payUrl`, and `SendPaymentReceipt` always passes the invoice shortlink as `payUrl` with no online-pay check. On a no-method or cash/check-only account /i shows the claim-no-methods fallback, so both emails promise what the page cannot do.
**Requirement:** REQ-1054's rule covers every customer email that asks for payment. With no online pay way, the unpaid invoice email's button does not say "View & pay invoice" / "Ver y pagar factura", and the part-payment receipt's button does not say "Pay the balance" / "Pagar saldo" (the balance line and a link to the invoice may stay, labelled as viewing it). With an online way (e.g. Venmo) both keep their pay CTA. EN + ES.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/payment-receipt/pay-cta-gate.test.ts` ("REQ-1121 (LOOP-007 q3-44, en|es): …" — `renderReceiptHtml({balanceCents>0, payUrl, payOnline:false})` has no payCta; `payOnline:true` keeps it) and `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/pay-cta-gate.test.ts` ("REQ-1121 …": `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` / `renderInvoiceHtml` unpaid, with the Ways-to-pay block SendPaperworkEmail would build — "" for no methods → no "View & pay"/"Ver y pagar"; Venmo → kept) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/pay-cta-gate.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1121 (LOOP-007 q3-44): …": booted app, Spanish account with no methods → POST /invoices/:id/email + POST /payments $400 check; the captured emails and GET /outbox/:id bodies carry neither CTA; the same on a Venmo account keeps both) · e2e `e2e/q3-44-pay-cta-gate/q3-44-pay-cta-gate.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1121 (LOOP-007 q3-44): …": no-method account, invoice emailed + part payment, /i shows claim-no-methods, Outbox bodies via GET /api/outbox/:id have no pay CTA; after adding Venmo both do). Note for the fixer: the unit contract for the invoice renderers is "empty Ways-to-pay block ⇒ no pay CTA" (no new parameter needed); the receipt takes a new `payOnline` option. REQ-933's control test (unpaid intro "pay whenever" with no ways) and REQ-1071's receipt-link test are not changed by this requirement.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-44 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/payment-receipt/pay-cta-gate.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/pay-cta-gate.test.ts` → `FAILED | 6 passed | 6 failed` (`the receipt still says "Pay the balance →"`, `… "Pagar saldo →"`, `the basic en invoice email's button reads "View &amp; pay invoice"`, `the quote-linked es invoice email's button reads "Ver y pagar factura"`, …; every Venmo control passes); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/pay-cta-gate.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`the emails promise online payment: invoice email: "Ver y pagar factura" | outbox invoice: "Ver y pagar factura" | receipt email: "Pagar saldo →" | outbox receipt: "Pagar saldo →"`); `shots run e2e/q3-44-pay-cta-gate -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1121 … · 13.6s · expectation failed: /i says contact the contractor, yet the invoice email in the Outbox asks to pay — expected [], got ["Ver y pagar factura"]`.
**Fix:** the invoice email's button comes from one helper, `invoiceCtaKey(paid, payWays)` (`send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`, used by both `renderInvoiceHtml` and `renderInvoiceBasicHtml`): paid → "View paid invoice" (REQ-933); unpaid with a non-empty Ways-to-pay block → "View & pay invoice"; unpaid with an empty block → the new `paperworkEmail.invoice.ctaView` "View invoice" / "Ver factura". `payWaysEmailHtml` returns "" exactly when `hasOnlinePayWay` is false (same `projectPayMethods` + card inputs), so this is REQ-1054's rule. `SendPaymentReceipt` gains the same `payOnline(userId, apm)` check `SendSignedConfirmation` uses (Stripe/Square settings + `hasOnlinePayWay`) and passes `payOnline` to `renderReceiptHtml`. With `payOnline: false` the button reads the new `confirmPayment.email.viewCta` "View the invoice →" / "Ver la factura →", and the balance line and invoice link stay. en/es keys were added before the `comms.a2p.*` block. The invoice and receipt SMS were not changed (out of scope for q3-44).
**Test correction (e2e):** `e2e/q3-44-pay-cta-gate` compared arrays with shots' `expect.eq`, which is strict `!==`, so `[]` never equals `[]` and the story could never pass. It now compares `found(...).join(" | ")` with `""`. The assertion is the same (no pay CTA in the Outbox bodies), and a leak still reports the leaked words.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-44):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/payment-receipt/pay-cta-gate.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/pay-cta-gate.test.ts` → `ok | 12 passed | 0 failed`. Neighbours + integration: `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/payment-receipt/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-payment-receipt/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/confirm-payment/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/ src/paperwork/domain/business/email-html-lang.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-numbers.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/paid-email-lang.int.test.ts` → `ok | 247 passed | 0 failed` (includes `payment-controller/pay-cta-gate.int.test.ts`). `deno check` + `deno lint` on the 3 touched modules are clean. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit …` → `Test Suites: 679 passed`. E2E against a warm `PORT=53300 deno task serve`: `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53300 SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/q3-44-pay-cta-gate -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1121 … · 26.1s`, and the neighbours `e2e/q2-37-pay-online-gate` → `✓ REQ-1054`, `e2e/req-963-partial-receipt` → `✓ REQ-963`, `✓ REQ-1071`. ## REQ-1119 — AMENDMENT of REQ-1080: the invoice's Bill-to phone follows the one phone rule, and the customer API refuses undeclared keys (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-45, q3-46, q3-47)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues, cycle 3: **q3-45** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Invoice form accepts a phone with an extension, shows it cleaned, recommends text, then the send fails with a raw error"; **q3-46** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Customer sees the raw phone '843-555-0145 x12' on /i"; **q3-47** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Customer phone stored but the customer page shows Phone '—' (API 'phone' field, or a value with an extension)".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** REQ-1080's one phone rule (`customerPhoneE164`) was applied to POST/PUT /customers only; nothing on the invoice's Bill-to phone calls it. The New invoice Bill to → Phone input (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` ~6226, REQ-593) shows `formatPhoneInput(raw)`, which keeps 10 digits, so "843-555-0145 x12" reads "(843) 555-0145" while the raw text stays in state; `newInvoiceFieldErrors` (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`) checks the bill email, never the bill phone; POST/PUT /invoices store `dto.billTo` as sent (`CreateInvoiceDto.billTo` is `@IsObject` only), and `billToCustomerPlan` quietly drops the bad phone from the customer it creates — so /i shows the raw string (`fmtPhone` returns non-10-digit input unchanged) and the customer page reads "Phone —". The send sheet's `recommendedChannel` / `defaultSendChannel` (`front-end/lib/send-dialog.ts`) count any non-blank phone that `phoneCantReceiveTexts` does not flag, and that predicate answers false for an unparseable number, so the sheet recommends "Text + Email"; `dispatchCustomerSms` (`customer-sms/mod.ts` ~80) then returns the untranslated `invalid phone: ${to}`, shown as "The text didn't go through: invalid phone: …". Separately (q3-47 leg A), `parseCreateCustomer` / `parseUpdateCustomer` (`backend/src/crm/dto/customer.ts`) call `validateSync(dto)` without `whitelist`/`forbidNonWhitelisted`, and `CustomerStore.create` spreads `...input`, so `{phone:"843-555-0111"}` (or `deletedAt`, `isAdmin`) is saved and returned by GET while every screen reads only `phoneNumber`.
**Requirement:** the invoice's Bill-to phone obeys the same rule as a customer's phone: the New invoice form names a phone the rule refuses under the field (`billPhone: customer.invalidPhone`), never hides an extension in its display, and does not issue; POST/PUT /invoices refuse such a `billTo.phoneNumber` with 400 `customer.invalidPhone`, storing nothing; the send sheet never recommends or starts on a text to a phone the send path cannot parse (email is recommended, Text carries a hint); an "invalid" text failure is dictionary copy in the contractor's language, never `invalid phone: …`; a valid Bill-to phone lands on the bill-to customer. POST/PUT /customers refuse an undeclared key (`phone`, `deletedAt`, …) with a 400 instead of saving it.
**Tests:**
- unit (deno) `backend/src/crm/dto/customer.test.ts` ("REQ-1119 q3-47 parseCreateCustomer refuses the undeclared key …" ×4, "REQ-1119 q3-47 parseUpdateCustomer refuses the undeclared key `phone` …") · `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/customer-sms/mod.test.ts` ("REQ-1119 q3-45 dispatchCustomerSms: an invalid phone's reason is translated copy, never the raw 'invalid phone: …'")
- unit (jest) `jest/unit/invoice-bill-phone.test.ts` ("REQ-1119 a Bill-to phone '…' is refused on the billPhone field" ×3 + 3 controls; "REQ-1119 recommendedChannel / defaultSendChannel / channelNeedsKey … extension phone"; "REQ-1119 an invoice billed to '843-555-0145 x12' opens the sheet on email")

(5) `backend/src/crm/dto/customer.ts` validates with `{ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true }`, so an undeclared key (`phone`, `deletedAt`, `isAdmin`) is a 400, never saved (every front-end caller sends declared keys only).
