## REQ-1120 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-48 + q3-49: the New-worker and editor-invite Phone boxes take a number typed the way their placeholder shows
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues, cycle 3: **q3-48** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Worker phone field (maxlength=10) truncates a number typed the way its placeholder shows" (/field/workers → New worker) and **q3-49** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Editor invite phone field truncates a formatted number, then Invite silently does nothing" (/admins → Invite an editor).
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** both Phone inputs (`front-end/islands/FieldWorkersPage.tsx` data-cy=wk-phone, from fd52cfa2 REQ-137..143; `front-end/islands/AdminsPage.tsx` data-cy=adm-phone, from d346384e REQ-146) show the placeholder `PHONE_PLACEHOLDER` "(555) 123-4567" (14 characters, `front-end/lib/field.ts`) but carry `maxlength={10}` and `pattern="\d{10}"`. The browser cuts a paste or fill to 10 raw characters before the island's onInput strips non-digits, so "843-555-0123" becomes "843-555-01" → "84355501" and "(843) 555-0123" becomes "(843) 555-" → "843555". The worker add is then refused ("Enter a 10-digit cell number."). On /admins `phoneOk` (`form.phone.length === 10`) is false, so Invite is disabled and `submit()` returns early, and there is no phone error element, so nothing says why. The backend already accepts formatted numbers (`backend/src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts`).
**Requirement:** both Phone boxes accept a US cell typed as "843-555-0123", "(843) 555-0123" or "+1 (843) 555-0123" and keep its 10 digits (a leading US "1" dropped); the worker is added and the editor invited with that number; on /admins a number that really is short shows `adm-phone-error` under the Phone box (aria-invalid), so Invite is never silently inert.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/phone-box-formatted-q3-48.test.ts` ("REQ-1120 …": reads the real wk-phone / adm-phone input attributes, models the browser's maxlength cut followed by the digit strip, and expects 10 digits for each formatted input; the box must fit its placeholder and "+1 (843) 555-0123", and any pattern must accept the placeholder) · int n/a — client-only defect; the backend already accepts formatted numbers (field.int.test.ts) · e2e `e2e/phone-box-formatted/phone-box-formatted.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1120 (LOOP-007 q3-48) …": page.fill a dashed and a parenthesised number into wk-phone, the box holds 10 digits, the POST is 201 and the row shows "(843) …"; "REQ-1120 (LOOP-007 q3-49) …": the same on adm-phone, Invite enabled, the row listed, adm-sent shown, then "84355" + blur shows adm-phone-error with aria-invalid).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-48 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern phone-box-formatted-q3-48` → `Tests: 10 failed, 2 passed, 12 total` (`Expected: >= 14 Received: 10`; `Expected: "8435550123" Received: "84355501"`; `Received: "843555"`; `Received: "18435"`, for both wk-phone and adm-phone); `shots run e2e/phone-box-formatted -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1120 (LOOP-007 q3-48) … expectation failed: the box holds all 10 digits of "843-924-8478" — expected "8439248478", got "84392484"`, `✗ REQ-1120 (LOOP-007 q3-49) … expectation failed: the box holds all 10 digits of "(843) 599-2600" — expected "8435992600", got "843599"`.
**Fix:** one shared phone-box rule in `front-end/lib/field.ts`: `cellDigits(raw)` (strip non-digits, drop a leading US "1" from 11 digits, keep 10) and `PHONE_BOX_MAXLEN = 20` (room for the placeholder and "+1 (843) 555-0123", so the browser's maxlength cut can no longer run ahead of the digit strip). Both `wk-phone` (FieldWorkersPage.tsx) and `adm-phone` (AdminsPage.tsx) use them, and their `maxlength={10}` / `pattern="\d{10}"` are gone; the 10-digit check stays in JS (`boxErr("phone")` on /field/workers, `phoneOk` on /admins). On /admins the Phone box now has `adm-phone-error` (existing en/es key `admins.err.bad_phone`, no new lang keys) with aria-invalid/aria-describedby, shown after blur or on a refused submit, cleared with the form after a sent invite.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-48):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern phone-box-formatted-q3-48` → `Tests: 12 passed, 12 total`; the unit lane over every suite naming AdminsPage/FieldWorkersPage/lib/field/maxlength → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6543 passed` (field-sample-leftovers REQ-363 pins "no (843) in field.ts", so the new doc comments use 555 numbers); `cd front-end && deno lint lib/field.ts islands/FieldWorkersPage.tsx islands/AdminsPage.tsx` → `Checked 3 files`; `deno check` same files → clean; `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> BASE_URL=<own serve on a random port> SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/phone-box-formatted -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1120 (LOOP-007 q3-48) … 56.5s`, `✓ REQ-1120 (LOOP-007 q3-49) … 45s`, `2 pass · 0 fail` (a private SHOTS_DIR + a server already up: shots' own serve ran the stories before the backend listened, and a parallel run shared the default evidence dir). Neighbour stories that drive wk-phone/adm-phone (actor-name, admin-invite-login-link, field-worker-form-hints, field-tasks, invite-share-link, sms-fictional-guard, field-sample-leftovers, field-worker-errors, timeclock, account-admins): `49 pass · 3 fail`. The 3 failures are not from this change: REQ-520 expects copy ("Workers get their texts in Spanish unless you switch the language here.") that is no longer in lang/en.json at 0a71387e; REQ-144 timed out on a click and passed on a re-run; REQ-143 adds its worker through wk-phone fine and then fails at /field/tasks "No tasks this day." (field-tasks.e2e.test.ts:299). The field-tasks re-run alone (24 pass · 8 fail, all click timeouts or later /field/tasks steps) was on a host at load average ~120 on 16 cores.

## REQ-1122 — AMENDMENT of REQ-960: a /payments card never doubles the payment method (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-50)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-50** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Payment card doubles the method: 'Check Check #1042 from Greg.'"
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `noteFor()` in `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` always puts the method word in front of the raw reference — `paymentsPage.note.checkRef` "Check {ref} from {name}." / "Cheque {ref} de {name}." — and never checks whether the reference already starts with the method word. The Mark-paid / Record-a-payment reference placeholder (`markPaid.referencePlaceholder` "e.g. check #1042" / "p. ej. cheque #1042", `MarkPaidDialog.tsx`) teaches owners to type exactly that, so "Check #1042" becomes "Check Check #1042 from Greg." (es "Cheque Check #1042 de Greg."). The other methods' `withRef` path has the same flaw ("Cash from Greg. Ref Cash 12."). Added by 31461d36 (REQ-960, q1-36), whose test only used a bare ref "1042".
**Requirement:** the card line states the method once. A reference that already starts with the method word (any case, EN or ES: check/cheque/chk/ck for checks; the method's own label, e.g. cash/efectivo, for others) is not prefixed again: ref "Check #1042" → "Check #1042 from Greg." / "Cheque #1042 de Greg."; a bare "1042" stays "Check 1042 from Greg.". The stored reference is not changed.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/payments-note-no-double-method.test.ts` ("REQ-1122 …": the real `noteFor` lifted from the island together with any same-file top-level helper it calls, run on both dictionaries — "Check #1042", "CHECK 1042", "check #1042", es "cheque #1042" and "Check #1042" give the once-worded line; bare "1042" unchanged; cash refs "Cash 12"/"Efectivo 12" carry the method word once) · int n/a — front-end copy only; the backend already stores the reference as typed (the e2e asserts it) · e2e `e2e/payment-note-facts/payment-note-facts.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1122 q3-50 (en|es) …": Check $400 to Greg Pruitt with ref "Check #1042" recorded → the /payments card front `.qcard__story` reads exactly "Check #1042 from Greg." / "Cheque #1042 de Greg."). Contract for the fixer: `noteFor` stays a top-level function in `PaymentsPage.tsx`; a helper it uses must be a top-level function in the same file (the lifter follows calls) or inlined.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-50 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern payments-note-no-double-method` → `7 failed, 2 passed` (`Expected: "Check #1042 from Greg."  Received: "Check Check #1042 from Greg."`; `Received string: "Check CHECK 1042 from Greg."`; `"Check check #1042 from Greg."`; `Expected: "Cheque #1042 de Greg."  Received: "Cheque cheque #1042 de Greg."`; `"Cheque Check #1042 de Greg."`; `Received: "Cash 12 → Cash from Greg. Ref Cash 12.: 2"`). `PORT=5917 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5917 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/payment-note-facts -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1122 q3-50 (en) … expectation failed: the card front does not double the method: "Check Check #1042 from Greg."`, `✗ REQ-1122 q3-50 (es) … "Cheque Check #1042 de Greg."` (REQ-960's neighbours stay ✓).
**Fix:** `noteFor()` in `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` now takes a leading word naming the method the line already states off the typed reference before building the sentence — check: check/cheque/chq/chk/ck; cash: cash/efectivo; card: card/tarjeta; ach: ach (any case, optional "." and separator). A ref that is only the method word counts as no ref. Methods whose line does not name them (venmo, zelle, cashapp, paypal, other → "Payment from …") keep the ref as typed. The logic is inlined in `noteFor` rather than a helper, because REQ-960's `jest/unit/payments-note.test.ts` lifts `noteFor` alone. The stored reference and the placeholder are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-50):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern payments-note` → `Test Suites: 2 passed; Tests: 18 passed` (REQ-1122 9/9 + REQ-960). Full jest unit lane → `Tests: 1 skipped, 6540 passed, 6541 total`. `cd front-end && deno lint islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` → `Checked 1 file`; `deno check islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` → clean; `deno fmt -` (stdin) → no diff. `PORT=5917 KV_PATH=:memory: deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5917 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/payment-note-facts -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1122 q3-50 (en) … 87.5s`, `✓ REQ-1122 q3-50 (es) … 88.7s`, `✓ REQ-960 q1-36 (en)`, `✓ REQ-960 q1-36 (es)`.

## REQ-1123 — AMENDMENT of REQ-982 / REQ-691: the /payments card back offers "Text client" only for a phone that can take a text (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-51)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-51** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Payment trail offers 'Text client' for a number that can't take texts" — Marisol's (843) 555-0123 is flagged by the send sheet, yet her /payments INV-001 card back has a "Text client" link (→ /clients?open=…).
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the REQ-691/REQ-982 gate was only added to the /invoices card back (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx`, `textClientState` → "Can't receive texts" / "Fix the phone" / "Add a phone"). The /payments "Payment trail" footer, added by REQ-626 (e8b435f1), always renders `<a data-cy="pay-card-text" href={clientHref}>` with `paymentsPage.card.textClient` (`front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` ~1067-1074). It cannot even ask the rule: PaymentsPage keeps only a `customerNames` id→name map (~355), `enrich()` (~258) carries no phone, so `invoiceTextPhone()` / `textClientState()` from `front-end/lib/invoice-text-client.ts` (fictional 555-01XX via `shared/quote-flow/sms-number.ts`) are never called on /payments.
**Requirement:** the /payments card back shows "Text client" only when the phone the backend would text (`invoiceTextPhone`) passes the shared rule (`textClientState === "ok"`); a phone that can't receive texts shows a can't-text note (`data-cy="pay-card-cant-text"`), and a missing/invalid one gets the same fallback the invoice card uses (Add a phone / Fix the phone), en + es. A customer with a real phone keeps "Text client".
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/c5-preview-ask-textclient.test.tsx` ("REQ-1123 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-51): …": the PaymentsPage card back's Text client is gated on textClientState / canTextClient and the island resolves the phone with invoiceTextPhone; the back has a `pay-card-cant-text` fallback; its can't-text label key exists in en + es and differs from Text client) · integration n/a — nothing changes in the backend or on the wire; the customer phone already comes back from GET /customers · e2e `e2e/c5-preview-ask-textclient/c5-preview-ask-textclient.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1123 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-51): …": Marisol (843) 555-0123 and Ana +15128675309, a sent invoice + a recorded check payment each; /payments, flip both cards; Marisol: no `pay-card-text`, one `pay-card-cant-text`; Ana: Text client kept). The fixer must also update `jest/unit/card-actions.test.ts` (REQ-626 "payment card's four targets"), which pins an unconditional Text client href.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-51 at 0a71387e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/c5-preview-ask-textclient.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 11 passed | 4 failed` (`the /payments card back's Text client is gated on textClientState / canTextClient — today pay-card-text renders unconditionally`; `the /payments card back has a can't-text fallback (data-cy pay-card-cant-text)`; en/es `the /payments card back names a can't-text label key … — today its only label is paymentsPage.card.textClient`); `SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/c5-preview-ask-textclient -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1123 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-51): … · 63.4s · expectation failed: no "Text client" on Marisol's payment card — (843) 555-0123 can't receive texts: Payment trail$420.00· Other (Check)Check from Marisol.ReceiptView invoiceText client — expected 0, got 1` (the REQ-691 and REQ-982 stories in the same file pass).
**Fix (fix/q3-q3-51):** `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` keeps a `customerById` map next to `customerNames`; `enrich()` resolves the phone with `invoiceTextPhone(inv, customerById.get(inv.customerId))` and stores `textState = textClientState(phone)` on each `EnrichedPayment`. The card back's third button is `pay-card-text` ("Text client") only when `textState === "ok"`; otherwise it is `pay-card-cant-text` ("Can't receive texts", title `asstChat.send.cantText`), `pay-card-fix-phone` ("Fix the phone") or `pay-card-add-phone` ("Add a phone"), each linking to the client's sheet (`clientHref`). New keys `paymentsPage.card.addPhone/cantText/fixPhone` in en + es. `jest/unit/card-actions.test.ts` (REQ-626) now also pins that Text client is gated on `p.textState === "ok"` and that every fallback still opens `clientHref`. None of the test-writer's assertions changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-51):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/c5-preview-ask-textclient.test.tsx` → `ok | 15 passed | 0 failed`; `SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/c5-preview-ask-textclient -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1123 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-51): the /payments card back offers no Text client for a phone that can't receive texts, and keeps it for a real one · 78.8s`, `7 pass · 0 fail · 0 skipped`; neighbours: `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --runTestsByPath unit/card-actions.test.ts unit/payments-note.test.ts unit/payment-claims.test.ts unit/paid-how.test.ts unit/payment-record-search.test.ts unit/q1-35-owner-cents.test.ts unit/search-select-i18n.test.ts unit/es-copy-plurals-c1.test.ts unit/cash-flow-weeks.test.ts unit/svg-kebab-attrs.test.ts unit/invoice-card-refresh.test.ts unit/i18n-dictionary-consistency.test.ts` → `Tests: 202 passed, 202 total`; `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/mark-paid-dialog.test.tsx lib/payment-card.test.ts lib/paid-this-month.test.ts` → `ok | 15 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` → `Checked 1 file`; `deno check islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` → clean.

## REQ-1124 — AMENDMENT of REQ-926 / REQ-984: a chargeback on an amount-only invoice makes up no "Services" line, and the /i heading stays "Invoice INV-…" (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-52)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-52** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "After a chargeback the customer's invoice is retitled 'Services' and gains a line table" — /i read "Invoice INV-002" before a $35 chargeback and "Services" after, with JOB DETAILS "Services $1,000.50 / Chargeback fee $35.00".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** two pieces that each follow their own requirement. `withChargebackFee` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/chargeback/mod.ts`, REQ-926, 0a417179) turns an amount-only invoice into lines; with no `jobName` and no `description` its base line is the hard-coded English `"Services"`, whatever `inv.lang` is. REQ-984's `invoiceTitle` (`shared/documents/linked-view.ts`) heads /i with the job, else the summary, else the FIRST line's description, else "Invoice INV-…". Before the chargeback there are no lines, so the h1 is "Invoice INV-002"; after it, the first line is the made-up "Services", so the h1 (`front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx`) becomes "Services" — in English on a Spanish bill too. `withoutChargebackFee` removes only the `chargebackFor` fee line, so after Undo the made-up base line stays and the invoice stays itemized and titled "Services". ("Version 1" stays: REQ-926 chose no revision on purpose.)
**Requirement:** a chargeback on an amount-only invoice never puts a made-up English "Services" line on it. The base line it adds is honest and in the invoice's language, and is tagged as the chargeback's own (`chargebackBase: <paymentId>`); the customer's /i heading stays "Invoice INV-…" / "Factura INV-…" (chargeback lines never become the title); Undo of the last fee takes the tagged base line off too, so the invoice is amount-only again (no lines).
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/chargeback/test.ts` ("REQ-1124 (q3-52) withChargebackFee: a bare amount-only invoice (en|es) gets no made-up "Services" line …", "REQ-1124 (q3-52) withoutChargebackFee: undoing the only chargeback … gives back NO lines …") · int `front-end/lib/chargeback-invoice-title.int.test.tsx` ("REQ-1124 (q3-52) int: …": real backend in process, KV :memory:, amount-only invoice → payment → POST /payments/:id/chargeback {feeCents:3500} → server-rendered /i h1 is "Invoice INV-…" (en) / "Factura INV-…" (es); undo → invoice `lineItems` is []) · e2e `e2e/payment-chargeback/payment-chargeback.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1124 (q3-52): a chargeback on an amount-only invoice keeps the customer's /i heading …": opens /i?as=customer before and after the chargeback, then undoes and checks no lines).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-52 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/chargeback/test.ts` → `FAILED | 3 passed | 3 failed` (`Expected actual: "Services" not to be: "Services": the base line is the made-up English placeholder "Services" (en)` and `(es)`; undo diff `- [{ description: "Services", price: 100050, quantity: 1, unit: "ea" }]` / `+ []`); `cd front-end && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check lib/chargeback-invoice-title.int.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`after the chargeback the EN heading is "Services"` — `- Services` / `+ Invoice INV-001`); `SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/payment-chargeback -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1124 (q3-52): … · expectation failed: the heading became "Services"`.
**Fix:** `withChargebackFee` gives an amount-only invoice's made-up base line the tag `chargebackBase: <paymentId>`. With no job name or description, the line reads an honest "Invoice amount" / "Importe de la factura" (`CHARGEBACK_BASE_LABEL`) in the invoice's language, with both texts in `descriptionByLang` when `lang` is set. `withoutChargebackFee` also takes off the tagged base line once no chargeback fee line is left, so Undo returns the invoice to amount-only. `invoiceTitle` (`shared/documents/linked-view.ts`) takes `lines` (with flags) and skips `chargebackFor` / `chargebackBase` lines, so a chargeback never retitles a bill. /i (`front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx`) and the invoice PDF hero (`render-invoice-pdf`) pass `lines`. The public projection of a standalone invoice's own lines (`public-controller`) keeps the two flags. The DTOs and `LineItem` declare `chargebackBase`. The invoice email's hero is unchanged because its lines come only from the quote, never from the invoice's chargeback lines.
**Test change (REQ-926 unit, `chargeback/test.ts`, "an amount-only invoice first gets its amount as one line"):** the expected base line `{description:"Fence stain",…}` now also has `chargebackBase: "pay-2"`. This is required by this amendment, because every made-up base line is the chargeback's own, so that Undo can take it off. The assertion is not weakened. Also added: unit `front-end/lib/invoice-headline-flip.test.ts` "REQ-1124 (q3-52): invoiceTitle skips a chargeback's own lines …".

## REQ-1126 — An invoice that is already past due when it is emailed never says "pay whenever you're ready", and its Status reads Overdue (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-54)

**User's words (Raphael):** "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green."

**Issue:** q3-54 [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] — "An invoice issued already overdue emails as 'pay whenever you're ready'". QA: /invoices → New invoice, Issue date 2026-10-01, Net 7, Issue → Email. The board says "42d overdue"; the customer's email says "Status Sent" and "Tap below to review it and pay whenever you're ready" (es: "pagar cuando quieras").

**Root cause:** the invoice email picks its intro and Status from the `paid` flag and the stored `status` only, never comparing `dueDate` with today. Both renderers in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` (itemized `renderInvoiceHtml` ~1881, standalone `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` ~2159) use `paid ? "paperworkEmail.invoicePaid.intro" : "paperworkEmail.invoice.intro"`, so every unpaid bill gets "pay whenever you're ready". The Status row (`invoiceEmailStatus` → `shared/quote-flow/email-format.ts` `invoiceEmailStatusKey`) falls through to the stored status, and "overdue" is never stored (`shared/documents/invoice-status.ts` derives it at read time), so a past-due bill reads "Sent". REQ-962 allows a backdated issue date, so a bill can be overdue the moment it is issued.

**Tests:**
- unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/past-due-copy.test.ts` ("REQ-1126 (LOOP-007 q3-54) …"): `renderInvoiceHtml` + `renderInvoiceBasicHtml`, en + es, due 2026-10-08 → no "whenever you" / "cuando quieras"; standalone Status = `invoiceStatusLabel("overdue")` ("Overdue" / "Vencida"); `invoiceEmailStatusKey({status:"sent", dueDate:"2026-10-08"})` = "overdue"; controls: a 2099-12-31 due date keeps the old intro and "Sent", paid/void stay paid/void.
- int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/past-due.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1126 (LOOP-007 q3-54) …"): KV :memory:, a sent invoice issued 2026-10-01 due 2026-10-08 (standalone and quote-linked) → `SendPaperworkEmail.run` en + es → captured htmlBody has no "whenever you" / "cuando quieras"; standalone Status = Overdue / Vencida.
- e2e `e2e/invoice-overdue-at-issue/invoice-overdue-at-issue.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1126 q3-54 …"): /invoices?new=1, Issue date 2026-10-01, Net 7 (due 2026-10-08), Issue → send sheet → Email → newest /api/outbox invoice email has no "whenever you're ready" and its Status reads "Overdue".

**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, at 0a71387e):** unit `FAILED | 7 passed | 7 failed` (the 7 controls pass); int `FAILED | 0 passed | 6 failed`; e2e `✗ … expectation failed: the past-due email does not say "whenever you're ready" (got "… Tap below to review it and pay whenever you're ready.")`.

**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `shared/quote-flow/email-format.ts` `invoiceEmailStatusKey(i, now = new Date())` returns `"overdue"` for an open bill (not void / paid / claimed / draft / scheduled) whose due date has passed, using the board's own rule `isInvoiceOverdue` from `shared/documents/invoice-status.ts` (REQ-966, the same predicate behind GET /invoices' `urgency` and the CSV Status), so the email, the board and the CSV cannot drift; overdue outranks "partly paid" as in REQ-966. The Status row therefore reads "Overdue" / "Vencida" (existing `invoiceStatusLabel` entries). (2) `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` — new `invoiceEmailPastDue(i, paid)` (= not paid and the status key is "overdue") and `invoiceEmailIntro(...)`; both renderers (`renderInvoiceHtml` and `renderInvoiceBasicHtml`) pick paid → `paperworkEmail.invoicePaid.intro`, past due → new `paperworkEmail.invoiceOverdue.intro` ("… It was due {dueDate} and is now past due; tap below to review it and pay." / "… Vencía el {dueDate} y ya está vencida; toca abajo para revisarla y pagarla."), otherwise the old intro; the standalone email's preheader uses new `paperworkEmail.invoiceOverdue.preheader` ("… past due since {dueDate}" / "… vencida desde el {dueDate}"). The en + es keys were added together after `paperworkEmail.invoicePaid.cta`. No test was changed.

**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && NO_COLOR=1 deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/past-due-copy.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/past-due.int.test.ts` → `ok | 20 passed | 0 failed`; e2e `PORT=48593 KV_PATH=<scratch> deno task serve` + `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:48593 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/invoice-overdue-at-issue -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1126 q3-54 … · 41.2s`, `1 pass · 0 fail`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/preview-invoice-send/ src/paperwork/domain/business/invoice-aging/` → `ok | 120 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit invoice-polish email-i18n a2p-panel` (ran the unit lane) → every suite PASS, incl. `i18n-dictionary-consistency`, `email-i18n`, `invoice-polish`, `landing-no-trial`; `deno lint` on the two touched .ts files clean; `deno fmt --check -` (stdin) clean on both; lang/en.json + lang/es.json parse as JSON.

## REQ-1127 — AMENDMENT of REQ-946: a standalone itemized invoice's email lists each line with its price (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-55)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-55** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Invoice email lists line items without their prices". A standalone INV-003 with service lines "Gate repair" $180.10 + "Hinge hardware" $45.20 was emailed. The email showed only "Gate repair, Hinge hardware" and the $225.30 subtotal, while the /i page and the PDF list both prices.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `renderInvoiceHtml` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts` ~L1615-1637) builds its line items only from the linked QUOTE: `items = quoteItems.length ? agreementLineItems(...) : quoteItems`. A standalone invoice has no quote, so `items` is [] and `agreementTotal` is undefined. The invoice then goes to `renderInvoiceBasicHtml`, the "Lightweight amount-only invoice email (the original)" (9d773fe22). That function reads `i.lineItems` only through `groupVisits` (REQ-173 batch visits), which returns null for plain service lines. So the email prints the jobName, the Invoice details table, the amount and the subtotal, and no line rows. REQ-921 (624d6d26) made every new standalone invoice a list of service+price rows, with jobName = `jobNameFromServices(lines)` (the names joined with ", "). The email was never updated for that, and REQ-946's "the invoice emails still show the line items" was only applied to the quote-backed path.
**Requirement:** when a standalone (quote-less) invoice has its own line items, the invoice email lists each line with its price (line total, plus the qty × each sub-line when qty > 1), in en and es. This matches the invoice's /i page and PDF. REQ-173 visit grouping still applies to batch visits, and a truly amount-only invoice keeps today's look.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/standalone-lines.test.ts` ("REQ-1127 (q3-55) en|es: the email of a standalone two-line invoice prints each line's price": the real `renderInvoiceHtml` with no quote; expects $180.10, $45.20 and $225.30) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/standalone-lines.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1127 (q3-55) send-paperwork-email en|es: the sent email of a standalone two-line invoice carries both line prices": the real `SendPaperworkEmail.run` on a KV :memory: invoice, captures htmlBody) · e2e `e2e/invoice-email-line-prices/invoice-email-line-prices.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1127 (q3-55): the emailed standalone two-service invoice shows each line's price …": POST /api/invoices with the New-invoice payload, POST …/email, open it from /messages, read the outbox frame).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-55 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/standalone-lines.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/standalone-lines.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 4 failed` (`the "Gate repair" line's price $180.10 is missing from the email: …pay whenever you're ready. Gate repair, Hinge hardware Invoice details … Amount due $225.30 Subtotal $225.30 View & pay invoice`; `the sent invoice email never prices "Gate repair" ($180.10)`, en and es); `PORT=<random> SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/invoice-email-line-prices -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1127 (q3-55): … expectation failed: the "Gate repair" line's price $180.10 is in the email: "… Gate repair, Hinge hardware INVOICE DETAILS … AMOUNT DUE $225.30 Subtotal $225.30 View & pay invoice →…"`.
**Fix:** `renderInvoiceBasicHtml` (the standalone invoice email, `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`) now prices the invoice's own `lineItems` under the job name, in the email's language (`localizeLineItems(invoiceLineItemsByLang(i, i.lineItems), lang, i.lang)`, REQ-710). It reuses the itemized email's row markup, extracted to `invoiceLineRowsHtml` (name, "2 ea · $X each" when qty > 1, right-aligned line total), so both emails draw lines the same way. REQ-173 batch visits keep their grouping. A bill with no lines, or one qty-1 line that only repeats the job name (or sits under its own description note), keeps the original amount-only look.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-55):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/standalone-lines.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/standalone-lines.int.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`; neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/*.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/preview-invoice-send src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-numbers.int.test.ts src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-invoice src/field/entrypoints/batch-email-dates.int.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/paperwork-email-controller src/communication/domain/data/email-service/test.ts` → `ok | 134 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on mod.ts clean; e2e `PORT=51733 deno task serve` then `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> BASE_URL=http://localhost:51733 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/invoice-email-line-prices -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1127 (q3-55): the emailed standalone two-service invoice shows each line's price ($180.10, $45.20), not only the $225.30 subtotal · 55.8s` (1 pass · 0 fail).

## REQ-1128 — AMENDMENT of REQ-966: an invoice due today is not overdue; the CSV, GET /invoices urgency, /i and /invoices share one rule (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-56)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-56** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "CSV export calls an invoice due today 'overdue'; the app says it isn't" — at 2026-11-19T12:34Z the CSV row read `INV-002,1,overdue,…,2026-11-19,…` while /invoices listed only INV-003 as overdue and the customer page said "Nothing overdue".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the app has three overdue rules. The CSV Status column (`shared/documents/exports.ts` `invoiceExportRow` → `invoiceDisplayStatus`) and the backend's `invoice-aging.isOverdue` (behind GET /invoices `urgency`, `deriveUrgency` and the aging buckets) all call `isInvoiceOverdue` (`shared/documents/invoice-status.ts`), which returns `new Date(dueDate).getTime() < now.getTime()`. A bare "2026-11-19" parses as 2026-11-19T00:00:00Z, so an unpaid invoice is "overdue" from the first second of its due day. /i and the PDF (`isPastDue`, `${dueDate}T23:59:59Z`) and the /invoices card (`InvoicesPage.enrich`, `due < today`) count the whole due day as not yet overdue. The start-of-day rule came in with b3ac032c (REQ-966, which wrote "dueDate < now (same rule as isOverdue)" while promising the CSV shows "the status the app shows").
**Requirement:** a due date is due through its whole day: an invoice becomes overdue only once its due day has ended. The CSV Status, GET /invoices `urgency`, /i's pill and the /invoices card give the same answer for the same invoice and instant (a part-paid invoice due today exports "partly paid", an unpaid sent one "sent"; from the next day both "overdue").
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/loop7-q3-56-due-today-not-overdue.test.ts` ("REQ-1128 …": due 2026-11-19 at 12:34Z and 00:00:01Z → `isInvoiceOverdue` false, agreeing with `isPastDue` at five instants; `invoiceDisplayStatus` / `invoiceExportRow` Status "partly paid" / "sent"; at 2026-11-20T00:00:01Z → "overdue") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/exports.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1128 q3-56 GET /invoices/export.csv?status=all: an invoice due today … is NOT 'overdue' …": two invoices due today (UTC), one part-paid over POST /payments; CSV Status cells and GET /invoices `urgency`) · e2e n/a — the CSV is a download and the int test drives the same HTTP path; the /invoices card already counts the due day as not overdue.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-56 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern loop7-q3-56` → `Tests: 5 failed, 1 passed, 6 total` (`isInvoiceOverdue` at 00:00:01Z `Expected: false Received: true`; parity `["2026-11-19T00:00:01.000Z", true]` vs `false`; `Expected: "partly paid" Received: "overdue"`; `Expected: "sent" Received: "overdue"`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/exports.int.test.ts --filter REQ-1128` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`- "overdue", - "overdue" / + "partly paid", + "sent"`).
**Fix:** `isInvoiceOverdue` (`shared/documents/invoice-status.ts`) now returns `isPastDue(dueDate, now)` — overdue only once the due day has ended (after `${dueDate}T23:59:59Z`) — instead of `new Date(dueDate) < now`. That one rule feeds the CSV Status (`invoiceDisplayStatus` → `invoiceExportRow`), the backend's `invoice-aging.isOverdue` (GET /invoices `urgency` via `deriveUrgency`, and `bucketPendingInvoices`), and /i's pill. The /invoices card (`front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` `enrich`) no longer keeps its own `due < today` string compare: it calls the same `isInvoiceOverdue`, and its `daysOverdue` is at least 1 once overdue, so a browser west of UTC (where `new Date(due + "T00:00:00")` is local midnight) cannot read 0 days and drop the card back to "Out for payment" on the first night. `deriveUrgency`'s "soon" math is unchanged: on the due day the gap is ≤ 0, which is still "soon". Business time zone: still UTC everywhere, as before (out of scope).
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-56):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern loop7-q3-56` → `Tests: 6 passed, 6 total`; `cd backend && NO_COLOR=1 deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/exports.int.test.ts --filter REQ-1128` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed | 4 filtered out`. Neighbours: the whole exports.int.test.ts → `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`; invoice-aging / invoice-aging-buckets / invoice-urgency → `ok | 17 passed | 0 failed`; every backend test under src/paperwork, src/analytics, src/agents that mentions urgency/overdue/aging → `ok | 245 passed | 0 failed`; jest unit over every suite that reads InvoicesPage or invoice-status → `Tests: 1 skipped, 6537 passed, 6538 total`; `cd front-end && deno lint islands/InvoicesPage.tsx ../shared/documents/invoice-status.ts` → `Checked 2 files`; `deno check` on both → clean.

## REQ-1129 — AMENDMENT of REQ-019 / REQ-926: /payments "Export this month" downloads this month's payments, and the payments CSV keeps charged-back payments (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-57)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-57** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Payments 'Export this month' exports invoices, and the payments export omits chargebacks". A $400.25 check was recorded on INV-002 and charged back with a $35 fee. "Export this month" then downloaded the paid-invoice export, which had one INV-001 row, and /api/payments/export.csv held only the INV-001 Zelle row.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** there are two faults. (1) `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` hard-codes `exportHref = /api/invoices/export.csv?year=Y&month=M`, a leftover from REQ-019 (3e64b275), which predates the REQ-795 payments CSV. That URL hits the legacy no-status branch of `InvoiceController.exportCsv`, which keeps only invoices with `status === "paid"` paid this month. Payments are never read, so a part payment on an unpaid invoice is never exported. (2) `PaymentController.exportCsv` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/mod.ts`) reads `PaymentStore.listByUser`, which REQ-926 (0a417179) changed to drop `reversedAt` payments. The export was never moved to `listByUserAll`, and `paymentExportCsv` (`shared/documents/exports.ts`) has no status column. So a charged-back payment the /payments page lists in "Charged back" leaves no trace in its CSV.
**Requirement:** "Export this month" on /payments links the payments CSV (`/api/payments/export.csv?from=<month start>&to=<month end>`), not the invoice export. GET /payments/export.csv lists every payment the /payments page lists, including charged-back ones, with a "Status" column that reads "Charged back" for a reversed payment and something other than that for a received one. `listByUser` keeps its REQ-926 meaning ("money received") everywhere else.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/payments-export-month.test.ts` ("REQ-1129 …": the PaymentsPage `exportHref` is built against the payments export, not `/api/invoices/export.csv`; `PAYMENT_EXPORT_HEADER` has "Status" and `paymentExportCsv` marks the reversed row "charged back") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/export-chargeback.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1129 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-57) GET /payments/export.csv …": Zelle paid in full plus a $400.25 check part payment charged back with a $35 fee; the month export has both rows and the check row's Status reads charged back) · e2e `e2e/payments-export-month/payments-export-month.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1129 …": the same data; on /payments `[data-cy=payments-export]` href starts with `/api/payments/export.csv`, and the file it downloads has the 400.25 row marked charged back plus the 2544.42 row).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-57 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/export-chargeback.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`the export carries every payment the page lists (Zelle + the charged-back check); got: Received,Invoice #,…,Reference / 2026-11-19,INV-001,C-001,Rosa Diaz,zelle,2544.42,` `- 1 + 2`); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/payments-export-month.test.ts` → `3 failed` (`Expected substring: not "/api/invoices/export.csv"`; `Expected value: "Status" Received array: ["Received", "Invoice #", "Customer #", "Customer", "Method", "Amount", "Reference"]`); `shots run e2e/payments-export-month -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1129 … expectation failed: "Export this month" downloads the payments CSV (href /api/invoices/export.csv?year=2026&month=11)`.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-57):** (1) `PaymentsPage.tsx` builds `exportHref = reportExportHref("payments", presetRange("thisMonth", today))`, so it uses the Reports page's payments slice and its "This month" UTC-day range, which matches the backend's received-day filter: `/api/payments/export.csv?from=YYYY-MM-01&to=YYYY-MM-<last>`. (2) `PaymentController.exportCsv` reads `listByUserAll`. (3) `PAYMENT_EXPORT_HEADER` / `paymentExportCsv` get three trailing columns, `Status` ("received" or "charged back"), `Charged back` (the ISO day of `reversedAt`) and `Chargeback fee` (dollars, only on a reversed row), so the existing seven columns keep their positions. `listByUser` keeps REQ-926's "money received" meaning everywhere else. **Neighbouring REQ-795 tests updated for the new columns (not weakened):** `jest/unit/reports-export.test.ts` now expects the row to end with `,received,,`, and `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/exports.int.test.ts` now expects the payments row to end with `"received", "", ""`. Both still pin the header to `PAYMENT_EXPORT_HEADER`.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/export-chargeback.int.test.ts` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/payments-export-month.test.ts unit/reports-export.test.ts` → `Tests: 1 skipped, 6534 passed, 6535 total` (the project ran the whole unit lane); `shots run e2e/payments-export-month -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1129 … marked charged back · 192.8s`; neighbours `deno test -A --no-check --unstable-kv` on invoice-controller/exports.int, payment-controller/{e2e,future-date,partial-receipt}, payment-store/smk → passed, plus payment-controller/chargeback.int `ok | 3 passed`. In that same run, overpayment.int failed twice with `AddrInUse` because another worktree's run held its fixed port 9551; rerun alone it gave `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed` three times. `cd front-end && deno lint islands/PaymentsPage.tsx lib/reports-export.ts ../shared/documents/exports.ts` → `Checked 3 files`; `deno check islands/PaymentsPage.tsx ../shared/documents/exports.ts` → exit 0.

## REQ-1130 — AMENDMENT of REQ-202: the overpaid flag on the paid email and the invoice PDF makes no refund-or-credit promise (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-59)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-59** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Paid email promises 'we will refund or credit this' on an overpayment without asking the owner". QA recorded $1,100 cash on a $1,035.50 invoice with "Record anyway" (REQ-551). The paid email (010-email) then read "Overpaid by $64.50 — we will refund or credit this".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the backend render dictionary `WORDS` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts` hard-codes `overpaid` as "Overpaid by {amount} — we will refund or credit this" (es "Pago en exceso de {amount} — lo reembolsaremos o acreditaremos"). The line came in with 474f09dc (2026-11-06, REQ-198..210). `paymentStateLines()` fills it in whenever paid > amount and asks the owner nothing. The paid/invoice email (`send-paperwork-email` `overLine` → `<div data-overpaid>`) and the invoice PDF (`render-invoice-pdf`) both print it as written. So the customer always gets a promise in the contractor's voice that the owner never made. REQ-202 only asks to flag the overpayment. /i uses `public.doc.overpaid`, which reads "Overpaid by {amount}" / "Pagado de más por {amount}" with no promise. The invoices screen says "Refunds or credits aren't handled here — settle those with the customer directly." (`invoicesPage.remove.paymentsNote`).
**Requirement:** an overpayment is still flagged (REQ-202), but the paid email and the invoice PDF say only the amount, in the same words as /i: en "Overpaid by $64.50", es "Pagado de más por $64.50". There is never a refund, credit, "reembols…" or "acredit…" promise the owner did not make.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/overpaid-no-promise.test.ts` ("REQ-1130 (q3-59) paymentStateLines en/es …": with amount 103550 and paidCents 110000, the line has no refund/credit/reembols/acredit and equals `t(lang, "public.doc.overpaid", {amount: "$64.50"})`) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/overpaid-no-promise.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1130 (q3-59) en/es: the paid email …": a $1,100 payment goes through ComputeInvoiceBalance (status paid, overpaidCents 6450), then SendPaperworkEmail; the `[data-overpaid]` text equals /i's wording) and `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/overpaid-no-promise.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1130 (q3-59) render-invoice-pdf en/es …": the inflated PDF content streams still draw $64.50 and contain no refund/credit/reembols/acredit) · e2e `e2e/overpaid-no-promise/overpaid-no-promise.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1130 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-59): …": records $1,100 cash on $1,035.50 in /invoices, confirms "Record anyway", opens the paid email from /api/outbox, and checks that `[data-overpaid]` reads "Overpaid by $64.50" with no promise and that /i reads "Overpaid by $64.50").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-59 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/overpaid-no-promise.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/overpaid-no-promise.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/overpaid-no-promise.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 8 failed` (`es: promises a refund or credit on the owner's behalf: "Pago en exceso de $64.50 — lo reembolsaremos o acreditaremos"`; `- Overpaid by $64.50 — we will refund or credit this / + Overpaid by $64.50`; `en: the PDF promises "refund" on the owner's behalf`; `en: [data-overpaid] promises a refund or credit: "Overpaid by $64.50 — we will refund or credit this"`). E2E against a `PORT=47731 deno task serve` with `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47731 shots run e2e/overpaid-no-promise -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1130 … expectation failed: the paid email promises a refund or credit on the owner's behalf: "Overpaid by $64.50 — we will refund or credit this"`. Sanity check: with WORDS.overpaid temporarily set to "Overpaid by {amount}" / "Pagado de más por {amount}", the three deno files gave `ok | 8 passed | 0 failed`; the change was then reverted.
**Fix:** `WORDS.en.overpaid` → "Overpaid by {amount}" and `WORDS.es.overpaid` → "Pagado de más por {amount}" in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts`, the one dictionary `paymentStateLines()` reads for both the paid email's `[data-overpaid]` line and the invoice PDF. The overpayment is still flagged (REQ-202) in the same words as /i's `public.doc.overpaid`; no surface makes a refund or credit promise. No test was changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-59):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/overpaid-no-promise.test.ts` → `ok | 4 passed | 0 failed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-email/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/` (the new int tests plus every neighbouring test of the touched module and its two consumers) → `ok | 122 passed | 0 failed` (and `doc-render/` alone → `ok | 11 passed | 0 failed`). `deno lint` + `deno check` on `doc-render/mod.ts` → clean. E2E against `PORT=47731 deno task serve`: `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47731 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=~/Library/Caches/deno/npm/registry.npmjs.org/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/overpaid-no-promise -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1130 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-59): $1,100 recorded anyway on a $1,035.50 invoice — the paid email flags 'Overpaid by $64.50' with no refund-or-credit promise, like /i · 143.5s` (the REQ-551 (a)/(b) neighbours in the same lane also ✓).

## REQ-1135 — AMENDMENT of REQ-627: voiding an invoice the customer was sent can tell her it is cancelled and nothing is due (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-60)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-60** [minor/MISSING_IN_FLOW], cycle 3: "Voiding a sent invoice tells the customer nothing" — Rosa got the INV-003 nudge at 12:35:07, the owner voided it at 12:35:52, and the outbox's last row stayed 010.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** REQ-627 (2c1cd6c4, amended by ddb87697 for auth only) built void as a status change only. `POST /invoices/:id/void` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/mod.ts` `voidInvoice`) calls `removeOne(..., "void")`, whose void branch is a single `store.update({status:"void", voidedAt, voidedBy, voidReason})`, and returns `project(invoice)`. It emits no event, sends no email or SMS and writes no outbox row; `voidAndDuplicate` and bulk-remove are equally silent. No coordinator under `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/` carries a cancellation message, and the void dialog in `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` has no "tell the customer" option. The customer only learns of it if she opens `/i/:id` herself (`publicInvoice.cancelled.note`).
**Requirement:** the void step offers "Let <customer> know" (`data-cy="invoice-void-notify"`), checked by default when the invoice was sent and the customer can be reached. `POST /invoices/:id/void` (and void & duplicate, bulk-remove) accept `{notify?: boolean}`; with `notify: true` on a sent invoice, the customer gets exactly one message on the channel the invoice went out on, in the invoice's language, saying the invoice is cancelled and nothing is due, with the /i link — never the void reason or who voided it (REQ-627). It is recorded in the outbox. `notify: false` sends nothing. A failed send never undoes the void.
**Tests:** int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/void-notify.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1135 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-60): voiding a sent invoice with notify:true emails the customer exactly once …" and "… notify:false sends nothing") · e2e `e2e/invoice-removal-print/invoice-removal-print.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1135 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-60): voiding an emailed invoice with 'let the customer know' checked …": the checkbox is there and checked, confirm, the outbox gains one email about the invoice, /i still shows the cancelled note) · unit n/a for the red step — the gap is an absence (no message builder exists yet); the fixer adds a unit test for the new coordinator's message builder (EN/ES, no reason/name leaked, channel choice).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-60 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/void-notify.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`AssertionError: Values are not equal: REQ-1135: the void tells Rosa — one new outbox row (outbox before 1, after 1)`, `- 0 + 1`; the notify:false guard passes); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:<own serve> shots run e2e/invoice-removal-print -- --no-check --filter REQ-1135` → `✗ REQ-1135 … expectation failed: REQ-1135: the void step offers to let Rosa know — expected 1, got 0`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) new coordinator `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-invoice-cancelled/mod.ts` (`SendInvoiceCancelled`, registered in `paperwork/mod-root.ts`): after a void it tells the customer "<business> cancelled invoice INV-003. Nothing is due — please don't pay it." with her /i short link, as a branded email (REQ-628 `businessFrom` + logo) and/or text, in the language the invoice went out in (its outbox row, else REQ-715's resolution), on the channels the invoice went out on (REQ-784 outbox rows for that docId, limited to the contacts she still has; paper / unknown → every contact), and records each in the outbox as the new kind `invoiceCancelled`. Its copy builder `composeCancelledCopy` takes no reason and no voider, so neither can leak (REQ-627). It never throws: a failed send cannot undo the void. Void & duplicate adds "A corrected invoice will follow." (2) `invoice-controller/mod.ts`: `POST /invoices/:id/void`, `/void-duplicate` and `/bulk-remove` accept `{notify?: boolean}`; only `notify: true` on an invoice that was actually voided calls the coordinator, and the answer carries `notice: {channels, reason?}`. A never-sent invoice gets nothing (`never_sent`). (3) `shared/documents/void-notice.ts`: `voidNoticeDefault` (sent + an email or textable phone) and `voidNoticeChannels`, shared by the page and the coordinator. (4) `front-end/islands/InvoicesPage.tsx` VoidPanel: "Let <first name> know it's cancelled" (`data-cy="invoice-void-notify"`), checked by default by `voidNoticeDefault`, with a one-line preview of the message (`invoice-void-notify-preview`); a void whose notice did not go out flashes `invoicesPage.remove.notifyFailed`. The bulk void step has the same box (`invoices-bulk-notify`). (5) `lang/en.json` + `lang/es.json`: `invoiceCancelled.*`, `invoicesPage.remove.notify*`, `invoicesPage.bulk.notify`, `outbox.kind.invoiceCancelled`; `voidExplain` now mentions the message. No test was changed.
**Tests added by the fixer:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-invoice-cancelled/mod.test.ts` (6 × "REQ-1135 …": EN / ES copy, nothing due + the invoice named + the link, no reason or voider in either language, the void & duplicate line, the box's default, the channel choice).
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/removal.int.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/void-notify.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-invoice-cancelled/mod.test.ts` → `ok | 16 passed | 0 failed`; own serve (`PORT=52871 KV_PATH=<file> deno task serve`) + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:52871 shots run e2e/invoice-removal-print -- --no-check --filter REQ-1135` → `✓ REQ-1135 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-60): voiding an emailed invoice with 'let the customer know' checked …` (1 pass); the whole file → 4 pass, 1 fail: `REQ-627: Void & duplicate cancels … corrected draft copy` timed out (once on the draft page's skeleton, once alone on an earlier click) with the host at load average ~128 and every story taking 130–265 s; REQ-964's story, which runs the same void & duplicate → draft path, passed both times. Re-run alone at load ~45 → `✓ REQ-627: Void & duplicate cancels … · 2.7s`. Neighbours `deno test -A --unstable-kv` on the rest of `invoice-controller/`, `outbox-controller/e2e.test.ts` and `send-payment-reminder/` → `54 passed | 1 failed`, the one being REQ-209's timing bound in `exports.int.test.ts` (`ledger took 1226 ms` against `< 1 s` at load ~128; the ledger is not touched here). `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/invoice-removal-print.test.ts` (ran the whole unit lane) → `Test Suites: 679 passed; Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed`; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/outbox.test.tsx` → `ok | 15 passed`; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on InvoicesPage.tsx, void-notice.ts and the new coordinator (the one lint hit in invoice-controller/mod.ts, `deleteChangeOrder`'s unused `id` at :536, is pre-existing at 6e3e05ca).

## REQ-1131 — A cancelled invoice's /i page shows no payment instructions and calls itself "Cancelled" in the headline, like the pill (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-61; amends REQ-627)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-61** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Cancelled /i still shows payment instructions and mixes 'Void' with 'CANCELLED'" — after voiding INV-003, /i read "INV-003 · Version 1 · Void" above a "CANCELLED" pill and still printed "PAYMENT INSTRUCTIONS · Zelle: dana@whitfieldfence.com", under a note saying "please don't pay it".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the REQ-627 void work in `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` added `voided` checks to the pill, the balance block, the cancelled note and the pay UI, but missed two older pieces of the page. (1) The REQ-206 extras section builds `hasExtras` from `invoice.paymentInstructions` and renders `[data-cy=invoice-payment-instructions]` whenever the field is present, with no `voided` check. (2) The REQ-201 headline comes from `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` `invoiceHeadline`, which gets `state: invoiceState(i)` = "void" (`shared/documents/versions.ts`) and labels it from `STATE_LABELS` ("Void" / "Anulada"), while the pill uses `publicInvoice.cancelled.pill` ("Cancelled" / "Cancelada", via `shared/documents/invoice-status.ts`).
**Requirement:** on /i, a void invoice shows no payment instructions (REQ-627: "offers no pay UI"; REQ-629: a void bill gets no How-to-pay box), and its headline names the state with the pill's word: en "Cancelled", es "Cancelada" — never "Void" / "Anulada".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/public-invoice-void-headline.test.ts` ("REQ-1131 q3-61 …": `invoiceHeadline({number:"INV-003",version:1,state:"void"})` → "INV-003 · Version 1 · Cancelled" / "INV-003 · Versión 1 · Cancelada") · int n/a — the backend projection is right (state "void", the stored instructions); the defect is in the shared headline label and the /i render, covered by the unit and the e2e · e2e `e2e/invoice-void-public-page/invoice-void-public-page.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1131 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-61): … (en)" and "(es)": a sent invoice with "Zelle: dana@whitfieldfence.com" instructions, voided through POST /api/invoices/:id/void, then /i/:id?lang=en|es → no `[data-cy=invoice-payment-instructions]`, and `[data-cy=invoice-headline]` carries the pill's word).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-61 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/public-invoice-void-headline.test.ts` → `Tests: 2 failed` (`Expected: "INV-003 · Version 1 · Cancelled" Received: "INV-003 · Version 1 · Void"`; `Expected: "INV-003 · Versión 1 · Cancelada" Received: "INV-003 · Versión 1 · Anulada"`); against a worktree serve on a high port, `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> shots run e2e/invoice-void-public-page -- --no-check` → `✗ … (en) … a cancelled invoice shows no payment instructions — got "Payment instructionsZelle: dana@whitfieldfence.com" | the headline names the state "Cancelled" like the pill ("Cancelled") — got "INV-001 · Version 1 · Void"`, `✗ … (es) … got "Instrucciones de pagoZelle: dana@whitfieldfence.com" | … "Cancelada" like the pill ("Cancelada") — got "INV-001 · Versión 1 · Anulada"`.
**Fix:** (1) `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` `STATE_LABELS.void` now reads "Cancelled" / "Cancelada" — the same word as the pill (`publicInvoice.cancelled.pill`), the void dialog and the owner's list; the table feeds the /i headline, the related-document rows and the invoice PDF headline, so all of them now agree. (2) `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` computes `showPaymentInstructions = !!invoice.paymentInstructions && !voided` and uses it both in `hasExtras` and to gate `[data-cy=invoice-payment-instructions]`, so a void invoice prints no How-to-pay text. No test was changed.
