## REQ-1136 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-62: a cancelled (void) invoice's PDF says "Cancelled — nothing due · $0.00", never "AMOUNT DUE" (refs REQ-627, REQ-629, REQ-206, REQ-805)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-62** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Cancelled invoice's PDF still says 'AMOUNT DUE $225.30'". The tester voided INV-003. /i then read "$0.00 … please don't pay it", but /api/invoices/<id>/pdf still read "CANCELLED | … | AMOUNT DUE | Due October 8, 2026 | $225.30".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the customer's Download PDF (`GET /invoices/:id/pdf` in `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts`) is `RenderInvoicePdf` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/mod.ts`). Its status pill knows about void, but its "Amount due" money card (~lines 388-430) has only three branches: paid, partial and due. `paid = status === "paid" || !!paidAt` is false for a void bill, and its paidCents is 0, so the card falls through to `t("publicInvoice.amountDue")`, `t("publicInvoice.dueOn", {date})` and `fmtUSD(invoice.amount)`. The REQ-206 "Payment instructions" row (~line 513) has no void guard either. Only the REQ-805 How-to-pay block (~line 544) checks `status === "void"`. /i (REQ-627) shows `publicInvoice.cancelled.label` and $0.00, so the two surfaces contradict each other.
**Requirement:** a void invoice's PDF money card reads the same cancelled label /i uses ("Cancelled — nothing due" / "Cancelada — no se debe nada", in any letter case) with the figure $0.00. It never prints "Amount due" / "Monto a pagar", "Due <date>" / "Vence <date>", or the full amount as owed, and it does not print the payment-instructions row. This holds in EN and ES.
**Tests:** unit n/a — the money card is drawn inline in a coordinator with no pure helper (if the fixer extracts one, it gets a unit test) · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/void-money-card.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1136 q3-62 render-invoice-pdf (en|es): …": a sent $225.30 bill, voided through the store the way removeOne does it, is rendered and its drawn text read with `pdfFacts`) · e2e `e2e/invoice-removal-print/invoice-removal-print.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1136 q3-62: a voided invoice's Download PDF on /i …": POST /api/invoices/:id/void, open /i, follow the Download PDF href, assert on the same text).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-62 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/void-money-card.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed`. Both languages fail on every point: the money card does not read the cancelled label, its figure is not $0.00, it reads 'AMOUNT DUE'/'MONTO A PAGAR' and 'Due October 8, 2026'/'Vence October 8, 2026', it prints $225.30, and it prints the payment instructions. `BASE_URL=<own serve> shots run e2e/invoice-removal-print -- --no-check --filter REQ-1136` → `✗ … expectation failed: the PDF reads 'Cancelled — nothing due', as /i does: [… "AMOUNT DUE","Due October 8, 2026","$225.30","Payment instructions","Mail a check to PO Box 7731", …]`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** `RenderInvoicePdf` computes one `voided = status === "void"` flag beside `paid`. The money card's void branch comes first: label `t("publicInvoice.cancelled.label").toUpperCase()` (the key /i uses), no "Due <date>" sub-line, figure `fmtUSD(0)`. Under the card it prints /i's own sentence, `publicInvoice.cancelled.note` (business, voidedAt), wrapped to the page width. The REQ-206 "Payment instructions" row is skipped when voided, and REQ-805's How-to-pay guard reuses the same flag. A paid-then-voided bill reads cancelled as well, because the void check comes before `paid`.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-62):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/` → `ok | 17 passed | 0 failed` (REQ-1136 en + es, plus the neighbouring REQ-805/906/923/928/965/966 renderer tests). `deno check` + `deno lint` on the renderer pass, and it was formatted via `deno fmt -`. e2e: own `PORT=44639 deno task serve`, `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:44639 SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/invoice-removal-print -- --no-check` → deno test `ok | 5 passed | 0 failed`, with `✓ REQ-1136 q3-62: a voided invoice's Download PDF on /i says 'Cancelled — nothing due' and $0.00 …`. The shots summary listed some ✗ ENOENT writes. Those belong to other parallel agents' stories (REQ-565, REQ-1100, REQ-1127) that share this session's `worktree-ready/<session>/evidence` dir. They are not this file's tests.

## REQ-1132 — The invoice PDF hero prints the job title as stored, exactly like /i and the email — no re-casing (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-64)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-64** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Invoice PDF title-cases the job while /i and the email don't". The PDF read "Gate Repair, Hinge Hardware" while /i and the email read "Gate repair, Hinge hardware".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/mod.ts` resolves the hero title from the same source /i uses (quote summary, else `jobNameByLang[lang]`, else `invoice.jobName`, else `invoiceTitle(...)`). It strips any `quote:` prefix and then runs the old non-Unicode `.replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase())`, which has been there since the file was created in 9d773fe22. That capitalises the first letter after every `\b`, giving "Gate Repair, Hinge Hardware". Because `\b` also fires after an accented letter, Spanish titles get garbled: "Instalación de baño" → "InstalacióN De BañO". /i (`front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` via `invoiceTitle` in `shared/documents/linked-view.ts`) and the standalone invoice email (`send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`) print the stored name unchanged. REQ-720 removed this regex from the emails but did not touch the PDF. The quote PDF (`render-quote-pdf/mod.ts`) and `front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx` have the same regex.
**Requirement:** the invoice PDF hero title is exactly the title /i shows for the same invoice (`invoiceTitle` of the stored name), character for character. No casing transform, and Spanish accents are never mangled (REQ-720).
**Tests:** unit n/a. The defect is inside the coordinator, and no pure title helper exists yet; `invoiceTitle` is already correct. The integration test pins the behaviour and checks it against `invoiceTitle`. · int `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/hero-casing.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1132 q3-64 render-invoice-pdf: …" renders an EN standalone invoice "Gate repair, Hinge hardware" and an ES one "Instalación de baño", inflates the content streams, and asserts case-sensitively that the re-cased string is absent and the /i title is drawn) · e2e `e2e/invoice-pdf-title-casing/invoice-pdf-title-casing.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1132 q3-64: …" creates a standalone invoice through the API, reads the /i h1, fetches /api/invoices/<id>/pdf, and asserts the PDF draws the h1 text exactly and not "Gate Repair, Hinge Hardware").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-64 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/hero-casing.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`AssertionError: the PDF re-cases the title to "Gate Repair, Hinge Hardware"`; `AssertionError: the PDF re-cases the title to "InstalacióN De BañO"`). Sanity check: with the `.replace(/\b\w/g, …)` line removed from a scratch copy (reverted afterwards), the same command gives `ok | 2 passed`. `BASE_URL=<own warm serve> shots run e2e/invoice-pdf-title-casing -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1132 q3-64: … · expectation failed: the PDF does not re-case the title to 'Gate Repair, Hinge Hardware'`. The /i setup assertion passed, so /i reads "Gate repair, Hinge hardware". The shots-managed serve ran the story before the backend had booted (`backend_unreachable`, host load ~71), so it was run against a serve started separately and already warm.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-64):** `render-invoice-pdf/mod.ts` no longer runs `.replace(/\b\w/g, …)` on the hero. It strips the `quote:` prefix, trims, and draws the title as stored, so the PDF hero equals /i's `invoiceTitle` character for character. The same regex in the two sibling sites, the quote PDF's summary fallback (`render-quote-pdf/mod.ts`) and the web contract doc's summary fallback (`front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx`), is replaced with the Unicode-aware `titleCaseJobName(summary, lang)` from `shared/quote-flow/email-format.ts` (REQ-720). English summaries keep Title Case there, Spanish ones become sentence case and are no longer mangled, and the PDF and the web doc still match each other.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-64):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/hero-casing.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`. `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf/` → `ok | 45 passed | 0 failed`. `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit <unit files touching quote-doc / render-*-pdf / email-format>` → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed`. `deno lint` + `deno check` on `front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx` and on both backend `mod.ts` files → clean; `deno fmt -` via stdin → no diff. `PORT=6871 deno task serve` (own KV) + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:6871 shots run e2e/invoice-pdf-title-casing -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1132 q3-64: a standalone invoice's PDF hero carries the /i title character for character — 'Gate repair, Hinge hardware', not 'Gate Repair, Hinge Hardware' · 28.8s`.

## REQ-1133 — AMENDMENT of REQ-272 + REQ-586: the /i "Download PDF" carries the page's language, and the invoice PDF renders in it (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-65)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-65** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "/i 'Download PDF' link carries no lang" — the email links carry ?lang, the PDF link doesn't (fleet-r0c106d7f-2: "The /i "Download PDF" href is /api/invoices/<id>/pdf with no lang").
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** two links in the chain. (1) `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` builds the Download PDF href as a bare `` `/api/invoices/${invoice.id}/pdf` ``; the `lang` the page resolves (?lang → pm_lang cookie → invoice.docLang ?? contractor.commsLanguage → Accept-Language, clamped to sendLanguages, REQ-272/586/925) labels the link but never reaches its href. (2) Adding ?lang alone would change nothing: `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts` `getInvoicePdf` reads only `@Param("id")` and calls `this.invoicePdf.run(id)`, and `RenderInvoicePdf.run(invoiceId)` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/mod.ts`) picks `lang = ident?.commsLanguage === "es" ? "es" : "en"` — the contractor's Settings only, ignoring the invoice's own document language and the visitor's pick. The link (c3847643 / 1a520814, 2026-08) predates REQ-272 and REQ-586, neither of which carried the language to the PDF; REQ-048 noted the same gap for the quote PDF.
**Requirement:** the /i Download PDF href carries the language /i paints (`?lang=<lang>`), and GET /invoices/:id/pdf renders in: a valid ?lang (en|es, clamped to the contractor's send languages, REQ-925), else the invoice's own document language (its `lang`, else its quote's send language — the same order /i uses), else the contractor's commsLanguage, else en.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/customer-link-lang.test.tsx` ("REQ-1133 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-65): /i 'Download PDF' carries the language the page paints as ?lang=") · int `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/invoice-pdf-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1133 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-65): GET /invoices/:id/pdf renders in ?lang, else the invoice's own document language …": es-docLang invoice under an en contractor → "Factura INV-…" with no ?lang and with ?lang=es, "Invoice INV-…" with ?lang=en; quote sent in es → Spanish; es contractor + ?lang=en → English; no pick → contractor default; en-only account + ?lang=es → English) · e2e `e2e/invoice-pdf-lang/invoice-pdf-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1133 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-65): on /i?lang=es the 'Descargar PDF' link carries lang=es and downloads a Spanish PDF ('Factura INV-…')").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-65 at 0a71387e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/customer-link-lang.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 8 passed | 1 failed` (`the Download PDF href is a bare /api/invoices/<id>/pdf with no lang: `/api/invoices/${invoice.id}/pdf``); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/invoice-pdf-lang.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`no ?lang: the PDF follows the invoice's own document language (es), not the contractor's en` — `- Invoice INV-001 + Factura INV-001`); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:<port> shots run e2e/invoice-pdf-lang -- --no-check` → `✗ … expectation failed: the Download PDF href carries lang=es (got /api/invoices/<id>/pdf) — expected "es", got null` (setup passed: /i painted `<html lang="es">`). The shots-managed serve answered `backend_unreachable` under host load (~79), so the story ran against a hand-started `deno task serve` on a random port.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-65):** (1) `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` builds the Download PDF href as `withSendLang(`/api/invoices/${invoice.id}/pdf`, lang)` — the language the page resolved and paints. (2) `GET /invoices/:id/pdf` (`public-controller/mod.ts` `getInvoicePdf`) reads `?lang` and passes it to `RenderInvoicePdf.run(id, { lang })`. (3) `RenderInvoicePdf` resolves its language with `resolveCommsLanguage({ override: asCommsLang(?lang) ?? invoiceDocLang(invoice, owned quote, customer), customerLanguage, identityCommsLanguage, sendLanguages: ident.commsLanguages })` — the same order /i opens in (REQ-586/715), clamped to the send-in set (REQ-925) — instead of `ident.commsLanguage` alone. The PDF's text already reads the *ByLang copies, so it follows. **Test amended:** `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/base-lang.int.test.ts` (REQ-710) built "the English PDF" of a Spanish-typed invoice/quote by calling `run(inv.id)` under an en-comms contractor — a premise REQ-1133 deliberately changes (that invoice now downloads in Spanish, its document language). Its two tests now ask for the English PDF explicitly, `run(inv.id, { lang: "en" })` (the visitor's EN pick); their assertions are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-65):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/customer-link-lang.test.tsx` → `ok | 9 passed | 0 failed`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/invoice-pdf-lang.int.test.ts` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`; `BASE_URL=http://localhost:33127 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/invoice-pdf-lang -- --no-check` (hand-started `PORT=33127 deno task serve`) → `✓ REQ-1133 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-65): on /i?lang=es the 'Descargar PDF' link carries lang=es and downloads a Spanish PDF ('Factura INV-…') · 39.8s`. Neighbours: `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-invoice-pdf/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-numbers.int.test.ts src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/load-business-logo/int.test.ts src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/` → `ok | 134 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on every touched file (front-end and backend); touched hunks match `deno fmt -` output.

## REQ-1134 — "What we handled today" lists the chargeback, the void and every one of the day's actions (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-66; amends REQ-566)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-66** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Dashboard 'What we handled today' leaves out the chargeback, void and claim confirmation" — after INV-001 claim+confirm, INV-002 issue / $400.25 check / chargeback (+$35) / cash, INV-003 issue / void, the panel read "Payment recorded: $400.25 from Greg Pruitt" as if the check were good.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the panel only reads the notifications feed (REQ-299), and a row reaches it only when an action emits a bus event that `notificationL10n()` maps. REQ-566 (031cce84) wired issue, payment recorded and task done; later owner actions emit nothing: `ChargebackPayment.charge()/undo()` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/chargeback-payment/mod.ts`, REQ-926, 0a417179) has no EventBus at all, and `POST /invoices/:id/void` → `removeOne(…, "void", …)` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/mod.ts`) returns without an emit. `notificationL10n()` (`backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/mod.ts`) has no branch for a reversal or a void, so it would return null anyway. And `front-end/islands/DashboardPage.tsx` keeps only `grouped.slice(0, 4)`, so the day's earlier rows (the INV-001 confirmation) fall off.
**Requirement:** every owner action of the day shows on "What we handled today": a chargeback is its own row naming the amount, the client and the fee ("chargeback" / "contracargo"); a void is its own row naming the invoice and the client ("void" / "anulada"); and the panel is not cut to 4 rows while today's earlier actions exist. Event contract for the unit test: `invoice:payment_reversed` { amountCents, customerName, feeCents }, `invoice:voided` { invoiceNumber, customerName }.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/test.ts` ("REQ-1134 (LOOP-007 q3-66): a chargeback maps to a feed row …", "… a voided invoice maps to a feed row …", EN + ES) · int `backend/src/communication/entrypoints/notification-controller/owner-activity.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1134 (LOOP-007 q3-66): charging back a recorded check lands a chargeback row …", "… voiding an issued invoice lands a row …": POST /payments → POST /payments/:id/chargeback {feeCents 3500}; POST /invoices/:id/void; GET /notifications) · e2e `e2e/dash-handled-today/dash-handled-today.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1134 (LOOP-007 q3-66): /dashboard 'What we handled today' lists the chargeback, the void and every earlier action of the day") · jest n/a — the 4-row cap is inline in the DashboardPage island with no pure helper; the e2e story covers it through the real page.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-66 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/test.ts` → `FAILED | 16 passed | 2 failed` (`AssertionError: Values are not equal: payment_reversed must map to a feed row`; `… invoice:voided must map to a feed row`); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --filter REQ-1134 src/communication/entrypoints/notification-controller/owner-activity.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`the feed names the chargeback of $400.25 from Greg Pruitt; got ["Payment recorded: $400.25 from Greg Pruitt","Invoice for $400.25 sent to Greg Pruitt"]`; `the newest row says Rosa Delgado's invoice was voided; got ["Invoice for $120 sent to Rosa Delgado"]`); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:47611 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/dash-handled-today -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1134 … expectation failed: the panel names Greg Pruitt's chargeback — panel: What we handled todayThe monsters have been busyInvoice for $120 sent to Rosa Delgado1 min agoPayment recorded: $435.25 from Greg Pruitt1 min agoPayment recorded: $400.25 from Greg Pruitt1 min agoInvoice for $400.25 sent to Greg Pruitt1 min ago — expected true, got false` (own `PORT=47611 deno task serve`, because shots' own serve answered `backend_unreachable` under host load ~55).
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/owner-activity/mod.ts` — two new REQ-566-style builders: `paymentReversedEvent` (`invoice:payment_reversed` { amountCents, method, feeCents, customerName }; with `undone` → `invoice:payment_reversal_undone`) and `invoiceVoidedEvent` (`invoice:voided` { invoiceNumber, amountCents, customerName }). (2) `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/payment-controller/mod.ts` — `POST /payments/:id/chargeback` and `…/chargeback/undo` emit them after a successful outcome (module function `announceReversal`, which looks up the client through the invoice; a failed lookup only drops the name). (3) `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/invoice-controller/mod.ts` — `removeOne()` takes an `onVoided` hook and calls it once the "void" status is stored; all three void paths (`POST /invoices/:id/void`, `/void-duplicate`, the void branch of `/bulk-remove`) pass `voidAnnouncer(bus, customers, userId)`, so no void path can stay silent. (4) `backend/src/communication/domain/coordinators/notify-on-event/mod.ts` — `notificationL10n()` maps `payment_reversed` → `notify.payment.reversed[Amount][Fee]` (type `invoice_overdue`, red), `payment_reversal_undone` → `notify.payment.reversalUndone[Amount]` (type `invoice_paid`), `voided` → `notify.invoice.voided[Number]` (type `generic`); EN "Chargeback: $400.25 from Greg Pruitt reversed (+$35 fee)" / ES "Contracargo: $400.25 de Greg Pruitt revertido (+$35 de cargo)", EN "Invoice INV-003 for Rosa Delgado voided" / ES "Factura INV-003 de Rosa Delgado anulada" (10 keys in `lang/en.json` + `lang/es.json`, beside their siblings, parity kept, last key still `comms.a2p.sys.house`). (5) `shared/quote-flow/notification-title.ts` — the one renderer formats `feeCents` → `{fee}` as dollars at read time (REQ-224's rule), so the topbar ticker renders the same words. (6) `front-end/islands/DashboardPage.tsx` — `grouped.slice(0, 4)` → `handledTodayRows(grouped, now)`: every row created on the viewer's calendar day, and on a quiet day still the 4 newest; `front-end/lib/notifications-feed.ts` fetches `limit=25` (was 10) so a busy day's rows are on the client to show. ## REQ-1137 — AMENDMENT of REQ-551 + REQ-798: the dashboard money bar's paid bucket counts min(paid, amount) (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-67)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-67** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Dashboard counts an INV-002 payment of $1,100.00 while the invoice says $1,035.50 paid" — the /dashboard money bar's paid row reads $1,100.00 and the "paid in the last 30 days" total carries the $64.50 overpaid rest, while /invoices, the paid email and the receipt say $1,035.50 paid with "Overpaid by $64.50".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `shared/receivables/money-bar.ts` builds each paid item with `cents: Math.round(i.paidCents ?? i.amount ?? 0) || Math.round(i.amount ?? 0)` — the invoice's raw stored `paidCents`, the sum of every confirmed payment including the overpayment (ComputeInvoiceBalance stores paidCents 110000 with overpaidCents 6450). It is never capped at the invoice amount, and `bucket()` sums those item cents into the paid bucket total and the bar's segment width. REQ-798's money bar (08b4524a, 2026-11-13) came a day after REQ-551 set the min(paid, amount) rule for every "paid" KPI and never adopted it; every other paid surface does (`paidKpiInvoiceCents` in front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts, `paymentSummary`, `invoiceBalance`, PaymentsPage's creditedPayments).
**Requirement:** the dashboard money bar's paid bucket counts each paid invoice at min(paid, amount): the row shows what was collected against the bill and the 30-day paid total (and the bar's total) leaves out any overpaid rest.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/money-bar-overpaid.test.ts` ("REQ-1137 …": buildMoneyBar with {amount 103550, paidCents 110000} → paid item cents 103550; with that plus an exactly-paid 20000 invoice the paid bucket and totalCents are 123550; an exactly-paid invoice keeps its full amount) · int n/a — buildMoneyBar is a pure shared function over /dashboard data the backend already serves correctly (the invoice's own overpaidCents is right) · e2e `e2e/overpayment-guard/overpayment-guard.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1137 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-67) / REQ-551 (c) …": $100 recorded with override on a $65 invoice, open /dashboard, click the Paid segment, the row reads $65.00 and the paid column starts "$65 ").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-67 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/money-bar-overpaid.test.ts` → `Tests: 2 failed` (`Expected: 103550 Received: 110000`; `Expected: 123550 Received: 130000`); `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53720 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/overpayment-guard -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1137 … expectation failed: the paid row counts what was owed (Randall Belknap · Back fence Paid Nov 19 · INV-001 · Electronic (Zelle) $100.00) — expected "$65.00", got "$100.00"` (REQ-551 (a) and (b) ✓). Note: the shots-managed serve gives `backend_unreachable` in this worktree because the backend takes ~2 min to boot; run against a detached `PORT=<p> deno task serve` with BASE_URL (and a root `.env` symlink).
**Fix:** `paidKpiInvoiceCents` (REQ-551's min(paid, amount)) moved from front-end/lib/headline-counts.ts to `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` (next to `paymentSummary`) and re-exported from headline-counts so /invoices, /payments and their tests are unchanged; `shared/receivables/money-bar.ts`'s paid item now uses `cents: Math.round(paidKpiInvoiceCents(i)) || Math.round(i.amount ?? 0)` (a paid invoice with no paidCents still counts its amount), so the row, the bucket total and totalCents leave out the overpaid rest. The overpaid rest stays visible on /invoices ("Overpaid by" pill) and the paid email.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-67):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/money-bar-overpaid.test.ts` → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6534 passed, 6535 total` (the unit project runs the whole lane); `cd front-end && deno test -A components/MoneyBar.dates.test.tsx components/MoneyBar.test.tsx components/MoneyBar.cents.test.tsx` → `31 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A lib/overpayment.test.tsx lib/paid-this-month.test.ts` → `14 passed | 0 failed`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the three touched files → clean; `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53720 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/overpayment-guard -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-551 (a) … · ✓ REQ-551 (b) … · ✓ REQ-1137 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-67) / REQ-551 (c): the dashboard money bar's paid bucket counts an overpaid $65 invoice as $65.00, not the $100 received`.

## REQ-1138 — Deleting a customer who still owes money never orphans the debt silently, and /customers gives one answer to "who owes me" (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-69)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-69** [major/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Deleting a customer who still owes money orphans the debt, and /customers disagrees with itself" — the delete confirm never mentions the balance; afterwards the hero reads "$821 currently owed" next to "Owe you 0" ("$1,671 que te deben" vs "Te deben 1"); the invoice stays with a 404 customer.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** three pieces built separately and never reconciled. (1) REQ-802/REQ-039: `DELETE /customers/:id` (`backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/mod.ts` `delete`) is an unconditional soft delete — no open-receivable check — and the confirm `clientsBoard.panel.deleteAsk` (shown by `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` and `ClientSheet.tsx`) is static, never naming a balance. (2) The deleted row leaves `customer-store list()`, so the board has no card and `countByStatus` (`backend/src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/mod.ts`) drops her from the "Owe you" chip. (3) REQ-696 (1b698f5a) made the hero `summarize(cards, unassignedOwedCents)`, folding open invoices whose customer is missing or gone into `owedCents`, so the hero still counts the deleted customer's $820.67 while the chips and cards do not.
**Requirement:** (a) DELETE /customers/:id on a customer with an open receivable answers 409 `{code:"customer_owes", owedCents, invoices:[numbers]}` unless `?force=1`; the More → Delete question names what she still owes (cents rule, e.g. "$820.67"), with Keep primary and an explicit Delete anyway (`cws-delete-yes`) that sends force=1. (b) The /customers headline owed figure equals what the cards / "Owe you" chip carry; open receivables no card carries are reported separately (`summary.unassignedOwedCents`), never folded into the headline (amends REQ-696: its unit assertion `summarize(cards, 200_00).owedCents === 300_00` must be updated by the fixer). (c) The /invoices card of an orphaned invoice never links to the deleted customer.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/test.ts` ("REQ-1138 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-69) clients-page — the headline owed equals the sum of the card balances …") · integration `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/delete.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1138 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-69) DELETE /customers/:id — … 409 customer_owes ($820.67); ?force=1 deletes; GET /clients' headline owed then agrees with the 'Owe you' count") · e2e `e2e/customer-delete-owes/customer-delete-owes.e2e.test.ts` (EN: More → Delete question names $820.67, Delete anyway, hero vs "Owe you" in one evaluate, /invoices card has no link to the deleted id; ES: force-deleted over the API, hero vs "Te deben").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-69 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/test.ts` → `FAILED | 12 passed | 1 failed` (`the headline owed is what the cards carry … - 167077 + 85010`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/delete.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 1 failed` (`a customer who owes $820.67 is not deleted silently (got 200 {"ok":true}) - 200 + 409`); `SHOTS_DIR=<own dir> BASE_URL=http://localhost:57138 shots run e2e/customer-delete-owes -- --no-check` (server `PORT=57138 deno task serve`) → `✗ … EN … expectation failed: the delete question says she still owes $820.67 — got "Delete Lucía Owes 9656647? Their quotes and invoices stay; the customer leaves the roster. Delete Keep"`, `✗ … ES … the hero's owed figure agrees with "Te deben 0" — got $821 in "0 trabajos firmados en curso · $821 que te deben actualmente · …" — expected 0, got 821`.
**Test fix (2026-11-19, fixer):** the integration test wrote the $179.33 part payment with a bare `PaymentStore().create`, which never runs ComputeInvoiceBalance, so the invoice kept `paidCents` unset and owed the full $1,000.00 (`- 100000 + 82067` on `refusedBody.owedCents`) on every surface (cards, hero, the new 409). The app records a payment through `POST /payments`, which stamps `paidCents`; the setup now posts it that way (asserting 200). No assertion was changed. The REQ-696 unit test is amended as the requirement says (`summarize(cards, 200_00).owedCents` is `100_00`, the 200_00 is `unassignedOwedCents`), and REQ-135's `summarize(cards)` deep-equal gains `unassignedOwedCents: 0`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (a) `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/open-receivable/mod.ts` `customerOpenReceivables(invoices, customerId)` — one customer's open receivables on the REQ-397 rule (`owedCents`, invoice numbers). `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/mod.ts` `DELETE /customers/:id` checks ownership, then answers 409 `{ok:false, code:"customer_owes", owedCents, invoices}` while she owes, unless `?force=1`. Front end: `front-end/lib/customer-delete-owes.ts` (`owesFromInvoices`, `owesFromError`, `owesAskVars` — amount on REQ-961's `fmtMoneyTotal`), `clientsClient.deleteAnyway(id)` (`?force=1`); `CustomerWorkspace.tsx` asks with the balance up front (from its invoice rows, `balanceCents > 0` = the same open rule), `ClientsBoard.tsx` and `ClientSheet.tsx` learn it from the 409 and turn the question into `clientsBoard.panel.deleteAskOwes` with "Delete anyway" (`clientsBoard.panel.deleteAnyway`); new keys in en + es. (c) `front-end/lib/invoice-client.ts` `liveCustomerId` — `InvoicesPage.tsx` `enrich` keeps an invoice's `customerId` only while that customer is on the live list, so a deleted customer's open invoice never links (`/customers?open=<id>`) or PUTs to her 404; it falls back to its own bill-to (name from customerSnapshot, REQ-988).

## REQ-1139 — AMENDMENT of REQ-1073: a part-paid invoice's headline (number · version · state) agrees with its "Partly paid" pill on /i and /invoices (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-70)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-70** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "/i header says 'Enviada/Sent' while the pill says 'PAGO PARCIAL/PARTLY PAID'" — after $500 on a $1,190.75 invoice, /i and the /invoices card read "INV-001 · Versión 1 · Enviada" directly above "Pago parcial".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** two status rules run on one card. The pill and the /invoices stage chip use REQ-1073's `isPartlyPaid` (`shared/documents/invoice-status.ts`). The REQ-201 headline uses `invoiceState()` (`shared/documents/versions.ts`), which only knows paid / void / claimed / scheduled / draft / revised / sent; a part-paid invoice is issued with stored status "pending", so it returns "sent". On /i the backend puts `state: invoiceState(i)` into the public payload (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts`) and `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` passes it to `invoiceHeadline` (`shared/documents/linked-view.ts`) → `stateLabel("sent")` = "Enviada". On /invoices, `headlineOf` → `formatInvoiceHeadline` → `invoiceHeadline(inv)` (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`) → label "Sent"/"Enviada". REQ-1073 (04f767eb) moved every other status surface onto `isPartlyPaid` and missed the headline.
**Requirement:** for a part-paid invoice (money recorded, balance owed, not void/paid/claimed) the headline on /i, the /invoices card and the /invoices detail never says "Sent"/"Enviada"; it says "Partly paid"/"Pago parcial" or carries no state word, so it agrees with the pill.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/loop7-q3-70-partly-paid-headline.test.ts` ("REQ-1139 …": `formatInvoiceHeadline` on amount 119075 / paidCents 50000 / status pending with the labels from lang/en.json and lang/es.json, as InvoicesPage's `headlineOf` calls it — no "Sent"/"Enviada", "Partly paid"/"Pago parcial" or no state word) · int n/a — the headline is composed in the render layer; the public payload's `state` field is one possible place for the fix, not the contract, and the e2e reads the real /i output through the backend · e2e `e2e/partly-paid-headline/partly-paid-headline.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1139 …": Spanish account, $1,190.75 invoice, $500 payment via the API, then reads `[data-cy=invoice-headline]` + `[data-status-pill]` on /i, `[data-cy=invoice-card-headline]` + `.qcard__status` on the /invoices card, and `[data-cy=invoice-headline]` on `/invoices?open=<id>`, each screen in one page.evaluate).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-70 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/loop7-q3-70-partly-paid-headline.test.ts` → `Tests: 2 failed` (`Expected pattern: not /\bSent\b/  Received string: "INV-001 · Version 1 · Sent"`; `Expected pattern: not /Enviada/  Received string: "INV-001 · Versión 1 · Enviada"`); `SHOTS_DIR=<own dir> BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47731 shots run e2e/partly-paid-headline -- --no-check` (against `PORT=47731 deno task serve`) → `expectation failed: /i headline says 'Enviada' under a 'Pago parcial' pill (all: {"iHeadline":"INV-001 · Versión 1 · Enviada","iPill":"Pago parcial","cardHeadline":"INV-001 · Versión 1 · Enviada","cardPill":"Pago parcial","detailHeadline":"INV-001 · Versión 1 · Enviada"}) — expected false, got true`.
**Fix (fix/q3-q3-70):** one rule now feeds the headline and the pill. `shared/documents/invoice-status.ts` gains `invoiceHeadlineState(state, invoice)`: a "sent" invoice that REQ-1073's `isPartlyPaid` calls partly paid reads the new `DocState` "partly" (`shared/documents/versions.ts`; `invoiceState` itself is unchanged, so stored/derived states elsewhere do not move); "revised", paid, void, claimed, draft and scheduled keep their words. `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts` `invoiceHeadline`/`formatInvoiceHeadline` (the /invoices card and detail via InvoicesPage `headlineOf`) and `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` (the /i headline, on top of the public payload's `state`) both pass through it. Labels: `STATE_LABELS.partly` in `shared/documents/linked-view.ts` ("Partly paid" / "Pago parcial"), `invoices.state.partly` in lang/en.json + lang/es.json, `partly` in InvoicesPage `headlineLabels`; `CustomerDocState` (backend/src/crm/dto/customer.ts) mirrors the widened `DocState`. Tests unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-70):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6534 passed, 6535 total` (includes `unit/loop7-q3-70-partly-paid-headline.test.ts` 3/3, and the 45 suites importing invoice-status / linked-view / invoice-form / versions / search: 501 passed); `SHOTS_DIR=<own dir> BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:53817 shots run e2e/partly-paid-headline -- --no-check` (against `PORT=53817 deno task serve`) → `✓ REQ-1139 (LOOP-007 q3-70): after $500 on a $1,190.75 invoice the headline on /i and on the /invoices card and detail agrees with the 'Pago parcial' pill — never 'Enviada' · 1 pass · 0 fail`; neighbour `shots run e2e/partly-paid-status` → `✓ REQ-1073 … 1 pass · 0 fail`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-customer-cards/` → `53 passed | 0 failed`; `deno check` + `deno lint` on the touched front-end/shared files and the backend modules that use `invoiceState` (customer dto, build-customer-cards, build-customer-workspace, public-controller) → clean.

## REQ-1140 — AMENDMENT of REQ-924(c): the customer page's Jobs tab counts and lists signed jobs, not only work orders (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-71)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-71** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "A signed job leaves the customer's Jobs tab at 0" — /customers/<id>?tab=jobs read "Jobs 0 … No work orders yet" ("Trabajos 0 … Todavía no hay órdenes de trabajo.") while the /customers board for the same customer said "En curso 1" / "1 trabajo firmado en curso".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** REQ-924 (1c0be6f7) built the Jobs tab from work orders only. `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-customer-workspace/mod.ts` returns `workOrders` (WorkOrderStore rows with this customerId) and no signed-job projection; `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` sets the tab badge to `jobs: ws.workOrders.length` and shows `customerWs.jobs.none` when that list is empty. Signing a quote creates no work order (REQ-210), while everywhere else a job IS a signed quote (pipeline-stats "only a signature creates a job"; REQ-562 `countJobs` in `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/signed-jobs/mod.ts` feeds the card's `activeJobs`). So after a signature the board counts 1 and the tab titled "Jobs & work orders" counts 0.
**Requirement:** the workspace carries `jobs` — one row per signed (won) quote of the customer, built by the same `countJobs`/`isSignedJob` rule so its active rows always equal the card's `activeJobs` — each row with the quote `id`, `number`, `active` (false once every non-void linked invoice is paid) and `url` `/quotes?open=<id>`. The Jobs tab badge counts the active signed jobs (plus unlinked open work orders), lists the signed jobs linking to their quote, and shows the "no work orders" empty state only when there are neither.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-customer-workspace/test.ts` ("REQ-1140 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-71) BuildCustomerWorkspace — …": an accepted quote + unpaid invoice → `jobs` = [that quote, active, Q-number, `/quotes?open=<id>`], active count = `customer.activeJobs`; all invoices paid → listed, `active:false`, matching `countJobs`) · int `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/clients-controller/workspace.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1140 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-71) GET /customers/:id/workspace — after the customer signs Q-001 …": public POST /quotes/:id/accept, then the workspace's `jobs[0]` is Q-001, active, and the active count equals the card's `activeJobs`) · e2e `e2e/customer-jobs-signed/customer-jobs-signed.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1140 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-71) EN|ES: …": sign Q-001 as the customer, open /customers/<id>?tab=jobs, badge reads the card's activeJobs (1), a link to `/quotes?open=<id>` names Q-001, no "No work orders yet." / "Todavía no hay órdenes de trabajo.") · jest unit n/a — the badge count is inline in the island, not a pure front-end helper; the e2e drives it in the real UI.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-71 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-customer-workspace/test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`Expected actual: "undefined" to not be null or undefined: the workspace carries the customer's signed jobs (got no \`jobs\` field — the Jobs tab can only count work orders)`, after `customer.activeJobs === 1` and `workOrders.length === 0` held); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/analytics/entrypoints/clients-controller/workspace.int.test.ts --filter REQ-1140` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`the workspace carries the customer's signed jobs — got jobs=undefined`); `SHOTS_DIR=… shots run e2e/customer-jobs-signed -- --no-check` → `✗ … EN … expectation failed: the Jobs tab badge reads the board's active job count (got "0") — expected "1", got "0"`, `✗ … ES … (got "0") — expected "1", got "0"`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** (1) `backend/src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-customer-workspace/mod.ts` adds a `jobs` projection to the workspace (`WorkspaceJob` in `backend/src/analytics/dto/customer-workspace.ts`). It has one row per quote of hers that passes REQ-562's `isSignedJob`, with `active = !isJobComplete(<her non-void invoices with that quoteId>)`. That is the same rule `countJobs` applies for the card's `activeJobs`, so the two counts can't drift. Each row carries `id`, `number` (the quote's Q- number), `title`, `signedAt`, `agreedCents`, `paidCents`, `url` `/quotes?open=<id>` and the work orders linked to it. Rows in flight sort first. Workspace work orders now carry their `quoteId`. (2) `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx`: the Jobs tab badge = active signed jobs + open/in-progress work orders that aren't linked to a signed job. The tab lists "Signed jobs" (Q- link, signed date, total and paid-of-agreed, In progress/Completed pill, the job's linked work orders and a "+ Create work order" link to `/work-orders?new=1&quoteId=…&customerId=…`) above the work-orders table. "No work orders yet." shows only when both lists are empty. ## REQ-1142 — The public invoice /i prints the tax rate the way the email, PDFs and send sheet do: "7%", never "7.00%" (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-72)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-72** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Tax rate reads '7.00%' on /i but '7%' elsewhere". QA saw /i "Impuesto (7.00%)", the outbox email "Impuesto (7%)" and the owner's send sheet "Tax (7%)" for the same invoice.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** the rate is formatted in three places. `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` (~line 850, from 474f09dc, REQ-198..210) has its own inline `` ` (${(invoice.taxRateBp / 100).toFixed(2)}%)` ``, which always prints two decimals: 700 bp → "7.00%", 750 → "7.50%", 1000 → "10.00%". The email (`send-paperwork-email/mod.ts`) and both invoice PDFs use backend `fmtTaxRate` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts`), and the owner send sheet (`InvoicesPage.tsx`) uses shared `bpToPercent` (`shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`). Both of those print "7%", "7.5%", "8.25%" and "10%".
**Requirement:** the tax label on /i uses the same rate string as the email, the PDFs and the send sheet (en "Tax (7%)", es "Impuesto (7%)"; 7.5 → "7.5%", 8.25 → "8.25%", 10 → "10%"), never padded decimals. Ideally one shared formatter feeds every surface.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/public-invoice-tax-rate.test.tsx` ("REQ-1142 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-72): …". It renders the real /i route over a stubbed `__backendFetch` with taxRateBp 700/750/825/1000 in en and es and expects "Tax (7%)" / "Impuesto (7%)" and so on. It also pins `fmtTaxRate(bp)` == `bpToPercent(bp)+"%"` for those rates, which is a green guard) · int `front-end/lib/public-invoice-tax-rate.int.test.tsx` ("REQ-1142 … int: …". It boots the real backend in process on KV :memory:, creates a customer and a 7% invoice over HTTP, emails it in Spanish, reads the email body back from GET /outbox, then server-renders /i/:id against that backend and expects the same "Impuesto (7%)") · e2e `e2e/public-invoice-tax-rate/public-invoice-tax-rate.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1142 …". On the real shell it creates a 7% invoice, emails it (es) and reads the outbox email. The customer then opens /i/:id?lang=es with no session, and the page's tax label must equal the email's).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-72 at 0a71387e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/public-invoice-tax-rate.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 6 passed | 6 failed` (`- Tax (7.00%) + Tax (7%)`, `- Impuesto (7.50%) + Impuesto (7.5%)`, `- Impuesto (10.00%) + Impuesto (10%)` …; 825 already reads "8.25%" and the helper-agreement guards pass); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check lib/public-invoice-tax-rate.int.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`/i must print the email's rate (got "Impuesto (7.00%)")  - Impuesto (7.00%) + Impuesto (7%)`); `SHOTS_DIR=<own dir> SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/public-invoice-tax-rate -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1142 … · 90s · expectation failed: the /i tax label matches the email's (got "Impuesto (7.00%)") — expected "Impuesto (7%)", got "Impuesto (7.00%)"`.
**Fix (2026-11-19):** the root cause was a third, inline formatter on /i (`(taxRateBp / 100).toFixed(2)`, from 474f09dc). `front-end/routes/i/[id].tsx` now prints `bpToPercent(invoice.taxRateBp)` from `shared/documents/invoice-form.ts`. Backend `fmtTaxRate` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/doc-render/mod.ts`), which the email and both invoice PDFs use, now returns `` `${bpToPercent(bp)}%` `` and no longer keeps its own copy of the rounding. So one function formats the rate on every surface: /i, email, PDFs and send sheet.

## REQ-1141 — A customer name (and business name) is capped at 120 characters, and the customer page heading never takes over a phone screen (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-73)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-73** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Customer names have no length limit" — POST /api/customers with a 308-character name was saved (200); at 390 px the customer page's `<h1 data-cy="cws-name">` wrapped to 486 px, and the sidebar and board cards printed the full string.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** nothing limits a customer name's length. `backend/src/crm/dto/customer.ts` — `CreateCustomerDto.name` / `UpdateCustomerDto.name` carry only `@IsString()`, and `assertName` (REQ-1080) only trims and refuses a blank name, so `parseCreateCustomer` / `parseUpdateCustomer` return any length and the store saves it. `front-end/components/CustomerForm.tsx`'s shared `field()` renders the Name and Business `<input>`s without `maxLength`. `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` renders `<h1 data-cy="cws-name">{c.name}</h1>` unclamped (`.cws-hero h1` in `static/customer-workspace.css` only has `overflow-wrap:anywhere`). The inquiry store already clips its own name to `MAX_NAME = 120`.
**Requirement:** POST and PUT /customers refuse a `name` or `businessName` longer than 120 characters (counted after trimming) with 400 `customer.nameTooLong`, saving/changing nothing; exactly 120 is kept whole. The New customer / Edit form's Name and Business inputs carry `maxlength=120`. At 390 px the customer page's name heading is at most two lines (clamped, full name in `title`), so even a name stored before the cap cannot take over the screen.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/crm/dto/customer.test.ts` ("REQ-1141 q3-73 …": parseCreate/UpdateCustomer refuse a 121-character name and business name and the QA's 308-character name with 400 `customer.nameTooLong`; exactly 120, and 120 plus padding, are kept) · int `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/name-length.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1141 q3-73: POST /customers with a 308-character name is 400 …": app booted on KV :memory:, POST 308 → 400 + key and list empty, POST 120 kept, PUT 121 → 400 and name unchanged) · e2e `e2e/customer-name-length/customer-name-length.e2e.test.ts` (three "REQ-1141 (q3-73): …" stories at 390x844: the form's cf-name / cf-business carry maxlength=120 and keep 120 of 308 typed; POST /api/customers 308 → 400 customer.nameTooLong; a 120-character worded name's cws-name h1 is under 80 px, on screen, with the full name in `title`) · jest unit n/a — the front-end change is an input attribute and CSS, proven in the browser by the e2e.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-73 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/dto/customer.test.ts` → the five REQ-1141 refusal tests FAILED with `Error: expected a throw` (the two "kept" tests pass); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/name-length.int.test.ts` → `AssertionError: Values are not equal: a 308-character name must be refused: {"name":"<b>x</b>ZZZZ…` (saved); `BASE_URL=<own serve> shots run e2e/customer-name-length -- --no-check` → `✗ … expectation failed: the Name input carries maxlength=120 ({"nameMax":null,"businessMax":null,"nameLen":308,"businessLen":308})`, `✗ … a 308-character name is refused … — expected 400, got 200`, `✗ … the name heading is at most two lines at 390 px (171.56248474121094 px tall)`.
**Fix:** one shared constant `CUSTOMER_NAME_MAX = 120` in `shared/quote-flow/customer-contact.ts` (the inquiry store's MAX_NAME). `backend/src/crm/dto/customer.ts` `assertName` (run by both `parseCreateCustomer` and `parseUpdateCustomer`) now throws `CustomerInputError("customer.nameTooLong")` (400) when the trimmed `name` or `businessName` is longer. `front-end/components/CustomerForm.tsx`'s `field()` takes a `maxLength`, and the Name and Business inputs pass `CUSTOMER_NAME_MAX`; `shared/customer-form/mod.ts` `validateCustomerForm` flags a prefilled name over the cap as `"tooLong"` (an edit of a name stored before the cap), which `errorText` shows as `customerForm.err.nameTooLong`. New keys `customer.nameTooLong` and `customerForm.err.nameTooLong` in lang/en.json and lang/es.json (same 6463 keys, `comms.a2p.sys.house` still last). Names stored before the cap: `.cws-hero h1` (static/customer-workspace.css) is clamped to two lines (`-webkit-line-clamp:2`, `overflow:hidden`) and `<h1 data-cy="cws-name">` carries `title={c.name}`. The sidebar row (`.cnav__name`) and the board card (`.ccard2__name`, `.ccard2__panel-name`) already ellipsize on one line, so they were left as they are.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-73):** `cd backend && NO_COLOR=1 deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/dto/customer.test.ts src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/name-length.int.test.ts` → `ok | 37 passed | 0 failed` (all seven REQ-1141 unit tests and the REQ-1141 int test ok). ## REQ-1144 — Two tabs editing the same customer: a save at a stale version is refused, never silently overwrites (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-74)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-74** [major/BUG_HARM], cycle 3: "Two tabs editing the same customer: the last save silently wins (version not enforced)" — two PUTs at version 1 both returned 200, the final notes were tab B's, and the version stayed 1.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `CustomerStore.update` (`backend/src/crm/domain/data/customer-store/mod.ts` ~104-131) reads the record with `getOwned`, merges `{...existing, ...definedPatch}` and writes it back with a plain `kv.set` — no `atomic().check(versionstamp)`, no compare against a caller's version, no version bump. The `version: 1` GET shows comes from `createNumbered` (`backend/src/core/data/numbered-store/mod.ts` ~135, `versionOf(record)` = 1 on create) and is spread forward unchanged forever. `PUT /customers/:id` (`customer-controller/mod.ts` ~120-128) passes `parseUpdateCustomer(body)` straight to the store with no version/If-Match and no 409 path, and `UpdateCustomerDto` has no `version`. The edit dialog (`front-end/components/CustomerForm.tsx`, `clientsClient.update` "the edit form sends every field") PUTs the whole form it loaded, so a stale tab writes back old phone/email/address/notes over another tab's (or an invited admin's) newer edit, and nobody is told. REQ-200/REQ-201's compare-and-set / `stale_version` never covered customer edits.
**Requirement:** a customer edit carries the version it loaded. PUT /customers/:id with `version` equal to the stored version saves and bumps the version (1 → 2); with an older version it is refused 409 `{error:"stale_version", currentVersion, customer}` and changes nothing; two concurrent saves at the same version → exactly one wins. In the browser, the Edit dialog sends its loaded version; on 409 it does not overwrite, shows an "edited somewhere else — here is the latest" notice (`[data-cy='cf-conflict']`), and the other tab's change survives.
**Tests:** unit n/a — the behaviour is KV compare-and-set through the store and controller; covered at the int level · int `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/stale-version.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1144 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-74): a save at a stale version is refused 409 stale_version and the newer edit is kept"; "… two concurrent saves at the same version — exactly one wins, the other is 409") · e2e `e2e/customer-edit-conflict/customer-edit-conflict.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1144 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-74): two tabs edit the same customer — tab B's stale save does not put back the old phone tab A changed, and tab B is told it was edited elsewhere": two pages on /customers/<id>, More → Edit in both, tab A saves a new phone, tab B saves notes; the stored phone must stay tab A's and tab B shows `cf-conflict`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-74 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/stale-version.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`a successful edit bumps the version — Actual 1 / Expected 2`; `exactly one concurrent save at version 1 wins (got 200, 200)`); `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/customer-edit-conflict -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1144 … · 97.5s · expectation failed: tab B's stale save must not put back the old phone (stored +18435550111, notes "tab B note") — expected "8435550199", got "8435550111"`.
**Fix:** `UpdateCustomerDto` takes an optional `version` (int ≥ 1) and `Customer` carries `version`. `CustomerStore.update` reads the row with its versionstamp, refuses a patch whose `version` is not `versionOf(stored)` with `StaleCustomerVersionError` (carries the current record), and writes `{…merged, version: current+1}` through `kv.atomic().check({key, versionstamp}).set(…)`; a lost race re-reads (a versioned edit is then refused, an unversioned one — the language picker, assistant renames — re-applies on the newer row, up to 5 tries). `PUT /customers/:id` maps the error to 409 `{error:"stale_version", currentVersion, customer}`. The Edit dialog (`front-end/components/CustomerForm.tsx`) sends the `version` of the customer it opened with; on 409 stale_version it does not overwrite: it loads the reply's customer into the fields, adopts `currentVersion`, and shows `[data-cy='cf-conflict']` (`customerForm.err.conflict`, en + es), so a further Save is a deliberate one on the latest values. `clientsClient` `CustomerCard` gains `version?`.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-74):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/stale-version.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/customer-edit-conflict -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1144 … · 130.3s` (1 pass · 0 fail). Neighbours green: backend `customer-controller/{address,delete,language,paging}.int.test.ts`, `customer-store/{int,smk}.test.ts`, `crm/dto/{customer,customer-address}.test.ts`, `agents/…/send-quote/int.test.ts`, `paperwork/…/{customer-language.int,render-numbers.int,milestone,send-paperwork-email/int,numbered-docs.int}` — all `ok`, 0 failed; `shots run e2e/customer-form` → 2 pass · 0 fail; jest `--selectProjects unit` customer-form, c5-customer-language, send-dialog-guard, owner-write-announce, contact-retry-validate, clients-add-dialog, customer-workspace → 97/97, settings-systems-tab, house-line-panel, systems-house-line (REQ-920 last key) → 11/11; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the touched front-end and backend files clean; lang/en.json + es.json same key set, last key `comms.a2p.sys.house`. (The first e2e attempt timed out on a 20 s `waitFor` with host load ~157; the rerun at load ~100 passed. `delete.int.test.ts` once hit `AddrInUse` on its fixed port 9802 from a parallel run; rerun ok.)

## REQ-1143 — AMENDMENT to REQ-921/979: New repeat visit with no services is not a dead end — + adds a typed service (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-75)
**Source:** Raphael: "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green." QA issue **q3-75** [minor/MISSING_IN_FLOW], cycle 3: "Start recurring service dead-ends without an existing service catalog" — on /field/subscriptions?new=1&customerId=…, typing "Gutter cleaning", a price and + shows "Pick a service on every line."; nothing typed saves, and the only help leaves the modal.
**Root cause:** REQ-979 wired inline create into the repeat-visit service box only as a dropdown row (`SearchSelect` `+ Add "<name>" as a service`, SearchSelect.tsx:79/249-259). When the owner moves to the price box instead of clicking that row, the outside-mousedown handler only closes the list (SearchSelect.tsx:81-87) and the typed text stays with nothing picked. `addItem` in front-end/islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx (~397-408) looks up `form.pickId`, finds nothing and returns `serviceLines.err.pick` before it checks the price, so a typed unknown name is never created (and -20 never reaches the price error). With an empty catalogue the hint is "You have no services yet." plus a same-tab `<a href="/field/services">` (REQ-921, 624d6d26e), which unmounts the modal; `close()` drops the form. `field.subs.noItems` still says "task type".
**Requirement:** on the New repeat visit form, + / Enter in the price box adds a typed service name when nothing is picked: a name matching a service (case-insensitive, trimmed) picks it; an unknown name is created through the existing POST /field/task-types (`fieldClient.createTaskType`) and added at the price. The price check still applies (≤ $0 → `serviceLines.err.price`). The decision is a pure `subsAddItemIntent({ catalog, pickId, typed, price })` in front-end/lib/field.ts (→ `pick` | `create` | `err`). The empty-catalogue hint stays in the modal (no same-tab link to /field/services). `field.subs.noItems` says "service" / "servicio", en + es.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/subs-typed-service.test.ts` ("REQ-1143: …": empty catalogue + typed "Gutter cleaning" at 40 → create 4000¢; a case/space variant of an existing name → pick it; a picked id wins; blank → err.pick; -20 → err.price; the island calls `subsAddItemIntent(` and reaches `createTaskType(` from + too; the subs-no-services hint has no same-tab `/field/services` link; noItems en/es without "task type"/"tipo de tarea") · int n/a — no backend change; POST /field/task-types and POST /field/subscriptions already have their own int tests · e2e `e2e/subs-no-services/subs-no-services.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1143 (LOOP-007 q3-75): …": fresh account, no services, a customer; type "Gutter cleaning", click price, 40, click subs-add-item → one row "Gutter cleaning" 40.00, task-types holds it once, Save → GET /field/subscriptions has it at 4000¢, no same-tab services link; a second story: -20 → "Give every service a price above $0.", no row).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, cycle 3, at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/subs-typed-service.test.ts` → `Tests: 7 failed, 7 total` (`Expected: "function" Received: "undefined"` ×4; `Expected pattern: /subsAddItemIntent\(/`; `Expected pattern: not /<a\s+href="\/field\/services"\s*>/`; `Expected pattern: not /task type/i  Received string: "Add at least one task type with a price."`). Against `FRONTEND_PORT=5873 BACKEND_PORT=5874 KV_PATH=<fresh> deno task serve`, `BASE_URL=http://localhost:5873 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/subs-no-services -- --no-check` → `0 pass · 2 fail`: "+ adds the typed service as one line at $40.00 (got {"rows":[],"err":"Pick a service on every line."})"; "a typed service with a -20 price gets the price error — expected "Give every service a price above $0.", got "Pick a service on every line."".
**Fix (2026-11-19, cycle 3):** `subsAddItemIntent` in front-end/lib/field.ts is the pure decision (picked id → that service; else trimmed/space-collapsed typed name matching a service case-insensitively → that service; else typed name → `create`; nothing → `err.pick`; price ≤ $0 → `err.price`). `ServiceSelect` passes SearchSelect's `onQuery` through; FieldSubscriptionsPage stores it as `form.pickName`. `addItem` is now async: on `create` it runs `fieldClient.createTaskType({ name })`, adds the service to the catalogue and the line at the price; the service box remounts empty after an add (`svcBox` key), a ref guards double +, and Save also adds a typed-but-not-added name. The empty-catalogue hint is now `field.subs.noServicesTyped` ("No services yet — type a name above and press + to add one." / es) with no link off the modal; `field.subs.noItems` says "service" / "servicio". Not changed: the New invoice row (InvoicesPage `new-invoice-no-services` still links to /field/services); that is left for its own entry.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19):** `cd jest && npx jest unit/subs-typed-service.test.ts` → `Tests: 7 passed, 7 total`. `npx jest --selectProjects unit --runTestsByPath unit/service-lines.test.ts unit/subs-typed-service.test.ts unit/subs-search-select.test.ts unit/field-subs-copy.test.ts unit/subs-create-customer.test.ts unit/subs-requirement-hints.test.ts` → `Tests: 35 passed, 35 total` (an earlier full unit run, 680 suites, was green except service-lines' REQ-921 300-char window, which the `key` prop had pushed `data-cy="subs-service"` past; moving `key` below `aria-label` fixed it, no test change). `cd front-end && deno lint` + `deno check` on islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx, components/ServiceSelect.tsx, lib/field.ts → clean.
