## REQ-1145 — AMENDMENT of REQ-1004: "Ends on" before First visit shows an inline error as it is entered (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-76)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-76** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Recurring 'Ends on' accepts a date before the first visit with no inline error" (/field/subscriptions new form).
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** REQ-1004 (df68d90ce) guarded the `subs-end` input in `front-end/islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx` only with `min={form.startDate}`. That attribute limits the native picker, but a typed or filled date ignores it and `submit` never checks form validity. The input's onChange just patches `endDate`, and `onStartDate` never re-checks an end date that is already set. The real `field.subs.endBeforeStart` check sits in `submit()` as the sixth early return, after the customer/address/items/days checks. It writes `form.err`, which shows as the shared bottom `subs-error` alert and not next to the field. So with no service row, Save shows the service error and the end-date message never appears. The address field already has the inline pattern (`addressErr`, aria-invalid, `.field-error`); the end date was never given one. The server refuses the bad date (`parseEndDate` 400, REQ-1004a), so bad data is never stored. The defect is only in the form's feedback.
**Requirement:** when Ends on is before First visit, an inline error `[data-cy=subs-end-error]` (`id="subs-end-error"`, text `field.subs.endBeforeStart`) shows under the Ends on input before Save, and the input carries `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby="subs-end-error"`. Moving First visit to on or before the end clears it. On Save with a bad pair, the end-date message is what shows, not a later-ordered check such as the service error. The rule is a pure helper, `endDateError(start, end)` in `front-end/lib/field-subs-end-date.ts`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/subs-end-inline-error.test.ts` ("REQ-1145 …": `endDateError` returns the key for end < start and null for an equal/later/blank end; the island renders `subs-end-error` and ties the input to it with aria-invalid; the island calls `endDateError`) · int n/a — the server 400 is already pinned by the REQ-1004 int test in `backend/src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts`, and the backend is unchanged · e2e `e2e/subs-end-inline-error/subs-end-inline-error.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1145 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-76): …": First visit 2026-11-19 + Ends on 2026-11-01 → inline error visible with the message and aria-invalid before Save; First visit 2026-10-25 clears it; with no service row, Save shows the end-date message, not the service error).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-76 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/subs-end-inline-error.test.ts` → `Tests: 4 failed` (`Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/field-subs-end-date'` ×2; `Expected substring: "data-cy=\"subs-end-error\""`; `Expected pattern: /endDateError\s*\(/`); `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/subs-end-inline-error -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1145 … expectation failed: an inline [data-cy=subs-end-error] shows under Ends on before Save (Ends on Nov 1, First visit Nov 19) — expected true, got false` (the screenshot shows Ends on 11/01/2026 under First visit 11/19/2026, with only the "November 1, 2026" hint and no error).
**Fix:** new pure helper `endDateError(start, end)` in `front-end/lib/field-subs-end-date.ts` (key `field.subs.endBeforeStart` when end < start, else null; blank end → null). `FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx` derives `endErr` from both dates on every render, so typing Ends on and moving First visit both re-check it; under the input it renders `<span class="field-error" role="alert" id="subs-end-error" data-cy="subs-end-error">` in place of the long-date hint, with `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` on the input (the address pattern). `submit()` now checks `endDateError` before the services/days checks, keeps the message inline (no bottom `subs-error`) and focuses `subs-end`. Backend and lang unchanged (existing key, en+es).
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-76):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/subs-end-inline-error.test.ts <14 neighbouring FieldSubscriptionsPage/endBeforeStart suites>` → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6535 passed, 6536 total` · `cd front-end && deno lint islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx lib/field-subs-end-date.ts` → `Checked 2 files`; `deno check` same files → clean; `deno fmt -` on both → no diff · `SHOTS_JOBS=2 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/subs-end-inline-error e2e/field-tasks -- --no-check '--filter=/REQ-1145|REQ-1004/'` → `✓ REQ-1145 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-76) … 30.9s`, `✓ REQ-1004 … Ends on set saves … 45.8s`, `✓ REQ-1004 … Pause … 28.6s` — 3 pass · 0 fail. (A first run at the default 16 workers had two stories time out clicking `subs-new` on a cold Vite serve — the screenshot shows the page loaded with the button; both passed on the re-run with 2 workers, so not this change.)

## REQ-1146 — Browser Back steps back through the customer page's tabs (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-77)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-77** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Browser Back from a customer tab skips earlier tabs" — after switching tabs on /customers/<id>, Back left the customer page (for /field/subscriptions?new=1) instead of returning to the previous tab.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `setTab` in `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` (~line 270, from 1c0be6f7, REQ-924) sets the tab state, edits `?tab=` on the current URL and writes it back with `history.replaceState(history.state, "", url)`, so a tab click swaps the current history entry instead of adding one. The island reads the tab from the URL only once (the initial `useState(tabFromUrl)`) and has no popstate listener. So after Invoices → Payments the stack is `[…, <previous page>, /customers/<id>?tab=payments]` and Back skips every earlier tab. REQ-924 says nothing about history; `ClientsPage.tsx` (~191-208) already uses `pushState` + a popstate handler for its segment chips.
**Requirement:** each tab click on the customer page adds a history entry; Back/Forward step through the tabs (the shown tab follows `?tab=`, Overview = no `tab` param), and only a Back from the first tab leaves the page. Non-click tab changes (redirects) may keep `replaceState`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/loop7-q3-77-cws-tab-history.test.ts` ("REQ-1146: a tab click adds a history entry (pushState) …"; "REQ-1146: the island follows Back/Forward — a popstate listener …": the `setTab` body uses `history.pushState(` and not `replaceState(`; the island adds and removes a `popstate` listener that calls `setTabState(tabFromUrl())`) · integration n/a — client-only history handling, no backend involved · e2e `e2e/customer-tab-back/customer-tab-back.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1146 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-77): browser Back steps back through the customer tabs …": /customers → /customers/<id> → Invoices → Payments; Back → ?tab=invoices with Invoices selected; Back → no ?tab= with Overview selected; Back → /customers).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-77 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern loop7-q3-77` → `Tests: 2 failed, 2 total` (`Expected pattern: /history\.pushState\(/`; `Expected pattern: /addEventListener\(\s*["']popstate["']/`); `SHOTS_DIR=<own dir> BASE_URL=<own serve> SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/customer-tab-back -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1146 … expectation failed: Back from Payments stays on her page (went to /customers) — expected "/customers/<id>", got "/customers"`.
**Fix:** `setTab` now calls `history.pushState({ tab: t }, "", url)` (skipped when the URL already shows that tab), and a mount `useEffect` adds/removes a `popstate` listener that calls `setTabState(tabFromUrl())`, the `ClientsPage.tsx` segment-chip pattern. A second cause showed up during the fix: Fresh's runtime stamps a page's first history entry `{ fClientNav: true }`, and because this app never sets `f-client-nav`, its own popstate handler calls `location.reload()` when Back pops to such an entry. That made Back from Invoices to Overview reload the whole page, and the e2e's wait for Overview timed out. The probe showed the pushes working: after Back #2 the state was `{"fClientNav":true,…}`, the page navigated twice and no tab was selected. So the same effect rewrites this page's own entry to `{ ...state, fClientNav: false }` with `replaceState` (same URL). Fresh's handler then returns early and the island's listener shows Overview in-page. The tests were not changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-77):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'loop7-q3-77|customer-workspace|cws'` → `Test Suites: 5 passed, 5 total · Tests: 36 passed, 36 total`; neighbours `--testPathPattern 'loop7-q2-62-partly|loop7-q2-8-customer|q2-61-customer-money'` → `Tests: 17 passed, 17 total`; `SHOTS_DIR=<own dir> BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5947 (own PORT=5947 KV_PATH=<file> deno task serve) SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/customer-tab-back -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1146 … · 10.1s — 1 pass · 0 fail`; neighbouring e2e `e2e/customer-workspace` → 2 pass, `e2e/customer-workspace-delete` → 1 pass, `e2e/customer-workspace-gone` → 1 pass; `cd front-end && deno lint islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` → `Checked 1 file`; `deno check islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` → ok; `deno fmt - < islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` → no diff.

## REQ-1147 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-78: emoji are not UI icons on app surfaces (amends REQ-366 / REQ-1070)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-78** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Emoji in menus and the activity feed" — the customer page's More menu draws "💬 Send a text" / "🔁 Start recurring service" next to Edit's SVG pencil, and the activity feed's dots are emoji.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** REQ-924 (1c0be6f7, 2026-11-18) built the customer workspace with emoji literals as icons: `front-end/islands/CustomerWorkspace.tsx` More menu items (💬 :497, 🔁 :504), the header address (📍 :445, beside the SVG `ICN.phone` / `ICN.mail`), the service card subline (📍 :1489, beside its SVG `ICN.repeat`), and `Activity()`'s `icon` field ("💵" "🧾" "📝" "🔁", :1643–1676) rendered as text inside `<span class="cws-dot">`; plus `front-end/components/CustomersNav.tsx:73` (`🔁 ${schedule}`), and the same 💬 note icon in `FieldTasksPage.tsx:779` and `WorkerScreen.tsx:920`. REQ-366's guard (`front-end/lib/ui-glyph-icons.test.tsx`, `DINGBAT = /[✀-➿■-◿]/u`, widened by REQ-1070 to U+2300–23FF) never covered U+1F300–1FAFF / U+2600–26FF, and REQ-1070 left emoji as an owner call, so nothing stopped it. Chromium draws the emoji with the OS colour-emoji font next to stroke SVG icons from `lib/dash-icons.tsx`, so one menu / row mixes two icon styles; the matching SVGs (ICN.msg, repeat, pin, pay, invoice, quote) already exist.
**Requirement:** an emoji is never used as a UI icon on an app surface — the customer workspace (More menu, header address, service subline, activity feed), the customers sidebar's schedule line, and the field-task / worker-screen note marker draw an inline SVG instead. Copy emoji inside message text (greetings, 🎉, the HR 🐋) are out of scope here.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/ui-glyph-icons.test.tsx` ("REQ-1147 (LOOP-007 q3-78): the customer workspace, customers sidebar, field tasks and worker screen draw no emoji as an icon …" — scans those four sources' code lines for U+1F300–1FAFF / U+2600–26FF; "REQ-1147 (LOOP-007 q3-78): the customer activity feed's .cws-dot draws an SVG icon, not an emoji" — Activity()'s `icon:` values hold no emoji and `.cws-dot` renders `<I d={…}/>`) · integration n/a — rendering only, no backend change · e2e `e2e/customer-emoji-icons/customer-emoji-icons.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1147 (q3-78): the customer page's More menu, header address, activity feed, service card and sidebar line draw SVG icons, never emoji" — customer with phone + address + a weekly service with today's visit done; asserts no `\p{Extended_Pictographic}` and an `<svg>` per icon in `.cws-contact`, `[data-cy=cws-menu]` items, `[data-cy=cws-activity] .cws-dot`, `.cws-svc__sub`, and her `nav-customer-line`).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-78 at 0a71387e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/ui-glyph-icons.test.tsx` → `FAILED | 7 passed | 2 failed` (hits `CustomerWorkspace.tsx:445 📍`, `:497 💬`, `:504 🔁`, `:1489 📍`, `:1643 💵`, `:1651 🧾`, `:1659 📝`, `:1676 🔁`, `CustomersNav.tsx:73 🔁`, `FieldTasksPage.tsx:779 💬`, `WorkerScreen.tsx:920 💬`; activity icons `'"💵"', '"🧾"', '"📝"', '"🔁"'`); `SHOTS_DIR=<private> BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:57311 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/customer-emoji-icons -- --no-check` → `✗ … expectation failed: no emoji in the header contact line (" (305) 555-0142📍 4601 Dick Pond Rd, Myrtle Beach, SC") — expected [], got ["📍"]` (a soft-assert probe of the same story also showed the menu `["💬","🔁"]` with 0 svg, Edit 1 svg, feed dot `🔁` 0 svg, service subline `["📍"]`, sidebar line `"🔁 Every week · Thu"`).
**Fix (fix/q3-q3-78):** every emoji used as an icon is now an inline SVG from `front-end/lib/dash-icons.tsx`. `CustomerWorkspace.tsx`: More menu 💬 → `<I d={ICN.msg}/>`, 🔁 → `<I d={ICN.repeat}/>` (beside Edit's `<Icon name="pencil">`; `.cws-menu` items are now `display:flex; gap:8px` so the three icons line up); header address and service subline 📍 → `<I d={ICN.pin}/>` inside `.cws-contact__addr` / `.cws-svc__addr` (inline-flex like the phone / mail links); `Activity()`'s `icon` is an ICN path (💵 → `ICN.pay`, 🧾 → `ICN.invoice`, 📝 → `ICN.quote`, 🔁 → `ICN.repeat`) rendered as `<I d={a.icon} size={14}/>` in `.cws-dot` (now `color: var(--cws-coffee)` instead of an emoji font-size). `CustomersNav.tsx`: `statusLine()` returns the bare schedule (it also feeds the row's accessible name) and the row draws `<I d={ICN.repeat}/>` in `.cnav__ic` before it. `FieldTasksPage.tsx` / `WorkerScreen.tsx`: the note's 💬 → `<I d={ICN.msg}/>`. Sweep of the other app surfaces the RCA listed (icons only, copy stays): `FieldAssignmentsPage.tsx` unpin button 📌 and `FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx` zone chip 📌 → a new `ICN.pushpin`; `InvoicesPage.tsx` at-risk ⚠ → `ICN.alert`, paid-lock 🔒 → `ICN.lock`; `AsstChat.tsx` "from" warnings ⚠ ×2 → `ICN.alert` (hand-edited, file not reformatted). Left as copy / tone, not icons: the 👋 greetings (AssistantCoachmark, WelcomeBackToast, OnboardingProgress, DashTopbar), DashSections' 🔥 "hot" marker beside the sent date, AsstChat's 👤 initials fallback, 🎙️ voice-memo placeholder text, 👀 demo card, 🔧 dev-only seed buttons, the HR 🐋, routes/index.tsx chat copy 👍. The unit guard's `EMOJI_ICON_SURFACES` now also covers `FieldAssignmentsPage.tsx`, `FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx` and `InvoicesPage.tsx` (all emoji-free now), so the sweep can't regress.
**Test correction (e2e):** the story compared arrays with shots' `expect.eq`, which is strict `===` (`~/.claude/tools/shots-lib/mod.ts:245`), so `expect.eq([], [])` always failed — after the fix it read "expected [], got []". The five no-emoji checks now compare the joined matches to `""` (`expect.eq(x.emoji.join(""), "", …)`): the same assertion (no `\p{Extended_Pictographic}` match), in a form `===` can pass.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-78):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/ui-glyph-icons.test.tsx` → `ok | 9 passed | 0 failed`. `PORT=48162 deno task serve` + `SHOTS_DIR=<scratch> BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:48162 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=~/Library/Caches/deno/npm/registry.npmjs.org/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/customer-emoji-icons -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1147 (q3-78): the customer page's More menu, header address, activity feed, service card and sidebar line draw SVG icons, never emoji · 1 pass · 0 fail`. Neighbours: `deno lint` + `deno check` on the 9 touched .tsx files → clean / `Checked`; `deno test -A --no-check` on the 28 front-end/lib tests that read the touched files → `159 passed | 1 failed` — the one red, `lib/backdrop-escape.test.tsx` "REQ-732 m26 … subscription line search", is pre-existing (it looks for `function onComboKey` in FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx, which HEAD 0a71387e does not have; the diff to that file is only the 📌 chip); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit <232 files naming the touched sources>` → `Test Suites: 679 passed, 679 total; Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed`.

## REQ-1149 — Same-name customers are told apart in the sidebar, and the New customer form warns before a duplicate (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-80; amends REQ-924(a), extends REQ-331)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-80** [minor/MISSING_IN_FLOW], cycle 3: "Two customers with the same name are indistinguishable in the sidebar" — no phone or number to tell them apart, and no duplicate warning on create (tester saw two identical rows "LG Lupe Garza Sin facturar").
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `front-end/lib/customer-nav.ts` `customerNavRows` builds each row's `base` from only `id`, `name`, `initials` and `href`, dropping the card's `number` ("C-002"), `phoneNumber` and `email` (`front-end/clients/clients.ts` CustomerCard), and its sort ties two same-name, never-billed rows on tone, amount and name. `front-end/components/CustomersNav.tsx` renders only the initials, `r.name` and the status line ("Nothing billed yet" / "Sin facturar" for both), and its aria label `${r.name} · ${line}` is identical too (layout from 1c0be6f7, REQ-924). Separately, nothing on the /customers path checks for an existing customer: `CustomerForm.tsx` submit calls `clientsClient.create` directly and POST /customers (`backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/mod.ts`) calls `store.create` with no lookup; REQ-331's `findExistingCustomer` (`shared/quote-flow/customer-dedupe.ts`) plus `allowDuplicate` is wired only into the chat wizard and bill-to-customer.
**Requirement:** (a) a sidebar customer row whose name (accent- and case-blind) is shared by another row carries a `tag` — the customer number, else the phone, else the email — shown beside the name and in the row's accessible name; a unique name carries no tag; same-name rows sort by number; the row cache key moves past v2. (b) The /customers New customer form runs `findExistingCustomer` before creating; on a match it shows an inline notice (`cf-duplicate`, naming the existing customer) with "Create anyway" (`cf-create-anyway`, sends `allowDuplicate`), no native dialog, nothing saved until she chooses. (c) POST /customers refuses a create that `findExistingCustomer` matches with 409 `customer.possibleDuplicate` naming the existing id, saving nothing; `allowDuplicate: true` creates it (the flag is not stored).
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/customer-nav-same-name.test.ts` ("REQ-1149 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-80): …" ×3: distinct number tags for two Lupe Garzas, none for a unique name; accent/case-blind with phone → email fallback; stable order by number) · unit `jest/unit/customer-same-name.test.ts` ("REQ-1149: …" ×3: CustomersNav renders `r.tag` / `nav-customer-tag` and puts it in `named(...)`; cache key not v2; CustomerForm imports and calls `findExistingCustomer`, has `cf-duplicate`, `cf-create-anyway`, `allowDuplicate`, no `confirm(`) · integration `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/duplicate.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1149 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-80): POST /customers with a name she already has is 409 …") · e2e `e2e/customer-same-name/customer-same-name.e2e.test.ts` (two stories: API-made Lupe Garza ×2 → the two `nav-customer-row`s differ in innerText and aria label; /customers New customer "Lupe Garza" twice → `cf-duplicate` before saving, Create anyway → 2 customers, rows differ).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-80 at 0a71387e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/customer-nav-same-name.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 3 failed` (`both same-name rows carry a tag (got [{"id":"b","name":"Lupe Garza","initials":"LG",…,"tone":"paid","amountCents":0,"billed":false},…])`; `the first row's tag is her phone (got undefined)`; order `- "b" "a" + "b"`); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern customer-same-name` → `Tests: 3 failed, 3 total`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/duplicate.int.test.ts` → `a second same-name customer is refused as a possible duplicate (got 200 {"name":"lupe  GARZA",…,"number":"C-002"})`; `BASE_URL=<own serve> shots run e2e/customer-same-name -- --no-check` → `✗ … two never-billed … expectation failed: the two rows read differently (got "LG Lupe Garza Nothing billed yet" and "LG Lupe Garza Nothing billed yet")`, `✗ … New customer 'Lupe Garza' twice … expectation failed: the second save shows the duplicate notice (cf-duplicate); customers now: 2`.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-80):** (a) `front-end/lib/customer-nav.ts` — `NavCard` carries `number`, `phoneNumber`, `email`; `customerNavRows` counts names folded with REQ-331's `foldName` and gives a row whose name is shared a `tag` (the number, else the US phone formatted "(512) 555-0199", else the email); the row keeps `number` as the last sort tiebreak (numeric compare). `front-end/components/CustomersNav.tsx` renders the tag beside the name (`nav-customer-tag`, "Lupe Garza · C-002") and in `named(...)`; the cache key is `pm:customers-nav:v3`. (b) `front-end/components/CustomerForm.tsx` create path reads the roster (`clientsClient.roster()`, GET /customers) and runs `findExistingCustomer` on the typed name / phone / email; a match shows the inline `cf-duplicate` notice in REQ-331/390's words (`duplicateNotice`) with the existing customer's number, an outlined "Open <name>" link (`cf-open-existing`, new key `customerForm.dup.open` en/es) and "Create anyway" (`cf-create-anyway`), which posts with `allowDuplicate` via `customerCreatePayload(..., { allowDuplicate })`; editing name / phone / email clears the notice; a 409 from the server (a stale roster) shows the same notice. `front-end/islands/ClientsPage.tsx` fires `CUSTOMERS_CHANGED` after a save or delete so the sidebar re-reads (the e2e found the sidebar still read "No customers yet" after a form create). (c) `backend/src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/mod.ts` POST /customers strips `allowDuplicate` (`takeAllowDuplicate`, never stored) and, without it, throws `CustomerDuplicateError` (409, message `customer.possibleDuplicate`, `existing: { id, name, number, phoneNumber, email }`) when `findExistingCustomer` matches. Callers that already chose to create keep doing so with `allowDuplicate: true`: the invoice form's "New client" (`InvoicesPage.tsx`), the typed-name "+ Add as a customer" on /field/tasks and /field/subscriptions; test seeds that create the same customer on one account too (`jest/integration/helpers/api.ts` seedCustomer, `assistant-flows` / `ux-job-name` int seeds, `cypress/support/commands.ts` apiCreateCustomer, backend `delete.int`, `square-pay.int`, `card-pay.e2e` seeds) — setup only, no assertion changed.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-80):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/customer-nav-same-name.test.ts` → `ok | 3 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern customer-same-name` → `Tests: 3 passed, 3 total`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/duplicate.int.test.ts` → `ok | 1 passed | 0 failed`; `PORT=5617 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5617 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/customer-same-name -- --no-check` → `✓ … New customer 'Lupe Garza' twice …` and `✓ … two never-billed customers named Lupe Garza …`. Neighbours: jest unit over every suite naming the touched files (106 suites) → `Tests: 1125 passed` after keeping `clientsClient.create(customerCreatePayload(` (REQ-625/599 source pins); `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/crm/entrypoints/customer-controller/ …/square-pay.int.test.ts …/card-pay.e2e.test.ts src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts src/field/entrypoints/quote-subscription.e2e.test.ts` → `ok | 79 passed | 0 failed` (the 196 backend test files that POST /customers were run in parallel first; the only REQ-1149 casualties were the three seeds above); shots `e2e/customer-form e2e/subs-create-customer e2e/invoice-client-pick` → all ✓; `e2e/customer-form-validation` "Add is pressable with an empty name" ✗ is pre-existing (HEAD's Save is `disabled={busy || !values.name.trim()}`, untouched here). deno lint + deno check green on every touched front-end/backend file; touched files fmt-clean via stdin.

**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". ## REQ-1153 — A logged-out deep link goes to /login?next=<page> and, after the code, back to that page (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-82)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-82** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Logged-out deep link lands on the marketing home, not login" — opening /dashboard after logging out lands on "/", with no redirect to login and no return to the page asked for.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** every authed `front-end/routes/<app>/_middleware.ts` (dashboard, quotes, invoices, payments, clients — re-exported by customers/field/hr/admins — assistant, settings, messages, communications, reports, tools, contracts, work-orders, wo, accounts-manager, admin, demo; plus `welcome.tsx:43`) answers `new Response(null, {status: 302, headers: {Location: "/"}})` when `loadUser()` finds no session — the original scaffold (49a5d6ca). P-35 (8fd0a2d6) later made a client-side 401 go to `/login?next=<page>` (`client.ts`), and REQ-879 made /login honour `?next=` for a visitor already signed in (`rejoinTarget`), but neither touched the server gates, so the app answers the same "no session" state two ways. The sign-in path also drops `next`: `islands/LoginForm.tsx` hands off to `/verify?phone=…&lang=…&from=login`, and `islands/CodeInput.tsx` goes to the backend's `redirectTo` (`/dashboard?welcome=back`). Owner alerts link to `${APP_URL}/quotes?open=<id>` (send-inquiry-alert / send-decision-alert), so without a session the quote is lost.
**Requirement:** with no session, every authed app page answers 302 `/login?next=<path+search, encoded>` (a `next` that is a site path only — never `//…` or a backslash); a live session passes as before. `next` is carried /login → /verify → CodeInput, and after a good code the tab goes to `next` when the backend's landing is the plain dashboard; the REQ-091 `/welcome` wizard still wins over `next`. REQ-907 (the sign-out button lands on "/") and /verify's missing-phone case are unchanged. The REQ-376 admin-gate int test's "no session → /" expectation becomes `/login?next=%2Fadmin`.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/login-redirect.test.ts` ("REQ-1153 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-82): …": `loginRedirect(url)` → 302 `/login?next=%2Fquotes%3Fopen%3Dabc`, encodes path + every query param, never a `//`/backslash next; `afterCodeTarget(redirectTo, next)` → next over `/dashboard?welcome=back`, `/welcome` beats next, unsafe/absent next keeps the landing) · integration `front-end/lib/login-redirect.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1153 …": the real 18 gates in a Fresh `App`, /me answered in process; no cookie / a stale cookie → 302 `/login?next=<page>`; a live session on /quotes?open=abc → 200) · e2e `e2e/login-next-deeplink/login-next-deeplink.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1153 …": an onboarded owner with a sent quote signs out (POST /api/auth/logout), opens `/quotes?open=<id>` → /login?next=…, phone + 000000 → ends on that quote with its badge "Sent"; and from `/login?next=/quotes?open=<id>` directly, the code ends on that quote, not /dashboard).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-82 at 0a71387e):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/login-redirect.int.test.ts lib/login-redirect.test.ts` → `FAILED | 1 passed | 9 failed` (every gate: `dashboard: /dashboard → 302 / (want 302 /login?next=%2Fdashboard)`, `quotes: /quotes?open=abc → 302 / (want 302 /login?next=%2Fquotes%3Fopen%3Dabc)` … `demo: /demo/stage?lang=en → 302 /`; unit: `front-end/lib/login-redirect.ts (loginRedirect + afterCodeTarget) does not exist yet`; the live-session pass-through is the 1 passing); `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> shots run e2e/login-next-deeplink -- --no-check` (server started first on PORT=58730; the runner's own serve started stories before the backend was up → `backend_unreachable`) → `✗ … expectation failed: a logged-out deep link goes to /login, not the marketing home (landed on /) — expected "/login", got "/"` and `✗ … expectation failed: after the code she is back on the quote she asked for (ended on /dashboard?welcome=back)`.
**Fix (fix/q3-q3-82):** new `front-end/lib/login-redirect.ts` — `safeNext` (REQ-879's site-path rule: a path on this site, never `//`, a backslash or /login|/verify), `loginHref`, `loginRedirect(url)` (302 `/login?next=<path+search>`, or plain `/login` when the path is not a safe site path) and `afterCodeTarget(redirectTo, next)` (next replaces only the plain `/dashboard` landing; `/welcome` and any other landing win). Every authed `_middleware.ts` (accounts-manager, admin, assistant, clients — re-exported by customers/field/hr/admins — communications, contracts, dashboard, demo, invoices, messages, payments, quotes, reports, settings, tools, wo, work-orders) and `routes/welcome.tsx` return `loginRedirect(new URL(ctx.req.url))` for no session. `islands/LoginForm.tsx` carries a safe `?next=` to `/verify?…&next=`; `routes/verify.tsx` sends a signed-in visitor to `rejoinTarget(search)` (next, else /dashboard), passes `next` to CodeInput and keeps it on the "Edit" link back to /login; `islands/CodeInput.tsx` goes to `afterCodeTarget(redirectTo, next)` after the code and after recover/start-fresh. Sign-out (REQ-907) and /verify's missing-phone redirect are unchanged.
**Neighbouring tests reconciled (they pinned the old bare "/" or the old source shape; no behaviour they guard changed otherwise):** `front-end/lib/admin-gate.int.test.ts` REQ-376 "no session" → `/login?next=%2Fadmin` (as this entry's requirement says); `front-end/lib/demo-stage-lang.int.test.ts` REQ-812 "no session" → `/login?next=%2Fdemo%2Fstage`; `jest/unit/phone-page.test.ts` REQ-915a gate wiring now looks for `loginRedirect(new URL(ctx.req.url))`; `jest/unit/demo-login-forgets-carry.test.ts` REQ-821 wiring regex now allows `afterCodeTarget(result.redirectTo, nextPage)` / `afterCodeTarget(res.redirectTo, nextPage)` (forgetDemo still runs before every redirect).
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-82):** `cd front-end && deno test -A --no-check lib/login-redirect.int.test.ts lib/login-redirect.test.ts lib/verify-edit-href.test.ts lib/demo-stage-lang.int.test.ts` → `ok | 22 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --no-check lib/admin-gate.int.test.ts` → the REQ-376/1153 no-session case passes; its 4 impersonation-interstitial cases (REQ-376 ×2, REQ-855, REQ-863) fail identically at HEAD ad6673a2 with the old middleware and test (`6 passed | 4 failed`), so they are pre-existing and unrelated; `deno lint` + `deno check` on the 25 touched front-end files → clean (`Checked 25 files`); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → `Test Suites: 679 passed` after the two wiring reconciliations (`phone-page`, `demo-login-forgets-carry` PASS, 11 tests); e2e: `PORT=58730 deno task serve` then `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:58730 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/login-next-deeplink -- --no-check` → `✓ … /login?next=/quotes?open=<id> carries next through /verify … · 16.1s`, `✓ … signed out, the owner opens an alert's /quotes?open=<id> … · 16.6s` — `2 pass · 0 fail`.

## REQ-1151 — AMENDMENT of REQ-972: the onboarding insurance step's "why" line promises only what the step does (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-83)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-83** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Wizard insurance step promises attaching proof but has no upload" — /welcome's insurance step shows only the "Insurance provider" and "Policy number (optional)" boxes; the upload is only in Settings.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `welcome.insurance.why` (lang/en.json "Lets you attach proof of insurance to your quotes. …", lang/es.json "Te permite adjuntar comprobante de seguro a tus cotizaciones. …"; copy from 69a72236, reworded by REQ-972 which only swapped "bids" → "quotes") is shown by `InsuranceStep` in `front-end/islands/WelcomeWizard.tsx`, which renders only two text inputs (provider, policyNumber) saved through `profileClient.updateInsurance` — no file input. The certificate upload (`insuranceFileId`) exists only in Settings (`InsuranceEditCard`, `front-end/islands/SettingsPage.tsx`), and no quote surface (quote PDF, /q, quote email) reads any insurance data; `backend/src/paperwork/public-controller/mod.ts` only notes that private insurance fields are not exposed. So the line promises a capability neither the step nor the quote pipeline provides.

**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/loop7-q3-83-insurance-step-why.test.ts` ("REQ-1151 en/es …": reads `welcome.insurance.why` from lang/en.json + lang/es.json and, when InsuranceStep's source has no `type="file"` input, rejects /attach/i and /adjuntar/i) · int n/a — front-end copy only; no backend behaviour is involved (option B, an upload in the step plus the COI on quotes, would need a paperwork int test) · e2e `e2e/welcome-insurance-why/welcome-insurance-why.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1151 q3-83 … (en)/(es)": new account, every question but insurance answered through the API, code in → /welcome insurance step; with no `input[type=file]` on the step, `p.welcome__why` must not promise attaching proof). The fixer must keep REQ-972's `jest/unit/quote-terminology.test.ts` (it pins "quotes"/"cotizaciones" in this string) green or amend it.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-83 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern loop7-q3-83` → `Tests: 2 failed, 2 total` (`Expected pattern: not /attach/i  Received string: "Lets you attach proof of insurance to your quotes. …"`; `Expected pattern: not /adjuntar/i  Received string: "Te permite adjuntar comprobante de seguro a tus cotizaciones. …"`); `SHOTS_JOBS=2 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/welcome-insurance-why -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1151 … (en) … expectation failed: … must not promise attaching proof of insurance (got "Lets you attach proof of insurance to your quotes. …")`, `✗ REQ-1151 … (es) … (got "Te permite adjuntar comprobante de seguro a tus cotizaciones. …")`.
**Fix (option A, copy only):** `welcome.insurance.why` now states only what is true. en: "Customers often ask who insures you before they accept your quotes. Add your insurer now; you can upload your certificate (COI) anytime in Settings. Skip it for now and we'll ask again next time — your dashboard keeps it on your setup list." es: "Los clientes suelen preguntar quién te asegura antes de aceptar tus cotizaciones. Agrega tu aseguradora ahora; puedes subir tu certificado de seguro (COI) cuando quieras en Configuración. Si lo saltas ahora, …". ## REQ-1152 — A repeat visit's address becomes the customer's when they had none (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-84, q3-85; REQ-340's rule carried to POST /field/subscriptions)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issues, cycle 3: **q3-84** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION] "Customer card says 'No address on file' although its repeat visit has a service address"; **q3-85** [minor/MISSING_IN_FLOW] "Add task leaves Address blank for a customer with a known address (New work order fills it)".
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** on New repeat visit (`front-end/islands/FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx`) the customer box sits above Address, so '+ Add "Grace Whitfield" as a customer' is clicked first and `createCustomer` POSTs her with `form.address.trim() || undefined` — empty. The address typed afterwards goes only to `fieldClient.createSubscription`; the controller's subscription `create` (`backend/src/field/entrypoints/field-controllers/mod.ts`, @Controller field/subscriptions @Post) checks the customer with `getOwned` and stores/geocodes the address on the subscription only. Unlike POST /field/tasks (REQ-340: `if (typed && !customer.address?.trim()) customers.update(…, { address: typed })`) it never writes the address back, so the customer record has none: the card prints `clientsDisplay.address.none` ("No address on file") beside the visit's own address, and Add task (`FieldTasksPage.tsx`, prefilled via `knownServiceAddress`, which uses only the customer's address or an ACTIVE visit — REQ-1007) is blank once the visit is paused or the page loaded before the visit existed. Introduced by 7610e2d3 (REQ-1068), which copied REQ-283's inline create but not REQ-340's write-back. The island also never mirrors the address onto its local customer row after the save (`reload()` refetches subscriptions only).
**Requirement:** when a repeat visit is saved with an address for a customer who has no address on file, that address becomes the customer's (whatever order the form was filled in); a customer who already has an address keeps it. The customer card then shows the address, and Add task prefills it.
**Tests:** int `backend/src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1152 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-84) a repeat visit's address becomes the customer's when they had none; a customer with one keeps it") · unit `jest/unit/subs-create-customer.test.ts` ("REQ-1152: after createSubscription, setCustomers fills the address of a customer who had none") · e2e `e2e/subs-create-customer/subs-create-customer.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1152 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-84, q3-85): New repeat visit — a customer added before the address is typed gets the visit's address; her card has it and Add task prefills it": create row clicked, then address typed, Save; GET /api/customers/:id, pause the visit, /customers?open=<id> client sheet, /field/tasks Add task tk-add-address).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-84 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts --filter REQ-1152` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed` (`the customer now has the repeat visit's address on file … - undefined + "2101 Kinney Ave, Austin, TX 78704"`); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern subs-create-customer` → `Tests: 1 failed, 3 passed` (`expect(after).toMatch(/setCustomers\(/)`); `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:6917 shots run e2e/subs-create-customer -- --no-check` (own `PORT=6917 deno task serve`) → `✗ REQ-1152 … expectation failed: GET /api/customers/:id carries the visit's address ({"api":null,"sheetSaysNone":true,"taskAddress":""}) — expected "2101 Kinney Ave, Austin, TX 78704", got undefined`.
**Fix:** `POST /field/subscriptions` (backend/src/field/entrypoints/field-controllers/mod.ts, `FieldSubscriptionsController.create`) keeps the customer from `getOwned` and, after storing the visit, writes the visit's address onto that customer when `!customer.address?.trim()` — the REQ-340 rule of `POST /field/tasks`, so it holds whatever order the form was filled in; a customer with an address keeps it. `PUT /field/subscriptions/:id` applies the same rule when an address is sent (a deleted customer is left alone; the visit still saves). Front end: FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx `submit` mirrors the saved address onto its local `customers` row when it was empty (as FieldTasksPage does for REQ-340), so the next form prefills it without a reload. With the customer carrying the address, the client sheet no longer says "No address on file" and Add task's `knownServiceAddress` prefills it even after the visit is paused (q3-85) — REQ-1007's "a paused visit is not used" rule is unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-84):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/field/entrypoints/field.int.test.ts` → `ok | 41 passed | 0 failed (4m22s)` (incl. REQ-1152 and REQ-340); `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'subs-create-customer|field-subscription|subscriptions'` → `Tests: 4 passed, 4 total`; `deno lint` + `deno check` on FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx (front-end) and field-controllers/mod.ts (backend) → clean; `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:6923 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/subs-create-customer -- --no-check` (own `PORT=6923 KV_PATH=<fresh> deno task serve`, host load ~150) → `✓ REQ-1152 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-84, q3-85): New repeat visit — … her card has it and Add task prefills it · 354.2s`, `tests finished rc 0`.

## REQ-1154 — AMENDMENT of REQ-944: the HR hire page prints every instant in the business's time zone (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-86)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-86** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "HR hire page prints times in UTC" — for an Austin business, /worker and /field/timesheet showed the 6:30 AM clock-in, while /hr/hires/<id> two minutes later read "Sent Nov 19 · 12:33 PM" (QA's browser was in UTC).
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `front-end/lib/hr.ts` `fmtWhen(iso, lang)` (introduced with REQ-883..889 in a12a9135) formats with `toLocaleDateString` / `toLocaleTimeString` and no `timeZone`, so it prints the browser's zone. `HrHireDetailPage` loads the hire client-side (useEffect → /api/hr/*) and prints mail.sentAt / openedAt / remindedAt / tokenExpiresAt, document doneAt, arm times and the signing-proof time through it; `front-end/routes/hr/hires/[id].tsx` renders `<HrHireDetailPage id={id} />` and never passes `user.businessTimezone`, although GET /me carries it (REQ-944) and `routes/field/timesheet.tsx` already passes `timeZone={user?.businessTimezone}`. REQ-944's fix threaded the zone through the document, chat, phone and greeting paths but missed lib/hr.ts.
**Requirement:** every instant /hr/hires/<id> prints (Sent, Opened, Reminded, Expires, document done, arm times, signing proof) is that instant's date and time on the business's wall clock, whatever zone the browser is in — the same clock /worker and /field/timesheet use (en + es).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/hr-fmtwhen-business-tz.test.ts` ("REQ-1154 …": `fmtWhen("2026-11-19T12:33:00Z", "en", "America/Chicago")` → "Nov 19 · 6:33 AM"; the es form is the Central clock; 00:30Z Nov 20 is "Nov 19 · 6:30 PM"; the [id] route passes `timeZone={user?.businessTimezone}`; every `fmtWhen` call in HrHireDetailPage passes a zone) · integration n/a — front-end formatting only; GET /me already carries businessTimezone (REQ-944) · e2e `e2e/hr-hire-business-tz/hr-hire-business-tz.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1154 …": a Central business sends a hire over the API, the browser is put in UTC via CDP, /hr/hires/<id>'s "Sent …" line must equal the send instant on the Central clock).
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-86 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern hr-fmtwhen-business-tz` → `Tests: 5 failed, 1 passed, 6 total` (`Expected: "Nov 19 · 6:33 AM" Received: "Nov 19 · 7:33 AM"` — the host's New York clock; `Expected: "19 nov · 6:33 a.m." Received: "19 nov · 7:33 a.m."`; `Expected: "Nov 19 · 6:30 PM" Received: "Nov 19 · 7:30 PM"`; the route has `<HrHireDetailPage id={id} />`; 8 zone-less calls `fmtWhen(h.mail.sentAt, lang)` …); `BASE_URL=<own serve> shots run e2e/hr-hire-business-tz -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1154 … expectation failed: the hire page prints the UTC clock: "Sent Nov 19 · 1:33 PM" (UTC "Nov 19 · 1:33 PM", business "Nov 19 · 7:33 AM")`.
**Fix:** `fmtWhen(iso, lang, timeZone?)` in `front-end/lib/hr.ts` passes `{ timeZone }` to BOTH `toLocaleDateString` and `toLocaleTimeString` (the day follows the zone too); `routes/hr/hires/[id].tsx` passes `timeZone={user?.businessTimezone}` to `HrHireDetailPage`, which threads it into all 8 `fmtWhen` calls. `fmtDate` (bare YYYY-MM-DD) is unchanged. No other HR island (HrHiresPage, HrOverviewPage, HrNewHirePage) or the public /sign page formats an instant, so nothing else needed the zone.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-86):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern hr-fmtwhen-business-tz` → `Tests: 6 passed, 6 total`; neighbours `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'hr-module|hr-fmtwhen-business-tz'` → `Test Suites: 2 passed, 2 total · Tests: 11 passed, 11 total`; `cd front-end && deno lint lib/hr.ts islands/HrHireDetailPage.tsx "routes/hr/hires/[id].tsx"` → `Checked 3 files`; `deno check` on the same three → clean; `PORT=23563 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:23563 shots run e2e/hr-hire-business-tz -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1154 (LOOP-007 q3, q3-86): with the browser in UTC and the business in Central, /hr/hires/<id> prints 'Sent …' on the business's clock, not UTC · 19.2s`.

## REQ-1155 — /sign/:token counts one document in the singular: "1 documento" / "1 document" (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-87)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-87** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Spanish signing page says '1 documentos'" — a hire whose Field crew packet holds one document reads "Equipo de Field crew · 1 documentos" on /sign/<token> (English shows "1 documents").
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `front-end/islands/HrSignPacket.tsx` renders `· {t("hr.sign.docsCount", { n: total })}` (total = `docs.length`) with no singular/plural choice, and the key has only a plural form: `lang/es.json` "{n} documentos", `lang/en.json` "{n} documents". `t()` in `front-end/lib/i18n.ts` only fills {placeholders}; the house convention is for the call site to pick `<key>.one` / `<key>.other` (REQ-744, `asstChat.payment.hintDays.one/other`). Introduced with the HR module, a12a9135 (REQ-883..889).
**Requirement:** the /sign intro line reads "· 1 documento" (es) / "· 1 document" (en) for a one-document packet, and keeps the plural ("2 documentos" / "2 documents") for more; en and es both carry `hr.sign.docsCount.one` and `.other`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/hr-sign-docs-count-plural.test.ts` ("REQ-1155 …": evaluates the key expression HrSignPacket passes to t() for n=1/2/5 and fills it from lang/en.json + lang/es.json; asserts "1 documento", "1 document", "2 documentos", "2 documents", and the .one/.other keys in both dictionaries) · int n/a — purely front-end string selection, no backend involved · e2e `e2e/hr-sign-docs-count/hr-sign-docs-count.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1155 …": owner creates a one-document department + hire, opens /sign/<token>?lang=es and ?lang=en, the card reads "· 1 documento" / "· 1 document" with no plural; a two-document packet keeps "· 2 documentos").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-87 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/hr-sign-docs-count-plural.test.ts` → `Tests: 3 failed` (`Expected: "1 documento" Received: "1 documentos"`; `Expected: "1 document" Received: "1 documents"`; `hr.sign.docsCount.one` → `Received: undefined`); `BASE_URL=<own serve> shots run e2e/hr-sign-docs-count -- --no-check` → `✗ … in en … expectation failed: REQ-1155: no plural noun for one document — card text: …Field crew team · 1 documents…`, `✗ … in es … card text: …Equipo de Field crew · 1 documentos…`, `✓ … two-document packet … '· 2 documentos'`.
**Fix:** `hr.sign.docsCount` split into `hr.sign.docsCount.one` ("{n} document" / "{n} documento") and `.other` ("{n} documents" / "{n} documentos") in lang/en.json + lang/es.json (in place, before the trailing comms.a2p.* keys); `front-end/islands/HrSignPacket.tsx` calls ``t(`hr.sign.docsCount.${total === 1 ? "one" : "other"}`, { n: total })`` — the house `.one`/`.other` convention. The same plural-only bug from a12a9135 was fixed in the sibling owner-side counters: `hr.depts.nDocs` / `hr.depts.nSystems` (HrDepartmentsPage, "1 docs" / "1 systems" / "1 sistemas") and `hr.docs.card.fields` (HrDocumentsPage, "1 fields" / "1 campos") now pick `.one`/`.other` the same way. `hr.settings.days` left alone (only 3/7/14/30 are offered); `hr.sign.step` / `hr.hires.progressOf` are "N of M", no noun.
**Test fix:** the unit test's regex for the t() call required `{ n: total }` with no trailing comma, so it rejected deno fmt's canonical wrapping of the same call (`{\n  n: total,\n}`). It now accepts an optional trailing comma inside the object and after it (`,?`); the key evaluation and every assertion are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-87):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/hr-sign-docs-count-plural.test.ts` → `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total · Tests: 1 skipped, 6535 passed, 6536 total` (the whole unit project ran, lang-parity / REQ-920 last-key tests included); `PORT=57811 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:57811 shots run e2e/hr-sign-docs-count -- --no-check` → `✓ … one-document packet on /sign in en reads "· 1 document"`, `✓ … in es reads "· 1 documento"`, `✓ … two-document packet … '· 2 documentos'` (3 pass · 0 fail); neighbour `shots run e2e/hr-onboarding …` → `✓ REQ-883..889: document → system → department → new hire → … ` (its "2 docs" / "2 systems" checks hold) and `✓ REQ-1034 (q2-18)`; `cd front-end && deno check` on the three islands → clean; `deno lint` → only the pre-existing `react-no-danger` at HrSignPacket.tsx:225 (present at HEAD, untouched).

## REQ-1156 — AMENDMENT of REQ-885/REQ-888: a hire in a department with no systems is never promised accounts (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-88)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-88** [minor/BUG_CONTRADICTION], cycle 3: "Finished-signing screen promises accounts the department doesn't have" — department "Field crew" has no systems, yet the hire's done screen reads "{company} tendrá tus cuentas listas antes del primer día" and the owner's hire page shows "Create accounts" above "No systems for this department."
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** both screens ignore whether the hire has anything to provision. (1) Hire side: `front-end/islands/HrSignPacket.tsx` (done screen, ~:294) always renders `hr.sign.done.body` ("…will have your accounts ready before Day 1" / "…tendrá tus cuentas listas antes del primer día"), and it cannot do otherwise because the `GET /hr/sign/:token` packet (`backend/src/hr/entrypoints/hr-controllers/mod.ts` ~:978-986; `SignPacket` in `front-end/clients/hr.ts`) carries no systems/accounts information. (2) Owner side: `front-end/islands/HrHireDetailPage.tsx:88` `canProvision` depends on status only and :291 renders the `hr-provision` "Create accounts" button on `canProvision && !closed`, never checking `h.systemIds`, while :304 prints "No systems for this department." in the same panel. An empty plan creates nothing — `aggregateProvisioning([])` is `active` at once (REQ-888(c), deliberate) — so the copy and the button contradict the rule. Both came in with a12a9135 (REQ-883..889).
**Requirement:** (a) `GET /hr/sign/:token` reports `accounts`, the number of accounts the hire's provisioning plan will create (0 for a department with no systems). (b) With `accounts === 0` the done screen makes no promise of accounts, in English or Spanish. (c) The owner's hire page offers no "Create accounts" (`data-cy=hr-provision`) button when the hire has no systems; "No systems for this department." stays.
**Tests:** unit n/a — the defect is a missing packet field and two islands' render branches; no pure function carries the decision today (the fixer may add one, e.g. a done-copy selector, with its own unit test) · integration `backend/src/hr/entrypoints/hr-sign-accounts.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1156 (LOOP-007 q3-88): GET /hr/sign/:token for a department with no systems reports accounts 0", "… with one system reports accounts 1") · e2e `e2e/hr-done-no-accounts/hr-done-no-accounts.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1156 (LOOP-007 q3-88): signing a no-systems packet in Spanish — the done screen never promises accounts ('cuentas')", "REQ-1156 (LOOP-007 q3-88): a signed no-systems hire's Accounts panel says 'No systems for this department.' with no 'Create accounts' button").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-88 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/entrypoints/hr-sign-accounts.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`the sign packet says how many accounts are coming (0 here), got undefined — keys: firstName,departmentName,companyName,lang,status,progress,docs`; `one connected system → accounts 1, got undefined`); `BASE_URL=http://localhost:47731 shots run e2e/hr-done-no-accounts -- --no-check` (own `PORT=47731 deno task serve`; the self-served lane reported backend_unreachable because the backend took ~138 s to boot under host load) → `✗ … the done screen promises no accounts for a no-systems department — got "Todo listo¡Ya eres oficialmente parte del equipo!Tus documentos están listos. Monster Reservations Group tendrá tus cuentas listas antes del primer día." — expected false, got true`; `✗ … no 'Create accounts' button (data-cy=hr-provision) beside 'No systems for this department.' — expected 0, got 1`.
**Fix (fix/q3-q3-88):** `Provisioner.plan` is now public and `GET /hr/sign/:token` returns `accounts: (await provisioner.plan(h)).length` — the same plan a run builds (the department's connected systems, else the hire's snapshot), so the count can never disagree with what provisioning does; `SignPacket.accounts` added in `front-end/clients/hr.ts`. Done screen: `HrSignPacket.tsx` renders `t(signDoneKey(p?.accounts))` — new pure helper in `front-end/lib/hr.ts`; 0 (or missing) → new key `hr.sign.done.bodyNoAccounts` ("Your paperwork is in. {company} will see you on Day 1." / "Tus documentos están listos. {company} te espera el primer día."). Owner page: `HrHireDetailPage.tsx` replaces the status-only `canProvision` with `accountsAction(h)` (also in `lib/hr.ts`): systems → "Create accounts" (`hr-provision`); no systems and status `signed` → a "Mark ready" button (`data-cy=hr-finish`, `hr.detail.markReady`) that calls the same provision endpoint, whose empty plan goes straight to `active` per REQ-888(c) — so a no-systems hire is never stranded at `signed` when auto-provision is off; no systems and already provisioning/active → no action. Unit test added: `jest/unit/hr-done-no-accounts.test.ts` ("REQ-1156 signDoneKey …", "REQ-1156 the no-accounts copy exists in both languages and never mentions accounts", "REQ-1156 accountsAction …").
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-88):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/entrypoints/hr-sign-accounts.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/` (neighbours: onboarding, hr-notices, hr.int, hr-empty-packet, hr-email-sender, systems-controller) → `ok | 33 passed | 0 failed`; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --runTestsByPath unit/hr-done-no-accounts.test.ts unit/hr-module.test.ts unit/hr-dept-no-division.test.ts` → `Tests: 11 passed, 11 total` (the whole unit project also ran: `Test Suites: 680 passed, 680 total`); `PORT=47761 deno task serve` + `BASE_URL=http://localhost:47761 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/hr-done-no-accounts -- --no-check` → `✓ … signing a no-systems packet in Spanish — the done screen never promises accounts ('cuentas')`, `✓ … a signed no-systems hire's Accounts panel says 'No systems for this department.' with no 'Create accounts' button`; `cd front-end && deno check` on the 4 touched front-end files → clean; `deno lint` → only the pre-existing `react-no-danger` at HrSignPacket.tsx:222 (untouched line); lang/en.json + lang/es.json valid JSON, 6463 keys each, last key still `comms.a2p.sys.house`.

## REQ-1157 — LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-89: the HR signing link carries the language its text/email was written in
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-89** [minor/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "HR signing link has no ?lang, so it opens in the phone's last-used language" — the texts went out in English, but the page opened in Spanish.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** `HrNotices.signUrl(token)` (`backend/src/hr/domain/coordinators/hr-notices/mod.ts`) builds `${appUrl()}/sign/${token}` with no language. `sendLink()` writes the SMS and the email in the owner's language (`users.language`, via `HrNotices.lang()`) but puts that bare URL in both, for the invite, the 24-hour reminder and the resend; the hire-detail API (`backend/src/hr/entrypoints/hr-controllers/mod.ts` `view()`) hands the same bare `signUrl` to the owner's Copy/Open link and SMS preview. `/sign/[token]` picks `?lang=` first, then the `pm_lang` cookie, then "es" — so the page opens in the phone's last-used DocuMonster language, or Spanish on a fresh phone, whatever language the message was in. In the HR module since its first commit a12a9135 (REQ-883..889). Every other outbound link (worker REQ-285, login REQ-1061, invoice/change order REQ-342) already carries `?lang=`.
**Requirement:** the HR signing link — in the invite text, the invite email, the 24-hour reminder (text + email) and the hire file's `signUrl` — is `/sign/<token>?lang=<lang>`, where `<lang>` is the language the message was written in (the owner's, en|es). Opened on a phone whose `pm_lang` cookie says otherwise, /sign shows the message's language.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/hr/domain/coordinators/hr-notices/test.ts` ("REQ-1157 (q3-89) sendLink invite|reminder from a 'en'|'es' owner links /sign/<token>?lang=… in the text and the email": HrNotices with stub stores, captures the SmsService/EmailService payloads) · int `backend/src/hr/entrypoints/hr-sign-link-lang.int.test.ts` ("REQ-1157 (q3-89) a 'en'|'es' owner's new hire: the text, the email and GET /hr/hires/:id signUrl all link /sign/<token>?lang=…": bootstrapServer + KV :memory:, POST /hr/hires with autoSend) · e2e `e2e/hr-sign-link-lang/hr-sign-link-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1157 (LOOP-007 q3-89): an English owner's signing link opens /sign in English on a phone whose pm_lang cookie is es": English owner adds a hire over the API, opens the hire file's signUrl with no session and `pm_lang=es`, expects `<html lang="en">` and "Hi Rosa!").
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-89 at 0a71387e):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/domain/coordinators/hr-notices/test.ts` → `FAILED | 8 passed | 4 failed` (`Expected actual: "Hey Rosa! 🐋 Welcome to Reyes Lawn & Pool. … http://localhost:5280/sign/TOK123" to contain: "/sign/TOK123?lang=en"`, same for the reminder and both es cases); `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/entrypoints/hr-sign-link-lang.int.test.ts` → `FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed` (`sms link=http://localhost:5280/sign/<token> · email link=…/sign/<token> · signUrl=…/sign/<token>`, `{sms,emailHref,signUrl}: false` vs `true`); `SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/hr-sign-link-lang -- --no-check` → `✗ … expectation failed: the English text's link opened /sign in "es" (link http://localhost:59318/sign/4kry3LJ6atHcGjTGaCf0tQ; title "Firma tus documentos de ingreso")`.
**Fix:** `HrNotices.signUrl(token, lang)` now returns `${appUrl()}/sign/${token}?lang=${lang}`; `sendLink()` builds the URL from the same `lang` it writes the text and the email in, so the invite, the 24-hour reminder and the resend all carry it. The owner's language is one exported helper, `ownerLang(user)` (users.language, English unless "es"), used by `HrNotices.lang()` and by the hire controllers' `view(d, h, lang)`, so every hire-file response's `signUrl` (Copy/Open link + SMS preview on /hr/hires/:id) matches what was sent. `front-end/routes/sign/[token].tsx`'s header comment now states the real precedence (?lang, then pm_lang, then es). `e2e/hr-onboarding` read the token as everything after `/sign/`; with the link now carrying `?lang=en` it takes the path segment only (`split("?")[0]`) — the story's assertions are unchanged.
**Evidence GREEN (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-89):** `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/domain/coordinators/hr-notices/test.ts` → `ok | 12 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/entrypoints/hr-sign-link-lang.int.test.ts` → `ok | 2 passed | 0 failed`; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/hr/` → `ok | 37 passed | 0 failed (4m39s)`; `deno check` + `deno lint` on both backend files and `deno lint routes/sign/[token].tsx` clean; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/hr-module.test.ts` → `Tests: 1 skipped, 6531 passed, 6532 total`; `BASE_URL=http://localhost:56390 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=…/playwright-core/1.64.1 shots run e2e/hr-onboarding e2e/hr-sign-link-lang -- --no-check` → `✓ REQ-1157 (LOOP-007 q3-89) … 29.3s`, `✓ REQ-1034 (q2-18) …`; REQ-883..889 hit a 90 s screenshot timeout before the hire step at load average ~100, and re-run alone → `✓ REQ-883..889: document → system → department → new hire → the phone signs … · 458.5s`.

## REQ-1158 — REVISION of REQ-884 (b): the new-hire text, the /sign greeting and the /sign brand slot carry no whale emoji (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-90)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-90** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "New-hire text uses a whale emoji" — the 004-sms to Rosa read "Hey Rosa! 🐋 Welcome to Reyes Lawn & Pool…", which reads oddly coming from a lawn/pool business.

## REQ-1159 — AMENDMENT of REQ-921/REQ-979: /field/tasks → Add task's Service box is the service picker that offers `+ Add "<name>" as a service` (LOOP-007 cycle 3, q3-91)
**Source:** Raphael (LOOP-007): "test every single aspect of this application … one Opus agent per issue to do root cause analysis, then one to write the test, then one to fix it and make it green". QA issue **q3-91** [polish/BUG_POLISH], cycle 3: "Add task Service box has no '+ Add as a service' option" — on /field/tasks → Add task, typing "Leaf cleanup" in Service shows no dropdown, while the repeat-visit form shows `+ Add "Lawn mowing" as a service`. Saving still worked.
**Root cause (at 0a71387e):** Add task's Service field (`front-end/islands/FieldTasksPage.tsx`, `data-cy="tk-add-type"`) is still the REQ-163 control from 7d93e0ec: `<input type="text" list="tk-types">` over a native `<datalist id="tk-types">` of the task types. A datalist only lists options that match the typed text, so a new name like "Leaf cleanup" shows nothing — there is no create row. On save `submitAdd` sends `taskTypeName` as free text, the backend's `findOrCreateTaskType` (`backend/src/field/entrypoints/field-controllers/mod.ts`) quietly creates the catalogue service, and the island appends it to `types`. REQ-921 (c) and REQ-979 moved New invoice, edit invoice and the repeat-visit form to `ServiceSelect` (`front-end/components/ServiceSelect.tsx`, SearchSelect + `onCreate` → `serviceLines.create`), but Add task was never in their scope, so it was never migrated. The card's "Add service" form (`tk-service-type`) uses the same datalist and has the same gap.
**Requirement:** on /field/tasks → Add task, the Service box is the house service picker (`ServiceSelect`) over the account's services; a typed name that matches no service offers `+ Add "<name>" as a service`; clicking it creates the service in the catalogue (POST /api/field/task-types) and picks it; the task then saves billing that service at the entered price.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/field-add-task-service-select.test.ts` ("REQ-1159 …": source pin — `tk-add-type` is a `<ServiceSelect` with `onCreate=` calling `createTaskType(`, and no longer `list="tk-types"`) · int n/a — the backend already creates the type from a name and POST /api/field/task-types has its own int tests; the defect is the front-end control · e2e `e2e/field-add-task-service/field-add-task-service.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-1159 (LOOP-007 q3-91) …": sign in, customer + worker via API, /field/tasks → Add task, pick the customer, type "Leaf cleanup" in the Service picker, expect the create row `+ Add "Leaf cleanup" as a service`, click it, GET /api/field/task-types lists it and the box shows it, price 85 + worker, save → POST /api/field/tasks ok and the one-off card shows "Leaf cleanup" / "$85.00"). The fixer must also update the existing `e2e/field-tasks` stories that `fill` `tk-add-type` to type and pick in the picker.
**Evidence RED (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-91 at 0a71387e):** `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/field-add-task-service-select.test.ts` → `Tests: 3 failed` (`expect(received).toBe(expected) Expected: true Received: false` for `startsWith("<ServiceSelect")`; `Expected: >= 0 Received: -1` for the `<ServiceSelect` before tk-add-type; `Expected pattern: not /list="tk-types"/`); `SHOTS_DIR=<own dir> SHOTS_SERVE_TIMEOUT=300000 SHOTS_PLAYWRIGHT=… shots run e2e/field-add-task-service -- --no-check` → `✗ REQ-1159 (LOOP-007 q3-91) … expectation failed: the Add task Service box is a search picker (search-select-input), like the repeat-visit form — expected 1, got 0`.
**Fix (2026-11-19, fix/q3-q3-91):** both Service boxes on /field/tasks — Add task (`tk-add-type`) and the card's Add service (`tk-service-type`) — are now `ServiceSelect` over the page's `types`, with `onCreate` → `fieldClient.createTaskType({ name })`. The new service is merged into `types` and picked (`adoptService`), the same as the repeat-visit form. The native `<datalist id="tk-types">` is gone. `AddForm` and the service draft carry the picked `typeId` plus its `typeName`, so `addTaskProblem`, the createTask / addTaskService payloads (`taskTypeName`) and REQ-415's `serviceHint` placeholder stay as they were. `ServiceSelect` takes an optional `placeholder` (REQ-415's account-own example) and `invalid` (REQ-283's aria-invalid on Service) and passes both to SearchSelect. Scope decision: the card's Add service form moved too (it had the same datalist and the same gap). The worker's on-site add-service (REQ-164 worker side) and /field/checklists stay out of scope, as REQ-921's Decision says.
**Neighbouring tests updated (the control changed, the intent did not):** `jest/unit/field-add-task-customer.test.ts` (REQ-283) pinned `aria-invalid={addBad === "type"` on the old input. It now pins `invalid={addBad === "type"` and checks that ServiceSelect forwards `invalid={invalid}` to SearchSelect, the same form as its customer-box line. `e2e/field-tasks` (REQ-164/165/283/340/415/521/526) and `e2e/field-multi-day-job` (REQ-785) used to `fill` the text input. They now type and pick through the new `pickOrAddService` in `e2e/_shared/service-lines.ts` (picks the matching row, or `+ Add "<name>" as a service`), and REQ-415/521 read the placeholder / aria-invalid from the picker's `search-select-input`.
